title: RFS: Reinforcement learning with Residual flow steering for dexterous manipulation
abstract: Imitation learning has emerged as an effective approach for bootstrapping sequential decision-making in robotics, achieving strong performance even in high-dimensional dexterous manipulation tasks. Recent behavior cloning methods further leverage expressive generative models, such as diffusion models and flow matching, to represent multimodal action distributions. However, policies pretrained in this manner often exhibit limited generalization and require additional fine-tuning to achieve robust performance at deployment time. Such adaptation must preserve the global exploration benefits of pretraining while enabling rapid correction of local execution errors. We propose Residual Flow Steering (RFS), a data-efficient reinforcement learning framework for adapting pretrained generative policies. RFS steers a pretrained flow-matching policy by jointly optimizing a residual action and a latent noise distribution, enabling complementary forms of exploration: local refinement through residual corrections and global exploration through latent-space modulation. This design allows efficient adaptation while retaining the expressive structure of the pretrained policy. We demonstrate the effectiveness of RFS on dexterous manipulation tasks, showing efficient fine-tuning both in simulation and in real-world settings when adapting pretrained base policies. title_zh: RFS：面向灵巧操作的 Residual Flow Steering 强化学习
abstract_zh: 模仿学习已成为一种有效方法，可为机器人领域的序贯决策提供初始引导，即使在高维灵巧操作任务中也能取得出色表现。近期的行为克隆方法进一步利用扩散模型和 flow matching 等具有强表达能力的生成模型来表示多模态动作分布。然而，以这种方式预训练的策略往往泛化能力有限，需要额外微调才能在部署时获得稳健性能。此类适配必须保留预训练带来的全局探索优势，同时能够快速纠正局部执行错误。我们提出 Residual Flow Steering（RFS），这是一种数据高效的强化学习框架，用于适配预训练的生成式策略。RFS 通过联合优化残差动作和潜在噪声分布来引导预训练的 flow matching 策略，从而实现互补的探索形式：通过残差修正进行局部细化，以及通过潜在空间调制进行全局探索。该设计既能实现高效适配，又能保留预训练策略的表达结构。我们在灵巧操作任务上展示了 RFS 的有效性，表明在适配预训练基础策略时，无论是在仿真环境还是真实世界环境中都能实现高效微调。项目网站：https://weirdlabuw.github.io/rfs/

brief_zh.summary: 灵巧操作中的模仿学习常以扩散模型或流匹配策略表达多模态动作，但这类预训练策略在部署时泛化不足，直接微调又容易破坏其表达结构，难以同时保留全局探索能力并快速纠正局部执行误差。RFS 将预训练流匹配策略作为可引导的生成先验，在适配阶段联合优化残差动作与潜在噪声分布：残差项负责在执行附近做细粒度修正，潜在空间调制则提供更大范围的探索。两者共同作用于原策略的生成过程，而不是替换或重新参数化整张策略网络，因此能在数据有限时完成强化学习适配，并保留预训练学到的多模态行为结构。
brief_zh.method: 实验先在灵巧操作任务上用流匹配预训练基础策略，再在生成路径上训练残差动作头与潜在噪声调制模块。rollout 采集的状态、动作和奖励用于强化学习更新：残差项逐步修正预训练动作，噪声调制改变采样起点以探索不同模式。两类参数联合优化，原策略生成路径保持不变；仿真与真实平台沿用同一流程，真实端仅做少量在线交互。对照包括直接微调与仅加残差的变体。
brief_zh.driving: 自动驾驶可把预训练驾驶策略当作生成先验：用残差动作修正局部轨迹偏差，用潜在噪声调制探索不同驾驶模式，在少量闭环数据下适配新场景，并保留多模态决策。该思路适合轨迹规划、行为克隆后的在线强化学习及仿真到实车校准，也便于在残差层加入安全约束。

title: Sim-to-Real Reinforcement Learning for Vision-Based Dexterous Manipulation on Humanoids
abstract: Learning generalizable robot manipulation policies, especially for complex multi-fingered humanoids, remains a significant challenge. Existing approaches primarily rely on extensive data collection and imitation learning, which are expensive, labor-intensive, and difficult to scale. Sim-to-real reinforcement learning (RL) offers a promising alternative, but has mostly succeeded in simpler state-based or single-hand setups. How to effectively extend this to vision-based, contact-rich bimanual manipulation tasks remains an open question. In this paper, we introduce a practical sim-to-real RL recipe that trains a humanoid robot to perform three challenging dexterous manipulation tasks: grasp-and-reach, box lift and bimanual handover. Our method features an automated real-to-sim tuning module, a generalized reward formulation based on contact and object goals, a divide-and-conquer policy distillation framework, and a hybrid object representation strategy with modality-specific augmentation. We demonstrate high success rates on unseen objects and robust, adaptive policy behaviors – highlighting that vision-based dexterous manipulation via sim-to-real RL is not only viable, but also scalable and broadly applicable to real-world humanoid manipulation tasks.
title_zh: 用于人形机器人视觉灵巧操作的 Sim-to-Real 强化学习
abstract_zh: 学习可泛化的机器人操作策略，尤其是针对复杂的多指人形机器人，仍是一项重大挑战。现有方法主要依赖大规模数据采集和模仿学习，这些方法成本高昂、劳动密集且难以扩展。Sim-to-real 强化学习（RL）提供了一种有前景的替代方案，但主要在较简单的基于状态或单手设置中取得了成功。如何将其有效扩展到基于视觉、接触丰富的双手操作任务，仍是一个开放问题。本文提出一套实用的 sim-to-real RL 方案，训练人形机器人执行三项具有挑战性的灵巧操作任务：grasp-and-reach、box lift 和 bimanual handover。我们的方法包含一个自动化的 real-to-sim 调优模块、一种基于接触和物体目标的通用奖励公式、一个分治式策略蒸馏框架，以及一种结合模态特定增强的混合物体表示策略。我们在未见过的物体上展示了高成功率和稳健、自适应的策略行为，表明通过 sim-to-real RL 实现基于视觉的灵巧操作不仅可行，而且具有可扩展性，并可广泛适用于真实世界的人形机器人操作任务。

brief_zh.summary: 人形机器人视觉灵巧操作需要同时处理高维本体、接触丰富的双手协作和真实感知差异，现有工作多依赖昂贵且难以扩展的遥操作数据与模仿学习；sim-to-real 强化学习虽在状态输入或单手任务上有效，却尚未证明能扩展到基于视觉的双手操作。论文给出一套可落地的训练方案：自动校准真实与仿真之间的差异，用接触和物体目标构造通用奖励，以分治式策略蒸馏拆分复杂技能，并通过混合物体表示和模态特定增强提升视觉策略的泛化能力。其贡献不只是单项技巧，而是把仿真训练、真实对齐和视觉泛化串成完整流程。
brief_zh.method: 实验在仿真中搭建人形机器人双手操作环境，覆盖抓取伸展、箱体抬升和双手交接。先用自动 real-to-sim 模块根据真实观测校准动力学、接触与视觉参数；奖励由接触事件和物体目标共同构成，避免逐任务手写密集奖励。复杂任务采用分治式策略蒸馏，先训练子技能教师，再蒸馏为统一学生。视觉侧对物体采用混合表示，并对图像、本体状态分别增强。训练在仿真完成，再迁移到真实平台检验未见物体上的泛化。
brief_zh.driving: 这套流程可迁移到自动驾驶仿真训练与实车校准：real-to-sim 调参对应传感器、动力学和执行器标定；接触与目标式奖励可改写为车道保持、交互安全和任务完成奖励；分治蒸馏可把感知、预测、规划子技能整合为统一策略；模态增强与混合表示适合多传感器融合。

title: Maximum Entropy Reinforcement Learning with Diffusion Policy
abstract: The Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) algorithm with a Gaussian policy has become a mainstream implementation for realizing the Maximum Entropy Reinforcement Learning (MaxEnt RL) objective, which incorporates entropy maximization to encourage exploration and enhance policy robustness. While the Gaussian policy performs well on simpler tasks, its exploration capacity and potential performance in complex multi-goal RL environments are limited by its inherent unimodality. In this paper, we employ the diffusion model, a powerful generative model capable of capturing complex multimodal distributions, as the policy representation to fulfill the MaxEnt RL objective, developing a method named MaxEnt RL with Diffusion Policy (MaxEntDP). Our method enables efficient exploration and brings the policy closer to the optimal MaxEnt policy. Experimental results on Mujoco benchmarks show that MaxEntDP outperforms the Gaussian policy and other generative models within the MaxEnt RL framework, and performs comparably to other state-of-the-art diffusion-based online RL algorithms. Our code is available at https://github.com/diffusionyes/MaxEntDP.
title_zh: 基于 Diffusion Policy 的最大熵强化学习
abstract_zh: 采用高斯策略的 Soft Actor-Critic（SAC）算法已成为实现最大熵强化学习（MaxEnt RL）目标的主流实现，该目标通过引入熵最大化来鼓励探索并增强策略稳健性。尽管高斯策略在较简单的任务上表现良好，但其固有的单峰性限制了其在复杂多目标 RL 环境中的探索能力和潜在性能。本文将扩散模型——一种能够捕捉复杂多模态分布的强大生成模型——用作策略表示，以实现 MaxEnt RL 目标，并提出名为 MaxEnt RL with Diffusion Policy（MaxEntDP）的方法。我们的方法能够实现高效探索，并使策略更接近最优 MaxEnt 策略。在 Mujoco 基准上的实验结果表明，MaxEntDP 优于 MaxEnt RL 框架内的高斯策略和其他生成模型，并且与其他最先进的基于扩散的在线 RL 算法性能相当。我们的代码见：https://github.com/diffusionyes/MaxEntDP。

brief_zh.summary: 最大熵强化学习通过熵奖励鼓励探索，但主流实现多用高斯策略，其单峰分布难以覆盖复杂多目标环境中的多模态最优行为，探索容易塌缩到单一模式。论文把扩散模型引入最大熵策略表示，提出 MaxEntDP，使策略能够表达多峰动作分布，并在优化 Q 值的同时保留熵目标。关键问题在于如何让扩散采样与最大熵目标一致，而不是把扩散策略仅当作确定性动作生成器；作者据此构造了适配扩散策略的策略改进与熵估计方式，使探索更充分，策略分布也更接近理论上的最优最大熵策略。
brief_zh.method: 实验以 Mujoco 连续控制任务为环境，在在线强化学习循环中让智能体交互。策略用扩散模型表示，从噪声经多步去噪生成动作，并估计动作对数概率与熵；critic 沿用双 Q 网络和软更新，actor 损失同时考虑 Q 值与熵项。对照包括高斯策略 SAC、其他生成式策略及在线扩散强化学习算法。实现上重点处理扩散采样开销与策略梯度估计，使扩散策略可嵌入常规 off-policy 流程。
brief_zh.driving: 自动驾驶决策常有多模态行为，如让行、绕行或加速通过，高斯策略容易把这些模式平均成犹豫动作。MaxEntDP 提示可用扩散策略作规划器或行为策略，在线交互中保留熵奖励覆盖多种合理模式，再由 critic 约束选出安全动作。工程上可把去噪放在轨迹生成层，用仿真回报训练 critic，并为模型预测控制提供多样化候选轨迹先验。

title: HiCoGen: Hierarchical Compositional Text-to-Image Generation in Diffusion Models via Reinforcement Learning
abstract: Recent advances in diffusion models have demonstrated impressive capability in generating high-quality images for simple prompts. However, when confronted with complex prompts involving multiple objects and hierarchical structures, existing models struggle to accurately follow instructions, leading to issues such as concept omission, confusion, and poor compositionality. To address these limitations, we propose a Hierarchical Compositional Generative framework (HiCoGen) built upon a novel Chain of Synthesis (CoS) paradigm. Instead of monolithic generation, HiCoGen first leverages a Large Language Model (LLM) to decompose complex prompts into minimal semantic units. It then synthesizes these units iteratively, where the image generated in each step provides crucial visual context for the next, ensuring all textual concepts are faithfully constructed into the final scene. To further optimize this process, we introduce a reinforcement learning (RL) framework. Crucially, we identify that the limited exploration of standard diffusion samplers hinders effective RL. We theoretically prove that sample diversity is maximized by concentrating stochasticity in the early generation stages and, based on this insight, propose a novel Decaying Stochasticity Schedule to enhance exploration. Our RL algorithm is then guided by a hierarchical reward mechanism that jointly evaluates the image at the global, subject, and relationship levels. We also construct HiCoPrompt, a new text-to-image benchmark with hierarchical prompts for rigorous evaluation. Experiments show our approach significantly outperforms existing methods in both concept coverage and compositional accuracy.
title_zh: HiCoGen：通过强化学习实现扩散模型中的分层组合式文本到图像生成
abstract_zh: 扩散模型的最新进展已展现出在根据简单提示生成高质量图像方面的出色能力。然而，面对涉及多个对象和分层结构的复杂提示时，现有模型难以准确遵循指令，导致概念遗漏、混淆和组合性差等问题。为解决这些局限，我们提出一种分层组合式生成框架（HiCoGen），它建立在一种新颖的 Chain of Synthesis（CoS）范式之上。HiCoGen 不采用整体式生成，而是首先利用大语言模型（LLM）将复杂提示分解为最小语义单元。随后，它迭代地合成这些单元，其中每一步生成的图像都为下一步提供关键的视觉上下文，从而确保所有文本概念都被忠实地构建到最终场景中。为进一步优化这一过程，我们引入了强化学习（RL）框架。关键在于，我们发现标准扩散采样器的有限探索会阻碍有效的 RL。我们从理论上证明，将随机性集中于生成的早期阶段可以最大化样本多样性，并基于这一洞见提出一种新颖的 Decaying Stochasticity Schedule 来增强探索。随后，我们的 RL 算法由一种分层奖励机制引导，该机制从全局、主体和关系三个层面联合评估图像。我们还构建了 HiCoPrompt，这是一个带有分层提示的新文本到图像基准，用于严格评估。实验表明，我们的方法在概念覆盖率和组合准确性方面均显著优于现有方法。

brief_zh.summary: 文本到图像扩散模型在简单提示下已较成熟，但面对包含多个对象、属性和层级关系的复杂提示时，常出现概念遗漏、对象混淆和空间关系错误。整体式生成让模型一次性处理全部语义，难以保证每个元素都被落实。HiCoGen 提出 Chain of Synthesis 范式：先用大语言模型把复杂提示拆成最小语义单元，再逐步合成，每一步都把上一步图像作为视觉上下文，使后续生成围绕已有场景补全。为优化这一多步过程，作者用强化学习训练生成流程，并针对扩散采样探索不足设计分层奖励，从全局、主体和关系三个层面评价中间结果。
brief_zh.method: 方法先把提示交给 LLM 解析为对象、属性和关系组成的语义单元序列，再按序调用扩散模型生成或编辑图像，前一步图像作为后一步条件，形成链式合成。训练时把每次生成视为强化学习动作，奖励模型从全局一致性、主体完整性和关系正确性三层打分。作者依据扩散随机性在早期更能提升样本多样性的分析，采用随时间衰减的随机性调度来增强探索。HiCoPrompt 基准用于组织分层提示，并与整体式生成和提示分解方法对照。
brief_zh.driving: 自动驾驶场景生成同样需要按对象和关系组合，例如雨天路口左转车辆避让行人。HiCoGen 的链式分解可把提示拆成道路、交通参与者和交互关系，逐步生成并以前一步图像为条件，减少元素遗漏与关系错乱；分层奖励可对应全局交通合理性、主体完整性和关系正确性。可用于 corner case 合成与仿真场景扩展。

title: RePrompt: Reasoning-Augmented Reprompting for Text-to-Image Generation via Reinforcement Learning
abstract: Despite recent progress in text-to-image (T2I) generation, existing models often struggle to faithfully capture user intentions from short and under-specified prompts. While prior work has attempted to enhance prompts using large language models (LLMs), these methods frequently generate stylistic or unrealistic content due to insufficient grounding in visual semantics and real-world composition. Inspired by recent advances in reasoning for language model, we propose RePrompt, a novel reprompting framework that introduces explicit reasoning into the prompt enhancement process via reinforcement learning. Instead of relying on handcrafted rules or stylistic rewrites, our method trains a language model to generate structured, self-reflective prompts by optimizing for image-level outcomes. The tailored reward models assesse the generated images in terms of human preference, semantic alignment, and visual composition, providing indirect supervision to refine prompt generation. Our approach enables end-to-end training without human-annotated data. Experiments on GenEval and T2I-Compbench show that RePrompt significantly boosts spatial layout fidelity and compositional generalization across diverse T2I backbones, establishing new state-of-the-art results. title_zh: RePrompt：通过强化学习实现推理增强的文本到图像重提示生成
abstract_zh: 尽管文本到图像（T2I）生成近期取得了进展，但现有模型往往难以从简短且描述不充分的提示中忠实捕捉用户意图。尽管先前工作尝试使用大语言模型（LLM）增强提示，但这些方法由于缺乏对视觉语义和真实世界构图的充分依据，常常生成风格化或不真实的内容。受语言模型推理领域最新进展的启发，我们提出 RePrompt，一种新颖的重提示框架，通过强化学习将显式推理引入提示增强过程。我们的方法不依赖手工规则或风格化改写，而是通过针对图像级结果进行优化，训练语言模型生成结构化、具有自我反思能力的提示。定制的奖励模型从人类偏好、语义对齐和视觉构图三个方面评估生成图像，从而为改进提示生成提供间接监督。我们的方法无需人工标注数据即可实现端到端训练。在 GenEval 和 T2I-Compbench 上的实验表明，RePrompt 在多种 T2I 主干模型上显著提升了空间布局保真度和组合泛化能力，并确立了新的最先进结果。代码：https://github.com/microsoft/DKI_LLM/tree/main/RePrompt。

brief_zh.summary: 文本到图像模型在用户只给简短、信息不足的提示时，往往难以还原真实意图。已有基于大语言模型的提示增强方法多依赖手工规则或风格化改写，缺少对视觉语义和真实构图的有效依据，容易生成好看但不符合需求的内容。RePrompt 把显式推理引入重提示过程：语言模型不是直接扩写句子，而是生成包含场景分析、对象属性和空间关系推理的结构化提示，并通过强化学习依据最终图像结果优化提示策略。由于监督信号来自图像级奖励而非人工标注的改写文本，该方法能够端到端训练，并把人类偏好、语义对齐和视觉构图同时纳入优化。
brief_zh.method: 训练时，语言模型接收原始短提示，先输出包含推理过程的结构化重提示，再交给固定的文本到图像主干生成图像。奖励模型从人类偏好、与原始提示的语义对齐、对象布局与空间构图三方面评价图像，并把图像级奖励回传给语言模型，用强化学习更新提示策略。流程无需人工撰写配对提示，属于在线采样加奖励优化；对照包括规则扩写、LLM 直接改写及不同主干组合。
brief_zh.driving: 自动驾驶语言接口常面对简短指令，如“前面堵了，换条路”或“靠边接人”，直接交给规划器会遗漏约束。RePrompt 可迁移为指令重写器：先推理场景、目标、可接受路径和风险，再生成结构化驾驶意图，用仿真执行结果或闭环评分作强化学习奖励。无需人工标注改写语料，奖励拆成用户偏好、语义一致和轨迹合理性。

title: Consolidating Reinforcement Learning for Multimodal Discrete Diffusion Models
abstract: Optimizing discrete diffusion model (DDM) with rewards remains a challenge—the non-autoregressive paradigm makes importance sampling intractable and rollout complex, puzzling reinforcement learning methods such as Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). In this study, we introduce MaskGRPO , the first viable approach to enable scalable multimodal reinforcement learning in discrete diffusion with effective importance sampling and modality-specific adaptations. To this end, we first clarify the theoretical foundation for DDMs, which facilitates building an importance estimator that captures valuable token fluctuation for gradient updates. We then delicately tailored the rollout method for visual sequences, which yields diverse completions and reliable optimization gradients. Across math reasoning, coding, and visual generation benchmarks, MaskGRPO brings more stable and efficient updates, doubling reinforcement learning gains while speeding up training by up to 30% . This study establishes MaskGRPO as a systematic policy optimization approach and the first practical way for discretized visual diffusion. title_zh: 整合面向多模态离散扩散模型的强化学习
abstract_zh: 利用奖励优化离散扩散模型（DDM）仍是一项挑战——非自回归范式使重要性采样难以处理且 rollout 复杂，这令 Group Relative Policy Optimization（GRPO）等强化学习方法陷入困境。本研究提出 MaskGRPO，这是首个可行方法，能够通过有效的重要性采样和模态特定适配，在离散扩散中实现可扩展的多模态强化学习。为此，我们首先厘清 DDM 的理论基础，从而有助于构建一个重要性估计器，以捕捉对梯度更新有价值的 token 波动。随后，我们为视觉序列精心定制了 rollout 方法，从而产生多样化的补全结果和可靠的优化梯度。在数学推理、编程和视觉生成基准上，MaskGRPO 带来了更稳定、更高效的更新，使强化学习收益翻倍，同时将训练速度提升最多 30%。本研究确立了 MaskGRPO 作为一种系统性策略优化方法，并为离散化视觉扩散提供了首个实用途径。代码见：https://github.com/martian422/MaskGRPO。

brief_zh.summary: 离散扩散模型通过非自回归方式并行生成 token，奖励优化却因此难以直接套用强化学习：轨迹的重要性采样不可解析，rollout 也复杂，GRPO 一类方法难以稳定工作。论文提出 MaskGRPO，试图为离散扩散建立可扩展的多模态强化学习流程。其关键做法是先厘清离散扩散的优化目标，构造能捕捉对梯度更新有价值 token 波动的重要性估计器；再针对视觉序列设计专门的补全式 rollout，使采样既有多样性又能提供可靠梯度；同时加入模态特定适配，让文本、代码和视觉生成共享同一策略优化框架。由此缓解非自回归采样带来的高方差问题，使奖励优化在数学推理、编程和视觉生成等任务上更稳定，也为离散视觉扩散的强化学习后训练提供了系统方案。
brief_zh.method: 方法以离散扩散模型为策略：先根据扩散去噪过程推导 token 级重要性权重，仅对真正影响梯度更新的 token 波动进行重加权，避免对整条序列做不可行的精确重要性采样。训练时针对视觉序列设计补全式 rollout，从部分已知 token 出发并行生成多个候选补全，保留模态多样性并估计相对优势；再按文本、代码、视觉等模态调整掩码、采样长度和噪声调度。实验将 MaskGRPO 接到 GRPO 类强化学习流程上，在数学推理、编程和视觉生成基准中与常规策略优化做法对照，重点观察训练稳定性、采样效率和生成多样性。
brief_zh.driving: 可迁移到自动驾驶的离散轨迹或驾驶动作 token 强化学习后训练：非自回归规划器一次生成整段轨迹，普通策略梯度难以判断哪个 token 该负责，MaskGRPO 的 token 重要性估计和补全式 rollout 可降低方差，在保持多模态轨迹的同时用碰撞、舒适性和合规奖励稳定更新。视觉序列的模态适配也可用于联合优化多相机特征与轨迹 token，减少在线采样开销。

title: Exploratory Diffusion Model for Unsupervised Reinforcement Learning
abstract: Unsupervised reinforcement learning (URL) pre-trains agents by exploring diverse states in reward-free environments, aiming to enable efficient adaptation to various downstream tasks. Without extrinsic rewards, prior methods rely on intrinsic objectives, but heterogeneous exploration data demand strong modeling capacity for both intrinsic reward design and policy learning. We introduce the Ex ploratory D iffusion M odel ( ExDM ), which leverages the expressive power of diffusion models to fit diverse replay-buffer distributions, thus providing accurate density estimates and a score-based intrinsic reward that drives exploration into under-visited regions. This mechanism substantially broadens state coverage and yields robust pre-trained policies. Beyond exploration, ExDM offers theoretical guarantees and practical algorithms for fine-tuning diffusion policies under limited interactions, overcoming instability and computational overhead from multi-step sampling. Extensive experiments on Maze2d and URLB show that ExDM achieves superior exploration and faster downstream adaptation, establishing new state-of-the-art results, particularly in environments with complex structure or cross-embodiment settings. title_zh: 用于无监督强化学习的探索性扩散模型
abstract_zh: 无监督强化学习（URL）通过在无奖励环境中探索多样状态来预训练智能体，旨在实现对各种下游任务的高效适配。在没有外部奖励的情况下，先前方法依赖内在目标，但异构的探索数据对内在奖励设计和策略学习都提出了很强的建模能力要求。我们提出 Exploratory Diffusion Model（ExDM），它利用扩散模型的表达能力来拟合多样化的回放缓冲区分布，从而提供准确的密度估计和基于分数的内在奖励，驱动探索进入访问不足的区域。该机制大幅拓宽了状态覆盖范围，并产生稳健的预训练策略。除探索之外，ExDM 还为在有限交互下微调扩散策略提供了理论保证和实用算法，克服了多步采样带来的不稳定性和计算开销。在 Maze2d 和 URLB 上的大量实验表明，ExDM 实现了更优的探索和更快的下游适配，确立了新的最先进结果，尤其是在具有复杂结构或跨具身设置的环境中。源代码见：https://github.com/yingchengyang/ExDM。

brief_zh.summary: 无监督强化学习希望在无奖励环境中先探索多样状态，再快速适配下游任务。现有方法依赖人工设计的内在奖励，但探索数据高度异构，回放缓冲区的状态分布复杂，手工奖励既难覆盖访问不足区域，也容易让策略停留在局部模式。论文提出探索性扩散模型 ExDM，用扩散模型拟合多样化回放缓冲区的状态分布，借此获得密度估计和基于分数的内在奖励，把策略推向低密度、少访问的区域，从而扩大状态覆盖并得到更稳健的预训练策略。论文进一步分析有限交互下微调扩散策略的问题，给出理论保证和实用算法，缓解多步采样带来的不稳定与计算开销，使预训练探索真正能转化为下游任务适应能力。
brief_zh.method: ExDM 先在无奖励环境中用探索策略收集多样回放数据，训练扩散模型拟合状态分布；推理时以扩散分数衡量状态新颖度，把低密度区域分数转为内在奖励，驱动智能体访问少见的异构状态。预训练阶段用该奖励优化探索策略，并将扩散模型保留为策略先验。下游仅给少量交互和任务奖励，将预训练扩散策略作为初始化，通过减少采样步数、复用去噪轨迹和约束更新幅度稳定微调。实验覆盖 Maze2d 的结构化迷宫与 URLB 的跨具身任务，并与手工内在奖励、普通策略初始化等无监督学习方法对照。
brief_zh.driving: 自动驾驶可利用海量无标注驾驶日志做 URL 预训练：以扩散模型拟合状态分布，用分数奖励发现回放中稀少但可行驶的状态，预训练策略覆盖更多路口、拥堵和长尾场景；下游只需少量碰撞或舒适性反馈即可微调扩散规划器。低步数、稳定的微调流程也适合仿真中高交互成本场景，并为数据闭环挑选高信息量片段提供密度依据。

title: Goal-Driven Reward by Video Diffusion Models for Reinforcement Learning
abstract: Reinforcement Learning (RL) has achieved remarkable success in various domains, yet it often relies on carefully designed programmatic reward functions to guide agent behavior. Designing such reward functions can be challenging and may not generalize well across different tasks. To address this limitation, we leverage the rich world knowledge contained in pretrained video diffusion models to provide goal-driven reward signals for RL agents without ad-hoc design of reward. Our key idea is to exploit off-the-shelf video diffusion models pretrained on large-scale video datasets as informative reward functions in terms of video-level and frame-level goals. For video-level rewards, we first finetune a pretrained video diffusion model on domain-specific datasets and then employ its video encoder to evaluate the alignment between the latent representations of agent's trajectories and the generated goal videos. To enable more fine-grained goal-achievement, we derive a frame-level goal by identifying the most relevant frame from the generated video using CLIP, which serves as the goal state. We then employ a learned forward-backward representation that represents the probability of visiting the goal state from a given state-action pair as frame-level reward, promoting more coherent and goal-driven trajectories. Experiments on Meta-World and Distracting Control Suite demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach.
title_zh: 视频扩散模型为强化学习提供目标驱动奖励
abstract_zh: 强化学习（RL）已在多个领域取得显著成功，但它通常依赖精心设计的程序化奖励函数来引导智能体行为。设计此类奖励函数可能颇具挑战性，而且可能难以在不同任务之间良好泛化。为应对这一局限，我们利用预训练视频扩散模型中蕴含的丰富世界知识，为 RL 智能体提供目标驱动的奖励信号，而无需临时设计奖励。我们的核心思想是将在大规模视频数据集上预训练的现成视频扩散模型作为信息丰富的奖励函数，用于视频级和帧级目标。对于视频级奖励，我们首先在领域特定数据集上微调预训练视频扩散模型，然后利用其视频编码器评估智能体轨迹的潜在表示与生成的目标视频之间的对齐程度。为实现更细粒度的目标达成，我们使用 CLIP 从生成视频中识别最相关的帧，从而得到帧级目标，并将其作为目标状态。随后，我们采用一种学习得到的 forward-backward 表示，将给定状态-动作对访问目标状态的概率作为帧级奖励，从而促进生成更连贯、更具目标导向的轨迹。在 Meta-World 和 Distracting Control Suite 上的实验证明了我们方法的有效性。

brief_zh.summary: 强化学习通常依赖人工编写的程序化奖励，设计成本高且跨任务泛化差。论文利用预训练视频扩散模型中蕴含的世界知识，把现成模型改造成目标驱动的奖励函数，避免为每个任务临时设计奖励。针对视频级目标，先在领域数据上微调视频扩散模型，再用其视频编码器衡量智能体轨迹的潜在表示与生成目标视频是否对齐；针对更细粒度的帧级目标，用 CLIP 从生成视频中挑选最相关帧作为目标状态，并学习前向—后向表示，把状态—动作访问目标状态的概率转成奖励。这样既能评价整体行为是否朝目标演进，也能在关键帧层面提供密集引导，使稀疏目标下的轨迹更连贯、更有方向性。
brief_zh.method: 方法分两路构造奖励。视频级路线先在领域特定数据上微调预训练视频扩散模型，使其能生成符合任务分布的目标视频；训练强化学习智能体时，将采样轨迹编码到同一潜空间，与目标视频表示计算对齐度作为奖励。帧级路线先用 CLIP 从生成视频中检索最相关的帧，确定目标状态，再采集状态—动作—后继状态数据训练前向—后向表示，以访问目标状态的概率作为逐步奖励。两类奖励接入 Meta-World 和 Distracting Control Suite 的强化学习流程，检验干扰环境下的引导作用；实现上复用冻结或轻量微调的视频编码器，避免每步重新生成视频。
brief_zh.driving: 可把路线或驾驶指令转成目标视频，用视频扩散模型评价规划轨迹与目标未来的潜空间对齐，形成不依赖手工规则的宏观奖励；再用 CLIP 选关键帧给出路口、让行等目标状态，借助前向—后向表示提供帧级奖励，缓解稀疏碰撞奖励难学习的问题。该流程也可用于仿真场景生成和奖励标注，帮助闭环筛选长尾驾驶片段。

title: PROMPTMINER: Black-Box Prompt Stealing against Text-to-Image Generative Models via Reinforcement Learning and VLM-Guided Optimization
abstract: Text-to-image (T2I) generative models such as Stable Diffusion and FLUX can synthesize realistic, high-quality images directly from textual prompts. The resulting image quality depends critically on well-crafted prompts that specify both subjects and stylistic modifiers, which have become valuable digital assets. However, the rising value and ubiquity of high-quality prompts expose them to security and intellectual-property risks. One key threat is the prompt stealing attack, i.e., the task of recovering the textual prompt that generated a given image. Prompt stealing enables unauthorized extraction and reuse of carefully engineered prompts, yet it can also support beneficial applications such as data attribution, model provenance analysis, and watermarking validation. Existing approaches often assume white-box gradient access, require large-scale labeled datasets for supervised training, or rely solely on captioning without explicit optimization, limiting their practicality and adaptability. To address these challenges, we propose PROMPTMINER, a black-box prompt stealing framework that decouples the task into two phases: (1) a reinforcement learning-based optimization phase to reconstruct the primary subject, and (2) a VLM-guided search phase to recover stylistic modifiers. Experiments across multiple datasets and diffusion backbones demonstrate that PROMPTMINER achieves superior results, with CLIP similarity up to 0.958 and textual alignment with SBERT up to 0.751, surpassing all baselines. Even when applied to in-the-wild images with unknown generators, it outperforms the strongest baseline by 7.5% in CLIP similarity, demonstrating better generalization. Finally, PROMPTMINER maintains strong performance under defensive perturbations, highlighting remarkable robustness.
title_zh: PROMPTMINER：通过强化学习与 VLM 引导优化对文本到图像生成模型实施黑盒提示词窃取
abstract_zh: Stable Diffusion 和 FLUX 等文本到图像（T2I）生成模型能够直接根据文本提示词合成逼真、高质量的图像。所生成图像的质量在很大程度上取决于精心设计的提示词，这些提示词需要同时指定主体和风格修饰词，并已成为有价值的数字资产。然而，高质量提示词的价值不断提升且日益普及，也使其面临安全和知识产权风险。一个关键威胁是提示词窃取攻击，即恢复生成给定图像的文本提示词这一任务。提示词窃取使精心设计的提示词可能被未经授权地提取和复用，但它也能支持数据归因、模型来源分析和水印验证等有益应用。现有方法通常假设可以访问白盒梯度，需要大规模标注数据集进行监督训练，或者仅依赖图像描述生成而缺乏显式优化，从而限制了其实用性和适应性。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 PROMPTMINER，一个黑盒提示词窃取框架，将任务解耦为两个阶段：(1) 基于强化学习的优化阶段，用于重建主要主体；(2) VLM 引导的搜索阶段，用于恢复风格修饰词。在多个数据集和扩散主干模型上的实验表明，PROMPTMINER 取得了更优结果，CLIP 相似度最高达 0.958，与 SBERT 的文本对齐度最高达 0.751，超过了所有基线。即使应用于生成器未知的真实场景图像，其 CLIP 相似度仍比最强基线高出 7.5%，展现出更好的泛化能力。最后，PROMPTMINER 在防御性扰动下仍保持强劲性能，凸显了其出色的鲁棒性。

brief_zh.summary: 文本到图像模型生成质量高度依赖精心设计的提示词，提示词已成为有价值的数字资产，但也带来被窃取和复用的风险；提示词恢复又可服务于数据归因、模型溯源和水印验证。现有窃取方法要么假设可访问白盒梯度，要么依赖大规模标注数据做监督训练，要么只做图像描述而缺少显式优化，因而在真实黑盒生成器上适应性不足。论文提出 PromptMiner，把黑盒提示词窃取拆成两个阶段：先用强化学习在生成器反馈下优化主体描述，恢复图像中的核心对象；再用视觉语言模型引导风格修饰词的搜索，补足材质、光照、构图等风格信息。这种解耦缩小了搜索空间，使方法无需梯度和大规模配对标签，也能适应不同扩散主干、未知生成器及带防御扰动的图像。
brief_zh.method: PromptMiner 只通过生成器的输入输出接口工作：给定目标图像，策略网络先生成候选提示词，送入黑盒文本到图像模型得到图像，再用图像嵌入与目标图像的一致性作为奖励，通过强化学习更新主体描述，这一阶段不需要梯度或成对标注。随后固定主体部分，调用视觉语言模型观察目标图与当前生成图，提出并筛选风格修饰词，迭代搜索光照、材质、镜头和画风等属性，直至风格对齐。两阶段把主体语义和风格解耦，缩小组合搜索空间；实验在多个数据集和扩散主干上与白盒梯度、监督训练和纯图像描述基线对照，还测试未知生成器与防御性扰动下的泛化表现。
brief_zh.driving: 可迁移为自动驾驶仿真数据闭环中的黑盒提示词优化与溯源工具：当只能调用外部图像生成服务时，用强化学习先锁定雨天、夜间、行人横穿等场景主体，再用视觉语言模型搜索光照、视角和天气风格，从目标传感器图像反推可复现的生成提示，用于审计合成数据来源与复现长尾场景；也可反过来优化稀有场景提示词，降低对白盒梯度和人工标注的依赖。

title: Score-Based Diffusion Policy Compatible with Reinforcement Learning via Optimal Transport
abstract: Diffusion policies have shown promise in learning complex behaviors from demonstrations, particularly for tasks requiring precise control and long-term planning. However, they face challenges in robustness when encountering distribution shifts. This paper explores improving diffusion-based imitation learning models through online interactions with the environment. We propose OTPR (Optimal Transport-guided score-based diffusion Policy for Reinforcement learning fine-tuning), a novel method that integrates diffusion policies with RL using optimal transport theory. OTPR leverages the Q-function as a transport cost and views the policy as an optimal transport map, enabling efficient and stable fine-tuning. Moreover, we introduce masked optimal transport to guide state-action matching using expert keypoints and a compatibility-based resampling strategy to enhance training stability. Experiments on three simulation tasks demonstrate OTPR’s superior performance and robustness compared to existing methods, especially in complex and sparse-reward environments. In sum, OTPR provides an effective framework for combining IL and RL, achieving versatile and reliable policy learning.
title_zh: 通过最优传输实现与强化学习兼容的基于分数的扩散策略
abstract_zh: 扩散策略在学习复杂行为方面已展现出潜力，尤其是对于需要精确控制和长期规划的任务。然而，当遇到分布偏移时，它们在鲁棒性方面仍面临挑战。本文探索通过与环境进行在线交互来改进基于扩散的模仿学习模型。我们提出 OTPR（Optimal Transport-guided score-based diffusion Policy for Reinforcement learning fine-tuning），一种利用最优传输理论将扩散策略与强化学习相结合的新方法。OTPR 将 Q 函数作为传输代价，并将策略视为最优传输映射，从而实现高效、稳定的微调。此外，我们引入掩码最优传输，利用专家关键点引导状态-动作匹配，并提出基于兼容性的重采样策略以增强训练稳定性。在三个仿真任务上的实验表明，与现有方法相比，OTPR 具有更优的性能和鲁棒性，尤其是在复杂且奖励稀疏的环境中。总之，OTPR 为结合模仿学习（IL）和强化学习（RL）提供了一个有效框架，实现了通用且可靠的策略学习。

brief_zh.summary: 扩散策略在模仿学习中能表达复杂行为，但离线训练后一旦进入分布外状态，动作容易失准，在线交互微调又面临扩散多步采样和策略更新不稳定的问题。论文提出 OTPR，把扩散策略与强化学习通过最优传输连接起来：将 Q 函数视为传输代价，把策略看作从状态—动作分布到高价值区域的最优传输映射，从而在保留扩散策略表达能力的同时进行稳定微调。为进一步约束匹配，作者引入掩码最优传输，用专家关键点引导哪些状态—动作应被对齐；并提出基于兼容性的重采样，筛掉与当前策略不匹配的样本以降低训练波动。该方法面向模仿学习后的在线改进，尤其关注复杂、奖励稀疏环境中分布偏移导致的鲁棒性下降。
brief_zh.method: OTPR 以预训练扩散模仿策略为起点，在仿真环境中在线采集状态—动作—奖励—后继状态，同时保留专家轨迹提供关键点。训练时用 Q 网络给出传输代价，把策略更新表述为最优传输问题，使高价值的真实状态—动作获得更大传输质量；掩码最优传输利用专家关键点限定可匹配的状态—动作对，避免错误对齐；兼容性重采样则根据当前策略与样本的匹配程度调整采样权重，抑制离群交互造成的梯度噪声。扩散策略仍通过去噪过程生成动作，Q 函数和传输目标只作用于微调阶段。实验在三个仿真任务中与常规扩散策略微调及强化学习方法对照，覆盖奖励稀疏和分布偏移情形。
brief_zh.driving: 自动驾驶中，模仿学习得到的扩散规划器常因分布偏移在长尾状态失效。OTPR 可在仿真中在线微调：以碰撞、舒适性和进度构成的 Q 值作传输代价，把规划轨迹推向高价值区域；用专家关键点约束路口、让行和车道保持等状态—动作匹配，并按兼容性重采样剔除失配交互，降低扩散多步采样的方差，适合奖励稀疏场景下的规划器后训练。

title: PIGDreamer: Privileged Information Guided World Models for Safe Partially Observable Reinforcement Learning
abstract: Partial observability presents a significant challenge for Safe Reinforcement Learning (Safe RL), as it impedes the identification of potential risks and rewards. Leveraging specific types of privileged information during training to mitigate the effects of partial observability has yielded notable empirical successes. In this paper, we propose Asymmetric Constrained Partially Observable Markov Decision Processes (ACPOMDPs) to theoretically examine the advantages of incorporating privileged information in Safe RL. Building upon ACPOMDPs, we propose the Privileged Information Guided Dreamer ( PIGDreamer ), a model-based RL approach that leverages privileged information to enhance the agent’s safety and performance through privileged representation alignment and an asymmetric actor-critic structure. Our empirical results demonstrate that PIGDreamer significantly outperforms existing Safe RL methods. Furthermore, compared to alternative privileged RL methods, our approach exhibits enhanced performance, robustness, and efficiency. Codes are available at: https://github.com/hggforget/PIGDreamer.
title_zh: PIGDreamer：面向安全部分可观测强化学习的特权信息引导世界模型
abstract_zh: 部分可观测性给安全强化学习（Safe RL）带来了重大挑战，因为它妨碍了对潜在风险和奖励的识别。在训练期间利用特定类型的特权信息来缓解部分可观测性的影响，已在实践中取得显著成功。本文提出非对称约束部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（ACPOMDPs），从理论上考察在 Safe RL 中引入特权信息的优势。基于 ACPOMDPs，我们提出特权信息引导的 Dreamer（PIGDreamer），这是一种基于模型的强化学习方法，通过特权表示对齐和非对称 actor-critic 结构，利用特权信息提升智能体的安全性和性能。实验结果表明，PIGDreamer 显著优于现有的 Safe RL 方法。此外，与其他的特权强化学习方法相比，我们的方法在性能、鲁棒性和效率方面均有提升。代码可在 https://github.com/hggforget/PIGDreamer 获取。

brief_zh.summary: 部分可观测性使安全强化学习难以识别真实风险与奖励，现有做法虽常在训练中引入特权信息并取得效果，却缺少对这类信息作用机制的理论刻画，安全约束与策略学习也容易脱节。论文提出非对称约束部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程，将特权信息、部分观测和安全约束纳入统一形式化，并据此设计基于模型的 PIGDreamer。其核心是用特权表示对齐约束世界模型的潜在表示，配合非对称 actor-critic，让评论家借助训练期特权信息评估风险，而执行策略仍只依赖可观测输入，从而在提升安全性的同时保持部署可行性。
brief_zh.method: 方法上，先定义安全强化学习的非对称约束部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程，在世界模型中进行想象 rollout，并用特权状态构造辅助对齐目标，使潜在状态能预测与风险相关的特权表示；actor 仅接收部分观测，critic 额外接收特权信息，形成非对称训练。安全约束纳入策略与价值更新。实验在部分可观测的安全控制环境中，与安全强化学习方法和特权强化学习方法对照，并考察去掉表示对齐、改用对称结构以及观测受扰时的表现。
brief_zh.driving: 对自动驾驶而言，可在仿真训练阶段把自车真值状态、邻近交通参与者意图或占据栅格等特权信息用于世界模型对齐与 critic 评估，部署时 actor 只读传感器特征，降低对高精地图和真值的依赖；安全约束进入想象 rollout，可用于风险敏感决策与长尾场景训练，也便于评估观测缺失下的鲁棒性。

title: DemoFunGrasp: Universal Dexterous Functional Grasping via Demonstration-Editing Reinforcement Learning
abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has achieved great success in dexterous grasping, significantly improving grasp performance and generalization from simulation to the real world. However, fine-grained functional grasping, which is essential for downstream manipulation tasks, remains underexplored and faces several challenges: the complexity of specifying goals and reward functions for functional grasps across diverse objects, the difficulty of multi-task RL exploration, and the challenge of sim-to-real transfer. In this work, we propose DemoFunGrasp for universal dexterous functional grasping. We factorize functional grasping conditions into two complementary components -- grasping style and affordance -- and integrate them into an RL framework that can learn to grasp any object with any functional grasping condition. To address the multi-task optimization challenge, we leverage a single grasping demonstration and reformulate the RL problem as one-step demonstration editing, substantially enhancing sample efficiency and performance.Experimental results in both simulation and the real world show that DemoFunGrasp generalizes to unseen combinations of objects, affordances, and grasping styles, outperforming baselines in both success rate and functional grasping accuracy. In addition to strong sim-to-real capability, by incorporating a vision-language model (VLM) for planning, our system achieves autonomous instruction-following grasp execution.
title_zh: DemoFunGrasp：通过示范编辑强化学习实现通用灵巧功能性抓取
abstract_zh: 强化学习（RL）在灵巧抓取方面取得了巨大成功，显著提升了抓取性能以及从仿真到现实世界的泛化能力。然而，对于下游操作任务至关重要的细粒度功能性抓取仍未得到充分探索，并面临若干挑战：为不同物体指定功能性抓取目标和奖励函数的复杂性、多任务 RL 探索的困难，以及仿真到现实迁移的挑战。在本工作中，我们提出 DemoFunGrasp，用于通用灵巧功能性抓取。我们将功能性抓取条件分解为两个互补组成部分——抓取风格和可供性（affordance）——并将它们整合到一个 RL 框架中，使其能够学习在任意功能性抓取条件下抓取任意物体。为应对多任务优化挑战，我们利用单个抓取示范，并将 RL 问题重新表述为一步示范编辑，从而显著提升样本效率和性能。仿真和真实世界中的实验结果表明，DemoFunGrasp 能够泛化到未见过的物体、可供性和抓取风格组合，并在成功率和功能性抓取准确率上均优于基线。除了强大的仿真到现实能力外，通过引入视觉语言模型（VLM）进行规划，我们的系统还能实现自主遵循指令的抓取执行。

brief_zh.summary: 灵巧手抓取已能借助强化学习获得较强性能，但面向下游操作的功能性抓取仍缺少通用方案：不同物体需要分别设计抓取目标和奖励，多任务探索困难，仿真到现实也存在差距。DemoFunGrasp 将功能性抓取条件拆成抓取风格与可供性两部分，并统一编码进强化学习策略，使同一策略能在任意风格—可供性组合下抓取不同物体。为缓解多任务优化，方法仅使用单条抓取示范，把强化学习改写成一步示范编辑，用编辑后的示范提供稠密引导，显著改善探索与样本效率，并结合视觉语言模型完成指令驱动的自主抓取。
brief_zh.method: 训练时先采集一条通用抓取示范，再依据目标物体的可供性区域和指定抓取风格，对示范中的手部位姿与接触关系做一步编辑，生成当前任务的目标轨迹，并以其构造奖励或动作引导；策略以物体几何、可供性、风格条件为输入，在仿真中通过并行环境训练，配合域随机化缩小仿真与真实差异。评测涵盖未见物体、未见可供性与风格组合，并与常规功能性抓取基线比较，真机验证视觉语言模型分解指令、选择目标并调用抓取策略的执行链路。
brief_zh.driving: 对自动驾驶的启发是把复杂驾驶任务拆成可组合的“风格+可供性”条件，例如激进或保守驾驶风格与可通行区域、交互意图等场景可供性，并用单条专家轨迹编辑生成不同条件下的训练目标，减少多任务强化学习的盲目探索；仿真中配合域随机化和高层视觉语言模型做指令分解，也有助于构建可泛化的数据闭环与决策策略。

title: Simultaneous Multi-Robot Motion Planning with Projected Diffusion Models
abstract: Recent advances in diffusion models hold significant potential in robotics, enabling the generation of diverse and smooth trajectories directly from raw representations of the environment. Despite this promise, applying diffusion models to motion planning remains challenging due to their difficulty in enforcing critical constraints, such as collision avoidance and kinematic feasibility. These limitations become even more pronounced in Multi-Robot Motion Planning (MRMP), where multiple robots must coordinate in shared spaces. To address these challenges, this work proposes S imultaneous M RMP D iffusion (SMD), a novel approach integrating constrained optimization into the diffusion sampling process to produce collision-free, kinematically feasible trajectories. Additionally, the paper introduces a comprehensive MRMP benchmark to evaluate trajectory planning algorithms across scenarios with varying robot densities, obstacle complexities, and motion constraints. Experimental results show SMD consistently outperforms classical and other learning-based motion planners, achieving higher success rates and efficiency in complex multi-robot environments. The code and implementation are available at https://github.com/RAISELab-atUVA/Diffusion-MRMP.
title_zh: 基于投影扩散模型的同步多机器人运动规划
abstract_zh: 扩散模型的最新进展在机器人领域具有巨大潜力，能够直接从环境的原始表示生成多样且平滑的轨迹。尽管前景广阔，但将扩散模型应用于运动规划仍具挑战性，因为它们难以强制满足关键约束，例如避碰和运动学可行性。这些局限在多机器人运动规划（MRMP）中更为突出，因为多个机器人必须在共享空间中协调。为应对这些挑战，本文提出 Simultaneous MRMP Diffusion（SMD），一种将约束优化融入扩散采样过程的新方法，用于生成无碰撞且运动学可行的轨迹。此外，本文还引入一个全面的 MRMP 基准，用于评估轨迹规划算法在不同机器人密度、障碍物复杂度和运动约束场景下的表现。实验结果表明，SMD 在复杂多机器人环境中始终优于经典运动规划器和其他基于学习的运动规划器，取得了更高的成功率和效率。代码与实现见 https://github.com/RAISELab-atUVA/Diffusion-MRMP。

brief_zh.summary: 扩散模型可直接从环境原始表示生成多样且平滑的轨迹，但采样过程难以硬性满足避碰、运动学可行性等关键约束；在多机器人共享空间协调时，这一问题会进一步放大，容易产生彼此冲突或不可执行的联合轨迹。论文提出 SMD，把约束优化嵌入扩散采样，在去噪的每一步将候选轨迹投影到可行域，同时考虑机器人之间的联合避碰与单机运动约束，从而生成全局协调的轨迹。作者还建立覆盖机器人密度、障碍复杂度和运动约束的 MRMP 基准，用于系统比较经典与学习型规划器。
brief_zh.method: SMD 把多机器人联合轨迹作为扩散变量，训练去噪网络从噪声逐步恢复专家轨迹；推理时在每次去噪后求解投影优化，把候选轨迹拉回无碰撞、满足速度、加速度与关节限位的可行集合，再继续反向扩散，形成“扩散采样—约束投影”交替流程。作者构建统一 MRMP 基准，改变机器人数量、障碍布局和动力学限制，与经典采样/优化规划器及学习型规划器对照；工程上投影模块可按机器人模型复用，便于扩展到不同构型与密集场景。
brief_zh.driving: 自动驾驶多车轨迹生成可直接借鉴“扩散采样+约束投影”：把自车与周围交通参与者的联合轨迹作为变量，在去噪过程中投影到无碰撞、道路边界和车辆动力学可行域，避免先生成再后处理的冲突；统一的多智能体基准也可用于压力测试密集交互、遮挡和不同动力学配置，提升规划器的可扩展性与可验证性。

title: Efficient Online Reinforcement Learning for Diffusion Policy
abstract: Diffusion policies have achieved superior performance in imitation learning and offline reinforcement learning (RL) due to their rich expressiveness. However, the conventional diffusion training procedure requires samples from target distribution, which is impossible in online RL since we cannot sample from the optimal policy. Backpropagating policy gradient through the diffusion process incurs huge computational costs and instability, thus being expensive and not scalable. To enable efficient training of diffusion policies in online RL, we generalize the conventional denoising score matching by reweighting the loss function. The resulting Reweighted Score Matching (RSM) preserves the optimal solution and low computational cost of denoising score matching, while eliminating the need to sample from the target distribution and allowing learning to optimize value functions. We introduce two tractable reweighted loss functions to solve two commonly used policy optimization problems, policy mirror descent and max-entropy policy, resulting in two practical algorithms named Diffusion Policy Mirror Descent (DPMD) and Soft Diffusion Actor-Critic (SDAC). We conducted comprehensive comparisons on MuJoCo benchmarks. The empirical results show that the proposed algorithms outperform recent diffusion-policy online RLs on most tasks, and the DPMD improves more than 120% over soft actor-critic on Humanoid and Ant.
title_zh: 面向扩散策略的高效在线强化学习
abstract_zh: 由于具有丰富的表达能力，扩散策略在模仿学习和离线强化学习（RL）中取得了优异性能。然而，传统扩散训练过程需要从目标分布中采样，这在在线 RL 中是不可能的，因为无法从最优策略中采样。通过扩散过程反向传播策略梯度会带来巨大的计算成本和不确定性，因此代价高昂且难以扩展。为在在线 RL 中高效训练扩散策略，我们通过对损失函数重新加权来推广传统去噪分数匹配。由此得到的重加权分数匹配（RSM）保留了去噪分数匹配的最优解和低计算成本，同时无需从目标分布中采样，并允许学习以优化价值函数。我们引入两种可处理的重加权损失函数，用于求解两种常用的策略优化问题——策略镜像下降和最大熵策略，从而得到两种实用算法：Diffusion Policy Mirror Descent（DPMD）和 Soft Diffusion Actor-Critic（SDAC）。我们在 MuJoCo 基准上进行了全面比较。实证结果表明，所提算法在大多数任务上优于近期面向扩散策略的在线 RL 方法，并且 DPMD 在 Humanoid 和 Ant 上相较 soft actor-critic 提升超过 120%。

brief_zh.summary: 扩散策略表达能力强，已在模仿学习和离线强化学习中表现突出，但在线强化学习难以直接套用：传统扩散训练需要从目标策略采样，而在线阶段无法获得最优策略样本，反向传播策略梯度又要穿过整个去噪链，计算昂贵且方差较大。论文推广去噪分数匹配，通过损失重加权得到重加权分数匹配，在保留原最优解和低计算开销的同时摆脱目标分布采样，并允许用价值函数塑造策略。基于策略镜像下降和最大熵策略两种目标，作者给出两种可处理损失，形成 DPMD 与 SDAC。
brief_zh.method: 方法以扩散策略为 actor，在线采集交互数据进入回放池，由 critic 估计动作价值；训练时不反传穿过整条去噪采样链，而是对去噪分数匹配中的噪声样本按价值与策略改进方向重加权，使策略更新偏向高价值动作。针对策略镜像下降和最大熵策略两种目标，分别推导可处理的权重形式，得到 DPMD 与 SDAC。实验在 MuJoCo 连续控制任务上，与近期面向扩散策略的在线强化学习方法和 SAC 对照，并考察不同扩散步数与重加权设计下的训练表现。
brief_zh.driving: 对自动驾驶规划，可把扩散式轨迹生成器作为策略，在仿真或日志回放中在线用价值函数微调，而无需对去噪链反传，降低训练成本与不稳定；重加权分数匹配可把安全、舒适和进度奖励转成动作偏好，适合轨迹规划器、行为决策器和生成式场景策略的持续改进，也便于利用离线数据与在线交互混合训练。

title: The Image as Its Own Reward: Reinforcement Learning with Adversarial Reward for Image Generation
abstract: A reliable reward function is essential for reinforcement learning (RL) in image generation. Most current RL approaches depend on pre-trained preference models that output scalar rewards to approximate human preferences. However, these rewards often fail to capture human perception and are vulnerable to reward hacking, where higher scores do not correspond to better images. To address this, we introduce Adv-GRPO, an RL framework with an adversarial reward that iteratively updates both the reward model and the generator. The reward model is supervised using reference images as positive samples and can largely avoid being hacked. Unlike KL regularization that constrains parameter updates, our learned reward directly guides the generator through its visual outputs, leading to higher-quality images. Moreover, while optimizing existing reward functions can alleviate reward hacking, their inherent biases remain. For instance, PickScore may degrade image quality, whereas OCR-based rewards often reduce aesthetic fidelity. To address this, we take the image itself as a reward, using reference images and vision foundation models (e.g., DINO) to provide rich visual rewards. These dense visual signals, instead of a single scalar, lead to consistent gains across image quality, aesthetics, and task-specific metrics. Finally, we show that combining reference samples with foundation-model rewards enables distribution transfer and flexible style customization. In human evaluation, our method outperforms Flow-GRPO and SD3, achieving 70.0% and 72.4% win rates in image quality and aesthetics, respectively. Code and models has been released in https://github.com/showlab/Adv-GRPO.
title_zh: 图像即奖励：面向图像生成的对抗奖励强化学习
abstract_zh: 可靠的奖励函数对于图像生成中的强化学习（RL）至关重要。目前大多数 RL 方法依赖输出标量奖励的预训练偏好模型来近似人类偏好。然而，这些奖励往往无法反映人类感知，并且容易受到奖励黑客（reward hacking）的影响——更高的分数并不对应更好的图像。为此，我们提出 Adv-GRPO，一个采用对抗奖励的 RL 框架，它迭代更新奖励模型和生成器。奖励模型以参考图像作为正样本进行监督，能够在很大程度上避免被劫持。与约束参数更新的 KL 正则化不同，我们学习到的奖励通过其视觉输出直接引导生成器，从而生成更高质量的图像。此外，尽管优化现有奖励函数可以缓解奖励黑客问题，其固有偏差仍然存在。例如，PickScore 可能会降低图像质量，而基于 OCR 的奖励往往会降低美学保真度。为解决这一问题，我们将图像本身作为奖励，利用参考图像和视觉基础模型（如 DINO）提供丰富的视觉奖励。这些密集的视觉信号而非单一标量，在图像质量、美学和任务特定指标上带来了一致增益。最后，我们表明，将参考样本与基础模型奖励相结合能够实现分布迁移和灵活的风格定制。在人类评估中，我们的方法优于 Flow-GRPO 和 SD3，在图像质量和美学方面的胜率分别为 70.0% 和 72.4%。代码与模型已发布于 https://github.com/showlab/Adv-GRPO。

brief_zh.summary: 图像生成中的强化学习依赖预训练偏好模型给出标量奖励，但这类奖励未必符合人的感知，生成器还可能利用其偏差进行奖励黑客，导致分数升高而图像变差；单纯加 KL 约束只能限制参数漂移，不能纠正奖励本身的偏差。论文提出 Adv-GRPO，让奖励模型与生成器交替更新，并以参考图像作为正样本监督奖励模型，使其不易被生成样本劫持。进一步把图像本身当作奖励，利用参考图像和 DINO 等视觉基础模型提供稠密视觉信号，而非单一标量；结合参考样本还能实现分布迁移与风格定制。
brief_zh.method: 训练采用对抗式闭环：生成器按 GRPO 方式用当前奖励优化并产出图像；奖励模型以真实参考图为正样本，以生成图为负样本或对比样本更新，随后再指导下一轮生成，形成奖励与策略的共同演化。奖励不只输出标量，还比较参考图与生成图在 DINO 等视觉基础模型特征空间中的相似性，形成稠密视觉奖励；任务特定奖励可与该视觉奖励组合。实验与 Flow-GRPO、SD3 等对照，并做人工评价，同时测试参考样本引导下的风格迁移与分布偏移。
brief_zh.driving: 该思路可迁移到自动驾驶的生成式仿真与数据闭环：用真实场景图像作参考，以 DINO 等基础模型的稠密特征而非单一标量评分来约束场景、天气或传感器图像生成，能减少奖励黑客并保持几何与语义一致性；奖励模型与生成器交替更新，也可用于难例合成、风格定制和感知训练数据的定向扩充，但需加入交通要素一致性检查。

title: WAM-Flow: Parallel Coarse-to-Fine Motion Planning via Discrete Flow Matching for Autonomous Driving
abstract: We introduce WAM-Flow, a vision-language-action (VLA) model that casts ego-trajectory planning as discrete flow matching over a structured token space. In contrast to autoregressive decoders, WAM-Flow performs fully parallel, bidirectional denoising, enabling coarse-to-fine refinement with a tunable compute-accuracy trade-off. Specifically, the approach combines a metric-aligned numerical tokenizer that preserves scalar geometry via triplet-margin learning, a geometry-aware flow objective and a simulator-guided GRPO alignment that integrates safety, ego progress, and comfort rewards while retaining parallel generation. A multi-stage adaptation converts a pre-trained auto-regressive backbone (Janus-1.5B) from causal decoding to non-causal flow model and strengthens road-scene competence through continued multimodal pretraining. Thanks to the inherent nature of consistency model training and parallel decoding inference, WAM-Flow achieves superior closed-loop performance against autoregressive and diffusion-based VLA baselines, with 1-step inference attaining 88.7 PDMS and 5-step inference reaching 90.3 PDMS on NAVSIM v1 benchmark. These results establish discrete flow matching as a new promising paradigm for end-to-end autonomous driving.
title_zh: WAM-Flow：面向自动驾驶、基于离散流匹配的并行粗到细运动规划
abstract_zh: 我们提出 WAM-Flow，这是一种 vision-language-action（VLA）模型，将自车轨迹规划建模为结构化 token 空间上的离散流匹配。与自回归解码器不同，WAM-Flow 执行完全并行、双向的去噪，从而支持粗到细的细化，并提供可调的计算-精度权衡。具体而言，该方法结合了通过 triplet-margin 学习保留标量几何信息的度量对齐数值 tokenizer、几何感知的流目标，以及模拟器引导的 GRPO 对齐；后者在保留并行生成的同时，融合安全性、自车行进进度与舒适性奖励。多阶段适配将预训练的自回归骨干模型（Janus-1.5B）从因果解码转换为非因果流模型，并通过持续的多模态预训练增强道路场景能力。得益于一致性模型训练与并行解码推理的固有特性，WAM-Flow 在闭环性能上优于自回归和基于扩散的 VLA 基线；在 NAVSIM v1 基准上，1 步推理达到 88.7 PDMS，5 步推理达到 90.3 PDMS。这些结果确立了离散流匹配作为端到端自动驾驶的一种有前景的新范式。

brief_zh.summary: 自动驾驶端到端规划中，VLA模型常以自回归方式逐token生成轨迹，存在单向因果依赖、难以全局修正且推理步数与精度耦合的问题；扩散式VLA又可能采样成本高、几何约束弱。WAM-Flow将轨迹规划建模为结构化token上的离散流匹配，用完全并行双向去噪实现粗到细细化，并可通过步数调节计算与精度的权衡；设计保留标量几何信息的度量对齐数值tokenizer、几何感知流目标，以及模拟器引导的GRPO对齐，多阶段把Janus-1.5B从因果解码适配为非因果流模型并持续多模态预训练。其关键在于让几何先验与驾驶目标同时约束并行生成的轨迹分布，而不是仅靠末端回归。
brief_zh.method: 以预训练自回归VLA骨干Janus-1.5B为起点，多阶段改造：先做非因果注意力与流匹配目标适配，再用驾驶多模态数据持续预训练；轨迹坐标经triplet-margin约束的数值tokenizer离散化，保留标量几何关系；训练时学习几何感知的离散流场，并用模拟器闭环奖励做GRPO对齐，将安全性、进度、舒适性纳入策略优化；推理从噪声token并行双向去噪，按粗到细逐步细化，一步或五步均可解码，并配合一致性训练减少步数。
brief_zh.driving: 对自动驾驶端到端规划的直接启发是把轨迹生成从串行解码改为可并行的结构化去噪，使规划器能在少量步数内给出粗轨迹并逐步细化，便于车端算力调度；数值tokenizer保留几何量纲，可减少离散化带来的轨迹畸变；GRPO接入仿真奖励，为安全、进度和舒适性提供可调对齐接口，适合在数据闭环中持续微调。

title: Empowering World Models with Reflection for Embodied Video Prediction
abstract: Video generation models have made significant progress in simulating future states, showcasing their potential as world simulators in embodied scenarios. However, existing models often lack robust understanding, limiting their ability to perform multi-step predictions or handle Out-of-Distribution (OOD) scenarios. To address this challenge, we propose the Reflection of Generation (RoG), a set of intermediate reasoning strategies designed to enhance video prediction. It leverages the complementary strengths of pre-trained vision-language and video generation models, enabling them to function as a world model in embodied scenarios. To support RoG, we introduce Embodied Video Anticipation Benchmark(EVA-Bench), a comprehensive benchmark that evaluates embodied world models across diverse tasks and scenarios, utilizing both in-domain and OOD datasets. Building on this foundation, we devise a world model, Embodied Video Anticipator (EVA), that follows a multistage training paradigm to generate high-fidelity video frames and apply an autoregressive strategy to enable adaptive generalization for longer video sequences. Extensive experiments demonstrate the efficacy of EVA in various downstream tasks like video generation and robotics, thereby paving the way for large-scale pre-trained models in real-world video prediction applications. The video demos are available at https://sites.google.com/view/icml-eva.
title_zh: 以反思增强世界模型，实现具身视频预测
abstract_zh: 视频生成模型在模拟未来状态方面取得了显著进展，展现了其作为具身场景中世界模拟器的潜力。然而，现有模型往往缺乏稳健的理解能力，限制了其执行多步预测或处理分布外（Out-of-Distribution，OOD）场景的能力。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了生成反思（Reflection of Generation，RoG），这是一组旨在增强视频预测的中间推理策略。它利用预训练视觉-语言模型与视频生成模型的互补优势，使二者能够在具身场景中充当世界模型。为支持 RoG，我们引入了具身视频预测基准（Embodied Video Anticipation Benchmark，EVA-Bench），这是一个综合基准，利用域内和 OOD 数据集，在不同任务和场景中评估具身世界模型。在此基础上，我们设计了一个世界模型——具身视频预测器（Embodied Video Anticipator，EVA），它采用多阶段训练范式生成高保真视频帧，并应用自回归策略为更长的视频序列实现自适应泛化。大量实验证明，EVA 在视频生成和机器人等各类下游任务中均有效，从而为大规模预训练模型在真实世界视频预测应用中的发展铺平道路。视频演示见 https://sites.google.com/view/icml-eva。

brief_zh.summary: 具身场景的视频世界模型虽能生成未来画面，但往往只做被动像素外推，缺乏对任务、物体和物理关系的显式理解，导致多步预测误差累积，遇到分布外场景容易失效。论文提出生成反思（RoG），在生成前后引入由视觉语言模型完成的中间推理，让VLM负责场景理解与结果检查，视频生成模型负责细粒度未来演化，两者互补构成世界模型；同时构建覆盖域内与OOD任务的EVA-Bench，并据此设计EVA，以多阶段训练生成高保真帧，再用自回归策略扩展到长序列，使世界模型从单步渲染转向可检验的推理式预测。
brief_zh.method: 先在EVA-Bench上组织域内与OOD的具身视频预测任务，覆盖不同场景和任务长度；EVA采用多阶段训练：先用大规模视频数据学习帧级生成，再针对具身数据适配，推理时把历史帧、动作和语言指令送入模型，生成下一段视频；RoG在生成前让预训练VLM分析当前状态、动作意图和可能后果，形成反思性中间表示，再条件化视频生成器，生成后可用VLM复核并修正；长序列采用自回归滚动预测，将已生成帧回灌作为后续条件。
brief_zh.driving: 对自动驾驶的世界模型与仿真可借鉴：可将VLM的场景理解与视频生成器解耦，前者负责交通参与者意图和风险推理，后者生成多步未来视频，用于预测遮挡区域、构造OOD测试场景；生成前的反思可转化为规划前的风险自检，生成后的复核可用于仿真结果筛选；自回归长序列生成则支持长时交通演化推演，为数据闭环补充稀缺和长尾场景。

title: SOLD: Slot Object-Centric Latent Dynamics Models for Relational Manipulation Learning from Pixels
abstract: Learning a latent dynamics model provides a task-agnostic representation of an agent’s understanding of its environment. Leveraging this knowledge for model-based reinforcement learning (RL) holds the potential to improve sample efficiency over model-free methods by learning from imagined rollouts. Furthermore, because the latent space serves as input to behavior models, the informative representations learned by the world model facilitate efficient learning of desired skills. Most existing methods rely on holistic representations of the environment’s state. In contrast, humans reason about objects and their interactions, predicting how actions will affect specific parts of their surroundings. Inspired by this, we propose Slot-Attention for Object-centric Latent Dynamics (SOLD) , a novel model-based RL algorithm that learns object-centric dynamics models in an unsupervised manner from pixel inputs. We demonstrate that the structured latent space not only improves model interpretability but also provides a valuable input space for behavior models to reason over. Our results show that SOLD outperforms DreamerV3 and TD-MPC2 - state-of-the-art model-based RL algorithms - across a range of multi-object manipulation environments that require both relational reasoning and dexterous control. Videos and code are available at https:// slot-latent-dynamics.github.io.
title_zh: SOLD：面向基于像素的关系操作学习的槽位对象中心潜动力学模型
abstract_zh: 学习潜动力学模型可提供一种与任务无关的表示，用以刻画智能体对其环境的理解。利用这一知识进行基于模型的强化学习（RL），有望通过从想象展开中学习，相比无模型方法提升样本效率。此外，由于潜空间作为行为模型的输入，世界模型所学到的信息丰富表示有助于高效学习所需技能。大多数现有方法依赖于环境状态的整体表示。相比之下，人类会对物体及其交互进行推理，预测动作将如何影响周围环境的特定部分。受此启发，我们提出了用于对象中心潜动力学的槽位注意力（Slot-Attention for Object-centric Latent Dynamics，SOLD），这是一种新颖的基于模型 RL 算法，能够以无监督方式从像素输入中学习对象中心动力学模型。我们证明，结构化潜空间不仅提升了模型可解释性，还为行为模型进行推理提供了有价值的输入空间。结果表明，在需要关系推理和灵巧控制的一系列多物体操作环境中，SOLD 优于 DreamerV3 和 TD-MPC2——当前最先进的基于模型 RL 算法。视频和代码见 https://slot-latent-dynamics.github.io。

brief_zh.summary: 基于像素的基于模型强化学习通常把整幅观测压缩成单一潜状态，难以显式表达多物体及其关系，面对需要关系推理和灵巧控制的操作任务时，动力学预测与策略学习容易相互纠缠，样本效率受限。SOLD提出用槽位注意力从像素中无监督地分解物体，并在对象槽位上学习动作条件动力学，使世界模型能够预测动作如何改变特定物体及其交互；结构化潜空间既提升可解释性，也为行为模型提供更适合关系推理的输入，从而将对象中心表示与想象展开的模型强化学习结合起来。
brief_zh.method: 在多个多物体操作环境中，仅以像素为输入，不提供物体标注或分割监督；编码器配合槽位注意力把场景分解为若干对象槽，槽位经时序模块和动作条件预测器学习下一时刻的槽位状态与奖励、终止信号，形成对象中心潜动力学；行为模型在想象展开中用这些槽位表示学习策略，环境交互数据用于更新世界模型与策略；对照DreamerV3和TD-MPC2等整体状态模型强化学习基线，并在关系推理与灵巧控制任务上做消融，检验槽位结构和动力学建模的作用。
brief_zh.driving: 对自动驾驶的启发是把场景显式分解为车辆、行人、车道等对象槽，并在槽位上学习动作条件动力学，而不是用单一全局特征预测未来；这种结构适合处理交互关系、遮挡和长尾组合，可用于构建可解释的预测式仿真器和规划器内部世界模型；在数据闭环中，对象级槽位还便于定位失败场景、替换或增广特定参与者，降低采集与标注成本。

title: AutoVLA-D: Learn a Trajectory-Geometric Condition from Reasoning for Autonomous Driving VLA
abstract: Autoregressive VLA planning usually predicts continuous trajectories as the final output, but driving instructions often describe actions rather than ego states, which weakens direct conditioning on the final continuous trajectory. We address this gap with TrajCond, which introduces a discrete trajectory-geometric condition for VLA planning. Specifically, we represent TrajCond as a 1D-Brohan differential action trajectory and learn it with a two-stage training framework before final continuous trajectory prediction. With the simultaneous autoregressive generation of discrete and numeric trajectories, we name our method AutoVLA-D (Double). Experiments on NAVSIM navtest, nuScenes, and NeuroNCAP show that discrete trajectories are weaker as direct outputs but more effective as TrajCond, consistently improving final continuous trajectory prediction across closed-loop and open-loop driving benchmarks. Code is available at https://github.com/ShivaTeam/AutoVLA-D.
title_zh: AutoVLA-D：从推理中学习轨迹几何条件，用于自动驾驶 VLA
abstract_zh: 自回归 VLA 规划通常将连续轨迹作为最终输出进行预测，但驾驶指令往往描述动作而非自车状态，这削弱了对最终连续轨迹的直接条件约束。我们通过 TrajCond 弥补这一差距，为 VLA 规划引入一种离散的轨迹几何条件。具体而言，我们将 TrajCond 表示为 1D-Brohan 差分动作轨迹，并在最终连续轨迹预测之前采用两阶段训练框架学习该条件。由于离散轨迹与数值轨迹同时进行自回归生成，我们将方法命名为 AutoVLA-D（Double）。在 NAVSIM navtest、nuScenes 和 NeuroNCAP 上的实验表明，离散轨迹作为直接输出时较弱，但作为 TrajCond 更为有效，在闭环和开环驾驶基准上持续改善最终连续轨迹预测。代码见 https://github.com/ShivaTeam/AutoVLA-D。

brief_zh.summary: 自动驾驶VLA规划器常把连续轨迹直接作为自回归序列的末端输出，但语言指令更多描述转向、加速等动作，而非精确自车状态，导致动作语义与最终轨迹之间缺少显式、可学习的条件桥梁。论文提出TrajCond，将轨迹几何转成离散的1D-Brohan差分动作token，作为连续轨迹预测前的中间条件；模型同时自回归生成离散轨迹与数值轨迹，并以两阶段训练先学习该条件、再生成最终连续轨迹，使动作指令能通过离散几何约束更直接地影响规划结果。其价值在于把动作意图显式落到可校验的轨迹几何上，而非让网络自行隐式对齐。
brief_zh.method: 在NAVSIM、nuScenes和NeuroNCAP等驾驶数据与闭环、开环设置上，将自车轨迹表示为1D-Brohan差分动作序列并离散化为token；模型先根据视觉、语言和历史信息自回归生成TrajCond离散轨迹，再在同一序列中生成连续轨迹参数，形成双输出；训练分两阶段：第一阶段学习离散轨迹几何条件，第二阶段联合或随后适配连续轨迹预测，推理时保留两步自回归过程；对照直接输出连续轨迹或仅用离散轨迹的VLA设置，分析离散条件对最终轨迹的作用。
brief_zh.driving: 对自动驾驶规划的具体帮助是给VLA增加一层可解释的轨迹几何中间表示：先把驾驶指令转成离散的转向、加减速动作序列，再由其条件化连续轨迹，缓解语言到轨迹的语义鸿沟；该结构便于在车端做分阶段校验，离散动作可用于快速粗筛与规则约束，连续轨迹负责平滑输出；在数据闭环中可用离散轨迹token做失败归因、指令重标注和轨迹检索。

title: Merging and Disentangling Views in Visual Reinforcement Learning for Robotic Manipulation
abstract: Vision is well-known for its use in manipulation, especially using visual servoing. To make it robust, multiple cameras are needed to expand the field of view. That is computationally challenging. Merging multiple views and using Q-learning allows the design of more effective representations and optimization of sample efficiency. Such a solution might be expensive to deploy. To mitigate this, we introduce a merge and disentanglement (MAD) algorithm that efficiently merges views to increase sample efficiency while augmenting with single-view features to allow lightweight deployment and ensure robust policies. We demonstrate the efficiency and robustness of our approach using Meta-World and ManiSkill3.
title_zh: 机器人操作视觉强化学习中的视图融合与解耦
abstract_zh: 视觉在机器人操作中的作用广为人知，尤其是在视觉伺服中。为增强其鲁棒性，需要多个相机来扩大视野，但这在计算上具有挑战性。融合多个视图并使用 Q-learning 可以设计更有效的表征并优化样本效率。然而，此类方案部署成本可能较高。为缓解这一问题，我们引入融合与解耦（MAD）算法，该算法高效地融合视图以提高样本效率，同时通过单视图特征进行增强，以支持轻量部署并确保策略的鲁棒性。我们使用 Meta-World 和 ManiSkill3 证明了该方法的效率和鲁棒性。

title: Decentralized Aerial Manipulation of a Cable-Suspended Load Using Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
abstract: This paper presents the first decentralized method to enable real-world 6-DoF manipulation of a cable-suspended load using a team of Micro-Aerial Vehicles (MAVs). Our method leverages multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) to train an outer-loop control policy for each MAV. Unlike state-of-the-art controllers that utilize a centralized scheme, our policy does not require global states, inter-MAV communications, nor neighboring MAV information. Instead, agents communicate implicitly through load pose observations alone, which enables high scalability and flexibility. It also significantly reduces computing costs during inference time, enabling onboard deployment of the policy. In addition, we introduce a new action space design for the MAVs using linear acceleration and body rates. This choice, combined with a robust low-level controller, enables reliable sim-to-real transfer despite significant uncertainties caused by cable tension during dynamic 3D motion. We validate our method in various real-world experiments, including full-pose control under load model uncertainties, showing setpoint tracking performance comparable to the state-of-the-art centralized method. We also demonstrate cooperation amongst agents with heterogeneous control policies, and robustness to the complete in-flight loss of one MAV. Videos of experiments: https://github.com/anonymousCoRL/MDCM_CoRL2025
title_zh: 基于多智能体强化学习的缆绳悬挂负载分布式空中操作
abstract_zh: 本文提出了首个能够在真实世界中利用微型飞行器（Micro-Aerial Vehicles, MAVs）团队对缆绳悬挂负载进行 6-DoF 操作的分布式方法。我们的方法采用多智能体强化学习（MARL）为每架 MAV 训练外环控制策略。与采用集中式方案的先进控制器不同，我们的策略不需要全局状态、MAV 间通信，也不需要邻居 MAV 的信息。相反，智能体仅通过负载位姿观测进行隐式通信，从而实现高度的可扩展性与灵活性。该方法还显著降低了推理时的计算成本，使策略能够机载部署。此外，我们为 MAV 设计了一种新的动作空间，使用线性加速度和机体角速率。这一选择结合稳健的低层控制器，使得尽管动态三维运动过程中缆绳张力会带来显著不确定性，仍能实现可靠的 sim-to-real 迁移。我们在多项真实世界实验中验证了该方法，包括负载模型不确定性下的全位姿控制，并展示了与最先进集中式方法相当的设定点跟踪性能。我们还展示了采用异构控制策略的智能体之间的协作，以及对一架 MAV 在飞行中完全失效的鲁棒性。实验视频：https://github.com/anonymousCoRL/MDCM_CoRL2025

title: R3DM: Enabling Role Discovery and Diversity Through Dynamics Models in Multi-agent Reinforcement Learning
abstract: Multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) has achieved significant progress in large-scale traffic control, autonomous vehicles, and robotics. Drawing inspiration from biological systems where roles naturally emerge to enable coordination, role-based MARL methods have been proposed to enhance cooperation learning for complex tasks. However, existing methods exclusively derive roles from an agent’s past experience during training, neglecting their influence on its future trajectories. This paper introduces a key insight: an agent’s role should shape its future behavior to enable effective coordination. Hence, we propose Role Discovery and Diversity through Dynamics Models (R3DM), a novel role-based MARL framework that learns emergent roles by maximizing the mutual information between agents’ roles, observed trajectories, and expected future behaviors. R3DM optimizes the proposed objective through contrastive learning on past trajectories to first derive intermediate roles that shape intrinsic rewards to promote diversity in future behaviors across different roles through a learned dynamics model. Benchmarking on SMAC and SMACv2 environments demonstrates that R3DM outperforms state-of-the-art MARL approaches, improving multi-agent coordination to increase win rates by up to 20%. The code is available at https://github.com/UTAustin-SwarmLab/R3DM.
title_zh: R3DM：在多智能体强化学习中通过动力学模型实现角色发现与多样性
abstract_zh: 多智能体强化学习（MARL）在大规模交通控制、自动驾驶车辆和机器人领域取得了显著进展。受生物系统中角色自然涌现以实现协调的启发，研究者提出了基于角色的 MARL 方法，以增强复杂任务中的合作学习。然而，现有方法仅根据智能体在训练期间的过往经验来推导角色，忽略了角色对其未来轨迹的影响。本文引入一个关键见解：智能体的角色应当塑造其未来行为，从而实现有效协调。因此，我们提出 R3DM（Role Discovery and Diversity through Dynamics Models），一种新颖的基于角色的 MARL 框架；它通过最大化智能体角色、观测轨迹与预期未来行为之间的互信息来学习涌现角色。R3DM 通过在过去轨迹上进行对比学习来优化所提出的目标，首先推导出中间角色；这些角色借助学习到的动力学模型塑造内在奖励，以促进不同角色在未来行为上的多样性。在 SMAC 和 SMACv2 环境上的基准测试表明，R3DM 优于最先进的 MARL 方法，将多智能体协调性能提升，最高使胜率提高 20%。代码见 https://github.com/UTAustin-SwarmLab/R3DM。

title: ReinboT: Amplifying Robot Visual-Language Manipulation with Reinforcement Learning
abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown great potential in general robotic decision-making tasks via imitation learning. However, the variable quality of training data often constrains the performance of these models. On the other hand, offline Reinforcement Learning (RL) excels at learning robust policy models from mixed-quality data. In this paper, we introduce Reinforced robot GPT (ReinboT), a novel end-to-end VLA model that integrates the RL principle of maximizing cumulative reward. ReinboT achieves a deeper understanding of the data quality distribution by predicting dense returns that capture the nuances of manipulation tasks. The dense return prediction capability enables the robot to generate more robust decision-making actions, oriented towards maximizing future benefits. Extensive experiments show that ReinboT achieves state-of-the-art performance on the CALVIN mixed-quality dataset and exhibits superior few-shot learning and out-of-distribution generalization capabilities in real-world tasks.
title_zh: ReinboT：利用强化学习增强机器人的视觉-语言操作
abstract_zh: Vision-Language-Action（VLA）模型通过模仿学习在通用机器人决策任务中展现出巨大潜力。然而，训练数据质量参差不齐往往制约了这些模型的性能。另一方面，离线强化学习（RL）擅长从混合质量数据中学习稳健的策略模型。本文提出 Reinforced robot GPT（ReinboT），一种新颖的端到端 VLA 模型，融合了最大化累积奖励的 RL 原则。ReinboT 通过预测稠密回报来更深入地理解数据质量分布，这些回报刻画了操作任务的细微差异。稠密回报预测能力使机器人能够生成更稳健、以最大化未来收益为导向的决策动作。大量实验表明，ReinboT 在 CALVIN 混合质量数据集上取得了最先进的性能，并在真实世界任务中展现出卓越的 few-shot 学习与 out-of-distribution（OOD）泛化能力。

title: Mixture-of-World Models: Scaling Multi-Task Reinforcement Learning with Modular Latent Dynamics
abstract: A fundamental challenge in multi-task reinforcement learning (MTRL) is achieving sample efficiency in visual domains where tasks exhibit significant heterogeneity in both observations and dynamics. Model-based RL (MBRL) offers a promising path to sample efficiency through world models, but standard monolithic architectures struggle to capture diverse task dynamics, leading to poor reconstruction and prediction accuracy. We introduce the mixture-of-world models (MoW), a scalable architecture that integrates three key components: i) modular VAEs for task-adaptive visual compression, ii) a hybrid Transformer-based dynamics model combining task-conditioned experts with a shared backbone, and, iii) a gradient-based task clustering strategy for efficient parameter allocation. On the Atari 100k benchmark, **a single MoW agent** (trained once over Atari $26$ games) achieves a mean human-normalized score of $\mathbf{110.4}$%, competitive with the $\mathbf{114.2}$% achieved by the recent STORM-an ensemble of $26$ task-specific models-while requiring $\mathbf{50}$% fewer parameters. On Meta-World, MoW attains a $\mathbf{74.5}$% average success rate within $300$K steps, establishing a new state-of-the-art. These results demonstrate that MoW provides a scalable and parameter-efficient foundation for generalist world models. $('.dropdown-menu a.dropdown-toggle').on('click', function (e) { if (!$(this).next().hasClass('show')) { $(this).parents('.dropdown-menu').first().find('.show').removeClass("show"); } var $subMenu = $(this).next(".dropdown-menu"); $subMenu.toggleClass('show'); $(this).parents('li.nav-item.dropdown.show').on('hidden.bs.dropdown', function (e) { $('.dropdown-submenu .show').removeClass("show"); }); return false; }); Name Change Policy × Requests for name changes in the electronic proceedings will be accepted with no questions asked. title_zh: 世界模型混合（Mixture-of-World Models）：利用模块化潜在动力学扩展多任务强化学习
abstract_zh: 多任务强化学习（MTRL）中的一个根本挑战是：在观测和动力学均呈现显著任务异质性的视觉领域中实现样本效率。基于模型的 RL（MBRL）通过世界模型提供了一条有望提升样本效率的路径，但标准的单体式架构难以捕捉多样的任务动力学，导致重建和预测精度不佳。我们提出 world model 混合（mixture-of-world models，MoW），一种可扩展架构，集成三个关键组件：i）用于任务自适应视觉压缩的模块化 VAE；ii）结合任务条件专家与共享骨干的混合 Transformer 动力学模型；以及 iii）用于高效参数分配的基于梯度的任务聚类策略。在 Atari 100k 基准上，单个 MoW 智能体（在 26 个 Atari 游戏上训练一次）达到 110.4% 的人类归一化平均得分，与近期 STORM——由 26 个任务专用模型组成的集成——所达到的 114.2% 相当，同时所需参数减少 50%。在 Meta-World 上，MoW 在 300K 步内达到 74.5% 的平均成功率，确立了新的最先进水平。这些结果表明，MoW 为通用世界模型提供了可扩展且参数高效的基础。

title: MODULI: Unlocking Preference Generalization via Diffusion Models for Offline Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning
abstract: Multi-objective Reinforcement Learning (MORL) seeks to develop policies that simultaneously optimize multiple conflicting objectives, but it requires extensive online interactions. Offline MORL provides a promising solution by training on pre-collected datasets to generalize to any preference upon deployment. However, real-world offline datasets are often conservatively and narrowly distributed, failing to comprehensively cover preferences, leading to the emergence of out-of-distribution (OOD) preference areas. Existing offline MORL algorithms exhibit poor generalization to OOD preferences, resulting in policies that do not align with preferences. Leveraging the excellent expressive and generalization capabilities of diffusion models, we propose MODULI (Multi-objective Diffusion Planner with Sliding Guidance), which employs a preference-conditioned diffusion model as a planner to generate trajectories that align with various preferences and derive action for decision-making. To achieve accurate generation, MODULI introduces two return normalization methods under diverse preferences for refining guidance. To further enhance generalization to OOD preferences, MODULI proposes a novel sliding guidance mechanism, which involves training an additional slider adapter to capture the direction of preference changes. Incorporating the slider, it transitions from in-distribution (ID) preferences to generating OOD preferences, patching, and extending the incomplete Pareto front. Extensive experiments on the D4MORL benchmark demonstrate that our algorithm outperforms state-of-the-art Offline MORL baselines, exhibiting excellent generalization to OOD preferences.
title_zh: MODULI：利用扩散模型解锁离线多目标强化学习中的偏好泛化
abstract_zh: 多目标强化学习（MORL）旨在开发同时优化多个相互冲突目标的策略，但需要大量在线交互。离线 MORL 提供了一种有前景的解决方案：通过在预先收集的数据集上训练，在部署时泛化到任意偏好。然而，现实世界的离线数据集往往分布保守且覆盖范围狭窄，无法全面覆盖各种偏好，从而导致出现 out-of-distribution（OOD）偏好区域。现有离线 MORL 算法对 OOD 偏好的泛化能力较差，导致所得策略与偏好不一致。借助扩散模型出色的表达能力和泛化能力，我们提出 MODULI（Multi-objective Diffusion Planner with Sliding Guidance），它采用偏好条件扩散模型作为规划器，生成与各种偏好对齐的轨迹，并据此推导用于决策的动作。为实现准确生成，MODULI 引入了两种面向多样偏好的回报归一化方法，以改进引导。为进一步增强对 OOD 偏好的泛化，MODULI 提出一种新颖的滑动引导机制，其中训练一个额外的 slider adapter 来捕捉偏好变化的方向。结合该 slider，MODULI 从 in-distribution（ID）偏好过渡到生成 OOD 偏好，修补并扩展不完整的 Pareto 前沿。在 D4MORL 基准上的大量实验表明，我们的算法优于最先进的离线 MORL 基线，并对 OOD 偏好展现出卓越的泛化能力。

title: TreeGRPO: Tree-Advantage GRPO for Online RL Post-Training of Diffusion Models
abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training is crucial for aligning generative models with human preferences, but its prohibitive computational cost remains a major barrier to widespread adoption. We introduce **TreeGRPO**, a novel RL framework that dramatically improves training efficiency by recasting the denoising process as a search tree. From shared initial noise samples, TreeGRPO strategically branches to generate multiple candidate trajectories while efficiently reusing their common prefixes. This tree-structured approach delivers three key advantages: (1) *High sample efficiency*, achieving better performance under same training samples (2) *Fine-grained credit assignment* via reward backpropagation that computes step-specific advantages, overcoming the uniform credit assignment limitation of trajectory-based methods, and (3) *Amortized computation* where multi-child branching enables multiple policy updates per forward pass. Extensive experiments on both diffusion and flow-based models demonstrate that TreeGRPO achieves **2.4$\times$** faster training} while establishing a superior Pareto frontier in the efficiency-reward trade-off space. Our method consistently outperforms GRPO baselines across multiple benchmarks and reward models, providing a scalable and effective pathway for RL-based visual generative model alignment. title_zh: TreeGRPO：面向扩散模型在线强化学习后训练的树优势 GRPO
abstract_zh: 强化学习（RL）后训练对于使生成模型与人类偏好对齐至关重要，但其高昂的计算成本仍是广泛采用的主要障碍。我们提出 TreeGRPO，一种新颖的 RL 框架，通过将去噪过程重构为搜索树来大幅提升训练效率。从共享的初始噪声样本出发，TreeGRPO 策略性地进行分支以生成多个候选轨迹，同时高效复用它们的公共前缀。这种树结构方法带来三项关键优势：（1）高样本效率，在相同训练样本下取得更优性能；（2）通过奖励反向传播实现细粒度信用分配，计算特定步骤的优势，克服基于轨迹方法中均匀信用分配的局限；（3）摊销计算，多子分支使每次前向传播能够进行多次策略更新。在扩散模型和基于流的模型上的大量实验表明，TreeGRPO 在建立效率-奖励权衡空间中更优 Pareto 前沿的同时，实现了 2.4 倍的训练加速。我们的方法在多个基准和奖励模型上持续优于 GRPO 基线，为基于 RL 的视觉生成模型对齐提供了一条可扩展且有效的路径。项目网站：https://treegrpo.github.io

title: Efficient Reinforcement Learning by Guiding World Models with Non-Curated Data
abstract: Leveraging offline data is a promising way to improve the sample efficiency of online reinforcement learning (RL). This paper expands the pool of usable data for offline-to-online RL by leveraging abundant non-curated data that is reward-free, of mixed quality, and collected across multiple embodiments. Although learning a world model appears promising for utilizing such data, we find that naive fine-tuning fails to accelerate RL training on many tasks. Through careful investigation, we attribute this failure to the distributional shift between offline and online data during fine-tuning. To address this issue and effectively use the offline data, we propose two techniques: i) experience rehearsal and ii) execution guidance. With these modifications, the non-curated offline data substantially improves RL's sample efficiency. Under limited sample budgets, our method achieves nearly twice the aggregate score of learning-from-scratch baselines across 72 visuomotor tasks spanning 6 embodiments. On challenging tasks such as locomotion and robotic manipulation, it outperforms prior methods that utilize offline data by a decent margin. $('.dropdown-menu a.dropdown-toggle').on('click', function (e) { if (!$(this).next().hasClass('show')) { $(this).parents('.dropdown-menu').first().find('.show').removeClass("show"); } var $subMenu = $(this).next(".dropdown-menu"); $subMenu.toggleClass('show'); $(this).parents('li.nav-item.dropdown.show').on('hidden.bs.dropdown', function (e) { $('.dropdown-submenu .show').removeClass("show"); }); return false; }); Name Change Policy × Requests for name changes in the electronic proceedings will be accepted with no questions asked. title_zh: 利用非精选数据引导世界模型的高效强化学习
abstract_zh: 利用离线数据是提升在线强化学习（RL）样本效率的一条有前景的途径。本文通过利用大量非精选数据来扩展可用于 offline-to-online RL 的数据池；这些数据无奖励、质量混合，且采集自多种具身形态。尽管学习世界模型看似有望利用此类数据，但我们发现，朴素的微调无法在许多任务上加速 RL 训练。经过仔细研究，我们将这一失败归因于微调过程中离线数据与在线数据之间的分布偏移。为解决该问题并有效利用离线数据，我们提出两种技术：i）经验重演（experience rehearsal）和 ii）执行引导（execution guidance）。借助这些改进，非精选离线数据显著提升了 RL 的样本效率。在有限的样本预算下，我们的方法在涵盖 6 种具身形态的 72 个视觉运动任务上取得了接近从头学习基线两倍的总体得分。在运动控制和机器人操作等具有挑战性的任务上，我们的方法以可观的优势优于先前利用离线数据的方法。

title: Vid2World: Crafting Video Diffusion Models to Interactive World Models
abstract: World models, which predict future transitions from past observation and action sequences, have shown great promise for improving data efficiency in sequential decision-making. However, existing world models often require extensive domain-specific training and still produce low-fidelity, coarse predictions, limiting their usefulness in complex environments. In contrast, video diffusion models trained on large-scale internet data have demonstrated impressive capabilities in generating high-quality videos that capture diverse real-world dynamics. In this work, we present Vid2World , a general approach for leveraging and transferring pre-trained video diffusion models into interactive world models. To bridge the gap, Vid2World systematically explores video diffusion causalization , reshaping both the architecture and training objective of pre-trained models to enable autoregressive generation. Additionally, it incorporates a causal action guidance mechanism to enhance action controllability in the resulting interactive world models. Extensive experiments across multiple domains, including robot manipulation, 3D game simulation, and open-world navigation, demonstrate that our method offers a scalable and effective pathway for repurposing highly capable video diffusion models into interactive world models. $('.dropdown-menu a.dropdown-toggle').on('click', function (e) { if (!$(this).next().hasClass('show')) { $(this).parents('.dropdown-menu').first().find('.show').removeClass("show"); } var $subMenu = $(this).next(".dropdown-menu"); $subMenu.toggleClass('show'); $(this).parents('li.nav-item.dropdown.show').on('hidden.bs.dropdown', function (e) { $('.dropdown-submenu .show').removeClass("show"); }); return false; }); Name Change Policy × Requests for name changes in the electronic proceedings will be accepted with no questions asked. title_zh: Vid2World：将视频扩散模型打造为交互式世界模型
abstract_zh: 世界模型通过根据过去的观测和动作序列预测未来状态转移，在提升序列决策的数据效率方面展现出巨大潜力。然而，现有世界模型往往需要大量领域特定训练，且仍会产生低保真、粗糙的预测，限制了其在复杂环境中的实用性。相比之下，在大规模互联网数据上训练的视频扩散模型已展现出令人印象深刻的能力，能够生成捕捉多样化真实世界动态的高质量视频。在本工作中，我们提出 Vid2World，一种利用并将预训练视频扩散模型迁移为交互式世界模型的通用方法。为弥合这一差距，Vid2World 系统性地探索视频扩散因果化，重塑预训练模型的架构和训练目标，以实现自回归生成。此外，它引入因果动作引导机制，以增强所得交互式世界模型中的动作可控性。在机器人操作、3D 游戏模拟和开放世界导航等多个领域的广泛实验表明，我们的方法为将能力强大的视频扩散模型改造为交互式世界模型提供了一条可扩展且有效的路径。

title: MAGE: Multi-scale Autoregressive Generation for Offline Reinforcement Learning
abstract: Generative models have gained significant traction in offline reinforcement learning (RL) due to their ability to model complex trajectory distributions. However, existing generation-based approaches still struggle with long-horizon tasks characterized by sparse rewards. Some hierarchical generation methods have been developed to mitigate this issue by decomposing the original problem into shorter-horizon subproblems using one policy and generating detailed actions with another. While effective, these methods often overlook the multi-scale temporal structure inherent in trajectories, resulting in suboptimal performance. To overcome these limitations, we propose MAGE, a Multi-scale Autoregressive GEneration-based offline RL method. MAGE incorporates a condition-guided multi-scale autoencoder to learn hierarchical trajectory representations, along with a multi-scale transformer that autoregressively generates trajectory representations from coarse to fine temporal scales. MAGE effectively captures temporal dependencies of trajectories at multiple resolutions. Additionally, a condition-guided decoder is employed to exert precise control over short-term behaviors. Extensive experiments on five offline RL benchmarks against fifteen baseline algorithms show that MAGE successfully integrates multi-scale trajectory modeling with conditional guidance, generating coherent and controllable trajectories in long-horizon sparse-reward settings. The source code is available at https://github.com/xmu-rl-3dv/MAGE. $('.dropdown-menu a.dropdown-toggle').on('click', function (e) { if (!$(this).next().hasClass('show')) { $(this).parents('.dropdown-menu').first().find('.show').removeClass("show"); } var $subMenu = $(this).next(".dropdown-menu"); $subMenu.toggleClass('show'); $(this).parents('li.nav-item.dropdown.show').on('hidden.bs.dropdown', function (e) { $('.dropdown-submenu .show').removeClass("show"); }); return false; }); Name Change Policy × Requests for name changes in the electronic proceedings will be accepted with no questions asked. title_zh: MAGE：面向离线强化学习的多尺度自回归生成
abstract_zh: 生成模型因其能够对复杂轨迹分布进行建模，在离线强化学习（RL）中获得了广泛关注。然而，现有基于生成的方法在具有稀疏奖励的长时程任务中仍表现不佳。一些分层生成方法通过使用一个策略将原始问题分解为较短时程的子问题，并用另一个策略生成细粒度动作，从而缓解该问题。这些方法虽然有效，但往往忽略了轨迹中固有的多尺度时间结构，导致性能次优。为克服这些局限，我们提出 MAGE，一种基于多尺度自回归生成的离线 RL 方法。MAGE 包含一个条件引导的多尺度自编码器来学习分层轨迹表示，以及一个多尺度 Transformer，从粗到细的时间尺度自回归地生成轨迹表示。MAGE 能在多个分辨率上有效捕捉轨迹的时间依赖关系。此外，采用条件引导解码器对短期行为进行精确控制。在五个离线 RL 基准上针对十五种基线算法的大量实验表明，MAGE 成功地将多尺度轨迹建模与条件引导相结合，在长时程稀疏奖励设置中生成连贯且可控的轨迹。源代码见 https://github.com/xmu-rl-3dv/MAGE。

title: CoDA: From Text-to-Image Diffusion Models to Training-Free Dataset Distillation
abstract: Prevailing Dataset Distillation (DD) methods leveraging generative models confront two fundamental limitations. First, despite pioneering the use of diffusion models in DD and delivering impressive performance, the vast majority of approaches paradoxically require a diffusion model pre-trained on the full target dataset, undermining the very purpose of DD and incurring prohibitive training costs. Second, although some methods turn to general text-to-image models without relying on such target-specific training, they suffer from a significant distributional mismatch, as the web-scale priors encapsulated in these foundation models fail to faithfully capture the target-specific semantics, leading to suboptimal performance. To tackle these challenges, we propose Core Distribution Alignment (CoDA), a framework that enables effective DD using only an off-the-shelf text-to-image model. Our key idea is to first identify the ``intrinsic core distribution'' of the target dataset using a robust density-based discovery mechanism. We then steer the generative process to align the generated samples with this core distribution. By doing so, CoDA effectively bridges the gap between general-purpose generative priors and target semantics, yielding highly representative distilled datasets. Extensive experiments suggest that, without relying on a generative model specifically trained on the target dataset, CoDA achieves performance on par with or even superior to previous methods with such reliance across all benchmarks, including ImageNet-1K and its subsets. Notably, it establishes a new state-of-the-art accuracy of 60.4\% at the 50-images-per-class (IPC) setup on ImageNet-1K. title_zh: CoDA：从文生图扩散模型到免训练数据集蒸馏
abstract_zh: 现有利用生成模型的数据集蒸馏（Dataset Distillation，DD）方法面临两个根本性局限。首先，尽管这些方法开创性地将扩散模型用于 DD 并取得了令人印象深刻的表现，但绝大多数方法却悖论式地需要一个在完整目标数据集上预训练的扩散模型，这削弱了 DD 的根本目的，并带来高昂得令人望而却步的训练成本。其次，尽管一些方法转向使用通用文本到图像模型而无需依赖这种目标特定训练，但它们会遭遇显著的分布不匹配，因为这些基础模型中蕴含的网络规模先验无法忠实捕捉目标特定的语义，从而导致性能次优。为应对这些挑战，我们提出核心分布对齐（Core Distribution Alignment，CoDA），一个仅使用现成文本到图像模型即可实现有效 DD 的框架。我们的核心思想是首先使用稳健的基于密度的发现机制识别目标数据集的“内在核心分布”，然后引导生成过程使生成样本与该核心分布对齐。通过这种方式，CoDA 有效弥合了通用生成先验与目标语义之间的差距，生成具有高度代表性的蒸馏数据集。大量实验表明，在不依赖专门在目标数据集上训练的生成模型的情况下，CoDA 在所有基准（包括 ImageNet-1K 及其子集）上取得了与先前此类依赖方法相当甚至更优的性能。值得注意的是，它在 ImageNet-1K 的每类 50 张图像（images-per-class，IPC）设置下创造了 60.4% 的最新最优准确率。代码见项目主页：https://github.com/zzzlt422/CoDA

title: Flow Matching with Injected Noise for Offline-to-Online Reinforcement Learning
abstract: Generative models have recently demonstrated remarkable success across diverse domains, motivating their adoption as expressive policies in reinforcement learning (RL). While they have shown strong performance in offline RL, particularly where the target distribution is well defined, their extension to online fine-tuning has largely been treated as a direct continuation of offline pre-training, leaving key challenges unaddressed. In this paper, we propose Flow Matching with Injected Noise for Offline-to-Online RL (FINO), a novel method that leverages flow matching-based policies to enhance sample efficiency for offline-to-online RL. FINO facilitates effective exploration by injecting noise into policy training, thereby encouraging a broader range of actions beyond those observed in the offline dataset. In addition to exploration-enhanced flow policy training, we combine an entropy-guided sampling mechanism to balance exploration and exploitation, allowing the policy to adapt its behavior throughout online fine-tuning. Experiments across diverse, challenging tasks demonstrate that FINO consistently achieves superior performance under limited online budgets. $('.dropdown-menu a.dropdown-toggle').on('click', function (e) { if (!$(this).next().hasClass('show')) { $(this).parents('.dropdown-menu').first().find('.show').removeClass("show"); } var $subMenu = $(this).next(".dropdown-menu"); $subMenu.toggleClass('show'); $(this).parents('li.nav-item.dropdown.show').on('hidden.bs.dropdown', function (e) { $('.dropdown-submenu .show').removeClass("show"); }); return false; }); Name Change Policy × Requests for name changes in the electronic proceedings will be accepted with no questions asked. title_zh: 面向离线到在线强化学习的噪声注入流匹配
abstract_zh: 生成模型近来在多个领域取得了显著成功，推动其被用作强化学习（RL）中表达能力强的策略。尽管它们在离线 RL 中表现出色，尤其是在目标分布定义明确的情况下，但将其扩展到在线微调在很大程度上仍被视为离线预训练的直接延续，关键挑战尚未得到解决。本文提出用于离线到在线 RL 的噪声注入流匹配（Flow Matching with Injected Noise，FINO），这是一种新颖方法，利用基于流匹配的策略提升离线到在线 RL 的样本效率。FINO 通过在策略训练中注入噪声来促进有效探索，从而鼓励产生离线数据集中未曾观察到的更广泛动作。除了探索增强的流策略训练外，我们还结合熵引导采样机制来平衡探索与利用，使策略能够在整个在线微调过程中自适应调整其行为。在多样且具有挑战性的任务上的实验表明，FINO 在有限在线预算下始终取得更优性能。

title: $\alpha$-DPO: Robust Preference Alignment for Diffusion Models via $\alpha$ Divergence
abstract: Diffusion models have demonstrated remarkable success in high-fidelity image generation, yet aligning them with human preferences remains challenging. Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) offers a promising framework, but its effectiveness is critically hindered by noisy data arising from mislabeled preference pairs and individual preference pairs. We theoretically show that existing DPO objectives are equivalent to minimizing the Forward Kullback–Leibler (KL) divergence, whose mass-covering nature makes it intrinsically sensitive to such noise. To address this limitation, we propose $\alpha$-DPO, which reformulates preference alignment through the lens of $\alpha$-divergence. This formulation promotes mode-seeking behavior and bounds the influence of outliers, thereby enhancing robustness. Furthermore, we introduce a dynamic scheduling mechanism that adaptively adjusts $\alpha$ according to the observed preference distribution, providing data-aware noise tolerance during training. Extensive experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets validate that $\alpha$-DPO consistently outperforms existing baselines, achieving superior robustness and preference alignment. $('.dropdown-menu a.dropdown-toggle').on('click', function (e) { if (!$(this).next().hasClass('show')) { $(this).parents('.dropdown-menu').first().find('.show').removeClass("show"); } var $subMenu = $(this).next(".dropdown-menu"); $subMenu.toggleClass('show'); $(this).parents('li.nav-item.dropdown.show').on('hidden.bs.dropdown', function (e) { $('.dropdown-submenu .show').removeClass("show"); }); return false; }); Name Change Policy × Requests for name changes in the electronic proceedings will be accepted with no questions asked. title_zh: α-DPO：通过 α 散度实现扩散模型的稳健偏好对齐
abstract_zh: 扩散模型在高保真图像生成方面取得了显著成功，但使其与人类偏好对齐仍具有挑战性。直接偏好优化（Direct Preference Optimization，DPO）提供了一个有前景的框架，但其有效性受到噪声数据的严重制约，这些噪声来自错误标注的偏好对和个体偏好对。我们从理论上表明，现有 DPO 目标等价于最小化前向 Kullback–Leibler（KL）散度，其质量覆盖（mass-covering）特性使其本质上对此类噪声敏感。为克服这一局限，我们提出 α-DPO，它从 α 散度的视角重新表述偏好对齐。该表述促进模式寻求行为并限制离群点的影响，从而增强稳健性。此外，我们引入动态调度机制，根据观察到的偏好分布自适应调整 α，在训练期间提供数据感知的噪声容忍度。在合成和真实世界数据集上的大量实验验证，α-DPO 始终优于现有基线，实现了更优的稳健性和偏好对齐。

title: Retaining Suboptimal Actions to Follow Shifting Optima in Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
abstract: Value decomposition is a core approach for cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL). However, existing methods still rely on a single optimal action and struggle to adapt when the underlying value function shifts during training, often converging to suboptimal policies. To address this limitation, we propose Successive Sub-value Q-learning (S2Q), which learns multiple sub-value functions to retain alternative high-value actions. Incorporating these sub-value functions into a Softmax-based behavior policy, S2Q encourages persistent exploration and enables $Q^{\text{tot}}$ to adjust quickly to the changing optima. Experiments on challenging MARL benchmarks confirm that S2Q consistently outperforms various MARL algorithms, demonstrating improved adaptability and overall performance. Our code is available at https://github.com/hyeon1996/S2Q. $('.dropdown-menu a.dropdown-toggle').on('click', function (e) { if (!$(this).next().hasClass('show')) { $(this).parents('.dropdown-menu').first().find('.show').removeClass("show"); } var $subMenu = $(this).next(".dropdown-menu"); $subMenu.toggleClass('show'); $(this).parents('li.nav-item.dropdown.show').on('hidden.bs.dropdown', function (e) { $('.dropdown-submenu .show').removeClass("show"); }); return false; }); Name Change Policy × Requests for name changes in the electronic proceedings will be accepted with no questions asked.
