title_zh: STAIRS-Former：用于离线多任务多智能体强化学习的交错递归结构时空注意力 Transformer
abstract_zh: 使用多任务数据集的离线多智能体强化学习（MARL）具有挑战性，原因在于不同任务中的智能体数量各异，而且需要泛化到未见场景。先前工作采用带有观测 token 化和分层技能学习的 Transformer 来应对这些问题。然而，它们未能充分利用 Transformer 注意力机制进行智能体间协调，并且依赖单一历史 token，这限制了其在部分可观测 MARL 设置中捕捉长时程时间依赖关系的能力。本文提出 STAIRS-Former，一种融合空间与时间层级结构的 Transformer 架构，能够有效关注关键 token，同时捕捉长交互历史。我们进一步引入 token dropout，以增强在不同智能体数量下的鲁棒性和泛化能力。在 SMAC、SMAC-v2、MPE 和 MaMuJoCo 等多个多智能体基准上使用多任务数据集进行的大量实验表明，STAIRS-Former 始终优于先前方法，并取得了新的最先进性能。

title: Steering Your Diffusion Policy with Latent Space Reinforcement Learning
abstract: Robotic control policies learned from human demonstrations have achieved impressive results in many real-world applications. However, in scenarios where initial performance is not satisfactory, as is often the case in novel open-world settings, such behavioral cloning (BC)-learned policies typically require collecting additional human demonstrations to further improve their behavior—an expensive and time-consuming process. In contrast, reinforcement learning (RL) holds the promise of enabling autonomous online policy improvement, but often falls short of achieving this due to the large number of samples it typically requires. In this work we take steps towards enabling fast autonomous adaptation of BC-trained policies via efficient real-world RL. Focusing in particular on diffusion policies—a state-of-the-art BC methodology—we propose *diffusion steering via reinforcement learning* (DSRL): adapting the BC policy by running RL over its latent-noise space. We show that DSRL is highly sample efficient, requires only black-box access to the BC policy, and enables effective real-world autonomous policy improvement. Furthermore, DSRL avoids many of the challenges associated with finetuning diffusion policies, obviating the need to modify the weights of the base policy at all. We demonstrate DSRL on simulated benchmarks, real-world robotic tasks, and for adapting pretrained generalist policies, illustrating its sample efficiency and effective performance at real-world policy improvement.
title_zh: 通过潜空间强化学习引导扩散策略
abstract_zh: 从人类演示中学习到的机器人控制策略已在许多真实世界应用中取得令人瞩目的成果。然而，在初始性能不理想的场景中——这在新颖的开放世界环境中很常见——这类通过行为克隆（BC）学习得到的策略通常需要收集额外的人类演示来进一步改进其行为，而这一过程既昂贵又耗时。相比之下，强化学习（RL）有望实现自主的在线策略改进，但通常由于需要大量样本而难以实现。本工作通过高效的现实世界 RL，朝着实现 BC 训练策略的快速自主适应迈出一步。我们特别关注扩散策略——一种最先进的 BC 方法——并提出通过强化学习的扩散引导（DSRL）：在其潜噪声空间上运行 RL 来使 BC 策略自适应。我们表明，DSRL 具有很高的样本效率，仅需对 BC 策略的黑盒访问，并能实现有效的现实世界自主策略改进。此外，DSRL 避免了微调扩散策略带来的许多挑战，完全无需修改基础策略的权重。我们在仿真基准、真实机器人任务以及适配预训练通用策略上展示了 DSRL，说明了其样本效率以及在现实世界策略改进中的有效性能。

title: Geometric Red-Teaming for Robotic Manipulation
abstract: Standard evaluation protocols in robotic manipulation typically assess policy performance over curated, in-distribution test sets, offering limited insight into how systems fail under plausible variation. We introduce a red-teaming framework that probes robustness through object-centric geometric perturbations, automatically generating CrashShapes—structurally valid, user-constrained mesh deformations that trigger catastrophic failures in pre-trained manipulation policies. The method integrates a Jacobian field–based deformation model with a gradient-free, simulator-in-the-loop optimization strategy. Across insertion, articulation, and grasping tasks, our approach consistently discovers deformations that collapse policy performance, revealing brittle failure modes missed by static benchmarks. By combining task-level policy rollouts with constraint-aware shape exploration, we aim to build a general purpose framework for structured, object-centric robustness evaluation in robotic manipulation. We additionally show that fine-tuning on individual CrashShapes, a process we refer to as blue-teaming, improves task success by up to 60 percentage points on those shapes, while preserving performance on the original object, demonstrating the utility of red-teamed geometries for targeted policy refinement. Finally, we validate both red-teaming and blue-teaming results with a real robotic arm, observing that simulated CrashShapes reduce task success from 90% to as low as 22.5%, and that blue-teaming recovers performance to up to 90% on the corresponding real-world geometry—closely matching simulation outcomes.
title_zh: 面向机器人操作的几何红队测试
abstract_zh: 机器人操作中的标准评估协议通常在被精心整理、分布内的测试集上评估策略性能，对系统在合理变化下如何失败提供的洞见有限。我们提出一种红队测试框架，通过以对象为中心的几何扰动来探查鲁棒性，自动生成 CrashShapes——结构有效、受用户约束的网格形变，这些形变会触发预训练操作策略的灾难性失败。该方法将基于 Jacobian 场的形变模型与无梯度、仿真器在环的优化策略相结合。在插入、铰接物体操作和抓取任务中，我们的方法一致地发现使策略性能崩溃的形变，揭示静态基准遗漏的脆弱失效模式。通过将任务级策略 rollout 与约束感知的形状探索相结合，我们旨在构建一个通用框架，用于机器人操作中结构化、以对象为中心的鲁棒性评估。我们还表明，在单个 CrashShapes 上微调（我们将该过程称为 blue-teaming）可使这些形状上的任务成功率提高最多 60 个百分点，同时保持原始对象上的性能，展示了红队测试生成的几何形状在定向策略改进中的效用。最后，我们用真实机械臂验证了红队测试和 blue-teaming 的结果，观察到仿真中的 CrashShapes 可使任务成功率从 90% 降至最低 22.5%，而 blue-teaming 可将对应真实世界几何形状上的性能恢复至最高 90%，与仿真结果高度吻合。

title: O$^3$Afford: One-Shot 3D Object-to-Object Affordance Grounding for Generalizable Robotic Manipulation
abstract: Grounding object affordance is fundamental to robotic manipulation as it establishes the critical link between perception and action among interacting objects. However, prior works predominantly focus on predicting single-object affordance, overlooking the fact that most real-world interactions involve relationships between pairs of objects. In this work, we address the challenge of object-to-object affordance grounding under limited data. Inspired by recent advances in few-shot learning with 2D vision foundation models, we propose a novel one-shot 3D object-to-object affordance learning approach for robotic manipulation. Semantic features from vision foundation models combined with point cloud representation for geometric understanding enable our one-shot learning pipeline to generalize effectively to novel objects and categories. We further integrate our 3D affordance representation with large language models (LLMs) for optimization-based motion planning, significantly enhancing LLMs’ capability to comprehend and reason about object interactions when generating task-specific constraint functions. Our experiments on 3D object-to-object affordance grounding and robotic manipulation demonstrate that our O$^3$Afford significantly outperforms existing baselines in terms of both accuracy and generalization capability.
title_zh: O$^3$Afford：面向可泛化机器人操作的单样本 3D 物体间可供性定位
abstract_zh: 物体可供性定位是机器人操作的基础，因为它建立了交互物体之间感知与行动的关键联系。然而，先前工作主要关注单物体可供性，忽略了大多数真实世界交互涉及成对物体之间的关系。本文研究有限数据条件下的物体间可供性定位难题。受 2D 视觉基础模型在少样本学习方面最新进展的启发，我们提出一种面向机器人操作的新型单样本 3D 物体间可供性学习方法。将视觉基础模型的语义特征与用于几何理解的点云表示相结合，使我们的单样本学习流程能够有效泛化到新物体和新类别。我们进一步将 3D 可供性表示与大语言模型（LLMs）集成，用于基于优化的运动规划，显著增强 LLMs 在生成任务特定约束函数时理解和推理物体交互的能力。在 3D 物体间可供性定位和机器人操作上的实验表明，O$^3$Afford 在准确性和泛化能力方面均显著优于现有基线。

title: 3DS-VLA: A 3D Spatial-Aware Vision Language Action Model for Robust Multi-Task Manipulation
abstract: Recently, 2D vision-language-action (VLA) models have made significant strides in multi-task manipulation. However, these models struggle to reason about 3D spatial relationships from 2D image inputs. Although an increasing number of 3D approaches explicitly integrate 3D information, they encounter challenges such as limited availability of large-scale 3D datasets and loss of spatial information during input processing. Meanwhile, existing policies typically focus on the perception-to-action learning paradigm, lacking an explicit understanding of the spatial and temporal relationships between the robot and its environment. To address this, we propose 3DS-VLA, which enhances pretrained 2D vision-language models (VLMs) with comprehensive 3D awareness, enabling the prediction of robust end-effector poses. Specifically, we enable a 2D vision encoder to encode both 2D images and 3D spatial observation by introducing a 2D-to-3D positional alignment mechanism. This allows 3DS-VLA to leverage the large-scale pre-trained knowledge of the VLM for effective reasoning in complex 3D robotic environments. Furthermore, to better understand the spatiotemporal relationship between 3D observations and robot behavior, we guide the model to learn the introduced sequential 3D spatial constraints, which define affordance-relevant 3D keypoints on objects, ensuring robust interactions. Experiments in simulated and real-world demonstrate that 3DS-VLA outperforms previous state-of-the-art policies and showcase its generalizable capabilities across multi-task, multi-embodiment, and diverse environmental settings.
title_zh: 3DS-VLA：面向鲁棒多任务操作的 3D 空间感知视觉-语言-动作模型
abstract_zh: 最近，2D 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在多任务操作方面取得了显著进展。然而，这些模型难以从 2D 图像输入中推理 3D 空间关系。尽管越来越多的 3D 方法显式集成 3D 信息，但它们面临大规模 3D 数据集可用性有限以及输入处理过程中空间信息丢失等挑战。同时，现有策略通常聚焦于从感知到动作的学习范式，缺乏对机器人与其环境之间空间和时间关系的显式理解。为此，我们提出 3DS-VLA，通过全面的 3D 感知能力增强预训练 2D 视觉-语言模型（VLMs），从而实现稳健的末端执行器位姿预测。具体而言，我们通过引入 2D 到 3D 的位置对齐机制，使 2D 视觉编码器能够同时编码 2D 图像和 3D 空间观测。这使 3DS-VLA 能够利用 VLM 的大规模预训练知识，在复杂 3D 机器人环境中进行有效推理。此外，为了更好地理解 3D 观测与机器人行为之间的时空关系，我们引导模型学习所引入的序列化 3D 空间约束；这些约束在物体上定义与可供性相关的 3D 关键点，从而确保稳健交互。仿真和真实世界实验表明，3DS-VLA 优于先前最先进的策略，并展示了其在多任务、多具身和多样化环境设置下的泛化能力。

title: MoTo: A Zero-shot Plug-in Interaction-aware Navigation for General Mobile Manipulation
abstract: Mobile manipulation is the fundamental challenge for robotics in assisting humans with diverse tasks and environments in everyday life. Conventional mobile manipulation approaches often struggle to generalize across different tasks and environments due to the lack of large-scale training. However, recent advances in manipulation foundation models demonstrate impressive generalization capability on a wide range of fixed-base manipulation tasks, which are still limited to a fixed setting. Therefore, we devise a plug-in module named MoTo, which can be combined with any off-the-shelf manipulation foundation model to empower them with mobile manipulation ability. Specifically, we propose an interaction-aware navigation policy to generate agent docking points for generalized mobile manipulation. To enable zero-shot ability, we propose an interaction keypoints framework via vision-language models (VLM) under multi-view consistency for both target object and robotic arm following instructions, where fixed-base manipulation foundation models can be employed. We further propose motion planning objectives for the mobile base and robot arm, which minimize the distance between the two keypoints and maintain the physical feasibility of trajectories. In this way, MoTo guides the agent to move to the docking points where fixed-base manipulation can be successfully performed, and leverages VLM generation and trajectory optimization to achieve mobile manipulation in a zero-shot manner, without any requirement on mobile manipulation expert data. Extensive experimental results on OVMM and real-world demonstrate that MoTo achieves success rates of 2.68% and 16.67% higher than the state-of-the-art mobile manipulation methods, respectively, without requiring additional training data.
title_zh: MoTo：面向通用移动操作的零样本即插即用交互感知导航
abstract_zh: 移动操作是机器人技术在日常生活中协助人类完成多样任务和适应多种环境的基础性挑战。传统移动操作方法通常因缺乏大规模训练而难以在不同任务和环境之间泛化。然而，操作基础模型的最新进展在广泛的固定基座操作任务上展现出令人瞩目的泛化能力，但仍局限于固定设置。因此，我们设计了一个名为 MoTo 的即插即用模块，可与任何现成的操作基础模型结合，赋予其移动操作能力。具体而言，我们提出一种交互感知导航策略，为通用移动操作生成智能体停靠点。为实现零样本能力，我们提出一种交互关键点框架：在多视图一致性约束下，利用视觉-语言模型（VLM）根据指令为目标物体和机械臂建立交互关键点，从而可采用固定基座的操作基础模型。我们进一步为移动基座和机械臂提出运动规划目标，以最小化这两个关键点之间的距离，并保持轨迹的物理可行性。通过这种方式，MoTo 引导智能体移动到能够成功执行固定基座操作的停靠点，并利用 VLM 生成和轨迹优化以零样本方式实现移动操作，且不要求任何移动操作专家数据。在 OVMM 和真实世界上的大量实验结果表明，在无需额外训练数据的情况下，MoTo 的成功率分别比最先进的移动操作方法高出 2.68% 和 16.67%。

title: KineDex: Learning Tactile-Informed Visuomotor Policies via Kinesthetic Teaching for Dexterous Manipulation
abstract: Collecting demonstrations enriched with fine-grained tactile information is critical for dexterous manipulation, particularly in contact-rich tasks that require precise force control and physical interaction. While prior works primarily focus on teleoperation or video-based retargeting, they often suffer from kinematic mismatches and the absence of real-time tactile feedback, hindering the acquisition of high-fidelity tactile data. To mitigate this issue, we propose KineDex, a hand-over-hand kinesthetic teaching paradigm in which the operator’s motion is directly transferred to the dexterous hand, enabling the collection of physically grounded demonstrations enriched with accurate tactile feedback. To resolve occlusions from human hand, we apply inpainting technique to preprocess the visual observations. Based on these demonstrations, we then train a visuomotor policy using tactile-augmented inputs and implement force control during deployment for precise contact-rich manipulation. We evaluate KineDex on a suite of challenging contact-rich manipulation tasks, including particularly difficult scenarios such as squeezing toothpaste onto a toothbrush, which require precise multi-finger coordination and stable force regulation. Across these tasks, KineDex achieves an average success rate of 74.4%, representing a 57.7% improvement over the variant without force control. Comparative experiments with teleoperation and user studies further validate the advantages of KineDex in data collection efficiency and operability. Specifically, KineDex collects data over twice as fast as teleoperation across two tasks of varying difficulty, while maintaining a near-100% success rate, compared to under 50% for teleoperation.
title_zh: KineDex：通过动觉示教学习触觉信息引导的视觉运动策略，用于灵巧操作
abstract_zh: 收集富含细粒度触觉信息的演示对于灵巧操作至关重要，尤其是在需要精确力控制和物理交互的接触密集型任务中。尽管先前工作主要关注遥操作或基于视频的重定向，但它们常受运动学不匹配和缺乏实时触觉反馈的影响，妨碍了高保真触觉数据的获取。为缓解该问题，我们提出 KineDex，一种手把手动觉示教范式，其中操作者的运动被直接传递到灵巧手，从而能够收集富含准确触觉反馈、具有物理基础的演示。为解决人手造成的遮挡，我们采用图像修复技术预处理视觉观测。基于这些演示，我们使用触觉增强输入训练视觉运动策略，并在部署期间实施力控制，以实现精确的接触密集型操作。我们在一系列具有挑战性的接触密集型操作任务上评估 KineDex，包括将牙膏挤到牙刷上等特别困难的场景，这些任务需要精确的多指协调和稳定的力调节。在这些任务上，KineDex 平均成功率达到 74.4%，相比未使用力控制的变体提升了 57.7%。与遥操作的对比实验和用户研究进一步验证了 KineDex 在数据收集效率和可操作性方面的优势。具体而言，在两个难度不同的任务中，KineDex 的数据收集速度是遥操作的两倍以上，同时保持接近 100% 的成功率，而遥操作的成功率低于 50%。

title: A Sharper Global Convergence Analysis for Average Reward Reinforcement Learning via an Actor-Critic Approach
abstract: This work examines average-reward reinforcement learning with general policy parametrization. Existing state-of-the-art (SOTA) guarantees for this problem are either suboptimal or hindered by several challenges, including poor scalability with respect to the size of the state-action space, high iteration complexity, and a significant dependence on knowledge of mixing times and hitting times. To address these limitations, we propose a Multi-level Monte Carlo-based Natural Actor-Critic (MLMC-NAC) algorithm. Our work is the first to achieve a global convergence rate of $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(1/\sqrt{T})$ for average-reward Markov Decision Processes (MDPs) (where $T$ is the horizon length), using an Actor-Critic approach. Moreover, the convergence rate does not scale with the size of the state space, therefore even being applicable to infinite state spaces.
title_zh: 基于 Actor-Critic 方法的平均奖励强化学习更紧的全局收敛性分析
abstract_zh: 这项工作研究了具有通用策略参数化的平均奖励强化学习。该问题现有的最先进（SOTA）保证要么是次优的，要么受到若干挑战的制约，包括随状态-动作空间规模扩展性差、迭代复杂度高，以及对混合时间和命中时间知识的显著依赖。为解决这些局限，我们提出一种基于多层蒙特卡洛的自然 Actor-Critic（MLMC-NAC）算法。我们的工作首次使用 Actor-Critic 方法，在平均奖励马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）上实现了 $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(1/\sqrt{T})$ 的全局收敛速率（其中 $T$ 为时域长度）。此外，该收敛速率不随状态空间规模增长，因此甚至适用于无限状态空间。

title: Adaptive Median Smoothing: Adversarial Defense for Unlearned Text-to-Image Diffusion Models at Inference Time
abstract: Text-to-image (T2I) diffusion models have raised concerns about generating inappropriate content, such as " nudity ". Despite efforts to erase undesirable concepts through unlearning techniques, these unlearned models remain vulnerable to adversarial inputs that can potentially regenerate such content. To safeguard unlearned models, we propose a novel inference-time defense strategy that mitigates the impact of adversarial inputs. Specifically, we first reformulate the challenge of ensuring robustness in unlearned diffusion models as a robust regression problem. Building upon the naive median smoothing for regression robustness, which employs isotropic Gaussian noise, we develop a generalized median smoothing framework that incorporates anisotropic noise. Based on this framework, we introduce a token-wise Adaptive Median Smoothing method that dynamically adjusts noise intensity according to each token’s relevance to target concepts. Furthermore, to improve inference efficiency, we explore implementations of this adaptive method at the text-encoding stage. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach enhances adversarial robustness while preserving model utility and inference efficiency, outperforming baseline defense techniques.
title_zh: 自适应中值平滑：针对经遗忘处理的文本到图像扩散模型的推理时对抗防御
abstract_zh: 文本到图像（T2I）扩散模型引发了人们对其生成不当内容（例如“裸露”）的担忧。尽管已通过遗忘技术努力擦除不良概念，这些经遗忘处理的模型仍易受到对抗输入的威胁，后者可能重新生成此类内容。为保护经遗忘处理的模型，我们提出一种新颖的推理时防御策略，以减轻对抗输入的影响。具体而言，我们首先将确保经遗忘扩散模型鲁棒性的挑战重新表述为一个鲁棒回归问题。基于用于回归鲁棒性的朴素中值平滑（其采用各向同性高斯噪声），我们开发了一个引入各向异性噪声的广义中值平滑框架。基于该框架，我们提出一种逐 token 的自适应中值平滑方法，可根据每个 token 与目标概念的相关性动态调整噪声强度。此外，为提高推理效率，我们探索了该自适应方法在文本编码阶段的实现方式。大量实验表明，我们的方法在增强对抗鲁棒性的同时保持了模型效用和推理效率，优于基线防御技术。

title: Mastering Massive Multi-Task Reinforcement Learning via Mixture-of-Expert Decision Transformer
abstract: Despite recent advancements in offline multi-task reinforcement learning (MTRL) have harnessed the powerful capabilities of the Transformer architecture, most approaches focus on a limited number of tasks, with scaling to extremely massive tasks remaining a formidable challenge. In this paper, we first revisit the key impact of task numbers on current MTRL method, and further reveal that naively expanding the parameters proves insufficient to counteract the performance degradation as the number of tasks escalates. Building upon these insights, we propose M3DT, a novel mixture-of-experts (MoE) framework that tackles task scalability by further unlocking the model’s parameter scalability. Specifically, we enhance both the architecture and the optimization of the agent, where we strengthen the Decision Transformer (DT) backbone with MoE to reduce task load on parameter subsets, and introduce a three-stage training mechanism to facilitate efficient training with optimal performance. Experimental results show that, by increasing the number of experts, M3DT not only consistently enhances its performance as model expansion on the fixed task numbers, but also exhibits remarkable task scalability, successfully extending to 160 tasks with superior performance.
title_zh: 通过混合专家 Decision Transformer 掌握大规模多任务强化学习
abstract_zh: 尽管离线多任务强化学习（MTRL）的最新进展已利用 Transformer 架构的强大能力，但大多数方法仍聚焦于数量有限的任务，扩展到极其海量的任务仍是一项艰巨挑战。本文首先重新审视任务数量对当前 MTRL 方法的关键影响，并进一步揭示：随着任务数量增加，单纯扩大参数不足以抵消性能下降。基于这些洞见，我们提出 M3DT，一种新颖的混合专家（MoE）框架，通过进一步释放模型的参数可扩展性来应对任务可扩展性问题。具体而言，我们同时增强了智能体的架构与优化：用 MoE 强化 Decision Transformer（DT）主干，以降低参数子集上的任务负载；并引入三阶段训练机制，以高效训练并实现最优性能。实验结果表明，通过增加专家数量，M3DT 不仅在固定任务数量下随模型扩展而持续提升性能，还展现出显著的任务可扩展性，成功扩展到 160 个任务并取得更优性能。

title: Revisiting Cooperative Off-Policy Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
abstract: Cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) has become a critical tool for addressing complex real-world problems. However, off-policy MARL methods, which rely on joint Q-functions, face significant scalability challenges due to the exponentially growing joint action space. In this work, we highlight a critical yet often overlooked issue: erroneous Q-target estimation, primarily caused by extrapolation error. Our analysis reveals that this error becomes increasingly severe as the number of agents grows, leading to unique challenges in MARL due to its expansive joint action space and the decentralized execution paradigm. To address these challenges, we propose a suite of techniques tailored for off-policy MARL, including annealed multi-step bootstrapping, averaged Q-targets, and restricted action representation. Experimental results demonstrate that these methods effectively mitigate erroneous estimations, yielding substantial performance improvements in challenging benchmarks such as SMAC, SMACv2, and Google Research Football.
title_zh: 重新审视合作式 off-policy 多智能体强化学习
abstract_zh: 合作式多智能体强化学习（MARL）已成为解决复杂现实问题的重要工具。然而，依赖联合 Q 函数的 off-policy MARL 方法，由于联合动作空间呈指数增长，面临显著的可扩展性挑战。本文强调一个关键但常被忽视的问题：错误的 Q 目标估计，其主要由外推误差导致。我们的分析表明，随着智能体数量增加，该误差会愈发严重；由于其庞大的联合动作空间和去中心化执行范式，这会在 MARL 中带来独特挑战。为应对这些挑战，我们提出一套专为 off-policy MARL 设计的技术，包括退火式多步自举、平均 Q 目标以及受限动作表示。实验结果表明，这些方法有效缓解了错误估计，并在 SMAC、SMACv2 和 Google Research Football 等具有挑战性的基准上带来了显著的性能提升。

title: Robust Offline Reinforcement Learning with Linearly Structured $f$-Divergence Regularization
abstract: The Robust Regularized Markov Decision Process (RRMDP) is proposed to learn policies robust to dynamics shifts by adding regularization to the transition dynamics in the value function. Existing methods mostly use unstructured regularization, potentially leading to conservative policies under unrealistic transitions. To address this limitation, we propose a novel framework, the $d$-rectangular linear RRMDP ($d$-RRMDP), which introduces latent structures into both transition kernels and regularization. We focus on offline reinforcement learning, where an agent learns policies from a precollected dataset in the nominal environment. We develop the Robust Regularized Pessimistic Value Iteration (R2PVI) algorithm that employs linear function approximation for robust policy learning in $d$-RRMDPs with $f$-divergence based regularization terms on transition kernels. We provide instance-dependent upper bounds on the suboptimality gap of R2PVI policies, demonstrating that these bounds are influenced by how well the dataset covers state-action spaces visited by the optimal robust policy under robustly admissible transitions. We establish information-theoretic lower bounds to verify that our algorithm is near-optimal. Finally, numerical experiments validate that R2PVI learns robust policies and exhibits superior computational efficiency compared to baseline methods.
title_zh: 基于线性结构化 $f$-散度正则化的鲁棒离线强化学习
abstract_zh: 鲁棒正则化马尔可夫决策过程（RRMDP）通过在价值函数的转移动态中加入正则化，学习对动态偏移具有鲁棒性的策略。现有方法大多采用无结构正则化，可能在不切实际的转移下产生保守策略。为克服这一局限，我们提出一种新颖框架——$d$-矩形线性 RRMDP（$d$-RRMDP），在转移核与正则化中同时引入潜在结构。我们聚焦离线强化学习，即智能体在名义环境中从预先收集的数据集中学习策略。我们开发了鲁棒正则化悲观值迭代（R2PVI）算法，该算法在转移核上带有基于 $f$-散度正则项的 $d$-RRMDP 中采用线性函数逼近进行鲁棒策略学习。我们给出了 R2PVI 策略次优间隙的实例相关上界，表明这些界受数据集对最优鲁棒策略在鲁棒可容许转移下所访问状态-动作空间的覆盖程度影响。我们建立了信息论下界，以验证该算法接近最优。最后，数值实验验证 R2PVI 能学习鲁棒策略，并且相比基线方法具有更优的计算效率。

title: Stealing That Free Lunch: Exposing the Limits of Dyna-Style Reinforcement Learning
abstract: Dyna-style off-policy model-based reinforcement learning (DMBRL) algorithms are a family of techniques for generating synthetic state transition data and thereby enhancing the sample efficiency of off-policy RL algorithms. This paper identifies and investigates a surprising performance gap observed when applying DMBRL algorithms across different benchmark environments with proprioceptive observations. We show that, while DMBRL algorithms perform well in control tasks in OpenAI Gym, their performance can drop significantly in DeepMind Control Suite (DMC), even though these settings offer similar tasks and identical physics backends. Modern techniques designed to address several key issues that arise in these settings do not provide a consistent improvement across all environments, and overall our results show that adding synthetic rollouts to the training process — the backbone of Dyna-style algorithms — significantly degrades performance across most DMC environments. Our findings contribute to a deeper understanding of several fundamental challenges in model-based RL and show that, like many optimization fields, there is no free lunch when evaluating performance across diverse benchmarks in RL.
title_zh: 窃取免费午餐：揭示 Dyna 风格强化学习的局限
abstract_zh: Dyna 风格的 off-policy 基于模型的强化学习（DMBRL）算法是一类通过生成合成状态转移数据来提升 off-policy RL 算法样本效率的技术。本文识别并研究了一个令人意外的性能差距：在不同具有本体感知观测的基准环境中应用 DMBRL 算法时会出现该差距。我们表明，尽管 DMBRL 算法在 OpenAI Gym 的控制任务中表现良好，但在 DeepMind Control Suite（DMC）中性能可能显著下降，即使这些设置提供相似的任务和相同的物理后端。旨在解决这些设置中若干关键问题的现代技术，并未在所有环境中带来一致的改进；总体而言，我们的结果表明，在训练过程中加入合成 rollout——Dyna 风格算法的核心——会在大多数 DMC 环境中显著降低性能。我们的发现有助于更深入理解基于模型的强化学习中的若干基本挑战，并表明，与许多优化领域一样，在强化学习中跨不同基准评估性能时并不存在免费午餐。

title: MaxIM: Maximally Informative Incremental Summarization via Reinforcement Learning
abstract: AI systems must often maintain bounded memory of unbounded interaction histories. However, optimizing the memory representation, and its updates, for downstream task utility is difficult for standard reinforcement learning (RL) due to severe credit assignment bottlenecks induced by sparse, delayed rewards. We introduce MaxIM (Maximally Informative Incremental Memory), a framework that formulates incremental summarization as a capacity-constrained, information-theoretic reward-shaping problem. Grounded in value suboptimality bounds, we show that bounding sequential information loss motivates maximizing the predictive log-likelihood of future, task-relevant targets, a variational lower bound on predictive sufficiency. We introduce a recursive consistency condition to ensure summaries are grounded by maximizing mutual information (MI) with the observed history. We mitigate credit assignment issues with a parameterized asymmetric critic that computes step-wise variational MI bounds for dense reward shaping. Empirical evaluation on long-horizon scientific reading and multi-turn dialogue benchmarks shows that MaxIM outperforms RL, supervised fine-tuning, and prompt-focused baselines on factual grounding, comprehensive autorater metrics, and downstream task utility across strict token budgets and extended horizons, without the need for expensive human preference labels.
comment: Accepted at the 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)
title_zh: MaxIM：通过强化学习实现信息量最大化的增量式摘要
abstract_zh: AI 系统常常需要为无界的交互历史维护有界记忆。然而，由于稀疏且延迟的奖励会引发严重的信用分配瓶颈，标准强化学习（RL）难以为下游任务效用优化记忆表示及其更新。我们提出 MaxIM（Maximally Informative Incremental Memory），一个将增量式摘要建模为容量受限、信息论奖励塑造问题的框架。基于价值次优性界，我们表明，限制序列信息损失会促使最大化未来任务相关目标的预测对数似然，而后者是预测充分性的一个变分下界。我们引入一种递归一致性条件，通过最大化与已观测历史的互信息（MI）来确保摘要具有事实依据。我们使用一个参数化的非对称 critic 缓解信用分配问题，该 critic 计算逐步变分 MI 界，用于稠密奖励塑造。在长时程科学阅读和多轮对话基准上的实证评估表明，在严格的 token 预算和延长的时程下，MaxIM 在事实依据、综合性自动评估器（autorater）指标和下游任务效用方面优于 RL、监督微调以及以提示为中心的基线，且无需昂贵的人工偏好标签。

title: VLA Adaptation with Real and Simulated Data: A Case Study on Robotic Chess
abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models are trained as general-purpose foundation models for robot learning, and require fine-tuning for each downstream task and robot. This raises practical questions such as how much data and training updates are needed, how checkpoints should be selected, and whether simulation can be leveraged to alleviate the cost of real data collection. We study these questions on a task that requires both precise manipulation and spatial understanding of the scene. In this task, an SO-101 arm moves a chess king between two squares that are given only by their names, such as e4 and a5. We fine-tune π_0.5 with various dataset sizes and update budgets, using teleoperated demonstrations as well as simulated demonstrations from a randomized scripted expert that imitates the variability of human demonstrations. In simulation, the success rate scales with both data and updates. Importantly, we find that a short learning-rate cool-down adds up to 31 points and is necessary for comparing checkpoints, and that validation loss and action error are unreliable for model selection. On the real arm, we fine-tune on up to 256 teleoperated demonstrations and evaluate ten policies in 25 trials each. Partial results indicate that pretraining on the simulated demonstrations helps substantially, most clearly when real data is scarce. We also present a negative result, in which training on the policy's own rollouts with filtered behavior cloning, RECAP-style advantage conditioning, corrections from an automatic coach, or residual reinforcement learning did not yield a measurable improvement over plain behavior cloning in our setting. We release the simulator, the expert and the real demonstrations.
comment: CoRL 2026 Workshop "Pretrain to Adapt: What Makes a Pretrained Policy Adaptable?". 8 pages main text, 15 pages total, 15 figures, 4 tables
title_zh: 使用真实与仿真数据进行 VLA 适配：机器人国际象棋案例研究
abstract_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型被训练为面向机器人学习的通用基础模型，并且需要针对每个下游任务和机器人进行微调。这引出了若干实际问题，例如需要多少数据和训练更新、应如何选择检查点，以及能否利用仿真来降低真实数据采集的成本。我们在一个同时要求精确操作和对场景进行空间理解的任务上研究这些问题。在该任务中，SO-101 机械臂要在两个仅以名称指定的方格之间移动国际象棋的王，例如 e4 和 a5。我们使用遥操作演示，以及来自随机化脚本专家的仿真演示（该专家模仿人类演示的变异性），以不同数据集规模和更新预算微调 π_0.5。在仿真中，成功率随数据量和更新次数增加而提升。重要的是，我们发现较短的 learning-rate cool-down 可带来最高 31 个百分点的提升，并且对于检查点比较是必要的；同时，验证损失和动作误差用于模型选择并不可靠。在真实机械臂上，我们使用最多 256 个遥操作演示进行微调，并以每个策略 25 次试验评估十个策略。部分结果表明，在仿真演示上进行预训练有显著帮助，在真实数据稀缺时最为明显。我们还报告了一个负面结果：在我们的设置中，使用策略自身的 rollout 进行训练，并结合过滤式行为克隆、RECAP 风格的优势条件化、来自自动教练的纠正或残差强化学习，均未比普通行为克隆带来可测量的改进。我们发布了仿真器、专家策略和真实演示数据。

title: Animating the Uncaptured: Humanoid Mesh Animation with Video Diffusion Models
abstract: Animation of humanoid characters is essential in various graphics applications, but require significant time and cost to create realistic animations. We propose an approach to synthesize 4D animated sequences of input static 3D humanoid meshes, leveraging strong generalized motion priors from generative video models -- as such video models contain powerful motion information covering a wide variety of human motions. From an input static 3D humanoid mesh and a text prompt describing the desired animation, we synthesize a corresponding video conditioned on a rendered image of the 3D mesh. We then employ an underlying SMPL representation to animate the corresponding 3D mesh according to the video-generated motion, based on our motion optimization. This enables a cost-effective and accessible solution to enable the synthesis of diverse and realistic 4D animations $('.dropdown-menu a.dropdown-toggle').on('click', function (e) { if (!$(this).next().hasClass('show')) { $(this).parents('.dropdown-menu').first().find('.show').removeClass("show"); } var $subMenu = $(this).next(".dropdown-menu"); $subMenu.toggleClass('show'); $(this).parents('li.nav-item.dropdown.show').on('hidden.bs.dropdown', function (e) { $('.dropdown-submenu .show').removeClass("show"); }); return false; }); Name Change Policy × Requests for name changes in the electronic proceedings will be accepted with no questions asked. title_zh: 让未被捕捉之物动起来：基于视频扩散模型的人形网格动画
abstract_zh: 人形角色的动画在各种图形应用中至关重要，但创建逼真的动画需要耗费大量时间和成本。我们提出一种方法，为输入的静态3D人形网格合成4D动画序列，并利用生成式视频模型中强大的泛化运动先验——此类视频模型包含覆盖多种人体运动的强大运动信息。给定静态3D人形网格和描述所需动画的文本提示，我们以该3D网格的渲染图像为条件，合成相应的视频。随后，基于我们的运动优化，采用底层SMPL表示，根据视频生成的运动驱动相应的3D网格。这提供了一种经济高效且易于使用的解决方案，能够合成多样且逼真的4D动画。

title: VIRAL: Visual Sim-to-Real at Scale for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
abstract: A key barrier to the real-world deployment of humanoid robots is the lack of autonomous loco-manipulation skills. We introduce VIRAL, a visual sim-to-real framework that learns humanoid loco-manipulation entirely in simulation and deploys it zero-shot to real hardware. VIRAL follows a teacher-student design: a privileged RL teacher, operating on full state, learns long-horizon loco-manipulation using a delta action space and reference state initialization. A vision-based student policy is then distilled from the teacher via large-scale simulation with tiled rendering, trained with a mixture of online DAgger and behavior cloning. We find that compute scale is critical: scaling simulation to tens of GPUs (up to 64) makes both teacher and student training reliable, while low-compute regimes often fail. To bridge the sim-to-real gap, VIRAL combines large-scale visual domain randomization--over lighting, materials, camera parameters, image quality, and sensor delays--with real-to-sim alignment of the dexterous hand and cameras. Deployed on a Unitree G1 humanoid, the resulting RGB-based policy performs continuous loco-manipulation for up to 54 cycles, generalizing to diverse spatial and appearance variations without any real-world fine-tuning, and approaching expert-level teleoperation performance. Extensive ablations dissect the key design choices required to make RGB-based humanoid loco-manipulation work in practice.
title_zh: VIRAL：面向人形机器人移动操作的大规模视觉仿真到现实迁移
abstract_zh: 人形机器人实际部署的一个关键障碍是缺乏自主的移动操作（loco-manipulation）技能。我们提出VIRAL，一个视觉仿真到现实框架，完全在仿真中学习人形机器人移动操作，并以零样本方式部署到真实硬件。VIRAL采用教师-学生设计：一个基于完整状态运行的特权RL教师，使用增量动作空间和参考状态初始化来学习长时程移动操作。随后，通过大规模仿真和分块渲染，将基于视觉的学生策略从教师中蒸馏出来，并使用在线DAgger与行为克隆的混合方式进行训练。我们发现计算规模至关重要：将仿真扩展到数十块GPU（最多64块）可使教师和学生的训练都变得可靠，而低计算量设置往往失败。为缩小仿真到现实的差距，VIRAL将大规模视觉域随机化（涵盖光照、材质、相机参数、图像质量和传感器延迟）与灵巧手和相机的真实到仿真对齐相结合。部署在Unitree G1人形机器人上，所得基于RGB的策略能够连续执行移动操作长达54个周期，无需任何真实世界微调即可泛化到多样的空间和外观变化，并接近专家级遥操作性能。大量消融实验剖析了使基于RGB的人形机器人移动操作在实际中奏效所需的关键设计选择。

title: StableMTL: Repurposing Latent Diffusion Models for Multi-Task Learning from Partially Annotated Synthetic Datasets
abstract: Multi-task learning for dense prediction is limited by the need for extensive annotation for every task, although recent works have explored training with partial task labels. Leveraging the generalization power of diffusion models, we extend the partial learning setup to a zero-shot setting, training a multi-task model on multiple synthetic datasets, each labeled for only a subset of tasks. Our method, StableMTL, repurposes an image generator for latent regression. Adapting a denoising framework with task encoding, task conditioning and a tailored training scheme. Instead of per-task losses requiring careful balancing, a unified latent loss is adopted, enabling seamless scaling to more tasks. To encourage inter-task synergy, we introduce a multi-stream model with a task-attention mechanism that converts N-to-N task interactions into efficient N-to-one attention, promoting effective cross-task sharing. StableMTL outperforms baselines on 7 tasks across 8 benchmarks.
title_zh: StableMTL：改造潜在扩散模型以用于部分标注合成数据集上的多任务学习
abstract_zh: 密集预测的多任务学习受限于每个任务都需要大量标注，尽管近期工作已探索使用部分任务标签进行训练。借助扩散模型的泛化能力，我们将部分学习设置扩展到零样本场景，在多个合成数据集上训练多任务模型，其中每个数据集仅标注了部分任务。我们的方法StableMTL将图像生成器改造用于潜在回归：采用带有任务编码、任务条件化和定制训练方案的去噪框架。与需要仔细权衡的各任务损失不同，我们采用统一的潜在损失，从而能够无缝扩展到更多任务。为促进任务间协同，我们引入一种多流模型，其任务注意力机制将N-to-N的任务交互转换为高效的N-to-one注意力，促进有效的跨任务共享。StableMTL在8个基准的7项任务上优于基线方法。

title: CME-CAD: Heterogeneous Collaborative Multi-Expert Reinforcement Learning for CAD Code Generation
abstract: Computer-Aided Design (CAD) is essential in industrial design, but the complexity of traditional CAD modeling and workflows presents significant challenges for automating the generation of high-precision, editable CAD models. Existing methods, such as 3D reconstruction from sketches, often produce non-editable, approximate models that fall short of meeting the stringent requirements for precision and editability in industrial design. Moreover, the reliance on text or image-based inputs often requires significant manual annotation, limiting their scalability and applicability in industrial settings. To overcome these challenges, we propose the Heterogeneous Collaborative Multi-Expert Reinforcement Learning (CME-CAD) paradigm, a novel training paradigm for CAD code generation. Our approach integrates the complementary strengths of these models, facilitating collaborative learning and improving the model's ability to generate accurate, constraint-compatible, and fully editable CAD models. We introduce a two-stage training process: Multi-Expert Fine-Tuning (MEFT), and Multi-Expert Reinforcement Learning (MERL). Additionally, we present CADExpert, an open-source benchmark consisting of 17,299 instances, including orthographic projections with precise dimension annotations, expert-generated Chain-of-Thought (CoT) processes, executable CADQuery code, and rendered 3D models. The CADExpert dataset is publicly available at https://modelscope.cn/datasets/zhuofanChen/CADExpert.
title_zh: CME-CAD：面向CAD代码生成的异构协同多专家强化学习
abstract_zh: 计算机辅助设计（CAD）在工业设计中至关重要，但传统CAD建模与工作流的复杂性，为自动化生成高精度、可编辑的CAD模型带来了重大挑战。现有方法（例如基于草图的3D重建）往往生成不可编辑的近似模型，难以满足工业设计对精度和可编辑性的严格要求。此外，对文本或图像输入的依赖通常需要大量人工标注，限制了其在工业场景中的可扩展性和适用性。为克服这些挑战，我们提出异构协同多专家强化学习（CME-CAD）范式，这是一种用于CAD代码生成的新型训练范式。我们的方法整合了这些模型的互补优势，促进协同学习，并提升模型生成准确、满足约束且完全可编辑的CAD模型的能力。我们引入两阶段训练过程：多专家微调（MEFT）和多专家强化学习（MERL）。此外，我们提出CADExpert，一个包含17,299个实例的开源基准，其中包括带精确尺寸标注的正投影图、专家生成的思维链（Chain-of-Thought，CoT）过程、可执行的CADQuery代码以及渲染后的3D模型。CADExpert数据集已公开：https://modelscope.cn/datasets/zhuofanChen/CADExpert。

title: Reviving ConvNeXt for Efficient Convolutional Diffusion Models
abstract: Recent diffusion models increasingly favor Transformer backbones, motivated by the remarkable scalability of fully attentional architectures. Yet the locality bias, parameter efficiency, and hardware friendliness--the attributes that established ConvNets as the efficient vision backbone--have seen limited exploration in modern generative modeling. Here we introduce the fully convolutional diffusion model (FCDM), a model having a backbone similar to ConvNeXt, but designed for conditional diffusion modeling. We find that using only 50% of the FLOPs of DiT-XL/2, FCDM-XL achieves competitive performance with 7x and 7.5x fewer training steps at 256x256 and 512x512 resolutions, respectively. Remarkably, FCDM-XL can be trained on a 4-GPU system, highlighting the exceptional training efficiency of our architecture. Our results demonstrate that modern convolutional designs provide a competitive and highly efficient alternative for scaling diffusion models, reviving ConvNeXt as a simple yet powerful building block for efficient generative modeling.
title_zh: 复兴ConvNeXt：实现高效卷积扩散模型
abstract_zh: 近期的扩散模型越来越倾向于采用Transformer骨干网络，其动机是全注意力架构出色的可扩展性。然而，局部性偏置、参数效率和硬件友好性——这些使卷积网络（ConvNets）成为高效视觉骨干的特性——在现代生成建模中仍鲜有探索。为此，我们提出全卷积扩散模型（FCDM），其骨干网络与ConvNeXt类似，但面向条件扩散建模设计。我们发现，FCDM-XL仅使用DiT-XL/2 50%的FLOPs，在256×256和512×512分辨率下分别以仅为DiT-XL/2的1/7和1/7.5的训练步数达到有竞争力的性能。值得注意的是，FCDM-XL可在4块GPU的系统上训练，凸显了我们架构卓越的训练效率。结果表明，现代卷积设计为扩展扩散模型提供了有竞争力且高效的替代方案，使ConvNeXt重新成为高效生成建模中简单而强大的构建模块。

title: WeMMU: Enhanced Bridging of Vision-Language Models and Diffusion Models via Noisy Query Tokens
abstract: Recent progress in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) has highlighted the challenge of efficiently bridging pre-trained Vision-Language Models (VLMs) with Diffusion Models. While methods using a fixed number of learnable query tokens offer computational efficiency, they suffer from task generalization collapse, failing to adapt to new tasks that are distant from their pre-training tasks. To overcome this, we propose Noisy Query Tokens, which learn a distributed representation space between the VLM and Diffusion Model via end-to-end optimization, enhancing continual learning. Additionally, we introduce a VAE branch with linear projection to recover fine-grained image details. Experimental results confirm our approach mitigates generalization collapse and enables stable continual learning across diverse tasks.
title_zh: WeMMU：通过Noisy Query Tokens增强视觉-语言模型与扩散模型的桥接
abstract_zh: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）的最新进展凸显了高效桥接预训练视觉-语言模型（VLMs）与扩散模型的挑战。使用固定数量可学习查询Token的方法虽然计算高效，但会出现任务泛化崩溃，无法适应与其预训练任务相距较远的新任务。为克服这一问题，我们提出Noisy Query Tokens，通过端到端优化在VLM与扩散模型之间学习一个分布式表示空间，从而增强持续学习。此外，我们引入带有线性投影的VAE分支，以恢复细粒度图像细节。实验结果证实，我们的方法缓解了泛化崩溃，并能在多样化任务上实现稳定的持续学习。

title: Flow Actor-Critic for Offline Reinforcement Learning
abstract: The dataset distributions in offline reinforcement learning (RL) often exhibit complex and multi-modal distributions, necessitating expressive policies to capture such distributions beyond widely-used Gaussian policies. To handle such complex and multi-modal datasets, in this paper, we propose Flow Actor-Critic, a new actor-critic method for offline RL, based on recent flow policies. The proposed method not only uses the flow model for actor as in previous flow policies but also exploits the expressive flow model for conservative critic acquisition to prevent Q-value explosion in out-of-data regions. To this end, we propose a new form of critic regularizer based on the flow behavior proxy model obtained as a byproduct of flow-based actor design. Leveraging the flow model in this joint way, we achieve new state-of-the-art performance for test datasets of offline RL including the D4RL and recent OGBench benchmarks. $('.dropdown-menu a.dropdown-toggle').on('click', function (e) { if (!$(this).next().hasClass('show')) { $(this).parents('.dropdown-menu').first().find('.show').removeClass("show"); } var $subMenu = $(this).next(".dropdown-menu"); $subMenu.toggleClass('show'); $(this).parents('li.nav-item.dropdown.show').on('hidden.bs.dropdown', function (e) { $('.dropdown-submenu .show').removeClass("show"); }); return false; }); Name Change Policy × Requests for name changes in the electronic proceedings will be accepted with no questions asked. title_zh: 面向离线强化学习的Flow Actor-Critic
abstract_zh: 离线强化学习（RL）中的数据集分布往往具有复杂且多模态的特点，因此需要比广泛使用的高斯策略更具表达能力的策略来捕捉这些分布。为处理此类复杂且多模态的数据集，本文提出Flow Actor-Critic，一种基于近期流策略的离线RL新actor-critic方法。所提方法不仅像以往的流策略那样将流模型用于actor，还利用富有表现力的流模型来获得保守的critic，以防止数据外区域的Q值爆炸。为此，我们提出一种新形式的critic正则化器，其基于流行为代理模型，而该代理模型是流式actor设计的副产品。以这种联合方式利用流模型，我们在离线RL测试数据集（包括D4RL和近期的OGBench基准）上取得了新的最先进性能。

title: Bayes Adaptive Monte Carlo Tree Search for Offline Model-based Reinforcement Learning
abstract: Offline reinforcement learning (RL) is a powerful approach for data-driven decision-making and control. Compared to model-free methods, offline model-based reinforcement learning (MBRL) explicitly learns world models from a static dataset and uses them as surrogate simulators, improving the data efficiency and enabling the learned policy to potentially generalize beyond the dataset support. However, there could be various MDPs that behave identically on the offline dataset and dealing with the uncertainty about the true MDP can be challenging. In this paper, we propose modeling offline MBRL as a Bayes Adaptive Markov Decision Process (BAMDP), which is a principled framework for addressing model uncertainty. We further propose a novel Bayes Adaptive Monte-Carlo planning algorithm capable of solving BAMDPs in continuous state and action spaces with stochastic transitions. This planning process is based on Monte Carlo Tree Search and can be integrated into offline MBRL as a policy improvement operator in policy iteration. Our "RL + Search" framework follows in the footsteps of superhuman AIs like AlphaZero, improving on current offline MBRL methods by incorporating more computation input. The proposed algorithm significantly outperforms state-of-the-art offline RL methods on twelve D4RL MuJoCo tasks and three challenging, stochastic tokamak control tasks. $('.dropdown-menu a.dropdown-toggle').on('click', function (e) { if (!$(this).next().hasClass('show')) { $(this).parents('.dropdown-menu').first().find('.show').removeClass("show"); } var $subMenu = $(this).next(".dropdown-menu"); $subMenu.toggleClass('show'); $(this).parents('li.nav-item.dropdown.show').on('hidden.bs.dropdown', function (e) { $('.dropdown-submenu .show').removeClass("show"); }); return false; }); Name Change Policy × Requests for name changes in the electronic proceedings will be accepted with no questions asked.
