title_zh: Stroke3D：通过潜在扩散模型将 2D 笔画提升为带骨骼绑定的 3D 模型
abstract_zh: 绑定了骨骼（rigged）的 3D 资产是 3D 形变和动画的基础。然而，现有的 3D 生成方法在生成可动画几何体方面面临挑战，而骨骼绑定技术又缺乏对骨骼创建的细粒度结构控制。为解决这些局限，我们提出 Stroke3D，一个可直接根据用户输入生成绑定骨骼网格的新框架：用户输入包括 2D 绘制笔画和描述性文本提示。我们的方法开创了一种两阶段流程，将生成过程分解为：1）可控骨骼生成（Controllable Skeleton Generation）：我们采用骨骼图 VAE（Skeletal Graph VAE，Sk-VAE）将骨骼的图结构编码到潜在空间，并由骨骼图 DiT（Skeletal Graph DiT，Sk-DiT）生成骨骼嵌入。生成过程同时以文本提供语义信息、以 2D 笔画提供显式结构控制为条件，再由 VAE 解码器重建最终的高质量 3D 骨骼；2）通过 TextuRig 和 SKA-DPO 增强网格合成（Enhanced Mesh Synthesis）：我们随后以生成的骨骼为条件合成带纹理的网格。在此阶段，我们首先通过 TextuRig 扩充现有骨骼到网格模型的训练数据——TextuRig 是一个由 Objaverse-XL 整理而来、包含带纹理与骨骼绑定的网格及对应描述的数据集。此外，我们采用一种由骨骼-网格对齐分数引导的偏好优化策略 SKA-DPO，以进一步提升几何保真度。我们的框架共同实现了更直观的工作流，可创建可直接用于动画的 3D 内容。据我们所知，我们的工作是首个以用户绘制的 2D 笔画为条件生成绑定骨骼的 3D 网格的方法。大量实验表明，Stroke3D 能够生成合理的骨骼和高质量的网格。

title: Versatile Loco-Manipulation through Flexible Interlimb Coordination
abstract: The ability to flexibly leverage limbs for loco-manipulation is essential for enabling autonomous robots to operate in unstructured environments. Yet, prior work on loco-manipulation is often constrained to specific tasks or predetermined limb configurations. In this work, we present einforcement Learning for Interlimb Coordination (ReLIC), an approach that enables versatile loco-manipulation through flexible interlimb coordination. The key to our approach is an adaptive controller that seamlessly bridges the execution of manipulation motions and the generation of stable gaits based on task demands. Through the interplay between two controller modules, ReLIC dynamically assigns each limb for manipulation or locomotion and robustly coordinates them to achieve the task success. Using efficient reinforcement learning in simulation, ReLIC learns to perform stable gaits in accordance with the manipulation goals in the real world. To solve diverse and complex tasks, we further propose to interface the learned controller with different types of task specifications, including target trajectories, contact points, and natural language instructions. Evaluated on 12 real-world tasks that require diverse and complex coordination patterns, ReLIC demonstrates its versatility and robustness by achieving a success rate of 78.9% on average.
title_zh: 通过灵活的肢体间协调实现多功能的 Loco-Manipulation
abstract_zh: 灵活利用肢体进行 Loco-Manipulation 的能力，对于使自主机器人在非结构化环境中运行至关重要。然而，以往关于 Loco-Manipulation 的工作往往局限于特定任务或预先设定的肢体构型。在本工作中，我们提出 ReLIC（Reinforcement Learning for Interlimb Coordination），这是一种通过灵活的肢体间协调实现多功能 Loco-Manipulation 的方法。该方法的关键在于一个自适应控制器：它根据任务需求，将操作运动的执行与稳定步态的生成无缝衔接起来。通过两个控制器模块之间的协同作用，ReLIC 动态地为每条肢体分配操作或移动功能，并稳健地协调它们以成功完成任务。ReLIC 在仿真中利用高效的强化学习，学习执行与真实世界操作目标相一致的稳定步态。为求解多样且复杂的任务，我们进一步提出将学习到的控制器与不同类型的任务规范相衔接，包括目标轨迹、接触点和自然语言指令。在 12 项需要多样且复杂协调模式的真实世界任务上进行评估时，ReLIC 取得了平均 78.9% 的成功率，展现了其多功能性与鲁棒性。

title: Multi-Loco: Unifying Multi-Embodiment Legged Locomotion via Reinforcement Learning Augmented Diffusion
abstract: Generalizing locomotion policies across diverse legged robots with varying morphologies is a key challenge due to differences in observation/action dimensions and system dynamics. In this work, we propose \textit{Multi-Loco}, a novel unified framework combining a morphology-agnostic generative diffusion model with a lightweight residual policy optimized via reinforcement learning (RL). The diffusion model captures morphology-invariant locomotion patterns from diverse cross-embodiment datasets, improving generalization and robustness. The residual policy is shared across all embodiments and refines the actions generated by the diffusion model, enhancing task-aware performance and robustness for real-world deployment. We evaluated our method with a rich library of four legged robots in both simulation and real-world experiments. Compared to a standard RL framework with PPO, our approach - replacing the Gaussian policy with a diffusion model and residual term - achieves a 10.35% average return improvement, with gains up to 13.57% in wheeled-biped locomotion tasks. These results highlight the benefits of cross-embodiment data and composite generative architectures in learning robust, generalized locomotion skills.
title_zh: Multi-Loco：通过强化学习增强的扩散模型统一多具身腿式运动
abstract_zh: 由于观测/动作维度和系统动力学的差异，将运动策略泛化到形态各异的多类腿式机器人是一项关键挑战。在本工作中，我们提出 Multi-Loco，这是一种新颖的统一框架，将形态无关的生成式扩散模型与通过强化学习（RL）优化的轻量级残差策略相结合。该扩散模型从多样化的跨具身数据集中捕捉形态不变的运动模式，从而提升泛化能力和鲁棒性。该残差策略在所有具身之间共享，并细化扩散模型生成的动作，从而增强面向真实世界部署的任务感知性能与鲁棒性。我们在仿真和真实世界实验中，使用包含四种腿式机器人的丰富机器人库对我们的方法进行了评估。与采用 PPO 的标准 RL 框架相比，我们的方法——用扩散模型和残差项替代高斯策略——实现了 10.35% 的平均回报提升，在轮式双足机器人运动任务中提升最高达 13.57%。这些结果凸显了跨具身数据和复合生成式架构在学习稳健且可泛化的运动技能方面的优势。

title: Diffusion Dynamics Models with Generative State Estimation for Cloth Manipulation
abstract: Cloth manipulation is challenging due to its highly complex dynamics, near-infinite degrees of freedom, and frequent self-occlusions, which complicate both state estimation and dynamics modeling. Inspired by recent advances in generative models, we hypothesize that these expressive models can effectively capture intricate cloth configurations and deformation patterns from data. Therefore, we propose a diffusion-based generative approach for both perception and dynamics modeling. Specifically, we formulate state estimation as reconstructing full cloth states from partial observations and dynamics modeling as predicting future states given the current state and robot actions. Leveraging a transformer-based diffusion model, our method achieves accurate state reconstruction and reduces long-horizon dynamics prediction errors by an order of magnitude compared to prior approaches. We integrate our dynamics models with model-predictive control and show that our framework enables effective cloth folding on real robotic systems, demonstrating the potential of generative models for deformable object manipulation under partial observability and complex dynamics.
title_zh: 用于布料操作的扩散动力学模型与生成式状态估计
abstract_zh: 布料操作之所以具有挑战性，是因为其动力学高度复杂、自由度近乎无限且频繁出现自遮挡，这使得状态估计和动力学建模都变得复杂。受生成模型近期进展的启发，我们假设这类具有强表达能力的模型能够从数据中有效捕捉复杂的布料构型与变形模式。因此，我们提出一种基于扩散的生成式方法，同时用于感知和动力学建模。具体而言，我们将状态估计表述为从部分观测中重建完整的布料状态，并将动力学建模表述为在给定当前状态和机器人动作的情况下预测未来状态。借助基于 Transformer 的扩散模型，我们的方法实现了准确的状态重建，并将长时程动力学预测误差相较先前方法降低了一个数量级。我们将动力学模型与模型预测控制集成，并表明我们的框架能够在真实机器人系统上实现有效的布料折叠，展示了生成模型在部分可观测性和复杂动力学条件下进行可变形物体操作的潜力。

title: DiWA: Diffusion Policy Adaptation with World Models
abstract: Fine-tuning diffusion policies with reinforcement learning (RL) presents significant challenges. The long denoising sequence for each action prediction impedes effective reward propagation. Additionally, standard RL methods require millions of physical interaction steps, making fine-tuning even more challenging. Prior work models the denoising steps in diffusion policies as a Markov Decision Process to adapt to RL policy updates, but its heavy reliance on environment interactions still leads to inefficiency. To bridge this gap, we introduce DiWA, a novel framework that leverages a world model for fine-tuning diffusion-based robotic skills entirely offline with reinforcement learning. Unlike model-free approaches that require millions of environment interactions to fine-tune a repertoire of robot skills, DiWA achieves effective adaptation using a world model trained once on a few hundred thousand offline play interactions. This results in dramatically improved sample efficiency, making the approach significantly more practical and safer for real-world robot learning. On the challenging CALVIN benchmark, DiWA improves performance across eight tasks using only offline adaptation, while requiring orders of magnitude fewer physical interactions than model-free baselines. To our knowledge, this is the first demonstration of fine-tuning diffusion policies for real-world robotic skills using an offline world model. We make the code publicly available at _redacted-for-review_.
title_zh: DiWA：基于世界模型的扩散策略自适应
abstract_zh: 使用强化学习（RL）微调扩散策略面临重大挑战。每次动作预测所涉及的长去噪序列会阻碍奖励的有效传播。此外，标准 RL 方法需要数百万次物理交互步骤，使微调更具挑战性。先前工作将扩散策略中的去噪步骤建模为马尔可夫决策过程，以适应 RL 策略更新，但其对环境交互的高度依赖仍然导致效率低下。为弥合这一差距，我们提出 DiWA，这是一种新颖的框架，利用世界模型完全离线地通过强化学习微调基于扩散的机器人技能。与需要数百万次环境交互才能微调一套机器人技能的无模型方法不同，DiWA 使用一个仅在数十万次离线试玩交互上训练一次的世界模型，即可实现有效的自适应。这大幅提升了样本效率，使该方法对于真实世界机器人学习而言显著更加实用和安全。在具有挑战性的 CALVIN 基准上，DiWA 仅通过离线自适应便提升了八项任务的性能，同时所需的物理交互次数比无模型基线少几个数量级。据我们所知，这是首次展示利用离线世界模型微调扩散策略，以获得真实世界机器人技能。代码已在 _redacted-for-review_ 公开提供。

title: Gen2Act: Human Video Generation in Novel Scenarios enables Generalizable Robot Manipulation
abstract: How can robot manipulation policies generalize to novel tasks involving unseen object types and new motions? In this paper, we provide a solution in terms of predicting motion information from web data through human video generation and conditioning a robot policy on the generated video. Instead of attempting to scale robot data collection which is expensive, we show how we can leverage video generation models trained on easily available web data, for enabling generalization. \textit{Our approach Gen2Act casts language-conditioned manipulation as zero-shot human video generation followed by execution with a single policy conditioned on the generated video.} To train the policy, we use an order of magnitude less robot interaction data compared to what the video prediction model was trained on. Gen2Act doesn’t require fine-tuning the video model at all and we directly use a pre-trained model for generating human videos. Our results on diverse real-world scenarios show how Gen2Act enables manipulating unseen object types and performing novel motions for tasks not present in the robot data.
title_zh: Gen2Act：在新场景中生成人类视频，实现可泛化的机器人操作
abstract_zh: 机器人操作策略如何才能泛化到涉及未见物体类型和新运动方式的新任务？在本文中，我们给出一种解决方案：通过人类视频生成从网络数据中预测运动信息，并让机器人策略以生成的视频为条件。我们没有试图扩大昂贵的机器人数据收集规模，而是展示如何利用在易于获取的网络数据上训练的视频生成模型来实现泛化。我们的方法 Gen2Act 将语言条件化操作转化为零样本人类视频生成，随后由单个以生成视频为条件的策略执行。为训练该策略，我们使用的机器人交互数据比训练视频预测模型所用的数据少一个数量级。Gen2Act 完全不需要微调视频模型，我们直接使用预训练模型生成人类视频。我们在多样化真实世界场景中的结果表明，Gen2Act 能够操作未见过的物体类型，并为机器人数据中不存在的任务执行新颖动作。

title: Off Policy Lyapunov Stability in Reinforcement Learning
abstract: Traditional reinforcement learning lacks the ability to provide stability guarantees. More recent algorithms learn Lyapunov functions alongside the control policies to ensure stable learning. However, the current self-learned Lyapunov functions are sample inefficient due to their on-policy nature. This paper introduces a method for learning Lyapunov functions off-policy and incorporates the proposed off-policy Lyapunov function into the Soft Actor Critic and Proximal Policy Optimization algorithms to provide them with a data efficient stability certificate. Simulations of an inverted pendulum and a quadrotor illustrate the improved performance of the two algorithms when endowed with the proposed off-policy Lyapunov function.
title_zh: 强化学习中的 Off-Policy Lyapunov 稳定性
abstract_zh: 传统强化学习无法提供稳定性保证。较新的算法会与控制策略共同学习 Lyapunov 函数，以确保学习过程的稳定性。然而，当前自学习的 Lyapunov 函数由于具有 on-policy 特性，样本效率不高。本文提出一种 off-policy 学习 Lyapunov 函数的方法，并将所提出的 off-policy Lyapunov 函数融入 Soft Actor-Critic（SAC）和 Proximal Policy Optimization（PPO）算法，为它们提供数据高效的稳定性证书。针对倒立摆和四旋翼的仿真表明，在配备所提出的 off-policy Lyapunov 函数后，这两种算法的性能均有所提升。

title: Lucid-XR: An Extended-Reality Data Engine for Robotic Manipulation
abstract: We introduce Lucid-XR, a generative data engine for creating diverse and realistic-looking data to train real-world robot systems. At the core of Lucid-XR is vuer, a web-based physics simulation environment that runs directly on the XR headset, enabling internet-scale access to immersive, latency-free virtual interactions without requiring specialized equipment. The complete system integrates on-device physics simulation with on-device human-to-robot pose retargeting, that are further amplified by a physics-guided video generation pipeline commandable with natural language specifications. We demonstrate zero-shot sim-to-real transfer of robot visual policies, trained entirely on Lucid-XR’s synthetic data, across bimanual and dexterous manipulation tasks that involve flexible materials, adhesive interaction between particles, and rigid body contact.
title_zh: Lucid-XR：面向机器人操作的扩展现实数据引擎
abstract_zh: 我们提出 Lucid-XR，这是一种生成式数据引擎，用于创建多样化且外观逼真的数据，以训练真实世界机器人系统。Lucid-XR 的核心是 vuer，一个可直接在 XR 头显上运行的基于 Web 的物理仿真环境，无需专用设备即可实现互联网规模的沉浸式、无延迟虚拟交互访问。完整系统将设备端物理仿真与设备端人体到机器人姿态重定向集成在一起，并通过可由自然语言规范控制的、物理引导的视频生成流程进一步增强。我们展示了完全在 Lucid-XR 合成数据上训练的机器人视觉策略的零样本仿真到现实（sim-to-real）迁移，涵盖涉及柔性材料、粒子间粘附交互和刚体接触的双臂与灵巧操作任务。

title: Mastering Multi-Drone Volleyball through Hierarchical Co-Self-Play Reinforcement Learning
abstract: In this paper, we tackle the problem of learning to play 3v3 multi-drone volleyball, a new embodied competitive task that requires both high-level strategic coordination and low-level agile control. The task is turn-based, multi-agent, and physically grounded, posing significant challenges due to its long-horizon dependencies, tight inter-agent coupling, and the underactuated dynamics of quadrotors. To address this, we propose Hierarchical Co-Self-Play (HCSP), a hierarchical reinforcement learning framework that separates centralized high-level strategic decision-making from decentralized low-level motion control. We design a three-stage population-based training pipeline to enable both strategy and skill to emerge from scratch without expert demonstrations: (I) training diverse low-level skills, (II) learning high-level strategy via self-play with fixed low-level controllers, and (III) joint fine-tuning through co-self-play. Experiments show that HCSP achieves superior performance, outperforming non-hierarchical self-play and rule-based hierarchical baselines with an average 82.9% win rate and a 71.5% win rate against the two-stage variant. Moreover, co-self-play leads to emergent team behaviors such as role switching and coordinated formations, demonstrating the effectiveness of our hierarchical design and training scheme.
title_zh: 通过分层协同自博弈强化学习掌握多无人机排球
abstract_zh: 本文研究如何学习进行 3v3 多无人机排球，这是一项全新的具身竞技任务，既需要高层战略协调，也需要低层敏捷控制。该任务是回合制、多智能体且具有物理基础的，长时程依赖、智能体间紧耦合以及四旋翼无人机的欠驱动动力学带来了重大挑战。为此，我们提出分层协同自博弈（Hierarchical Co-Self-Play, HCSP），这是一个分层强化学习框架，将集中式高层战略决策与分散式低层运动控制分离。我们设计了一个三阶段基于种群的训练流程，使策略与技能无需专家示范即可从零涌现：（I）训练多样化的低层技能；（II）在低层控制器固定时通过自博弈学习高层策略；（III）通过协同自博弈进行联合微调。实验表明，HCSP 取得了更优性能，优于非分层自博弈和基于规则的分层基线，平均胜率达到 82.9%，对阵两阶段变体时胜率达到 71.5%。此外，协同自博弈催生了角色切换和协同阵型等涌现式团队行为，证明了我们的分层设计与训练方案的有效性。

title: C2IQL: Constraint-Conditioned Implicit Q-learning for Safe Offline Reinforcement Learning
abstract: Safe offline reinforcement learning aims to develop policies that maximize cumulative rewards while satisfying safety constraints without the need for risky online interaction. However, existing methods often struggle with the out-of-distribution (OOD) problem, leading to potentially unsafe and suboptimal policies. To address this issue, we first propose Constrained Implicit Q-learning (CIQL), a novel algorithm designed to avoid the OOD problem. In particular, CIQL expands the implicit update of reward value functions to constrained settings and then estimates cost value functions under the same implicit policy. Despite its advantages, the further performance improvement of CIQL is still hindered by the inaccurate discounted approximations of constraints. Thus, we further propose Constraint-Conditioned Implicit Q-learning (C2IQL). Building upon CIQL, C2IQL employs a cost reconstruction model to derive non-discounted cumulative costs from discounted values and incorporates a flexible, constraint-conditioned mechanism to accommodate dynamic safety constraints. Experiment results on DSRL benchmarks demonstrate the superiority of C2IQL compared to baseline methods in achieving higher rewards while guaranteeing safety constraints under different threshold conditions.
title_zh: C2IQL：面向安全离线强化学习的约束条件化 Implicit Q-learning
abstract_zh: 安全离线强化学习旨在学习在满足安全约束的同时最大化累积奖励的策略，而无需进行高风险的在线交互。然而，现有方法常常难以处理分布外（OOD）问题，从而导致可能不安全且次优的策略。为解决这一问题，我们首先提出 Constrained Implicit Q-learning（CIQL），这是一种旨在避免 OOD 问题的新算法。具体而言，CIQL 将奖励价值函数的隐式更新扩展到约束场景，然后在同一隐式策略下估计成本价值函数。尽管具有这些优势，CIQL 的进一步性能提升仍受限于约束的折扣近似不准确。因此，我们进一步提出 Constraint-Conditioned Implicit Q-learning（C2IQL）。在 CIQL 基础上，C2IQL 采用成本重构模型从折扣值中推导非折扣累积成本，并引入灵活的约束条件化机制以适应动态安全约束。在 DSRL 基准上的实验结果表明，在不同阈值条件下，C2IQL 相比基线方法在保证安全约束的同时实现了更高奖励，具有优越性。

title: Convex Markov Games: A New Frontier for Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
abstract: Behavioral diversity, expert imitation, fairness, safety goals and others give rise to preferences in sequential decision making domains that do not decompose additively across time. We introduce the class of convex Markov games that allow general convex preferences over occupancy measures. Despite infinite time horizon and strictly higher generality than Markov games, pure strategy Nash equilibria exist. Furthermore, equilibria can be approximated empirically by performing gradient descent on an upper bound of exploitability. Our experiments reveal novel solutions to classic repeated normal-form games, find fair solutions in a repeated asymmetric coordination game, and prioritize safe long-term behavior in a robot warehouse environment. In the prisoner’s dilemma, our algorithm leverages transient imitation to find a policy profile that deviates from observed human play only slightly, yet achieves higher per-player utility while also being three orders of magnitude less exploitable.
title_zh: Convex Markov Games：多智能体强化学习的新前沿
abstract_zh: 行为多样性、专家模仿、公平性、安全目标以及其他需求，会在序贯决策领域产生无法按时间可加分解的偏好。我们引入凸 Markov 博弈（convex Markov games）这一类别，它允许对占据测度（occupancy measures）具有一般凸偏好。尽管时间范围为无限，且严格比 Markov 博弈更具一般性，纯策略纳什均衡仍然存在。此外，可以通过对可利用性（exploitability）的上界执行梯度下降，从经验上近似均衡。我们的实验揭示了对经典重复标准型博弈的新解，在重复非对称协调博弈中找到了公平解，并在机器人仓库环境中优先考虑安全的长期行为。在囚徒困境中，我们的算法利用瞬态模仿找到一个策略组合，该组合仅略微偏离观察到的人类行为，却实现了更高的每玩家效用，同时可利用性低三个数量级。

title: Provable Zero-Shot Generalization in Offline Reinforcement Learning
abstract: In this work, we study offline reinforcement learning (RL) with zero-shot generalization property (ZSG), where the agent has access to an offline dataset including experiences from different environments, and the goal of the agent is to train a policy over the training environments which performs well on test environments without further interaction. Existing work showed that classical offline RL fails to generalize to new, unseen environments. We propose pessimistic empirical risk minimization (PERM) and pessimistic proximal policy optimization (PPPO), which leverage pessimistic policy evaluation to guide policy learning and enhance generalization. We show that both PERM and PPPO are capable of finding a near-optimal policy with ZSG. Our result serves as a first step in understanding the foundation of the generalization phenomenon in offline reinforcement learning.
title_zh: 离线强化学习中可证明的零样本泛化
abstract_zh: 在这项工作中，我们研究具有零样本泛化（ZSG）性质的离线强化学习（RL）：智能体可以访问包含来自不同环境的经验的离线数据集，其目标是在训练环境上训练一个策略，使其在无需进一步交互的情况下在测试环境上表现良好。已有工作表明，经典离线 RL 无法泛化到新的、未见过的环境。我们提出悲观经验风险最小化（PERM）和悲观近端策略优化（PPPO），它们利用悲观策略评估来指导策略学习并增强泛化能力。我们证明 PERM 和 PPPO 都能找到具有 ZSG 的近最优策略。我们的结果是在理解离线强化学习中泛化现象基础方面迈出的第一步。

title: Unveiling Markov heads in Pretrained Language Models for Offline Reinforcement Learning
abstract: Recently, incorporating knowledge from pretrained language models (PLMs) into decision transformers (DTs) has generated significant attention in offline reinforcement learning (RL). These PLMs perform well in RL tasks, raising an intriguing question: what kind of knowledge from PLMs has been transferred to RL to achieve such good results? This work first dives into this problem by analyzing each head quantitatively and points out Markov head, a crucial component that exists in the attention heads of PLMs. It leads to extreme attention on the last-input token and performs well only in short-term environments. Furthermore, we prove that this extreme attention cannot be changed by re-training embedding layer or fine-tuning. Inspired by our analysis, we propose a general method GPT-DTMA, which equips a pretrained DT with Mixture of Attention (MoA), to enable adaptive learning and accommodate diverse attention requirements during fine-tuning. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of GPT-DTMA: it achieves superior performance in short-term environments compared to baselines, significantly reduces the performance gap of PLMs in long-term scenarios, and the experimental results also validate our theorems.
title_zh: 揭示用于离线强化学习的预训练语言模型中的 Markov heads
abstract_zh: 近来，将预训练语言模型（PLM）中的知识融入决策 Transformer（DT）在离线强化学习（RL）中引起了广泛关注。这些 PLM 在 RL 任务中表现良好，这引出一个有趣的问题：PLM 中的何种知识被迁移到 RL 中，从而取得如此好的结果？本文首先通过定量分析每个 head 来深入研究这一问题，并指出了 Markov head——PLM 注意力头中存在的一个关键组成部分。它会导致对最后一个输入 token 的极端注意力，并且仅在短期环境中表现良好。此外，我们证明这种极端注意力无法通过重新训练嵌入层或微调来改变。受我们的分析启发，我们提出一种通用方法 GPT-DTMA，它为预训练的 DT 配备注意力混合（Mixture of Attention，MoA），以便在微调期间实现自适应学习并适应多样的注意力需求。大量实验证明了 GPT-DTMA 的有效性：与基线相比，它在短期环境中取得了更优性能，显著缩小了 PLM 在长期场景中的性能差距，实验结果也验证了我们的定理。

title: Robust Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning with Stochastic Adversary
abstract: The performance of models trained by Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) is sensitive to perturbations in observations, lowering their trustworthiness in complex environments. Adversarial training is a valuable approach to enhance their performance robustness. However, existing methods often overfit to adversarial perturbations of observations and fail to incorporate prior information about the policy adopted by their protagonist agent, i.e., the primary one being trained. To address this important issue, this paper introduces Adversarial Training with Stochastic Adversary (ATSA), where the proposed adversary is trained online alongside the protagonist agent. The former consists of Stochastic Director (SDor) and SDor-guided generaTor (STor). SDor performs policy perturbations by minimizing the expected team reward of protagonists and maximizing the entropy of its policy, while STor generates adversarial perturbations of observations by following SDor’s guidance. We prove that SDor’s soft policy converges to a global optimum according to factorized maximum-entropy MARL and leads to the optimal adversary. This paper also introduces an SDor-STor loss function to quantify the difference between a) perturbations in the agent’s policy and b) those advised by SDor. We evaluate our ATSA on StarCraft II tasks and autonomous driving scenarios, demonstrating that a) it is robust against diverse perturbations of observations while maintaining outstanding performance in perturbation-free environments, and b) it outperforms the state-of-the-art methods.
title_zh: 带随机对手的鲁棒多智能体强化学习
abstract_zh: 由多智能体强化学习（MARL）训练的模型对观测扰动很敏感，这降低了它们在复杂环境中的可信度。对抗训练是增强其性能鲁棒性的一种有价值方法。然而，现有方法往往过拟合观测的对抗扰动，并且未能纳入关于其主角智能体（即正在训练的主要智能体）所采用策略的先验信息。为解决这一重要问题，本文提出带随机对手的对抗训练（Adversarial Training with Stochastic Adversary，ATSA），其中所提出的对手与主角智能体一起在线训练。前者由随机导演（Stochastic Director，SDor）和 SDor 引导的生成器（SDor-guided generaTor，STor）组成。SDor 通过最小化主角团队的期望团队奖励并最大化其策略的熵来执行策略扰动，而 STor 遵循 SDor 的引导生成观测的对抗扰动。我们证明，根据因子化最大熵 MARL，SDor 的软策略收敛到全局最优，并得到最优对手。本文还引入 SDor-STor 损失函数，用于量化 a）智能体策略中的扰动与 b）SDor 所建议的扰动之间的差异。我们在星际争霸 II 任务和自动驾驶场景上评估 ATSA，结果表明：a）它对观测的多样扰动具有鲁棒性，同时在无扰动环境中保持出色性能；b）它优于最先进的方法。

title: What kills v-prediction? A Patch-wise PCA Perspective on Pixel-Space Flow Matching
abstract: Latent Diffusion Models dominate generative modeling but face two-stage training complexity and the inherent reconstruction limits of pre-trained autoencoders. Pixel-space Flow Matching offers a simplified end-to-end alternative yet often encounters training difficulties when using the standard v-prediction objective. Recent research attributes this difficulty to the off-manifold nature of noised targets, motivating a shift toward x-prediction. In this paper, we investigate this explanation through patch-wise Principal Component Analysis (PCA) and identify a bandwidth bottleneck. The velocity in minor components is largely determined by the raw noisy input, requiring deep backbones to preserve information that competes with principal-component modeling. Through controlled experiments and representation analysis, we further examine why x-prediction remains effective: its parameterization provides a raw-input bypass, while its learned input representation can spontaneously concentrate on principal directions. Under low-rank observations, our analysis of the induced flow characterizes x-prediction as an implicit conditional-mean decoder, reconstructing discarded components from the retained information. These observations motivate the Raw-injected Transformer (RiT), which combines a lightweight raw-conditioned decoder with an output-side shortcut to separate semantic modeling from raw-state propagation. Our method restores effective v-prediction and achieves competitive performance on ImageNet 256256, providing a perspective on the interaction between prediction objectives and architectural bandwidth.
comment: Accepted as a Spotlight paper at NeurIPS 2026. Our code is available at
title_zh: 是什么扼杀了 v-prediction？从逐 patch PCA 视角看像素空间 Flow Matching
abstract_zh: 潜空间扩散模型主导了生成建模，但面临两阶段训练的复杂性以及预训练自编码器固有的重建限制。像素空间 Flow Matching 提供了一种简化的端到端替代方案，然而在使用标准 v-prediction 目标时常常遇到训练困难。近期研究将这一困难归因于加噪目标偏离流形（off-manifold）的性质，从而推动转向 x-prediction。本文通过逐 patch 主成分分析（PCA）研究这一解释，并识别出一个带宽瓶颈。次要成分中的速度在很大程度上由原始噪声输入决定，这要求深度骨干网络保留那些与主成分建模相竞争的信息。通过受控实验和表示分析，我们进一步考察了 x-prediction 为何仍然有效：其参数化提供了一条原始输入旁路，而其学习到的输入表示可以自发地集中于主方向。在低秩观测下，我们对诱导流的分析将 x-prediction 刻画为一种隐式条件均值解码器，它从保留下来的信息中重建被丢弃的成分。这些观察促使我们提出 Raw-injected Transformer（RiT），它将轻量级的原始条件解码器与输出侧捷径相结合，以将语义建模与原始状态传播分离。我们的方法恢复了有效的 v-prediction，并在 ImageNet 256×256 上取得了有竞争力的性能，为预测目标与架构带宽之间的相互作用提供了一种视角。

title: GraspVLA: a Grasping Foundation Model Pre-trained on Billion-scale Synthetic Action Data
abstract: Embodied foundation models are gaining increasing attention for their zero-shot generalization, scalability, and adaptability to new tasks through few-shot post-training. However, existing models rely heavily on real-world data, which is costly and labor-intensive to collect. Synthetic data offers a cost-effective alternative, yet its potential remains largely underexplored. To bridge this gap, we explore the feasibility of training Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models entirely with large-scale synthetic action data. We curate SynGrasp-1B, a billion-frame robotic grasping dataset generated in simulation with photorealistic rendering and extensive domain randomization. Building on this, we present GraspVLA, a VLA model pretrained on large-scale synthetic action data as a foundational model for grasping tasks. GraspVLA integrates autoregressive perception tasks and a flow-matching-based action generation into a unified Chain-of-Thought process, enabling joint training on synthetic action data and Internet semantics data. This design helps mitigate sim-to-real gaps and facilitates the transfer of learned actions to a broader range of Internet-covered objects, achieving open-vocabulary generalization in grasping. Extensive evaluations across real-world and simulation benchmarks demonstrate GraspVLA’s advanced zero-shot generalizability and few-shot adaptability to specific human preferences. We will release SynGrasp-1B dataset and pre-trained weights to benefit the community.
title_zh: GraspVLA：基于十亿级合成动作数据预训练的抓取基础模型
abstract_zh: 具身基础模型因其零样本泛化能力、可扩展性以及通过少样本后训练适应新任务的能力而日益受到关注。然而，现有模型严重依赖真实世界数据，而这类数据的采集成本高且耗费人力。合成数据提供了一种具有成本效益的替代方案，但其潜力在很大程度上仍未被充分探索。为弥合这一差距，我们探索完全使用大规模合成动作数据训练视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的可行性。我们构建了 SynGrasp-1B，这是一个在仿真中生成、采用照片级真实感渲染和广泛域随机化的十亿帧机器人抓取数据集。在此基础上，我们提出 GraspVLA，这是一个基于大规模合成动作数据预训练的 VLA 模型，可作为抓取任务的基础模型。GraspVLA 将自回归感知任务和基于 flow-matching 的动作生成整合到一个统一的思维链（Chain-of-Thought）过程中，从而能够在合成动作数据和互联网语义数据上联合训练。这一设计有助于缓解 sim-to-real 差距，并促进所学动作迁移到互联网覆盖的更广泛物体，实现抓取中的开放词汇泛化。在真实世界和仿真基准上的大量评估表明，GraspVLA 具有先进的零样本泛化能力以及对特定人类偏好的少样本适应能力。我们将发布 SynGrasp-1B 数据集和预训练权重，以惠及社区。

title: Benchmarking Real-World Robotic Manipulation through Stochastic Challenges
abstract: A challenging bottleneck in manipulation research is reproducibility and comparability of methods in real-world environments. Since manipulation is an interactive task, it cannot be evaluated on a static dataset of observations. Benchmarking in simulation is a common remedy, but cannot cover the whole complexity of real-world tests. This paper proposes a new paradigm of stochastic challenges. Like the well-known YCB objects, it is based on reproducible real-world scenes and therefore allows system-level innovation and comparability between different platforms. Due to their stochastic nature, our challenges however, mimic the rigor and surprise of hidden test sets. To this end, we show how different robots in different labs can be compared based on their success rate over different random task samples, if these samples come from the same distribution. We propose stochastic challenges as a general paradigm for robot benchmarking and implement this paradigm in a novel benchmark for mobile manipulation, on which we compare two robots tested in two different labs.
comment: Accepted at the 10th Conference on Robot Learning (CoRL 2026). 15 pages, 3 figures
title_zh: 通过随机挑战对真实世界机器人操作进行基准测试
abstract_zh: 操作研究中的一个棘手瓶颈是在真实世界环境中实现方法的可复现性和可比性。由于操作是一项交互式任务，无法在静态观测数据集上进行评估。仿真基准测试是一种常见的补救措施，但无法涵盖真实世界测试的全部复杂性。本文提出随机挑战这一新范式。与广为人知的 YCB 物体类似，它基于可复现的真实世界场景，因此允许系统级创新以及不同平台之间的可比性。然而，由于其随机性质，我们的挑战模拟了隐藏测试集的严谨性和意外性。为此，我们展示了如果这些样本来自同一分布，不同实验室中的不同机器人如何能够基于其在不同随机任务样本上的成功率进行比较。我们提出将随机挑战作为机器人基准测试的一种通用范式，并在一个用于移动操作的新基准中实现了该范式，在该基准上我们比较了在两个不同实验室中测试的两台机器人。

title: Reward-Estimated Hypergradient for Bilevel Reinforcement Learning with Black-Box Follower
abstract: Hypergradient (HG) methods for bilevel reinforcement learning (RL) typically assume a white-box follower whose reward is known. In practice, however, the leader rarely knows the follower's reward function and can only observe its trajectories. We address this black-box setting and propose Reward-Estimated Hypergradients (RE-HG), which recovers the follower's reward from these trajectories via inverse RL (IRL). Yet IRL identifies the reward only up to potential-based shaping, a transformation that leaves the follower's behavior unchanged but biases the HG. We prove that, for linear rewards, this bias cancels when IRL estimates are aggregated across sufficiently diverse dynamics, which the leader's own updates naturally supply. To handle finite samples, RE-HG truncates small eigenvalues of the aggregated feature covariance, restoring the identifiable subspace and stabilizing the estimation. Experiments show that RE-HG estimates gradients aligned with a white-box Oracle and achieves comparable performance; empirically, the truncation also suppresses HG explosions, letting RE-HG avoid local optima that trap the Oracle in sharp reward landscapes.
title_zh: 面向带黑盒跟随者的双层强化学习的奖励估计超梯度
abstract_zh: 用于双层强化学习（RL）的超梯度（HG）方法通常假设跟随者是奖励已知的白盒。然而在实践中，领导者很少知道跟随者的奖励函数，只能观察其轨迹。我们研究这一黑盒设定，并提出奖励估计超梯度（Reward-Estimated Hypergradients, RE-HG），通过逆强化学习（IRL）从这些轨迹中恢复跟随者的奖励。然而，IRL 只能将奖励辨识到基于势函数的奖励塑形（potential-based shaping）这一等价程度；该变换不改变跟随者行为，却会使 HG 产生偏差。我们证明，对于线性奖励，当 IRL 估计在足够多样的动力学上聚合时，这种偏差会相互抵消，而领导者自身的更新会自然提供这种多样性。为处理有限样本，RE-HG 对聚合特征协方差的小特征值进行截断，从而恢复可辨识子空间并稳定估计。实验表明，RE-HG 估计的梯度与白盒 Oracle 一致，并取得相当的性能；经验上，截断还抑制了 HG 数值爆炸，使 RE-HG 能够避开在尖锐奖励景观中困住 Oracle 的局部最优。

title: Vision Foundation Models Can Be Good Tokenizers for Latent Diffusion Models
abstract: The performance of Latent Diffusion Models (LDMs) is critically dependent on the quality of their visual tokenizers. While recent works have explored incorporating Vision Foundation Models (VFMs) into the tokenizers training via distillation, we empirically find this approach inevitably weakens the robustness of learnt representation from original VFM. In this paper, we bypass the distillation by proposing a more direct approach by leveraging the frozen VFM for the LDMs tokenizer, named VFM Variational Autoencoder (VFM-VAE). To fully exploit the potential to leverage frozen VFM for the LDMs tokenizer, we design a new decoder to reconstruct realistic images from the semantic-rich representation of VFM. With the proposed VFM-VAE, we conduct a systematic study on how the representation from different tokenizers impact the representation learning process throughout diffusion training, enabling synergistic benefits of dual-side alignment on both tokenizers and diffusion models. Our effort in tokenizer design and training strategy lead to superior performance and efficiency: our system reaches a **gFID (w/o CFG) of 2.22 in merely 80 epochs** (a 10xspeedup over prior tokenizers). With continued training to **640 epochs**, it further attains a **gFID (w/o CFG) of 1.62**. These results offer solid evidence for the substantial potential of VFMs to serve as visual tokenizers to accelerate the LDM training progress.
title_zh: 视觉基础模型可作为潜扩散模型的优秀 Tokenizer
abstract_zh: 潜扩散模型（LDMs）的性能关键取决于其视觉 tokenizer 的质量。尽管近期工作尝试通过蒸馏将视觉基础模型（VFMs）纳入 tokenizer 的训练，但我们从经验上发现，这种做法不可避免地削弱了原始 VFM 所学表示的鲁棒性。本文绕过蒸馏，提出一种更直接的方法：利用冻结的 VFM 构建 LDM 的 tokenizer，并将其命名为 VFM 变分自编码器（VFM Variational Autoencoder, VFM-VAE）。为充分挖掘利用冻结 VFM 作为 LDM tokenizer 的潜力，我们设计了一种新的解码器，用于从 VFM 语义丰富的表示中重建逼真图像。借助所提出的 VFM-VAE，我们系统研究了不同 tokenizer 的表示如何影响整个扩散训练过程中的表示学习，从而在 tokenizer 与扩散模型两侧实现双边对齐的协同增益。我们在 tokenizer 设计与训练策略上的努力带来了更优的性能和效率：我们的系统仅用 80 个 epoch 就达到 2.22 的 gFID（w/o CFG），相较先前 tokenizer 实现 10 倍加速。继续训练至 640 个 epoch 后，其 gFID（w/o CFG）进一步提升至 1.62。这些结果为 VFM 作为视觉 tokenizer 以加速 LDM 训练进程的巨大潜力提供了有力证据。

title: GrOCE : Graph-Guided Online Concept Erasure for Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
abstract: Concept erasure aims to remove harmful, inappropriate, or copyrighted content from text-to-image diffusion models while preserving non-target semantics. However, existing methods either rely on costly fine-tuning or apply coarse semantic separation, often degrading unrelated concepts and lacking adaptability to evolving concept sets. In this paper, we propose Graph-Guided Online Concept Erasure (GrOCE), a training-free framework that performs precise and context-aware online removal of target concepts. GrOCE constructs dynamic semantic graphs to identify clusters of target concepts and selectively suppress their influence within text prompts. It consists of three synergistic components: (1) dynamic semantic graph construction (Construct) incrementally builds a weighted graph over vocabulary concepts to capture semantic affinities; (2) adaptive cluster identification (Identify) extracts a target concept cluster through multi-hop traversal and diffusion-based scoring to quantify semantic influence; and (3) selective severing (Sever) removes semantic components associated with the target cluster from the text prompt while retaining non-target semantics and the global sentence structure. Extensive experiments demonstrate that GrOCE achieves state-of-the-art performance on the Concept Similarity (CS) and Frechet Inception Distance (FID) metrics, offering efficient, accurate, and stable concept erasure.
title_zh: GrOCE：面向文本到图像扩散模型的图引导在线概念擦除
abstract_zh: 概念擦除旨在从文本到图像扩散模型中移除有害、不当或受版权保护的内容，同时保留非目标语义。然而，现有方法要么依赖昂贵的微调，要么采用粗粒度的语义分离，往往会损害无关概念，并且缺乏对不断演变的概念集合的适应能力。本文提出图引导在线概念擦除（Graph-Guided Online Concept Erasure, GrOCE），这是一个无需训练的框架，可对目标概念进行精确且上下文感知的在线移除。GrOCE 构建动态语义图以识别目标概念簇，并选择性地抑制其在文本提示中的影响。它由三个协同组件构成：（1）动态语义图构建（Construct）在词汇概念上增量构建加权图，以捕捉语义亲和关系；（2）自适应簇识别（Identify）通过多跳遍历和基于扩散的评分提取目标概念簇，以量化语义影响；（3）选择性切断（Sever）从文本提示中移除与目标簇相关的语义成分，同时保留非目标语义和全局句子结构。大量实验表明，GrOCE 在概念相似度（Concept Similarity, CS）和 Frechet Inception Distance（FID）指标上达到最先进水平，实现了高效、准确且稳定的概念擦除。

title: From Manuals to Actions: A Unified VLA Model for Chain-of-Thought Manual Generation and Robotic Manipulation
abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have recently emerged, demonstrating strong generalization in robotic scene understanding and manipulation. However, when confronted with long-horizon tasks that require defined goal states, such as LEGO assembly or object rearrangement, existing VLA models still face challenges in coordinating long-horizon planning with precise manipulation.Therefore, we aim to endow a VLA model with the capability to infer the "how" process from the "what" outcomes, transforming goal states into executable procedures. In this paper, we introduce ManualVLA, a unified VLA framework built upon a Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) architecture, enabling coherent collaboration between multimodal manual generation and action execution. Unlike prior VLA models that directly map sensory inputs to actions, we first equip ManualVLA with a planning expert that generates intermediate manuals consisting of images, visual prompts, and textual instructions. Building upon these multimodal manuals, we design a Manual Chain-of-Thought (ManualCoT) reasoning process that feeds them into the action expert, where each manual step provides explicit control conditions, while its latent representation offers implicit guidance for accurate manipulation. To alleviate the burden of data collection, we develop a high-fidelity digital-twin toolkit based on 3D Gaussian Splatting, which automatically generates manual data for planning expert training. ManualVLA demonstrates strong real-world performance, achieving an average success rate 32% higher than the previous hierarchical SOTA baseline on LEGO assembly and object rearrangement tasks.
title_zh: 从手册到动作：面向思维链手册生成与机器人操作的统一 VLA 模型
abstract_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型近来崭露头角，在机器人场景理解与操作方面展现出强大的泛化能力。然而，面对需要明确目标状态的长时程任务，例如 LEGO 组装或物体重排，现有 VLA 模型在协调长时程规划与精确操作方面仍面临挑战。因此，我们希望赋予 VLA 模型从“what”结果推断“how”过程的能力，将目标状态转化为可执行流程。本文提出 ManualVLA，这是一个基于 Mixture-of-Transformers（MoT）架构构建的统一 VLA 框架，使多模态手册生成与动作执行能够连贯协作。与以往直接将感知输入映射为动作的 VLA 模型不同，我们首先为 ManualVLA 配备一个规划专家，用于生成由图像、视觉提示和文本指令构成的中间手册。在这些多模态手册的基础上，我们设计了手册思维链（Manual Chain-of-Thought, ManualCoT）推理过程，将其输入动作专家；其中每个手册步骤提供显式控制条件，而其潜在表示则为精确操作提供隐式引导。为减轻数据收集负担，我们开发了一套基于 3D Gaussian Splatting 的高保真数字孪生工具包，可自动生成用于训练规划专家所需的手册数据。ManualVLA 在真实世界中表现出强劲性能，在 LEGO 组装和物体重排任务上，其平均成功率比此前分层 SOTA 基线高 32%。

title: Training-free, Perceptually Consistent Low-Resolution Previews with High-Resolution Image for Efficient Workflows of Diffusion Models
abstract: Image generative models have become indispensable tools to yield exquisite high-resolution (HR) images for everyone, ranging from general users to professional designers. However, a desired outcome often requires generating a large number of HR images with different prompts and seeds, resulting in high computational cost for both users and service providers. Generating low-resolution (LR) images first could alleviate computational burden, but it is not straightforward how to generate LR images that are perceptually consistent with their HR counterparts. Here, we consider the task of generating high-fidelity LR images, called Previews, that preserve perceptual similarity of their HR counterparts for an efficient workflow, allowing users to identify promising candidates before generating the final HR image. We propose the commutator-zero condition to ensure the LR-HR perceptual consistency for flow matching models, leading to the proposed training-free solution with downsampling matrix selection and commutator-zero guidance. Extensive experiments show that our method can generate LR images with up to 33% computation reduction while maintaining HR perceptual consistency. When combined with existing acceleration techniques, our method achieves up to 3xspeedup. Moreover, our formulation can be extended to image manipulations, such as warping and translation, demonstrating its generalizability.
title_zh: 面向扩散模型高效工作流的无需训练、与高分辨率图像感知一致的低分辨率预览
abstract_zh: 图像生成模型已成为从普通用户到专业设计师等所有人产出精美高分辨率（HR）图像不可或缺的工具。然而，要获得理想结果，通常需要使用不同的提示和随机种子生成大量 HR 图像，这给用户和服务提供商都带来了高昂的计算成本。先生成低分辨率（LR）图像可以减轻计算负担，但如何生成与对应 HR 图像在感知上一致的 LR 图像并非易事。本文研究生成高保真 LR 图像（称为 Previews）的任务，这些图像在高效工作流中保持与其 HR 对应图像的感知相似性，使用户能够在生成最终 HR 图像之前识别有前景的候选结果。我们提出 commutator-zero 条件，以确保 flow matching 模型的 LR-HR 感知一致性，并由此提出一种无需训练的解决方案，包含下采样矩阵选择和 commutator-zero 引导。大量实验表明，我们的方法能够生成 LR 图像，在保持 HR 感知一致性的同时将计算量减少最多 33%。与现有加速技术结合时，我们的方法可实现最高 3 倍加速。此外，我们的形式化框架可扩展到图像扭曲和平移等图像操作，展现了其泛化能力。

title: Visual Diffusion Models are Geometric Solvers
abstract: In this paper we show that visual diffusion models can serve as effective geometric solvers: they can directly reason about geometric problems by working in pixel space. We first demonstrate this on the Inscribed Square Problem, a long-standing problem in geometry that asks whether every Jordan curve contains four points forming a square. We then extend the approach to two other well-known hard geometric problems: the Steiner Tree Problem and the Maximum Area Polygon Problem. Our method treats each problem instance as an image and trains a standard visual diffusion model that transforms Gaussian noise into an image representing a valid approximate solution that closely matches the exact one. The model learns to transform noisy geometric structures into correct configurations, effectively recasting geometric reasoning as image generation. Unlike prior work that necessitates specialized architectures and domain-specific adaptations when applying diffusion to parametric geometric representations, we employ a standard visual diffusion model that operates on the visual representation of the problem. This simplicity highlights a surprising bridge between generative modeling and geometric problem solving. Beyond the specific problems studied here, our results point toward a broader paradigm: operating in image space provides a general and practical framework for approximating notoriously hard problems, and opens the door to tackling a far wider class of challenging geometric tasks.
title_zh: 视觉扩散模型是几何求解器
abstract_zh: 本文表明，视觉扩散模型可以作为有效的几何求解器：它们能够在像素空间中直接对几何问题进行推理。我们首先在内接正方形问题（Inscribed Square Problem）上展示了这一点。该问题是几何学中长期存在的问题，询问每条 Jordan 曲线是否都包含四个构成正方形的点。随后，我们将该方法扩展到另外两个著名的困难几何问题：Steiner 树问题（Steiner Tree Problem）和最大面积多边形问题（Maximum Area Polygon Problem）。我们的方法将每个问题实例视为一幅图像，并训练一个标准的视觉扩散模型，将高斯噪声转换为表示有效近似解的图像，该近似解与精确解高度接近。模型学习将带噪几何结构转换为正确构型，从而有效地将几何推理重塑为图像生成。与以往将扩散模型应用于参数化几何表示时需要专门架构和领域特定适配的工作不同，我们采用一个在问题的视觉表示上运行的标准视觉扩散模型。这种简洁性凸显了生成建模与几何问题求解之间出人意料的联系。除本文研究的具体问题外，我们的结果还指向一种更广泛的范式：在图像空间中操作，为近似求解极其困难的问题提供了一个通用且实用的框架，并为解决更广泛类别的挑战性几何任务打开了大门。

title: Efficient and Training-Free Single-Image Diffusion Models
abstract: We consider the problem of generating images whose internal structure - defined by the distribution of patches across multiple scales---matches that of a single reference image. Recent approaches address this problem by training a diffusion model on a single image. But even in this setting, training is computationally expensive and requires hours of optimization. Instead, we model the image using a dataset of its patches at different scales. As this dataset is finite and the dimensionality of its patches is small, the score function for a noisy patch can be computed tractably using an optimal, closed-form denoiser, eliminating the need for neural network training. We integrate this patch-based denoiser into an efficient, training-free image diffusion model, and we describe how our method connects to classical patch-based image restoration techniques. Our approach achieves state-of-the-art generation quality and diversity compared to trained single-image diffusion models, and we demonstrate applications, including unconditional image generation, text-guided stylization, image symmetrization, and retargeting. Further, we show that our approach is compatible with latent space diffusion, and we show multiple additional acceleration techniques to achieve megapixel single-image generation in one second, and gigapixel generation in minutes.
title_zh: 高效且无需训练的单图像扩散模型
abstract_zh: 我们研究生成图像的问题，要求图像的内部结构——由多个尺度上 patch 的分布所定义——与单张参考图像相匹配。近期方法通过在单张图像上训练扩散模型来解决这一问题。但即使在这一设定下，训练的计算成本仍然很高，需要数小时的优化。相反，我们利用图像在不同尺度上的 patch 数据集对图像建模。由于该数据集有限且 patch 维度较小，含噪 patch 的得分函数可通过最优的闭式去噪器以可处理的方式计算，从而无需进行神经网络训练。我们将这种基于 patch 的去噪器集成到一个高效、无需训练的图像扩散模型中，并说明我们的方法与经典基于 patch 的图像复原技术之间的联系。与经过训练的单图像扩散模型相比，我们的方法实现了最先进的生成质量与多样性，并展示了多种应用，包括无条件图像生成、文本引导风格化、图像对称化和图像重定向。此外，我们证明该方法与潜空间扩散兼容，并展示了多种额外加速技术，可在一秒内实现百万像素级单图像生成，并在数分钟内实现十亿像素级生成。

title: PAM: A Pose-Appearance-Motion Engine for Sim-to-Real HOI Video Generation
abstract: Hand-object interaction (HOI) reconstruction and synthesis are becoming central to embodied AI and AR/VR. Yet, despite rapid progress, existing HOI generation research remains fragmented across three disjoint tracks: (1) pose-only synthesis that predicts MANO trajectories without producing pixels; (2) single-image HOI generation that hallucinates appearance from masks or 2D cues but lacks dynamics; and (3) video generation methods that require both the entire pose sequence and the ground-truth first frame as inputs, preventing true sim-to-real deployment. Inspired by the philosophy of previous work, we think that HOI generation requires a unified engine that brings together pose, appearance, and motion within one coherent framework. Thus we introduce PAM: a Pose-Appearance-Motion Engine for controllable HOI video generation. The performance of our engine is validated by: (1) On DexYCB, we obtain an FVD of 29.13 (vs. 38.83 for InterDyn), and MPJPE of 19.37 mm (vs. 30.05 mm for CosHand), while generating higher-resolution 480x720 videos compared to 256x256/256x384 baselines. (2) On OAKINK2, our full multi-condition model improves FVD from 68.76 - 46.31. (3) An ablation over input conditions on DexYCB shows that combining depth, segmentation, and keypoints consistently yields the best results. (4) For a downstream hand pose estimation task using SimpleHand, augmenting training with 3,400 synthetic videos (207k frames) allows a model trained on only 50% of the real data plus our synthetic data to match the 100% real baseline.
title_zh: PAM：面向 Sim-to-Real HOI 视频生成的姿态-外观-运动引擎
abstract_zh: 手物交互（HOI）重建与合成正日益成为具身 AI 和 AR/VR 的核心。然而，尽管进展迅速，现有 HOI 生成研究仍分散在三条互不相交的技术路线中：（1）仅姿态合成，可预测 MANO 轨迹但不生成像素；（2）单图像 HOI 生成，根据掩码或 2D 线索臆造外观，但缺乏动态；（3）视频生成方法，需要将完整姿态序列和真值首帧同时作为输入，因而无法实现真正的 sim-to-real 部署。受以往工作理念的启发，我们认为 HOI 生成需要一个统一引擎，在一个连贯框架内融合姿态、外观和运动。为此，我们提出 PAM：一个用于可控 HOI 视频生成的姿态-外观-运动引擎。我们的引擎性能通过以下结果得到验证：（1）在 DexYCB 上，我们取得 29.13 的 FVD（InterDyn 为 38.83）和 19.37 mm 的 MPJPE（CosHand 为 30.05 mm），同时相比 256×256/256×384 基线生成分辨率更高的 480×720 视频。（2）在 OAKINK2 上，我们的完整多条件模型将 FVD 从 68.76 改善至 46.31。（3）在 DexYCB 上对输入条件进行的消融实验表明，结合深度、分割和关键点始终能取得最佳结果。（4）对于使用 SimpleHand 的下游手部姿态估计任务，使用 3,400 段合成视频（207k 帧）增强训练后，仅用 50% 真实数据加我们的合成数据训练的模型即可达到与 100% 真实数据基线相当的水平。

title: Asynchronous Policy Gradient Aggregation for Efficient Distributed Reinforcement Learning
abstract: We study distributed reinforcement learning (RL) with policy gradient methods under asynchronous and parallel computations and communications. While non-distributed methods are well understood theoretically and have achieved remarkable empirical success, their distributed counterparts remain less explored, particularly in the presence of heterogeneous asynchronous computations and communication bottlenecks. We introduce two new algorithms, Rennala NIGT and Malenia NIGT, which implement asynchronous policy gradient aggregation and achieve state-of-the-art efficiency. In the homogeneous setting, Rennala NIGT provably improves the total computational and communication complexity while supporting the AllReduce operation. In the heterogeneous setting, Malenia NIGT simultaneously handles asynchronous computations and heterogeneous environments with strictly better theoretical guarantees. Our results are further corroborated by experiments, showing that our methods significantly outperform prior approaches. $('.dropdown-menu a.dropdown-toggle').on('click', function (e) { if (!$(this).next().hasClass('show')) { $(this).parents('.dropdown-menu').first().find('.show').removeClass("show"); } var $subMenu = $(this).next(".dropdown-menu"); $subMenu.toggleClass('show'); $(this).parents('li.nav-item.dropdown.show').on('hidden.bs.dropdown', function (e) { $('.dropdown-submenu .show').removeClass("show"); }); return false; }); Name Change Policy × Requests for name changes in the electronic proceedings will be accepted with no questions asked. title_zh: 面向高效分布式强化学习的异步策略梯度聚合
abstract_zh: 我们研究在异步且并行的计算与通信条件下，使用策略梯度方法的分布式强化学习（RL）。尽管非分布式方法在理论上已被充分理解，并取得了显著的实证成功，但其分布式对应方法仍未得到充分探索，尤其是在存在异构异步计算和通信瓶颈的情况下。我们提出两种新算法 Rennala NIGT 和 Malenia NIGT，它们实现了异步策略梯度聚合，并达到了当前最优的效率。在同构设置下，Rennala NIGT 在支持 AllReduce 操作的同时，可证明地改善了总计算与通信复杂度。在异构设置下，Malenia NIGT 能同时处理异步计算和异构环境，并具有严格更优的理论保证。实验结果进一步印证了我们的结论，表明我们的方法显著优于先前方法。

title: Preserve and Personalize: Personalized Text-to-Image Diffusion Models without Distributional Drift
abstract: Personalizing text-to-image diffusion models involves integrating novel visual concepts from a small set of reference images while retaining the model’s original generative capabilities. However, this process often leads to overfitting, where the model ignores the user’s prompt and merely replicates the reference images. We attribute this issue to a fundamental misalignment between the true goals of personalization, which are subject fidelity and text alignment, and the training objectives of existing methods that fail to enforce both objectives simultaneously. Specifically, prior approaches often overlook the need to explicitly preserve the pretrained model’s output distribution, resulting in distributional drift that undermines diversity and coherence. To resolve these challenges, we introduce a Lipschitz-based regularization objective that constrains parameter updates during personalization, ensuring bounded deviation from the original distribution. This promotes consistency with the pretrained model’s behavior while enabling accurate adaptation to new concepts. Furthermore, our method offers a computationally efficient alternative to commonly used, resource-intensive sampling techniques. Through extensive experiments across diverse diffusion model architectures, we demonstrate that our approach achieves superior performance in both quantitative metrics and qualitative evaluations, consistently excelling in visual fidelity and prompt adherence. We further support these findings with comprehensive analyses, including ablation studies and visualizations. $('.dropdown-menu a.dropdown-toggle').on('click', function (e) { if (!$(this).next().hasClass('show')) { $(this).parents('.dropdown-menu').first().find('.show').removeClass("show"); } var $subMenu = $(this).next(".dropdown-menu"); $subMenu.toggleClass('show'); $(this).parents('li.nav-item.dropdown.show').on('hidden.bs.dropdown', function (e) { $('.dropdown-submenu .show').removeClass("show"); }); return false; }); Name Change Policy × Requests for name changes in the electronic proceedings will be accepted with no questions asked. title_zh: 保留与个性化：无分布漂移的个性化文本到图像扩散模型
abstract_zh: 个性化文本到图像扩散模型是指从少量参考图像中整合新的视觉概念，同时保留模型原有的生成能力。然而，这一过程往往导致过拟合：模型会忽略用户的提示（prompt），仅复制参考图像。我们将该问题归因于个性化的真实目标——主体保真度（subject fidelity）与文本对齐（text alignment）——与现有方法的训练目标之间存在根本性错位，后者未能同时强制实现这两个目标。具体而言，先前方法往往忽视了显式保留预训练模型输出分布的必要性，从而导致分布漂移（distributional drift），损害多样性和连贯性。为解决这些挑战，我们引入一种基于 Lipschitz 的正则化目标，在个性化过程中约束参数更新，确保其相对原始分布的偏离有界。这促进了与预训练模型行为的一致性，同时能够准确适应新概念。此外，我们的方法为常用但资源密集的采样技术提供了一种计算高效的替代方案。通过在多种扩散模型架构上的大量实验，我们证明该方法在定量指标和定性评估中均取得更优性能，并在视觉保真度和提示遵循方面始终表现突出。我们还通过包括消融研究和可视化在内的全面分析进一步支持这些发现。

title: MemoryVLA: Perceptual-Cognitive Memory in Vision-Language-Action Models for Robotic Manipulation
abstract: Temporal context is essential for robotic manipulation because such tasks are inherently non-Markovian, yet mainstream VLA models typically overlook it and struggle with long-horizon, temporally dependent tasks. Cognitive science suggests that humans rely on working memory to buffer short-lived representations for immediate control, while the hippocampal system preserves verbatim episodic details and semantic gist of past experience for long-term memory. Inspired by these mechanisms, we propose MemoryVLA, a Cognition-Memory-Action framework for long-horizon robotic manipulation. A pretrained VLM encodes the observation into perceptual and cognitive tokens that form working memory, while a Perceptual-Cognitive Memory Bank stores low-level details and high-level semantics consolidated from it. Working memory retrieves decision-relevant entries from the bank, adaptively fuses them with current tokens, and updates the bank by merging redundancies. Using these tokens, a memory-conditioned diffusion action expert yields temporally aware action sequences. We evaluate MemoryVLA on 150+ simulation and real-world tasks across three robots. On SimplerEnv-Bridge, Fractal, LIBERO-5 suites and Mikasa-Robo, it achieves 71.9%, 72.7%, 96.5%, and 41.2% success rates, respectively, all outperforming state-of-the-art baselines CogACT and pi-0, with a notable +14.6 gain on Bridge and +11.8 gain on Mikasa-Robo. On 12 real-world tasks spanning general skills and long-horizon temporal dependencies, MemoryVLA achieves 84.0% success rate, with long-horizon tasks showing a +26 improvement over state-of-the-art baseline. title_zh: MemoryVLA：面向机器人操作的视觉-语言-动作模型中的感知-认知记忆
abstract_zh: 时间上下文对于机器人操作至关重要，因为此类任务本质上是非马尔可夫的，但主流 VLA 模型通常忽视这一点，难以处理长时程、依赖时间的任务。认知科学表明，人类依赖工作记忆（working memory）缓存短暂的表示以进行即时控制，而海马体系统则保存过往经验的逐字情景细节和语义要旨，以形成长期记忆。受这些机制启发，我们提出 MemoryVLA，一种面向长时程机器人操作的“认知-记忆-行动”框架。预训练的 VLM 将观测编码为感知 token 和认知 token，构成工作记忆；感知-认知记忆库（Perceptual-Cognitive Memory Bank）则存储由此巩固而来的低层细节和高层语义。工作记忆从该记忆库中检索与决策相关的条目，将其与当前 token 自适应融合，并通过合并冗余来更新记忆库。利用这些 token，由记忆条件化的扩散动作专家生成具有时间感知能力的动作序列。我们在三种机器人上的 150 多个仿真和真实世界任务上评估 MemoryVLA。在 SimplerEnv-Bridge、Fractal、LIBERO-5 套件和 Mikasa-Robo 上，它分别达到 71.9%、72.7%、96.5% 和 41.2% 的成功率，均优于最先进基线 CogACT 和 pi-0，其中在 Bridge 上取得 +14.6 的显著提升，在 Mikasa-Robo 上取得 +11.8 的提升。在涵盖通用技能和长时程时间依赖性的 12 个真实世界任务上，MemoryVLA 达到 84.0% 的成功率，长时程任务相较最先进基线提升了 +26。项目主页：https://shihao1895.github.io/MemoryVLA

title: Bayesian Robust Cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning Against Unknown Adversaries
abstract: We consider the problem of robustness against adversarial attacks in cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning (c-MARL) at deployment time, where agents can face an adversary with an unknown objective. We address the uncertainty about the adversarial objective by proposing a Bayesian Dec-POMDP game model with a continuum of adversarial types, corresponding to distinct attack objectives. To compute a perfect Bayesian equilibrium (PBE) of the game, we introduce a novel partitioning scheme of adversarial policies based on their performance against a reference c-MARL policy. This allows us to cast the problem as finding a PBE in a finite-type Bayesian game. To compute the adversarial policies, we introduce the concept of an externally constrained reinforcement learning problem and present a provably convergent algorithm for solving it. Building on this, we propose to use a simultaneous gradient update scheme to obtain robust Bayesian c-MARL policies. Experiments on diverse benchmarks show that our approach, called BATPAL, outperforms state-of-the-art baselines under a wide variety of attack strategies, highlighting its robustness and adaptiveness. $('.dropdown-menu a.dropdown-toggle').on('click', function (e) { if (!$(this).next().hasClass('show')) { $(this).parents('.dropdown-menu').first().find('.show').removeClass("show"); } var $subMenu = $(this).next(".dropdown-menu"); $subMenu.toggleClass('show'); $(this).parents('li.nav-item.dropdown.show').on('hidden.bs.dropdown', function (e) { $('.dropdown-submenu .show').removeClass("show"); }); return false; }); Name Change Policy × Requests for name changes in the electronic proceedings will be accepted with no questions asked. title_zh: 面向未知对手的贝叶斯鲁棒协作多智能体强化学习
abstract_zh: 我们考虑部署阶段协作多智能体强化学习（c-MARL）中抵御对抗攻击的鲁棒性问题，此时智能体可能面对一个目标未知的对手。为处理对抗目标的不确定性，我们提出一种具有连续统对抗类型的贝叶斯 Dec-POMDP 博弈模型，其中每种对抗类型对应不同的攻击目标。为计算该博弈的完美贝叶斯均衡（PBE），我们引入一种新颖的对抗策略划分方案，依据其针对参考 c-MARL 策略的表现进行划分。这使我们能够将问题转化为在有限类型贝叶斯博弈中寻找 PBE。为计算对抗策略，我们引入外部约束强化学习问题的概念，并给出一种可证明收敛的求解算法。在此基础上，我们提出采用同步梯度更新方案来获得鲁棒的贝叶斯 c-MARL 策略。在多个基准上的实验表明，我们称为 BATPAL 的方法在多种攻击策略下均优于最先进基线，凸显了其鲁棒性与自适应性。

title: SocialJax: An Evaluation Suite for Multi-agent Reinforcement Learning in Sequential Social Dilemmas
abstract: Sequential social dilemmas pose a significant challenge in the field of multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL), requiring environments that accurately reflect the tension between individual and collective interests. Previous benchmarks and environments, such as Melting Pot, provide an evaluation protocol that measures generalization to new social partners in various test scenarios. However, running reinforcement learning algorithms in traditional environments requires substantial computational resources. In this paper, we introduce SocialJax, a suite of sequential social dilemma environments and algorithms implemented in JAX. JAX is a high-performance numerical computing library for Python that enables significant improvements in operational efficiency. Our experiments demonstrate that the SocialJax training pipeline achieves at least 50\texttimes{} speed-up in real-time performance compared to Melting Pot’s RLlib baselines. Additionally, we validate the effectiveness of baseline algorithms within SocialJax environments. Finally, we use Schelling diagrams to verify the social dilemma properties of these environments, ensuring that they accurately capture the dynamics of social dilemmas. $('.dropdown-menu a.dropdown-toggle').on('click', function (e) { if (!$(this).next().hasClass('show')) { $(this).parents('.dropdown-menu').first().find('.show').removeClass("show"); } var $subMenu = $(this).next(".dropdown-menu"); $subMenu.toggleClass('show'); $(this).parents('li.nav-item.dropdown.show').on('hidden.bs.dropdown', function (e) { $('.dropdown-submenu .show').removeClass("show"); }); return false; }); Name Change Policy × Requests for name changes in the electronic proceedings will be accepted with no questions asked. title_zh: SocialJax：序贯社会困境中多智能体强化学习的评估套件
abstract_zh: 序贯社会困境是多智能体强化学习（MARL）领域的一项重大挑战，需要能够准确反映个体利益与集体利益之间张力的环境。此前的基准和环境（如 Melting Pot）提供了一种评估协议，用于衡量模型在各种测试场景中对新社会伙伴的泛化能力。然而，在传统环境中运行强化学习算法需要大量计算资源。本文提出 SocialJax，一套使用 JAX 实现的序贯社会困境环境和算法套件。JAX 是一个面向 Python 的高性能数值计算库，可显著提升运行效率。我们的实验表明，与 Melting Pot 的 RLlib 基线相比，SocialJax 训练流水线在实时性能上至少实现 50× 加速。此外，我们验证了基线算法在 SocialJax 环境中的有效性。最后，我们使用 Schelling 图验证这些环境的社会困境性质，确保它们能准确刻画社会困境的动态。

title: Neural+Symbolic Approaches for Interpretable Actor-Critic Reinforcement Learning
abstract: The integration of neural networks into actor-critic frameworks has been pivotal in advancing the field of reinforcement learning, enabling agents to perform complex tasks with greater efficiency and adaptability. However, neural network-based actor-critic models remain opaque ``black boxes,'' concealing their decision-making processes and hindering their use in critical applications where transparent and explainable reasoning is essential. This work introduces an innovative adaptation of the actor-critic framework that unites neural networks with rule ensembles to tackle key challenges in reinforcement learning. We harness the computational power, scalability, and adaptability of neural networks to model the critic, while integrating a rule ensemble system for the actor, ensuring transparency and interpretability for decision-making. Our study establishes a theoretical foundation for integrating rule ensembles into the Advantage Actor-Critic (A2C) framework. Experimental results from seven classic and complex environments demonstrate that our proposed method matches or exceeds the performance of representative RL models, including symbolic methods, while offering self-interpretability and transparency. $('.dropdown-menu a.dropdown-toggle').on('click', function (e) { if (!$(this).next().hasClass('show')) { $(this).parents('.dropdown-menu').first().find('.show').removeClass("show"); } var $subMenu = $(this).next(".dropdown-menu"); $subMenu.toggleClass('show'); $(this).parents('li.nav-item.dropdown.show').on('hidden.bs.dropdown', function (e) { $('.dropdown-submenu .show').removeClass("show"); }); return false; }); Name Change Policy × Requests for name changes in the electronic proceedings will be accepted with no questions asked.
