title_zh: 用于可解释 Actor-Critic 强化学习的神经+符号方法
abstract_zh: 将神经网络集成到 Actor-Critic 框架中对推动强化学习领域的发展至关重要，使智能体能够以更高的效率和适应性执行复杂任务。然而，基于神经网络的 Actor-Critic 模型仍是晦涩的“黑箱”，隐藏了其决策过程，阻碍了它们在需要透明且可解释推理的关键应用中的应用。本文提出一种创新的 Actor-Critic 框架改造方法，将神经网络与规则集成（rule ensemble）相结合，以应对强化学习中的关键挑战。我们利用神经网络的计算能力、可扩展性和适应性来建模 critic，同时为 actor 集成规则集成系统，从而确保决策的透明性和可解释性。我们的研究为将规则集成整合到 Advantage Actor-Critic（A2C）框架中奠定了理论基础。来自七个经典且复杂环境的实验结果表明，所提方法在提供自解释性和透明性的同时，性能可匹敌或超过具有代表性的 RL 模型（包括符号方法）。

title: Non-conflicting Energy Minimization in Reinforcement Learning based Robot Control
abstract: Efficient robot locomotion often requires balancing task performance with energy expenditure. A common approach in reinforcement learning (RL) is to penalize energy use directly in the reward function. This requires carefully weighting the reward terms to avoid undesirable trade-offs where energy minimization harms task success or vice versa. In this work, we propose a hyperparameter-free gradient optimization method to minimize energy without conflicting with task performance. Inspired by recent works in multitask learning, our method applies policy gradient projection between task and energy objectives to promote non-conflicting updates. We evaluate this technique on standard locomotion benchmarks of DM-Control and HumanoidBench and demonstrate a reduction of $64$% energy usage while maintaining comparable task performance. Further, we conduct experiments on a Unitree GO2 quadruped showcasing Sim2Real transfer of energy efficient policies. Our method is easy to implement in standard RL pipelines with minimal code changes, and offers a principled alternative to reward shaping for energy efficient control policies.
title_zh: 基于强化学习的机器人控制中的无冲突能量最小化
abstract_zh: 高效的机器人运动通常需要在任务性能与能量消耗之间取得平衡。强化学习（RL）中的一种常见做法是在奖励函数中直接惩罚能量使用。这需要仔细权衡各项奖励项的权重，以避免出现能量最小化损害任务成功、或反之的不利权衡。本文提出一种无超参数的梯度优化方法，在不与任务性能冲突的情况下最小化能量。受多任务学习近期工作的启发，我们的方法在任务目标和能量目标之间应用策略梯度投影，以促进无冲突更新。我们在 DM-Control 和 HumanoidBench 的标准运动基准上评估该技术，结果表明，在保持相当任务性能的同时，能耗降低了 64%。此外，我们在 Unitree GO2 四足机器人上开展实验，展示了高能效策略的 Sim2Real 迁移。我们的方法易于在标准 RL 流水线中实现，仅需极少的代码修改，并为高能效控制策略的奖励塑形提供了一种有原则的替代方案。

title: ReCoDe: Reinforcement Learning-based Dynamic Constraint Design for Multi-Agent Coordination
abstract: Constraint-based optimization is a cornerstone of robotics, enabling the design of controllers that reliably encode task and safety requirements such as collision avoidance or formation adherence. However, handcrafted constraints can fail in multi-agent settings that demand complex coordination. We introduce ReCoDe—Reinforcement-based Constraint Design—a decentralized, hybrid framework that merges the reliability of optimization-based controllers with the adaptability of multi-agent reinforcement learning. Rather than discarding expert controllers, ReCoDe improves them by learning additional, dynamic constraints that capture subtler behaviors, for example, by constraining agent movements to prevent congestion in cluttered scenarios. Through local communication, agents collectively constrain their allowed actions to coordinate more effectively under changing conditions. In this work, we focus on applications of ReCoDe to multi-agent navigation tasks requiring intricate, context-based movements and consensus, where we show that it outperforms purely handcrafted controllers, other hybrid approaches, and standard MARL baselines. We give empirical (real robot) and theoretical evidence that retaining a user-defined controller, even when it is imperfect, is more efficient than learning from scratch, especially because ReCoDe can dynamically change the degree to which it relies on this controller.
title_zh: ReCoDe：基于强化学习的多智能体协调动态约束设计
abstract_zh: 基于约束的优化是机器人学的基石，使控制器能够可靠地编码任务和安全要求，例如避碰或保持队形。然而，在需要复杂协调的多智能体场景中，手工设计的约束可能失效。我们提出 ReCoDe——基于强化学习的约束设计（Reinforcement-based Constraint Design）——一种去中心化的混合框架，融合了基于优化的控制器的可靠性与多智能体强化学习的适应性。ReCoDe 并不抛弃专家控制器，而是通过学习额外的动态约束来改进它们，以捕捉更细微的行为，例如通过约束智能体的移动来防止拥挤场景中的拥堵。通过局部通信，智能体共同约束其允许的动作，从而在变化条件下更有效地协调。本文聚焦 ReCoDe 在需要复杂、基于上下文的运动与共识的多智能体导航任务中的应用，并表明它优于纯手工设计的控制器、其他混合方法以及标准 MARL 基线。我们提供了实证证据（真实机器人）和理论证据，表明保留用户定义的控制器（即使其并不完美）比从头学习更高效，尤其是因为 ReCoDe 能够动态调整其对该控制器的依赖程度。

title: Reflective Planning: Vision-Language Models for Multi-Stage Long-Horizon Robotic Manipulation
abstract: Solving complex long-horizon robotic manipulation problems requires sophisticated high-level planning capabilities, the ability to reason about the physical world, and reactively choose appropriate motor skills. Vision-language models (VLMs) pretrained on Internet data could in principle offer a framework for tackling such problems. However, in their current form, VLMs lack both the nuanced understanding of intricate physics required for robotic manipulation and the ability to reason over long horizons to address error compounding issues. In this paper, we introduce a novel test-time computation framework that enhances VLMs’ physical reasoning capabilities for multi-stage manipulation tasks. At its core, our approach iteratively improves a pretrained VLM with a “reflection” mechanism - it uses a generative model to imagine future world states, leverages these predictions to guide action selection, and critically reflects on potential suboptimalities to refine its reasoning. Experimental results demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms several state-of-the-art commercial VLMs as well as other post-training approaches such as Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS). Videos are available at https://corl2025-reflectvlm.github.io.
title_zh: 反思式规划：用于多阶段长时程机器人操作的视觉-语言模型
abstract_zh: 解决复杂的长时程机器人操作问题，需要精细的高层规划能力、对物理世界进行推理的能力，以及能够反应性地选择合适的运动技能。基于互联网数据预训练的视觉-语言模型（VLMs）原则上可以提供应对此类问题的框架。然而，现有 VLMs 既缺乏机器人操作所需的、对复杂物理过程的细致理解，也缺乏在长时程上进行推理以应对误差累积问题的能力。本文提出一种新颖的测试时计算框架，可增强 VLMs 在多阶段操作任务中的物理推理能力。该方法的核心是借助“反思”机制对预训练 VLM 进行迭代改进：利用生成模型想象未来世界状态，借助这些预测指导动作选择，并对潜在的次优之处进行批判性反思，以完善其推理。实验结果表明，我们的方法显著优于多种最先进的商用 VLMs 以及其他后训练方法，如蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）。视频见 https://corl2025-reflectvlm.github.io。

title: Temporal Distance-aware Transition Augmentation for Offline Model-based Reinforcement Learning
abstract: The goal of offline reinforcement learning (RL) is to extract the best possible policy from the previously collected dataset considering the out-of-distribution (OOD) sample issue. Offline model-based RL (MBRL) is a captivating solution capable of alleviating such issues through a state-action transition augmentation with a learned dynamic model. Unfortunately, offline MBRL methods have been observed to fail in sparse rewarded and long-horizon environments for a long time. In this work, we propose a novel MBRL method, dubbed Temporal Distance-Aware Transition Augmentation (TempDATA), that generates additional transitions in a geometrically structured representation space, instead of state space. For comprehending long-horizon behaviors efficiently, our main idea is to learn state abstraction, which captures a temporal distance from both trajectory and transition levels of state space. Our experiments empirically confirm that TempDATA outperforms previous offline MBRL methods and achieves matching or surpassing the performance of diffusion-based trajectory augmentation and goal-conditioned RL on the D4RL AntMaze, FrankaKitchen, CALVIN, and pixel-based FrankaKitchen.
title_zh: 面向离线基于模型的强化学习的时间距离感知转移增强
abstract_zh: 离线强化学习（RL）的目标是在考虑分布外（OOD）样本问题的情况下，从先前收集的数据集中提取尽可能好的策略。离线基于模型的强化学习（MBRL）是一种颇具吸引力的解决方案，能够通过利用学习到的动力学模型进行状态-动作转移增强来缓解此类问题。遗憾的是，长期以来人们观察到离线 MBRL 方法在稀疏奖励和长时程环境中会失效。本文提出一种新的 MBRL 方法，称为时间距离感知转移增强（TempDATA），它在几何结构化的表示空间中而非状态空间中生成额外的转移。为了高效理解长时程行为，我们的核心思想是学习状态抽象，从状态空间的轨迹层面和转移层面捕捉时间距离。实验经验性地证实，TempDATA 在 D4RL AntMaze、FrankaKitchen、CALVIN 以及基于像素的 FrankaKitchen 上优于现有的离线 MBRL 方法，并达到或超过了基于扩散的轨迹增强和目标条件 RL 的性能。

title: RestoreGrad: Signal Restoration Using Conditional Denoising Diffusion Models with Jointly Learned Prior
abstract: Denoising diffusion probabilistic models (DDPMs) can be utilized to recover a clean signal from its degraded observation(s) by conditioning the model on the degraded signal. The degraded signals are themselves contaminated versions of the clean signals; due to this correlation, they may encompass certain useful information about the target clean data distribution. However, existing adoption of the standard Gaussian as the prior distribution in turn discards such information when shaping the prior, resulting in sub-optimal performance. In this paper, we propose to improve conditional DDPMs for signal restoration by leveraging a more informative prior that is jointly learned with the diffusion model. The proposed framework, called RestoreGrad, seamlessly integrates DDPMs into the variational autoencoder (VAE) framework, taking advantage of the correlation between the degraded and clean signals to encode a better diffusion prior. On speech and image restoration tasks, we show that RestoreGrad demonstrates faster convergence (5-10 times fewer training steps) to achieve better quality of restored signals over existing DDPM baselines and improved robustness to using fewer sampling steps in inference time (2-2.5 times fewer), advocating the advantages of leveraging jointly learned prior for efficiency improvements in the diffusion process.
title_zh: RestoreGrad：使用具有联合学习先验的条件去噪扩散模型进行信号恢复
abstract_zh: 去噪扩散概率模型（DDPMs）可以通过以退化信号为条件，从其退化观测中恢复干净信号。退化信号本身是干净信号的受污染版本；由于这种相关性，它们可能包含有关目标干净数据分布的某些有用信息。然而，现有方法采用标准高斯作为先验分布，在构造先验时反而丢弃了这些信息，导致性能次优。本文提出利用与扩散模型联合学习的、更具信息量的先验来改进用于信号恢复的条件 DDPMs。所提出的框架 RestoreGrad 将 DDPMs 无缝集成到变分自编码器（VAE）框架中，利用退化信号与干净信号之间的相关性来编码更好的扩散先验。在语音和图像恢复任务上，我们表明，相比现有 DDPM 基线，RestoreGrad 能够以更快的收敛速度（训练步数减少到原来的 1/5–1/10）获得更高质量的恢复信号，并且在推理时使用更少采样步骤（减少到原来的 1/2–1/2.5）时具有更好的鲁棒性，从而证明了利用联合学习先验提升扩散过程效率的优势。

title: Distributionally Robust Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Dynamic Chute Mapping
abstract: In Amazon robotic warehouses, the destination-to-chute mapping problem is crucial for efficient package sorting. Often, however, this problem is complicated by uncertain and dynamic package induction rates, which can lead to increased package recirculation. To tackle this challenge, we introduce a Distributionally Robust Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (DRMARL) framework that learns a destination-to-chute mapping policy that is resilient to adversarial variations in induction rates. Specifically, DRMARL relies on group distributionally robust optimization (DRO) to learn a policy that performs well not only on average but also on each individual subpopulation of induction rates within the group that capture, for example, different seasonality or operation modes of the system. This approach is then combined with a novel contextual bandit-based estimator of the worst-case induction distribution for each state-action pair, significantly reducing the cost of exploration and thereby increasing the learning efficiency and scalability of our framework. Extensive simulations demonstrate that DRMARL achieves robust chute mapping in the presence of varying induction distributions, reducing package recirculation by an average of 80% in the simulation scenario.
title_zh: 用于动态滑槽映射的分布鲁棒多智能体强化学习
abstract_zh: 在 Amazon 机器人仓库中，目的地到滑槽的映射问题对于高效包裹分拣至关重要。然而，该问题常常因包裹导入速率的不确定性和动态变化而变得复杂，这可能导致包裹回流增加。为应对这一挑战，我们引入分布鲁棒多智能体强化学习（DRMARL）框架，学习一种对导入速率对抗性变化具有韧性的目的地到滑槽映射策略。具体而言，DRMARL 依赖分组分布鲁棒优化（DRO）来学习一种不仅在平均情况下表现良好，而且在组内各个导入速率子群体上也表现良好的策略；这些子群体反映了系统的不同季节性变化或运行模式等情形。随后，该方法与一种新颖的、基于上下文 bandit 的最坏情况导入分布估计器相结合，该估计器针对每个状态-动作对进行估计，显著降低了探索成本，从而提高了框架的学习效率和可扩展性。大量仿真表明，DRMARL 在导入分布变化的情况下能够实现鲁棒的滑槽映射，在仿真场景中将包裹回流平均降低 80%。

title: Constrained Exploitability Descent: An Offline Reinforcement Learning Method for Finding Mixed-Strategy Nash Equilibrium
abstract: This paper proposes Constrained Exploitability Descent (CED), a model-free offline reinforcement learning (RL) algorithm for solving adversarial Markov games (MGs). CED combines the game-theoretical approach of Exploitability Descent (ED) with policy constraint methods from offline RL. While policy constraints can perturb the optimal pure-strategy solutions in single-agent scenarios, we find the side effect less detrimental in adversarial games, where the optimal policy can be a mixed-strategy Nash equilibrium. We theoretically prove that, under the uniform coverage assumption on the dataset, CED converges to a stationary point in deterministic two-player zero-sum Markov games. We further prove that the min-player policy at the stationary point follows the property of mixed-strategy Nash equilibrium in MGs. Compared to the model-based ED method that optimizes the max-player policy, our CED method no longer relies on a generalized gradient. Experiments in matrix games, a tree-form game, and an infinite-horizon soccer game verify that CED can find an equilibrium policy for the min-player as long as the offline dataset guarantees uniform coverage. Besides, CED achieves a significantly lower NashConv compared to an existing pessimism-based method and can gradually improve the behavior policy even under non-uniform data coverages. When combined with neural networks, CED also outperforms behavior cloning and offline self-play in a large-scale two-team robotic combat game.
title_zh: 约束可利用度下降：一种用于寻找混合策略纳什均衡的离线强化学习方法
abstract_zh: 本文提出约束可利用度下降（CED），一种用于求解对抗性马尔可夫博弈（MGs）的无模型离线强化学习（RL）算法。CED 将可利用度下降（ED）的博弈论方法与离线 RL 中的策略约束方法相结合。尽管策略约束可能会扰动单智能体场景中的最优纯策略解，但我们发现这种副作用在对抗性博弈中危害较小，因为此时最优策略可以是混合策略纳什均衡。我们从理论上证明，在数据集满足均匀覆盖假设的情况下，CED 在确定性双人零和马尔可夫博弈中收敛到驻点。我们进一步证明，驻点处的 min-player 策略遵循 MGs 中混合策略纳什均衡的性质。与优化 max-player 策略的基于模型的 ED 方法相比，我们的 CED 方法不再依赖广义梯度。在矩阵博弈、一个树形博弈以及无限时域足球博弈上的实验验证了：只要离线数据集保证均匀覆盖，CED 就能为 min-player 找到均衡策略。此外，与现有的基于悲观主义的方法相比，CED 实现了显著更低的 NashConv，并且即使在非均匀数据覆盖下也能逐步改进行为策略。当与神经网络结合时，CED 在大规模双队机器人对战博弈中还优于行为克隆和离线自我对弈。

title: M$^3$HF: Multi-agent Reinforcement Learning from Multi-phase Human Feedback of Mixed Quality
abstract: Designing effective reward functions in multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) is a significant challenge, often leading to suboptimal or misaligned behaviors in complex, coordinated environments. We introduce Multi-agent Reinforcement Learning from Multi-phase Human Feedback of Mixed Quality ($\text{M}^3\text{HF}$), a novel framework that integrates multi-phase human feedback of mixed quality into the MARL training process. By involving humans with diverse expertise levels to provide iterative guidance, $\text{M}^3\text{HF}$ leverages both expert and non-expert feedback to continuously refine agents’ policies. During training, we strategically pause agent learning for human evaluation, parse feedback using large language models to assign it appropriately and update reward functions through predefined templates and adaptive weights by using weight decay and performance-based adjustments. Our approach enables the integration of nuanced human insights across various levels of quality, enhancing the interpretability and robustness of multi-agent cooperation. Empirical results in challenging environments demonstrate that $\text{M}^3\text{HF}$ significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods, effectively addressing the complexities of reward design in MARL and enabling broader human participation in the training process.
title_zh: M$^3$HF：基于混合质量多阶段人类反馈的多智能体强化学习
abstract_zh: 设计有效的奖励函数是多智能体强化学习（MARL）中的一项重大挑战，在复杂且需要协调的环境中，往往会导致次优或错位的行为。我们提出基于混合质量多阶段人类反馈的多智能体强化学习（M$^3$HF），这是一个将混合质量的多阶段人类反馈融入 MARL 训练过程的新颖框架。通过让具有不同专业水平的人类提供迭代指导，M$^3$HF 同时利用专家和非专家反馈来持续改进智能体策略。在训练过程中，我们有策略地暂停智能体学习以进行人类评估，使用大语言模型解析反馈以对其进行恰当分配，并通过预定义模板和自适应权重（利用权重衰减和基于性能的调整）来更新奖励函数。我们的方法能够整合不同质量水平的细致人类见解，增强多智能体合作的可解释性与鲁棒性。在具有挑战性的环境中的实证结果表明，M$^3$HF 显著优于最先进的方法，有效应对了 MARL 中奖励设计的复杂性，并使更广泛的人类能够参与训练过程。

title: Accelerating Quantum Reinforcement Learning with a Quantum Natural Policy Gradient Based Approach
abstract: We address the problem of quantum reinforcement learning (QRL) under model-free settings with quantum oracle access to the Markov Decision Process (MDP). This paper introduces a Quantum Natural Policy Gradient (QNPG) algorithm, which replaces the random sampling used in classical Natural Policy Gradient (NPG) estimators with a deterministic gradient estimation approach, enabling seamless integration into quantum systems. While this modification introduces a bounded bias in the estimator, the bias decays exponentially with increasing truncation levels. This paper demonstrates that the proposed QNPG algorithm achieves a sample complexity of $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(\epsilon^{-1.5})$ for queries to the quantum oracle, significantly improving the classical lower bound of $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(\epsilon^{-2})$ for queries to the MDP.
title_zh: 基于量子自然策略梯度的方法加速量子强化学习
abstract_zh: 我们研究无模型设定下的量子强化学习（QRL）问题，其中可以以量子预言机方式访问马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）。本文提出量子自然策略梯度（QNPG）算法，它用确定性梯度估计方法替代经典自然策略梯度（NPG）估计器中的随机采样，从而能够无缝集成到量子系统中。尽管这一修改会在估计器中引入有界偏差，但该偏差会随截断层级的增加而呈指数衰减。本文证明，所提出的 QNPG 算法在查询量子预言机时达到 Õ(ε^{-1.5}) 的样本复杂度，显著改进了查询 MDP 时经典的 Õ(ε^{-2}) 下界。

title: Reidentify: Context-Aware Identity Generation for Contextual Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
abstract: Generalizing multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) to accommodate variations in problem configurations remains a critical challenge in real-world applications, where even subtle differences in task setups can cause pre-trained policies to fail. To address this, we propose Context-Aware Identity Generation (CAID), a novel framework to enhance MARL performance under the Contextual MARL (CMARL) setting. CAID dynamically generates unique agent identities through the agent identity decoder built on a causal Transformer architecture. These identities provide contextualized representations that align corresponding agents across similar problem variants, facilitating policy reuse and improving sample efficiency. Furthermore, the action regulator in CAID incorporates these agent identities into the action-value space, enabling seamless adaptation to varying contexts. Extensive experiments on CMARL benchmarks demonstrate that CAID significantly outperforms existing approaches by enhancing both sample efficiency and generalization across diverse context variants.
title_zh: Reidentify：面向上下文多智能体强化学习的上下文感知身份生成
abstract_zh: 将多智能体强化学习（MARL）推广到能够适应问题配置变化的情形，仍然是实际应用中的一个关键挑战；即使任务设置存在细微差异，也可能导致预训练策略失效。为解决这一问题，我们提出上下文感知身份生成（CAID），这是一个在上下文多智能体强化学习（CMARL）设定下增强 MARL 性能的新颖框架。CAID 通过基于因果 Transformer 架构构建的智能体身份解码器动态生成唯一的智能体身份。这些身份提供了上下文相关的表示，使相似问题变体中的对应智能体能够对齐，从而促进策略复用并提高样本效率。此外，CAID 中的动作调节器将这些智能体身份融入动作-价值空间，实现对不同上下文的无缝适应。在 CMARL 基准上的大量实验表明，CAID 通过提升样本效率并增强在不同上下文变体间的泛化能力，显著优于现有方法。

title: Q-Supervised Contrastive Representation: A State Decoupling Framework for Safe Offline Reinforcement Learning
abstract: Safe offline reinforcement learning (RL), which aims to learn the safety-guaranteed policy without risky online interaction with environments, has attracted growing recent attention for safety-critical scenarios. However, existing approaches encounter out-of-distribution problems during the testing phase, which can result in potentially unsafe outcomes. This issue arises due to the infinite possible combinations of reward-related and cost-related states. In this work, we propose State Decoupling with Q-supervised Contrastive representation (SDQC), a novel framework that decouples the global observations into reward- and cost-related representations for decision-making, thereby improving the generalization capability for unfamiliar global observations. Compared with the classical representation learning methods, which typically require model-based estimation (e.g., bisimulation), we theoretically prove that our Q-supervised method generates a coarser representation while preserving the optimal policy, resulting in improved generalization performance. Experiments on DSRL benchmark problems provide compelling evidence that SDQC surpasses other baseline algorithms, especially for its exceptional ability to achieve almost zero violations in more than half of the tasks, while the state-of-the-art algorithm can only achieve the same level of success in a quarter of the tasks. Further, we demonstrate that SDQC possesses superior generalization ability when confronted with unseen environments.
title_zh: Q-Supervised Contrastive Representation：面向安全离线强化学习的状态解耦框架
abstract_zh: 安全离线强化学习（RL）旨在无需与环境进行有风险的在线交互即可学习具有安全保障的策略，近年来在安全关键场景中受到越来越多的关注。然而，现有方法在测试阶段会遇到分布外（out-of-distribution）问题，可能导致潜在的不安全结果。该问题源于与奖励相关的状态和与成本相关的状态存在无限种可能组合。本文提出 State Decoupling with Q-supervised Contrastive representation（SDQC），这是一个新颖框架，将全局观测解耦为与奖励相关和与成本相关的表征以用于决策，从而提升对陌生全局观测的泛化能力。与通常需要基于模型估计（例如双模拟，bisimulation）的经典表征学习方法相比，我们从理论上证明，我们的 Q-supervised 方法在保持最优策略的同时生成更粗粒度的表征，从而带来更好的泛化性能。在 DSRL 基准问题上的实验提供了有力证据，表明 SDQC 优于其他基线算法，尤其是它在超过一半的任务中能够实现几乎零违规，而最先进的算法只能在四分之一的任务中达到同等成功水平。此外，我们证明 SDQC 在面对未见过的环境时具有更优的泛化能力。

title: Reinforcement Learning with Random Time Horizons
abstract: We extend the standard reinforcement learning framework to random time horizons. While the classical setting typically assumes finite and deterministic or infinite runtimes of trajectories, we argue that multiple real-world applications naturally exhibit random (potentially trajectory-dependent) stopping times. Since those stopping times typically depend on the policy, their randomness has an effect on policy gradient formulas, which we (mostly for the first time) derive rigorously in this work both for stochastic and deterministic policies. We present two complementary perspectives, trajectory or state-space based, and establish connections to optimal control theory. Our numerical experiments demonstrate that using the proposed formulas can significantly improve optimization convergence compared to traditional approaches.
title_zh: 随机时间视界下的强化学习
abstract_zh: 我们将标准强化学习框架扩展到随机时间视界。经典设定通常假设轨迹运行时间为有限且确定性的，或无限长；我们认为，许多现实应用天然具有随机（可能依赖于轨迹）的停止时间。由于这些停止时间通常依赖于策略，其随机性会影响策略梯度公式；本文（大多是首次）针对随机策略和确定性策略严格推导了这些公式。我们给出了两种互补视角——基于轨迹和基于状态空间——并建立了与最优控制理论的联系。数值实验表明，与传统方法相比，使用所提出的公式可以显著改善优化收敛性。

title: Deep Reinforcement Learning from Hierarchical Preference Design
abstract: Reward design is a fundamental, yet challenging aspect of reinforcement learning (RL). Researchers typically utilize feedback signals from the environment to handcraft a reward function, but this process is not always effective due to the varying scale and intricate dependencies of the feedback signals. This paper shows by exploiting certain structures, one can ease the reward design process. Specifically, we propose a hierarchical reward design framework – HERON for scenarios: (I) The feedback signals naturally present hierarchy; (II) The reward is sparse, but with less important surrogate feedback to help policy learning. Both scenarios allow us to design a hierarchical decision tree induced by the importance ranking of the feedback signals to compare RL trajectories. With such preference data, we can then train a reward model for policy learning. We apply HERON to several RL applications, and we find that our framework can not only train high performing agents on a variety of difficult tasks, but also provide additional benefits such as improved sample efficiency and robustness.
title_zh: 基于分层偏好设计的深度强化学习
abstract_zh: 奖励设计是强化学习（RL）中基础但具有挑战性的方面。研究人员通常利用环境中的反馈信号手工设计奖励函数，但由于反馈信号的尺度各异且依赖关系复杂，这一过程并非总是有效。本文表明，通过利用某些结构，可以简化奖励设计过程。具体而言，我们针对以下场景提出了一种分层奖励设计框架 HERON：（I）反馈信号天然呈现层次结构；（II）奖励稀疏，但存在较不重要的替代反馈来帮助策略学习。这两种场景都允许我们设计一棵由反馈信号的重要性排序诱导的分层决策树，用于比较 RL 轨迹。借助此类偏好数据，我们随后可以训练奖励模型以用于策略学习。我们将 HERON 应用于多个 RL 应用，发现该框架不仅能在多种困难任务上训练出高性能智能体，还能带来额外优势，例如提升样本效率和鲁棒性。

title: Masked Autoencoders Are Effective Tokenizers for Diffusion Models
abstract: Recent advances in latent diffusion models have demonstrated their effectiveness for high-resolution image synthesis. However, the properties of the latent space from tokenizer for better learning and generation of diffusion models remain under-explored. Theoretically and empirically, we find that improved generation quality is closely tied to the latent distributions with better structure, such as the ones with fewer Gaussian Mixture modes and more discriminative features. Motivated by these insights, we propose MAETok, an autoencoder (AE) leveraging mask modeling to learn semantically rich latent space while maintaining reconstruction fidelity. Extensive experiments validate our analysis, demonstrating that the variational form of autoencoders is not necessary, and a discriminative latent space from AE alone enables state-of-the-art performance on ImageNet generation using only 128 tokens. MAETok achieves significant practical improvements, enabling a gFID of 1.69 with 76$\times$ faster training and 31$\times$ higher inference throughput for 512$\times$512 generation. Our findings show that the structure of the latent space, rather than variational constraints, is crucial for effective diffusion models. Code and trained models will be released.
title_zh: 掩码自编码器是扩散模型的有效 Tokenizer
abstract_zh: 潜扩散模型的最新进展已证明其在高分辨率图像合成中的有效性。然而，用于改善扩散模型学习与生成的 tokenizer 潜在空间性质仍未被充分探索。从理论和实证上，我们发现生成质量的提升与结构更优的潜在分布密切相关，例如具有更少高斯混合（Gaussian Mixture）模态和更具判别性特征的分布。受这些洞见启发，我们提出 MAETok，这是一种利用掩码建模来学习语义丰富潜在空间的自编码器（AE），同时保持重建保真度。大量实验验证了我们的分析，表明自编码器的变分形式并非必要；仅凭 AE 提供的判别性潜在空间，就能在使用仅 128 个 token 的情况下实现 ImageNet 生成的最先进性能。MAETok 实现了显著的实用改进：在 512×512 生成任务中，将训练速度提升 76×、推理吞吐量提高 31×，并实现 1.69 的 gFID。我们的发现表明，对于有效的扩散模型而言，关键在于潜在空间的结构，而非变分约束。代码和训练好的模型将会发布。

title: GeoMind: A Benchmark for Spatial Understanding in Robotic Manipulation
abstract: Robotic manipulation has advanced rapidly in mapping visual observations and language instructions to actions. However, reliable manipulation in open-world environments requires robust spatial understanding: the ability to identify targets in complex layouts (spatial reasoning) and adapt to scenes that continuously evolve through interaction (spatial memory). Yet existing embodied benchmarks fall short in evaluating spatial understanding: they often introduce strong visual cues that bypass spatial reasoning, and focus on static scenes that offer little insight into an agent's capacity for spatial memory. To address this gap, we introduce GeoMind, a systematic benchmark for structured spatial understanding through tabletop manipulation. GeoMind comprises 54 evaluated task variants organized around spatial reasoning and spatial memory. It also incorporates a scalable pipeline that automates the generation and annotation of task instances with verified targets and executable interactions. Extensive evaluations across diverse embodied agents reveal their consistent weaknesses in spatial understanding. Our findings highlight that these agents struggle to track identities after spatial changes and convert relational or geometric constraints into executable actions. We release the GeoMind benchmark at https://github.com/Notfound-JH/GEOMIND-benchmark.git.
title_zh: GeoMind：面向机器人操作空间理解的基准
abstract_zh: 机器人操作在将视觉观测和语言指令映射为动作方面已取得快速进展。然而，在开放世界环境中实现可靠的操作需要稳健的空间理解：既包括在复杂布局中识别目标的能力（空间推理），也包括适应通过交互不断演变的场景的能力（空间记忆）。然而，现有的具身基准在评估空间理解方面仍有不足：它们往往引入强烈的视觉线索，从而绕过空间推理；并且侧重于静态场景，难以揭示智能体的空间记忆能力。为弥补这一空白，我们提出 GeoMind，这是一个通过桌面操作评估结构化空间理解的系统性基准。GeoMind 包含 54 个经过评估的任务变体，围绕空间推理和空间记忆进行组织。它还包含一个可扩展的流水线，可自动生成和标注任务实例，并确保目标经过验证且交互可执行。对不同具身智能体的大量评估揭示了它们在空间理解方面持续存在的弱点。我们的发现强调，这些智能体难以在空间变化后跟踪目标身份，也难以将关系或几何约束转化为可执行动作。我们在 https://github.com/Notfound-JH/GEOMIND-benchmark.git 发布 GeoMind 基准。

title: LO-World: Unified BEV Latent Modeling for Joint 4D Occupancy and LiDAR Forecasting
abstract: LiDAR point clouds and 3D semantic occupancy represent two distinct modalities capturing fine-grained metric geometry and dense volumetric semantics, respectively, holding natural potential for mutual complementarity. However, existing world models typically forecast these modalities independently or cascade them heuristically, missing the opportunity for reciprocal cross-modal regularization. To address this, we propose LO-World, a unified 4D world model that forecasts both modalities within a shared BEV latent space. This single-stream formulation enables dense semantics and metric geometry to mutually reinforce each other, while eliminating multi-pipeline redundancy. Specifically, LO-World couples an efficient hybrid range-voxel autoencoder with a flow-matching generator that caches historical context to reduce iterative sampling latency. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LO-World outperforms prior state-of-the-art baselines, improving occupancy forecasting IoU by 10.9% and reducing LiDAR Chamfer Distance by 30.1%. Meanwhile, it sustains a real-time throughput exceeding 25 FPS on a single RTX 4090. Our code is available at https://github.com/lzzzzzm/LO-World.
title_zh: LO-World：面向联合 4D 占据与 LiDAR 预测的统一 BEV 潜在建模
abstract_zh: LiDAR 点云和 3D 语义占据代表两种不同的模态，分别捕捉细粒度的度量几何和稠密的体素语义，天然具有互补潜力。然而，现有世界模型通常独立预测这些模态，或以启发式方式将它们级联起来，错失了跨模态相互正则化的机会。为此，我们提出 LO-World，这是一个统一的 4D 世界模型，可在共享的 BEV 潜在空间中预测这两种模态。这种单流公式使稠密语义和度量几何能够相互增强，同时消除多流水线的冗余。具体而言，LO-World 将高效混合距离-体素自编码器与流匹配（flow-matching）生成器相结合，后者缓存历史上下文以降低迭代采样延迟。大量实验表明，LO-World 优于先前的最先进基线，将占据预测 IoU 提升了 10.9%，并将 LiDAR Chamfer Distance 降低了 30.1%。同时，它在单张 RTX 4090 上保持超过 25 FPS 的实时吞吐量。我们的代码可在 https://github.com/lzzzzzm/LO-World 获取。

title: KDPE: A Kernel Density Estimation Strategy for Diffusion Policy Trajectory Selection
abstract: Learning robot policies that capture multimodality in the training data has been a long-standing open challenge for behavior cloning. Recent approaches tackle the problem by modeling the conditional action distribution with generative models. One of these approaches is Diffusion Policy, which relies on a diffusion model to denoise random points into robot action trajectories. While achieving state-of-the-art performance, it has two main drawbacks that may lead the robot out of the data distribution during policy execution. First, the stochasticity of the denoising process can highly impact on the quality of generated trajectory of actions. Second, being a supervised learning approach, it can learn data outliers from the dataset used for training. Recent work focuses on mitigating these limitations by combining Diffusion Policy either with large-scale training or with classical behavior cloning algorithms. Instead, we propose KDPE, a Kernel Density Estimation-based strategy that filters out potentially harmful trajectories output of Diffusion Policy while keeping a low test-time computational overhead. For Kernel Density Estimation, we propose a manifold-aware kernel to model a probability density function for actions composed of end-effector Cartesian position, orientation, and gripper state. KDPE overall achieves better performance than Diffusion Policy on simulated single-arm RoboMimic and MimicGen tasks, and on three real robot experiments:PickPlush, a tabletop grasping task, CubeSort, a multimodal pick and place task, and CoffeeMaking, a task that requires long-horizon capabilities and precise execution. The code will be released upon acceptance and additional material is provided on our anonymized project page:https://kdpe-robotics.github.io.
title_zh: KDPE：一种用于 Diffusion Policy 轨迹选择的核密度估计策略
abstract_zh: 学习能够捕捉训练数据多模态性的机器人策略，一直是行为克隆中悬而未决的开放挑战。近期方法通过使用生成模型对条件动作分布建模来解决该问题。其中一种方法是 Diffusion Policy，它依赖扩散模型将随机点去噪为机器人动作轨迹。尽管其达到了最先进性能，但它存在两个主要缺点，可能在策略执行期间使机器人偏离数据分布。首先，去噪过程的随机性会极大地影响生成动作轨迹的质量。其次，作为一种监督学习方法，它可能从训练数据集中学到数据离群点。近期工作侧重于将 Diffusion Policy 与大规模训练或经典行为克隆算法相结合，以缓解这些局限。相反，我们提出 KDPE，这是一种基于核密度估计（Kernel Density Estimation）的策略，可过滤掉 Diffusion Policy 输出的潜在有害轨迹，同时保持较低的测试时计算开销。针对核密度估计，我们提出一种流形感知核，用于为由末端执行器笛卡尔位置、姿态和夹爪状态组成的动作建模概率密度函数。在仿真的单臂 RoboMimic 和 MimicGen 任务，以及三个真实机器人实验中：PickPlush（桌面抓取任务）、CubeSort（多模态抓取放置任务）和 CoffeeMaking（需要长时程能力和精确执行的任务），KDPE 总体上取得了优于 Diffusion Policy 的性能。代码将在接收后发布，更多材料见我们的匿名项目页面：https://kdpe-robotics.github.io。

title: CADMA: Capacity-Aware Coverage Decomposition for Generative Model Assessment
abstract: Evaluating generative models requires measuring not only sample fidelity but also how well a generated set covers the real data distribution. Recent work has therefore introduced recall-oriented metrics for distribution-level evaluation. However, existing recall metrics often reduce distributional coverage to geometry-based coverage. This simplifying assumption weakens their diagnostic value and interpretability in two ways: these metrics provide only a single aggregate score that cannot distinguish essential diversity failures such as mode dropping and mode collapse, and geometry-based coverage can provide unreliable estimates by assigning high scores to poorly covered generative distributions. We therefore introduce CADMA, a capacity-aware framework for recall-oriented evaluation and diagnosis. CADMA evaluates distributional coverage through local capacity matching between real and generated samples, separating geometry-based coverage from effective coverage. This yields multi-dimensional coverage diagnostics that quantify mode dropping and mode collapse while reducing the overly optimistic estimates produced by geometry-based metrics. Through extensive experiments on toy data, real-world datasets, and generative models, we show that CADMA provides more reliable coverage estimates and more fine-grained, interpretable diagnostic signals of diversity failures than existing metrics. Our code is available at https://github.com/Open-Debin/CADMA_NeurIPS2026.
title_zh: CADMA：用于生成模型评估的容量感知覆盖分解
abstract_zh: 评估生成模型不仅需要衡量样本保真度，还需要衡量生成集合对真实数据分布的覆盖程度。因此，近期工作引入了面向召回的指标，用于分布级评估。然而，现有召回指标通常将分布覆盖简化为基于几何的覆盖。这种简化假设在两方面削弱了其诊断价值和可解释性：这些指标仅提供单一聚合分数，无法区分模式丢弃（mode dropping）和模式崩溃（mode collapse）等关键多样性失效；而基于几何的覆盖可能通过给覆盖不佳的生成分布赋予高分，提供不可靠的估计。因此，我们提出 CADMA，这是一个面向召回评估与诊断的容量感知框架。CADMA 通过真实样本与生成样本之间的局部容量匹配来评估分布覆盖，将基于几何的覆盖与有效覆盖区分开来。这产生了多维覆盖诊断，可量化模式丢弃和模式崩溃，同时减少基于几何的指标所产生的过度乐观估计。通过在玩具数据、真实世界数据集和生成模型上的大量实验，我们表明 CADMA 比现有指标提供了更可靠的覆盖估计，以及更细粒度、可解释的多样性失效诊断信号。我们的代码可在 https://github.com/Open-Debin/CADMA_NeurIPS2026 获取。

title: Test-Time Alignment of Text-to-Image Diffusion Models via Null-Text Embedding Optimisation
abstract: Test-time alignment (TTA) aims to adapt models to specific rewards during inference. However, existing methods tend to either under-optimise or over-optimise (reward hack) the target reward function. We propose Null-Text Test-Time Alignment (Null-TTA), which aligns diffusion models by optimising the unconditional embedding in classifier-free guidance, rather than manipulating latent or noise variables. Due to the structured semantic nature of the text embedding space, this ensures alignment occurs on a semantically coherent manifold and prevents reward hacking (exploiting non-semantic noise patterns to improve the reward). Since the unconditional embedding in classifier-free guidance serves as the anchor for the model's generative distribution, Null-TTA directly steers model's generative distribution towards the target reward rather than just adjusting the samples, even without updating model parameters. Thanks to these desirable properties, we show that Null-TTA achieves state-of-the-art target test-time alignment while maintaining strong cross-reward generalisation. This establishes semantic-space optimisation as an effective and principled novel paradigm for TTA.
title_zh: 通过 Null-Text 嵌入优化实现文本到图像扩散模型的测试时对齐
abstract_zh: 测试时对齐（TTA）旨在推理阶段使模型适应特定的奖励函数。然而，现有方法往往会对目标奖励函数优化不足，或过度优化（奖励黑客，reward hack）。我们提出 Null-Text 测试时对齐（Null-TTA），通过优化无分类器引导（classifier-free guidance）中的无条件嵌入来对齐扩散模型，而非操纵潜变量或噪声变量。由于文本嵌入空间具有结构化的语义特性，这可确保对齐发生在语义连贯的流形上，并防止奖励黑客（利用非语义噪声模式提升奖励）。由于无分类器引导中的无条件嵌入充当模型生成分布的锚点，Null-TTA 即使不更新模型参数，也能直接将模型的生成分布引向目标奖励，而不仅仅是调整样本。得益于这些理想特性，我们证明 Null-TTA 在实现最先进的目标测试时对齐的同时，仍保持强大的跨奖励泛化能力。这确立了语义空间优化作为一种有效且有原则的 TTA 新范式。

title: The Drift Kernel: Why Diffusion Models Change Even When Told Not To
abstract: Even when told to "do nothing," modern diffusion models subtly alter their output relative to the input they are supposed to preserve. We call this effect No-Op Drift. We introduce the Drift Kernel K_M(sigma), defined as the expected perceptual deviation induced when running a diffusion model at noise strength sigma under a null instruction. Using 120,000 baseline samples (30,000 per model across SD15, SD21, SDXL, and InstructPix2Pix) and 9,600 ablation samples (four strengths, null versus strict copy prompts), we show that variance-driven diffusion models follow a quadratic form K_M(sigma) approximately equal to k_M sigma^2 plus c_M, with aggregate R^2 equal to 0.97. We derive this scaling from first principles via a Taylor expansion of the decoder, yielding k_M equal to Tr(J_D J_D^T), which depends only on the decoder Jacobian and not on prompts. To validate mechanistic structure, we construct synthetic decoders that reproduce the two regimes seen in practice: quadratic variance-driven drift and flat, high-variance edit-driven drift. We show that prompt wording has negligible effect (less than 17 percent coefficient difference), proving that drift is structural and not prompt-induced. We release NoOp-Bench, a benchmark with 10,000 inputs and full code for reproducible kernel estimation. Additional proofs, ablations, LPIPS and CLIP metrics, and extended visualizations appear in the Supplementary Material.
title_zh: Drift Kernel：为什么扩散模型即使被要求不变仍会改变
abstract_zh: 即使被要求“什么都不做”，现代扩散模型仍会相对于本应保留的输入微妙地改变其输出。我们将这一效应称为 No-Op Drift（空操作漂移）。我们引入 Drift Kernel K_M(σ)，其定义为在空指令下以噪声强度 σ 运行扩散模型时引起的期望感知偏差。使用 120,000 个基线样本（SD15、SD21、SDXL 和 InstructPix2Pix 各 30,000 个）和 9,600 个消融样本（四种强度，空指令与严格复制提示），我们表明方差驱动的扩散模型遵循二次形式 K_M(σ) ≈ k_M σ^2 + c_M，总体 R^2 为 0.97。我们通过对解码器进行泰勒展开，从第一性原理推导出该缩放关系，得到 k_M = Tr(J_D J_D^T)，其仅取决于解码器雅可比矩阵，而与提示无关。为验证机制结构，我们构建了合成解码器，以复现实践中出现的两种情形：二次型方差驱动漂移，以及平坦的高方差编辑驱动漂移。我们表明提示措辞的影响可忽略不计（系数差异小于 17%），证明漂移是结构性的，而非由提示引起。我们发布 NoOp-Bench，这是一个包含 10,000 个输入的基准，并提供完整代码以实现可复现的核估计。更多证明、消融实验、LPIPS 和 CLIP 指标以及扩展可视化详见补充材料。

title: Conditional Advantage Estimation for Reinforcement Learning in Large Reasoning Models
abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) for large language models (LLMs) has achieved remarkable progress in enhancing LLMs’ reasoning capabilities on tasks with clear correctness criteria, such as mathematical reasoning tasks. Several training metrics, such as entropy or response length, have been observed to correlate with different reasoning behaviors in reinforcement learning. Prior approaches incorporate such priors through reward or advantage shaping, which often relies on hand-crafted penalties and preferences (e.g., higher-is-better or lower-is-better). However, without careful hyper-parameter tuning, these directional priors can be overly biased and may lead to failure. To this end, we introduce C onditional adv AN tage estimati ON ( CANON ), amplifying the impact of the target metric without presuming its direction. Specifically, CANON regroups the sampled responses into two groups based on the higher or lower value of a target metric, measures which metric trend contributes to better performance through inter-group comparison, and identifies the better response within the same group. In summary, CANON based on entropy consistently outperforms prior methods across three LLMs on both math reasoning and high-complexity logic tasks. When applied to response length, CANON further improves token efficiency, yielding a more favorable Pareto frontier in the performance–cost trade-off. $('.dropdown-menu a.dropdown-toggle').on('click', function (e) { if (!$(this).next().hasClass('show')) { $(this).parents('.dropdown-menu').first().find('.show').removeClass("show"); } var $subMenu = $(this).next(".dropdown-menu"); $subMenu.toggleClass('show'); $(this).parents('li.nav-item.dropdown.show').on('hidden.bs.dropdown', function (e) { $('.dropdown-submenu .show').removeClass("show"); }); return false; }); Name Change Policy × Requests for name changes in the electronic proceedings will be accepted with no questions asked.
