title_zh: 面向大型推理模型强化学习的条件优势估计
abstract_zh: 面向大语言模型（LLM）的可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）在提升 LLM 于具有明确正确性标准的任务（如数学推理任务）上的推理能力方面取得了显著进展。已有观察表明，熵或响应长度等若干训练指标与强化学习中的不同推理行为相关。先前方法通过奖励或优势塑形引入此类先验，这通常依赖手工设计的惩罚和偏好（例如越高越好或越低越好）。然而，若不仔细调参，这些方向性先验可能过度偏置并导致失败。为此，我们提出条件优势估计（Conditional Advantage Estimation，CANON），在不预设目标指标方向的情况下放大其影响。具体而言，CANON 根据目标指标的较高或较低取值将采样响应重新分为两组，通过组间比较衡量哪种指标趋势有助于获得更好性能，并在同一组内识别更优响应。总之，基于熵的 CANON 在三个 LLM 上于数学推理和高复杂度逻辑任务中均持续优于先前方法。当应用于响应长度时，CANON 进一步提升 token 效率，在性能—成本权衡中形成更优的 Pareto 前沿。

title: DexUMI: Using Human Hand as the Universal Manipulation Interface for Dexterous Manipulation
abstract: We present DexUMI - a data collection and policy learning framework that uses the human hand as the natural interface to transfer dexterous manipulation skills to various robot hands. DexUMI incorporates hardware and software adaptations to minimize the embodiment gap between the human hand and various robot hands. The hardware adaptation bridges the kinematics gap with a wearable hand exoskeleton. It allows direct haptic feedback in manipulation data collection and adapts human motion to feasible robot hand motion. Our software adaptation bridges the visual gap by replacing the human hand in video data with high-fidelity robot hand inpainting. We demonstrate DexUMI’s capabilities through comprehensive real-world experiments on two different dexterous robot hand hardware platforms, achieving an average task success rate of 86%.
title_zh: DexUMI：以人手作为灵巧操作的通用操作接口
abstract_zh: 我们提出 DexUMI——一个数据收集与策略学习框架，以人手作为自然接口，将灵巧操作技能迁移到各种机器人手。DexUMI 结合硬件与软件适配，以最小化人手与各种机器人手之间的具身差距（embodiment gap）。硬件适配通过可穿戴手部外骨骼弥合运动学差距。它允许在操作数据收集过程中提供直接触觉反馈，并将人体运动适配为机器人手可行的运动。我们的软件适配通过高保真机器人手修复（inpainting）替换视频数据中的人手，从而弥合视觉差距。我们在两个不同的灵巧机器人手硬件平台上开展了全面的真实世界实验，展示 DexUMI 的能力，平均任务成功率达到 86%。

title: COMBO-Grasp: Learning Constraint-Based Manipulation for Bimanual Occluded Grasping
abstract: This paper addresses the challenge of occluded robot grasping, i.e. grasping in situations where the desired grasp poses are kinematically infeasible due to environmental constraints such as surface collisions. Existing RL methods struggle with task complexity, and collecting expert demonstrations is often impractical. Instead, inspired by human bimanual manipulation strategies, where two hands coordinate to stabilise and reorient objects, we focus on a bimanual robotic setup to tackle this challenge. In particular, we introduce Constraint-based Manipulation for Bimanual Occluded Grasping (COMBO-Grasp), an approach which leverages two coordinated policies: a constraint policy trained using self-supervised datasets to generate stabilising poses and a grasping policy trained using RL that reorients and grasps the target object. A key contribution lies in value function-guided policy coordination, where gradients from a jointly trained value function refine the constraint policy during RL training to improve bimanual coordination and task performance. Lastly, COMBO-Grasp employs teacher-student policy distillation to effectively deploy vision-based policies in real-world environments. Experiments show that COMBO-Grasp significantly outperforms baselines and generalises to unseen objects in both simulation and real environments.
title_zh: COMBO-Grasp：面向双臂遮挡抓取学习基于约束的操作
abstract_zh: 本文研究机器人遮挡抓取这一挑战，即在因表面碰撞等环境约束导致期望抓取位姿在运动学上不可行的情况下的抓取。现有强化学习方法难以应对任务复杂性，而收集专家演示往往不切实际。为此，受人类双手协调稳定和重新定向物体的双臂操作策略启发，我们聚焦双臂机器人设置来应对该挑战。具体而言，我们提出面向双臂遮挡抓取的基于约束操作（Constraint-based Manipulation for Bimanual Occluded Grasping，COMBO-Grasp），该方法利用两个协调策略：一个使用自监督数据集训练以生成稳定位姿的约束策略，以及一个使用 RL 训练以重新定向并抓取目标物体的抓取策略。一项关键贡献在于价值函数引导的策略协调：在 RL 训练期间，来自联合训练价值函数的梯度会细化约束策略，以改善双臂协调和任务性能。最后，COMBO-Grasp 采用教师—学生策略蒸馏，以在真实环境中有效部署基于视觉的策略。实验表明，COMBO-Grasp 在仿真和真实环境中均显著优于基线，并能泛化到未见过的物体。

title: Contrastive Forward Prediction Reinforcement Learning for Adaptive Fault-Tolerant Legged Robots
abstract: In complex environments, adaptive and fault-tolerant capabilities are essential for legged robot locomotion. To address this challenge, this study proposes a reinforcement learning framework that integrates contrastive learning with forward prediction to achieve fault-tolerant locomotion for legged robots. This framework constructs a forward prediction model with contrastive learning, incorporating a comparator and a forward model. The forward model predicts the robot’s subsequent state, and the comparator compares these predictions with actual states to generate critical prediction errors. These errors are systematically integrated into the controller, facilitating the continuous adjustment and refinement of control signals.Experiments on quadruped robots across different terrains and various joint damage scenarios have verified the effectiveness of our method, especially the functions of the comparator and the forward model. Furthermore, robots can adapt to locked joints without prior training, demonstrating zero-shot transfer capability. Finally, the proposed method demonstrates universal applicability to both quadruped and hexapod robots, highlighting its potential for broader applications in legged robotics.
title_zh: 面向自适应容错足式机器人的对比前向预测强化学习
abstract_zh: 在复杂环境中，自适应与容错能力对足式机器人运动至关重要。为应对这一挑战，本研究提出一种将对比学习与前向预测相结合的强化学习框架，以实现足式机器人的容错运动。该框架构建了一个结合对比学习的前向预测模型，包含比较器和前向模型。前向模型预测机器人的后续状态，比较器将这些预测与实际状态进行比较，以生成关键预测误差。这些误差被系统地集成到控制器中，促进控制信号的持续调整与优化。在不同地形和各种关节损伤场景下对四足机器人开展的实验验证了本方法的有效性，尤其是比较器和前向模型的作用。此外，机器人无需预先训练即可适应关节锁死，展现出零样本迁移能力。最后，所提方法对四足和六足机器人均表现出通用适用性，凸显了其在足式机器人领域更广泛应用中的潜力。

title: GLOVER++: Unleashing the Potential of Affordance Learning from Human Behaviors for Robotic Manipulation
abstract: Learning manipulation skills from human demonstration videos offers a promising path toward generalizable and interpretable robotic intelligence—particularly through the lens of *actionable affordances*. However, transferring such knowledge remains challenging due to: 1) a lack of large-scale datasets with precise affordance annotations, and 2) insufficient exploration of affordances in diverse manipulation contexts. To address these gaps, we introduce **HOVA-500K**, a large-scale, affordance-annotated dataset comprising 500,000 images across 1,726 object categories and 675 actions. We also release a standardized benchmarking suite for multi-modal affordance reasoning. Built upon HOVA-500K, we present **GLOVER++**, a *global-to-local* affordance training framework that effectively transfers actionable affordance knowledge from human demonstrations to downstream open-vocabulary reasoning tasks. GLOVER++ achieves state-of-the-art results on the HOVA-500K benchmark and demonstrates strong generalization across diverse downstream robotic manipulation tasks. By explicitly modeling actionable affordances, GLOVER++ facilitates robust transfer across scenes, modalities, and tasks. We hope that HOVA-500K and the GLOVER++ framework will serve as valuable resources for bridging the gap between human demonstrations and robotic manipulation capabilities. We will release our dataset, code and models.
title_zh: GLOVER++：释放从人类行为中学习可供性以用于机器人操作的潜力
abstract_zh: 从人类演示视频中学习操作技能，为实现可泛化且可解释的机器人智能提供了一条有前景的路径——尤其是通过可操作可供性（actionable affordances）这一视角。然而，迁移此类知识仍面临挑战，原因包括：1）缺乏具有精确可供性标注的大规模数据集；2）对不同操作情境中可供性的探索不足。为弥补这些空白，我们推出 HOVA-500K，这是一个大规模可供性标注数据集，包含跨 1,726 个物体类别和 675 种动作的 500,000 张图像。我们还发布了一套用于多模态可供性推理的标准化基准测试套件。基于 HOVA-500K，我们提出 GLOVER++，一个从全局到局部（global-to-local）的可供性训练框架，可将人类演示中的可操作可供性知识有效迁移到下游开放词汇推理任务。GLOVER++ 在 HOVA-500K 基准上取得最先进结果，并在多种下游机器人操作任务中展现出强大泛化能力。通过显式建模可操作可供性，GLOVER++ 促进了跨场景、跨模态和跨任务的稳健迁移。我们希望 HOVA-500K 和 GLOVER++ 框架能成为弥合人类演示与机器人操作能力之间差距的宝贵资源。我们将发布数据集、代码和模型。

title: Granular loco-manipulation: Repositioning rocks through strategic sand avalanche
abstract: Legged robots have the potential to leverage obstacles to climb steep sand slopes. However, efficiently repositioning these obstacles to desired locations is challenging. Here we present DiffusiveGRAIN, a learning-based method that enables a multi-legged robot to strategically induce localized sand avalanches during locomotion and indirectly manipulate obstacles. We conducted 375 trials, systematically varying obstacle spacing, robot orientation, and leg actions in 75 of them. Results show that movement of closely-spaced obstacles exhibit significant interference, requiring joint modeling. In addition, different multi-leg excavation actions could cause distinct robot state changes, necessitating integrated planning of manipulation and locomotion. To address these challenges, DiffusiveGRAIN includes a diffusion-based environment predictor to capture multi-obstacle movements under granular flow interferences and a robot state predictor to estimate changes in robot state from multi-leg action patterns. Deployment experiments (90 trials) demonstrate that by integrating the environment and robot state predictors, the robot can autonomously plan its movements based on loco-manipulation goals, successfully shifting closely located rocks to desired locations in over 65% of trials. Our study showcases the potential for a locomoting robot to strategically manipulate obstacles to achieve improved mobility on challenging terrains.
title_zh: 颗粒介质移动操作：通过策略性沙崩重新定位岩石
abstract_zh: 足式机器人有潜力利用障碍物攀爬陡峭沙坡。然而，如何高效地将这些障碍物重新定位到目标位置仍具挑战性。在此，我们提出 DiffusiveGRAIN，一种基于学习的方法，使多足机器人能够在运动过程中策略性地诱发局部沙崩，并间接操纵障碍物。我们进行了 375 次试验，并在其中 75 次试验中系统地改变障碍物间距、机器人朝向和腿部动作。结果表明，紧密排列障碍物的运动存在显著相互干扰，需要进行联合建模。此外，不同的多腿挖掘动作会导致不同的机器人状态变化，因此需要对操作与运动进行集成规划。为应对这些挑战，DiffusiveGRAIN 包含一个基于扩散的环境预测器，用于捕捉颗粒流干扰下的多障碍物运动；以及一个机器人状态预测器，用于根据多腿动作模式估计机器人状态变化。部署实验（90 次试验）表明，通过集成环境预测器和机器人状态预测器，机器人能够基于移动操作目标自主规划运动，在超过 65% 的试验中成功将邻近岩石移动到目标位置。我们的研究展示了运动机器人在挑战性地形上通过策略性操纵障碍物来提升移动能力的潜力。

title: Diffusion Models are Secretly Exchangeable: Parallelizing DDPMs via Auto Speculation
abstract: Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models (DDPMs) have emerged as powerful tools for generative modeling. However, their sequential computation requirements lead to significant inference-time bottlenecks. In this work, we utilize the connection between DDPMs and Stochastic Localization to prove that, under an appropriate reparametrization, the increments of DDPM satisfy an exchangeability property. This general insight enables near-black-box adaptation of various performance optimization techniques from autoregressive models to the diffusion setting. To demonstrate this, we introduce Autospeculative Decoding (ASD), an extension of the widely used speculative decoding algorithm to DDPMs that does not require any auxiliary draft models. Our theoretical analysis shows that ASD achieves a $\tilde{O}(K^{\frac{1}{3}})$ parallel runtime speedup over the $K$ step sequential DDPM. We also demonstrate that a practical implementation of autospeculative decoding accelerates DDPM inference significantly in various domains.
title_zh: 扩散模型暗中具有可交换性：通过 Auto Speculation 并行化 DDPM
abstract_zh: 去噪扩散概率模型（DDPM）已成为强大的生成建模工具。然而，其顺序计算需求会导致显著的推理时瓶颈。在本工作中，我们利用 DDPM 与随机局部化（Stochastic Localization）之间的联系，证明在适当的重参数化下，DDPM 的增量满足可交换性。这一普遍性洞见使得能够近乎黑盒式地将自回归模型中的各种性能优化技术适配到扩散场景。为证明这一点，我们提出自动推测解码（Autospeculative Decoding，ASD），这是将广泛使用的推测解码算法扩展到 DDPM 的版本，且无需任何辅助草稿模型。我们的理论分析表明，相对于 K 步顺序 DDPM，ASD 可实现 $\tilde{O}(K^{\frac{1}{3}})$ 的并行运行时加速。我们还证明，自动推测解码的实际实现能够在多个领域显著加速 DDPM 推理。

title: Enhancing Cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning with State Modelling and Adversarial Exploration
abstract: Learning to cooperate in distributed partially observable environments with no communication abilities poses significant challenges for multi-agent deep reinforcement learning (MARL). This paper addresses key concerns in this domain, focusing on inferring state representations from individual agent observations and leveraging these representations to enhance agents’ exploration and collaborative task execution policies. To this end, we propose a novel state modelling framework for cooperative MARL, where agents infer meaningful belief representations of the non-observable state, with respect to optimizing their own policies, while filtering redundant and less informative joint state information. Building upon this framework, we propose the MARL SMPE$^2$ algorithm. In SMPE$^2$, agents enhance their own policy’s discriminative abilities under partial observability, explicitly by incorporating their beliefs into the policy network, and implicitly by adopting an adversarial type of exploration policies which encourages agents to discover novel, high-value states while improving the discriminative abilities of others. Experimentally, we show that SMPE$^2$ outperforms a plethora of state-of-the-art MARL algorithms in complex fully cooperative tasks from the MPE, LBF, and RWARE benchmarks.
title_zh: 通过状态建模与对抗性探索增强合作式多智能体强化学习
abstract_zh: 在无通信能力的分布式部分可观测环境中学习合作，对多智能体深度强化学习（MARL）构成了重大挑战。本文针对该领域的关键问题，重点研究从单个智能体的观测中推断状态表示，并利用这些表示来增强智能体的探索与协作任务执行策略。为此，我们提出一种面向合作式 MARL 的新型状态建模框架，其中智能体推断关于不可观测状态的有意义信念表示，以优化自身策略，同时过滤冗余且信息量较少的联合状态信息。基于该框架，我们提出 MARL SMPE$^2$ 算法。在 SMPE$^2$ 中，智能体通过将自身信念显式纳入策略网络，并采用对抗式探索策略隐式地提高自身策略在部分可观测条件下的判别能力；该探索策略鼓励智能体发现新颖的高价值状态，同时提升其他智能体的判别能力。实验上，我们表明 SMPE$^2$ 在 MPE、LBF 和 RWARE 基准中的复杂完全合作任务上优于大量最先进的 MARL 算法。

title: LMRL Gym: Benchmarks for Multi-Turn Reinforcement Learning with Language Models
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) provide excellent text-generation capabilities, but standard prompting and generation methods generally do not lead to intentional or goal-directed agents and might necessitate considerable prompt tuning. Even the best current LLMs rarely ask clarifying questions, engage in explicit information gathering, or take actions that lead to better decisions after multiple turns. Reinforcement learning has the potential to leverage the powerful modeling capabilities of LLMs, as well as their internal representation of textual interactions, to create capable goal-directed language agents. This can enable intentional and temporally extended interactions, such as with humans, the emergence of complex skills such as persuasion, and long-horizon strategic behavior, such as in the context of games. Enabling this requires the community to develop reliable reinforcement learning algorithms for training LLMs. Developing such algorithms requires tasks that can gauge progress on algorithm design, provide accessible and reproducible evaluations for multi-turn interactions, and cover a range of task properties and challenges in improving reinforcement learning algorithms. Our paper introduces the LMRL-Gym benchmark for evaluating multi-turn RL for LLMs, together with an open-source research framework for getting started on multi-turn RL with offline value-based and online policy-based RL methods. Our benchmark consists of 3 Interactive Dialogue tasks and 5 RL Capability tests for a total of 8 tasks, which require multiple rounds of language interaction and cover a range of tasks in open-ended dialogue and text games.
title_zh: LMRL Gym：语言模型多轮强化学习的基准
abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）具有出色的文本生成能力，但标准的提示与生成方法通常无法得到有意图或目标导向的智能体，并且可能需要大量提示调优。即便是当前最好的 LLM，也很少主动提出澄清问题、进行显式信息收集，或采取能在多轮后带来更好决策的行动。强化学习有望利用 LLM 强大的建模能力及其对文本交互的内部表示，构建有能力的目标导向语言智能体。这可以实现有意图且跨时间延展的交互（例如与人类交互）、说服等复杂技能的涌现，以及长时程战略行为（例如在游戏情境中）。要实现这一点，需要社区开发可靠的 LLM 强化学习算法。开发此类算法需要这样的任务：能够衡量算法设计进展、为多轮交互提供易于使用且可复现的评估，并覆盖一系列任务属性以及改进强化学习算法所面临的挑战。本文提出 LMRL-Gym 基准，用于评估 LLM 的多轮 RL，并提供一个开源研究框架，帮助研究者借助离线基于价值的 RL 方法和在线基于策略的 RL 方法入门多轮 RL。我们的基准包含 3 个交互式对话任务和 5 个 RL 能力测试，共 8 个任务；这些任务需要多轮语言交互，涵盖开放式对话和文本游戏中的一系列任务。

title: Online Laplacian-Based Representation Learning in Reinforcement Learning
abstract: Representation learning plays a crucial role in reinforcement learning, especially in complex environments with high-dimensional and unstructured states. Effective representations can enhance the efficiency of learning algorithms by improving sample efficiency and generalization across tasks. This paper considers the Laplacian-based framework for representation learning, where the eigenvectors of the Laplacian matrix of the underlying transition graph are leveraged to encode meaningful features from raw sensory observations of the states. Despite the promising algorithmic advances in this framework, it remains an open question whether the Laplacian-based representations can be learned online and with theoretical guarantees along with policy learning. We address this by formulating an online optimization approach using the Asymmetric Graph Drawing Objective (AGDO) and analyzing its convergence via online projected gradient descent under mild assumptions. Our extensive simulation studies empirically validate the convergence guarantees to the true Laplacian representation. Furthermore, we provide insights into the compatibility of different reinforcement learning algorithms with online representation learning.
title_zh: 强化学习中的在线拉普拉斯表示学习
abstract_zh: 表示学习在强化学习中起着至关重要的作用，尤其是在状态具有高维且非结构化特征的复杂环境中。有效的表示可以通过提高样本效率和跨任务泛化能力来增强学习算法的效率。本文考虑基于拉普拉斯的表示学习框架，其中利用底层转移图的拉普拉斯矩阵的特征向量，从状态的原始感官观测中编码有意义特征。尽管该框架在算法上取得了有前景的进展，但能否在与策略学习同步进行的情况下在线学习基于拉普拉斯的表示并获得理论保证，仍是一个开放问题。为此，我们通过非对称图绘制目标（Asymmetric Graph Drawing Objective，AGDO）构建一种在线优化方法，并在温和假设下通过在线投影梯度下降分析其收敛性。我们的大量仿真研究从经验上验证了其收敛到真实拉普拉斯表示的保证。此外，我们深入探讨了不同强化学习算法与在线表示学习的兼容性。

title: Mechanisms of Projective Composition of Diffusion Models
abstract: We study the theoretical foundations of composition in diffusion models, with a particular focus on out-of-distribution extrapolation and length-generalization. Prior work has shown that composing distributions via linear score combination can achieve promising results, including length-generalization in some cases (Du et al., 2023; Liu et al., 2022). However, our theoretical understanding of how and why such compositions work remains incomplete. In fact, it is not even entirely clear what it means for composition to "work". This paper starts to address these fundamental gaps. We begin by precisely defining one possible desired result of composition, which we call projective composition . Then, we investigate: (1) when linear score combinations provably achieve projective composition, (2) whether reverse-diffusion sampling can generate the desired composition, and (3) the conditions under which composition fails. We connect our theoretical analysis to prior empirical observations where composition has either worked or failed, for reasons that were unclear at the time. Finally, we propose a simple heuristic to help predict the success or failure of new compositions.
title_zh: 扩散模型投影组合的机制
abstract_zh: 我们研究扩散模型中组合的理论基础，特别关注分布外外推和长度泛化。已有工作表明，通过线性得分组合来组合分布可以取得有前景的结果，在某些情况下还包括长度泛化（Du et al., 2023; Liu et al., 2022）。然而，我们对此类组合如何以及为何有效的理论理解仍不完整。事实上，甚至并不完全清楚组合“有效”意味着什么。本文开始弥补这些根本性空白。我们首先精确地定义一种可能的理想组合结果，称之为投影组合（projective composition）。然后，我们研究：(1) 线性得分组合在何时可证明实现投影组合；(2) 逆扩散采样能否生成所需的组合；(3) 组合在何种条件下失败。我们将理论分析与先前的经验观察联系起来，这些观察中组合曾成功或失败，而当时原因尚不清楚。最后，我们提出一个简单的启发式方法，以帮助预测新组合的成功或失败。

title: Concurrent Reinforcement Learning with Aggregated States via Randomized Least Squares Value Iteration
abstract: Designing learning agents that explore efficiently in a complex environment has been widely recognized as a fundamental challenge in reinforcement learning. While a number of works have demonstrated the effectiveness of techniques based on randomized value functions on a single agent, it remains unclear, from a theoretical point of view, whether injecting randomization can help a society of agents concurently explore an environment. The theoretical results established in this work tender an affirmative answer to this question. We adapt the concurrent learning framework to randomized least-squares value iteration (RLSVI) with aggregated state representation. We demonstrate polynomial worst-case regret bounds in both finite- and infinite-horizon environments. In both setups the per-agent regret decreases at an optimal rate of $\Theta\left(\frac{1}{\sqrt{N}}\right)$, highlighting the advantage of concurent learning. Our algorithm exhibits significantly lower space complexity compared to Russo (2019) and Agrawal et. al (2021). We reduce the space complexity by a factor of $K$ while incurring only a $\sqrt{K}$ increase in the worst-case regret bound, compared to Russo (2019) and Agrawal et. al (2021). Interestingly, our algorithm improves the worst-case regret bound of Russo (2019) by a factor of $H^{1/2}$, matching the improvement in Agrawal et. al (2021). However, this result is achieved through a fundamentally different algorithmic enhancement and proof technique. Additionally, we conduct numerical experiments to demonstrate our theoretical findings.
title_zh: 通过随机最小二乘值迭代实现聚合状态下的并发强化学习
abstract_zh: 设计能够在复杂环境中高效探索的学习智能体，已被广泛认为是强化学习中的一项根本挑战。尽管已有若干工作证明基于随机值函数的技术对单个智能体有效，但从理论角度看，注入随机性是否能帮助由多个智能体组成的群体并发地探索环境仍不清楚。本工作建立的理论结果对该问题给出了肯定回答。我们将并发学习框架适配到采用聚合状态表示的随机最小二乘值迭代（RLSVI）。我们在有限时域和无限时域环境中都展示了多项式最坏情况遗憾界。在两种设置中，每个智能体的遗憾都以 $\Theta\left(\frac{1}{\sqrt{N}}\right)$ 的最优速率下降，凸显了并发学习的优势。与 Russo（2019）和 Agrawal 等（2021）相比，我们的算法展现出显著更低的空间复杂度。与 Russo（2019）和 Agrawal 等（2021）相比，我们将空间复杂度降低为原来的 $1/K$，而最坏情况遗憾界仅增大为原来的 $\sqrt{K}$ 倍。有趣的是，我们的算法将 Russo（2019）的最坏情况遗憾界改进了 $H^{1/2}$ 倍，与 Agrawal 等（2021）的改进相当。然而，这一结果是通过根本不同的算法增强和证明技术实现的。此外，我们进行了数值实验以验证理论发现。

title: Thermo-VLA: A Thermal-Aware Vision-Language-Action Model with Gated Residual Modulation for Robotic Manipulation
abstract: Recent Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have begun incorporating thermal sensing, but existing approaches typically treat thermal images as ordinary visual inputs, providing limited support for temperature-aware relational reasoning in manipulation. To address this limitation, we propose Thermo-VLA with a ThermoRes Encoder, which decomposes thermal images into cold and hot attribute representations and injects them into the RGB token through language-conditioned residual modulation, enabling temperature-driven target selection and continuous manipulation. We further construct six real-world robotic tasks on a dual-arm Unitree G1 platform, spanning basic grounding to relational reasoning. Experiments show that Thermo-VLA achieves an average success rate of 0.86 across four thermal-dependent tasks, outperforming a pi_0.5 baseline that directly incorporates RGB-thermal observations by 18 percentage points. Under unseen-object and scene variations, Thermo-VLA maintains an average success rate of 0.78, achieving the best generalisation performance among the compared methods. Beyond thermal sensing, we transfer the same residual modulation mechanism to colour attributes and observe consistent improvements in both simulation and real-robot experiments, indicating its potential to generalise beyond thermal attributes. Project website: https://j-x-chen.github.io/Thermo-VLA-web/
title_zh: Thermo-VLA：一种用于机器人操作的、具有门控残差调制的热感知视觉-语言-动作模型
abstract_zh: 近期的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型已开始引入热感测，但现有方法通常将热图像视为普通视觉输入，对操作中的温度感知关系推理支持有限。为解决这一局限，我们提出 Thermo-VLA，并设计 ThermoRes 编码器；该编码器将热图像分解为冷、热属性表示，并通过语言条件残差调制将其注入 RGB token，从而实现温度驱动的目标选择和连续操作。我们进一步在双臂 Unitree G1 平台上构建了六个真实世界机器人任务，涵盖从基础定位到关系推理的范围。实验表明，Thermo-VLA 在四个依赖热感知的任务上取得 0.86 的平均成功率，比直接融合 RGB-热观测的 pi_0.5 基线高出 18 个百分点。在未见物体和场景变化下，Thermo-VLA 保持 0.78 的平均成功率，在对比方法中取得最佳泛化性能。除热感测之外，我们将相同的残差调制机制迁移到颜色属性，并在仿真和真实机器人实验中观察到一致的改进，表明其有潜力泛化到热属性之外。项目网站：https://j-x-chen.github.io/Thermo-VLA-web/

title: Direct Trajectory Optimization for Inference-Time Alignment of Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
abstract: Alignment of text-to-image diffusion models with reward functions is a key challenge in controllable generation. Existing approaches typically rely on optimizing model inputs or fine-tuning denoising networks, which requires computationally expensive backpropagation through large denoising models. In this work, we propose Direct Trajectory Optimization (DTO), a training-free framework that performs alignment by directly optimizing the sampling trajectory of diffusion models. Specifically, DTO treats intermediate denoising scores and sampled noise as the optimization variables, eliminating the need for gradients through the denoising network. To mitigate the out-of-distribution problem, we introduce Reward-Optimized Score Guidance, which interpolates between the optimized scores and the pretrained model predictions to stabilize sampling, while providing a provable theoretical guarantee of reward improvement under constrained distributions. Empirically, DTO improves alignment performance across three diffusion models on two benchmarks, outperforming existing inference-time alignment methods while maintaining high efficiency. These results suggest that trajectory-level optimization is a promising direction for efficient and effective diffusion model alignment.
title_zh: 面向文本到图像扩散模型推理时对齐的直接轨迹优化
abstract_zh: 使文本到图像扩散模型与奖励函数对齐，是可控生成中的一项关键挑战。现有方法通常依赖优化模型输入或微调去噪网络，这需要通过大型去噪模型进行计算代价高昂的反向传播。在本工作中，我们提出直接轨迹优化（Direct Trajectory Optimization，DTO），这是一个无需训练的框架，通过直接优化扩散模型的采样轨迹来执行对齐。具体而言，DTO 将中间去噪得分和采样噪声视为优化变量，从而无需通过去噪网络求梯度。为缓解分布外问题，我们引入奖励优化得分引导（Reward-Optimized Score Guidance），它在优化后的得分与预训练模型预测之间进行插值以稳定采样，同时在受限分布下提供可证明的奖励提升理论保证。在实验上，DTO 在两个基准上的三个扩散模型中提升了对齐性能，在保持高效率的同时优于现有的推理时对齐方法。这些结果表明，轨迹级优化是实现高效且有效的扩散模型对齐的一个有前景方向。

title: Learning Heterogeneous Tactile Representation for General Dexterous Manipulation
abstract: Tactile sensing is an indispensable modality for contact-rich dexterous manipulation, a capability that hints at the ultimate frontiers of embodied intelligence. However, commercially available tactile sensors are still at a relatively early stage of development, with each type of sensor offering irreplaceable strengths alongside its own drawbacks. A key challenge is thus to free tactile understanding from sensor-specific physics, so that embodied models can effectively leverage heterogeneous tactile data. To this end, we develop LingBot-Touch, a tactile foundation model characterized by the following properties. (i) Our model yields a unified representation across different tactile sensors (i.e., piezoresistive, magnetic, and visuotactile sensors), and is easily extensible to new sensor types. (ii) The resulting tactile tokens are plug-and-play: they can be seamlessly integrated into policy models across paradigms, from diffusion policy to vision-language-action (VLA) models such as π_0.5 and LingBot-VLA, consistently enhancing manipulation dexterity. (iii) Extensive experiments, spanning simulation and real-robot deployments across multiple hardware platforms, demonstrate that our tactile representation substantially benefits complex manipulation tasks while maintaining strong computational efficiency. We believe the findings in this work demonstrate the potential of leveraging cross-sensor data to scale tactile learning, and offer encouraging insights for the design of future hardware and embodied models.
title_zh: 学习用于通用灵巧操作的异构触觉表征
abstract_zh: 触觉感知是接触密集型灵巧操作不可或缺的模态，这一能力指向具身智能的终极前沿。然而，商用触觉传感器仍处于相对早期的发展阶段，每类传感器在具备不可替代优势的同时也有自身缺陷。因此，一个关键挑战是让触觉理解摆脱特定传感器的物理特性，使具身模型能够有效利用异构触觉数据。为此，我们开发了 LingBot-Touch，一个具有以下特性的触觉基础模型。(i) 我们的模型可在不同触觉传感器（即压阻式、磁式和视觉触觉传感器）之间产生统一表征，并且易于扩展到新的传感器类型。(ii) 由此得到的触觉 token 是即插即用的：它们可以无缝集成到不同范式的策略模型中，从 diffusion policy 到 π_0.5 和 LingBot-VLA 等视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，并持续提升操作灵巧性。(iii) 跨越多个硬件平台的仿真和真实机器人部署实验表明，我们的触觉表征在保持强大计算效率的同时，显著有益于复杂操作任务。我们相信，本工作的发现展示了利用跨传感器数据来扩展触觉学习的潜力，并为未来硬件和具身模型的设计提供了令人鼓舞的启示。

title: WMAdapter: Adding WaterMark Control to Latent Diffusion Models
abstract: Watermarking is essential for protecting the copyright of AI-generated images. We propose WMAdapter, a diffusion model watermark plugin that embeds user-specified watermark information seamlessly during the diffusion generation process. Unlike previous methods that modify diffusion modules to incorporate watermarks, WMAdapter is designed to keep all diffusion components intact, resulting in sharp, artifact-free images. To achieve this, we introduce two key innovations: (1) We develop a contextual adapter that conditions on the content of the cover image to generate adaptive watermark embeddings. (2) We implement an additional finetuning step and a hybrid finetuning strategy that suppresses noticeable artifacts while preserving the integrity of the diffusion components. Empirical results show that WMAdapter provides strong flexibility, superior image quality, and competitive watermark robustness.
title_zh: WMAdapter：为潜在扩散模型添加水印控制
abstract_zh: 水印对于保护 AI 生成图像的版权至关重要。我们提出 WMAdapter，一种扩散模型水印插件，可在扩散生成过程中无缝嵌入用户指定的水印信息。与以往通过修改扩散模块来加入水印的方法不同，WMAdapter 旨在保持所有扩散组件完整，从而生成清晰、无伪影的图像。为此，我们引入两项关键创新：(1) 我们开发了一种上下文适配器，它以载体图像的内容为条件，生成自适应的水印嵌入。(2) 我们实现了一个额外的微调步骤和一种混合微调策略，在抑制明显伪影的同时保持扩散组件的完整性。实证结果表明，WMAdapter 提供了很强的灵活性、更优的图像质量和有竞争力的水印鲁棒性。

title: $\pi_0.5$: a Vision-Language-Action Model with Open-World Generalization
abstract: In order for robots to be useful, they must perform practically relevant tasks in the real world, outside of the lab. While vision-language-action (VLA) models have demonstrated impressive results for end-to-end robot control, it remains an open question how far such models can generalize in the wild. We describe $\pi_{0.5}$, a new model based on $\pi_0$ that uses co-training on heterogeneous tasks to enable broad generalization. $\pi_{0.5}$ uses data from multiple robots, high-level semantic prediction, web data, and other sources to enable broadly generalizable real-world robotic manipulation. Our system uses a combination of co-training and hybrid multi-modal examples that combine image observations, language commands, object detections, semantic subtask prediction, and low-level actions. Our experiments show that this kind of knowledge transfer is essential for effective generalization, and we demonstrate for the first time that an end-to-end learning-enabled robotic system can perform long-horizon and dexterous manipulation skills, such as cleaning a kitchen or bedroom, in entirely new homes.
title_zh: π_0.5：具有开放世界泛化能力的视觉-语言-动作模型
abstract_zh: 为了让机器人真正有用，它们必须在实验室之外的真实世界中执行实际相关任务。尽管视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在端到端机器人控制方面已取得令人瞩目的成果，但这类模型在开放世界中能泛化到什么程度仍是一个未解问题。我们描述了 π_0.5，这是一个基于 π_0 的新模型，利用异构任务的协同训练实现广泛泛化。π_0.5 使用来自多个机器人、高层语义预测、网络数据及其他来源的数据，以实现广泛可泛化的真实世界机器人操作。我们的系统结合了协同训练与混合多模态示例，这些示例融合了图像观测、语言指令、物体检测、语义子任务预测和底层动作。实验表明，这种知识迁移对于有效泛化至关重要；我们首次证明，一个具备端到端学习能力的机器人系统能够在全新的家庭中执行长时程、灵巧的操作技能，例如清洁厨房或卧室。

title: Tactile Beyond Pixels: Multisensory Touch Representations for Robot Manipulation
abstract: We present TacX, the first multisensory touch representations across four tactile modalities: image, audio, motion, and pressure. Trained on 1M contact-rich interactions collected with the Digit 360 sensor, TacX captures complementary touch signals at diverse temporal and spatial scales. By leveraging self-supervised learning, TacX fuses these modalities into a unified representation that captures physical properties useful for downstream robot manipulation tasks. We study how to effectively integrate real-world touch representations for both imitation learning and tactile adaptation of sim-trained policies, showing that TacX boosts policy success rates by 63% over an end-to-end model using tactile images and improves robustness by 90% in recovering object states from touch. Finally, we benchmark TacX’s ability to make inference about physical properties, such as object-action identification, material-quantity estimation and force estimation. TacX improves accuracy in characterizing physical properties by 48% compared to end-to-end approaches, demonstrating the advantages of multisensory pretraining for capturing features essential for dexterous manipulation.
title_zh: 超越像素的触觉：面向机器人操作的多感官触觉表征
abstract_zh: 我们提出 TacX，这是首个跨四种触觉模态——图像、音频、运动与压力——的多感官触觉表征。TacX 在通过 Digit 360 传感器收集的 100 万次接触丰富交互上训练，能够捕获不同时间和空间尺度上的互补触觉信号。借助自监督学习，TacX 将这些模态融合为统一表征，捕获对下游机器人操作任务有用的物理属性。我们研究了如何有效地将真实世界触觉表征集成到模仿学习和仿真训练策略的触觉适应中，结果表明，与使用触觉图像的端到端模型相比，TacX 将策略成功率提升了 63%，并在从触觉恢复物体状态方面将鲁棒性提升了 90%。最后，我们评测了 TacX 推断物理属性的能力，例如物体-动作识别、材料用量估计和力估计。与端到端方法相比，TacX 将物理属性刻画准确率提升了 48%，展示了多感官预训练在捕获灵巧操作所需特征方面的优势。

title: Training Strategies for Efficient Embodied Reasoning
abstract: Robot chain-of-thought reasoning (CoT) – wherein a model predicts helpful intermediate representations before choosing actions – provides an effective method for improving the generalization and performance of robot policies, especially vision-language-action models (VLAs). While such approaches have been shown to improve performance and generalization, they suffer from core limitations, like needing specialized robot reasoning data and slow inference speeds. To design new robot reasoning approaches that address these issues, a more complete characterization of why reasoning helps policy performance is critical. We hypothesize several mechanisms by which robot reasoning improves policies – (1) better representation learning, (2) improved learning curricularization, and (3) increased expressivity – then devise simple variants of robot CoT reasoning to isolate and test each one. We find that learning to generate reasonings does lead to better VLA representations, while attending to the reasonings aids in actually leveraging these features for improved action prediction. Our results provide us with a better understanding of why CoT reasoning helps VLAs, which we use to introduce two simple and lightweight alternative recipes for robot reasoning. Our proposed approaches achieve significant performance gains over non-reasoning policies, state-of-the-art results on the LIBERO-90 benchmark, and a 3x inference speedup compared to standard robot reasoning.
title_zh: 高效具身推理的训练策略
abstract_zh: 机器人思维链推理（chain-of-thought reasoning，CoT）——即模型在选择动作之前预测有帮助的中间表征——是提升机器人策略尤其是视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）泛化性和性能的有效方法。尽管此类方法已被证明能够改善性能和泛化性，但它们存在核心局限，例如需要专门的机器人推理数据以及推理速度慢。为了设计能够解决这些问题的新机器人推理方法，必须更完整地刻画推理为何有助于策略性能。我们假设机器人推理通过若干机制改善策略——(1) 更好的表征学习，(2) 改进的课程学习安排，(3) 增强的表达能力——然后设计简单的机器人 CoT 推理变体来分别隔离并检验每种机制。我们发现，学习生成推理确实会带来更好的 VLA 表征，而关注推理则有助于实际利用这些特征来改进动作预测。我们的结果让我们更好地理解 CoT 推理为何有助于 VLA，并据此提出了两种简单轻量的机器人推理替代方案。我们提出的方法相较于非推理策略取得了显著性能提升，在 LIBERO-90 基准上取得了最先进结果，并且相较于标准机器人推理实现了 3 倍推理加速。

title: KineSoft: Learning Proprioceptive Manipulation Policies with Soft Robot Hands
abstract: Underactuated soft robot hands offer inherent safety and adaptability advantages over rigid systems, but developing dexterous manipulation skills remains challenging. While imitation learning shows promise for complex manipulation tasks, traditional approaches struggle with soft systems due to demonstration collection challenges and ineffective state representations. We present KineSoft, a framework enabling direct kinesthetic teaching of soft robotic hands by leveraging their natural compliance as a skill teaching advantage rather than only as a control challenge. KineSoft makes two key contributions: (1) an internal strain sensing array providing occlusion-free proprioceptive shape estimation, and (2) a shape-based imitation learning framework that uses proprioceptive feedback with a low-level shape-conditioned controller to ground diffusion-based policies. This enables human demonstrators to physically guide the robot while the system learns to associate proprioceptive patterns with successful manipulation strategies. We validate KineSoft through physical experiments, demonstrating superior shape estimation accuracy compared to baseline methods, precise shape-trajectory tracking, and higher task success rates compared to baseline imitation learning approaches. KineSoft’s results demonstrate that embracing the inherent properties of soft robots leads to intuitive and robust dexterous manipulation capabilities.
title_zh: KineSoft：使用软体机器人手学习本体感觉操作策略
abstract_zh: 欠驱动软体机器人手相较刚性系统具有固有的安全性和适应性优势，但开发灵巧操作技能仍然具有挑战性。尽管模仿学习在复杂操作任务中展现出潜力，传统方法因演示收集困难以及状态表征无效而在软体系统上举步维艰。我们提出 KineSoft，一个框架，利用软体机器人手固有的柔顺性作为技能教学优势，而不仅是控制挑战，从而支持对软体机器人手进行直接动觉示教。KineSoft 有两项关键贡献：(1) 一个内部应变传感阵列，提供无遮挡的本体感觉形状估计；(2) 一个基于形状的模仿学习框架，它使用本体感觉反馈和底层形状条件控制器来为基于扩散的策略提供基础。这使人类演示者能够在物理上引导机器人，同时系统学习将本体感觉模式与成功的操作策略相关联。我们通过物理实验验证了 KineSoft，证明其相比基线方法具有更优的形状估计精度、精确的形状-轨迹跟踪能力，以及相比基线模仿学习方法更高的任务成功率。KineSoft 的结果表明，接纳软体机器人的固有特性能够带来直观且鲁棒的灵巧操作能力。

title: DexSkin: High-Coverage Conformable Robotic Skin for Learning Contact-Rich Manipulation
abstract: Human skin provides a rich tactile sensing stream, localizing intentional and unintentional contact events over a large and contoured region. Replicating these tactile sensing capabilities for dexterous robotic manipulation systems remains a longstanding challenge. In this work, we take a step towards this goal by introducing DexSkin. DexSkin is a soft, conformable capacitive electronic skin that enables sensitive, localized, and calibratable tactile sensing, and can be tailored to varying geometries. We demonstrate its efficacy for learning downstream robotic manipulation by sensorizing a pair of parallel jaw gripper fingers, providing tactile coverage across almost the entire finger surfaces. We empirically evaluate DexSkin’s capabilities in learning challenging manipulation tasks that require sensing coverage across the entire surface of the fingers, such as reorienting objects in hand and wrapping elastic bands around boxes, in a learning-from-demonstration framework. We then show that, critically for data-driven approaches, DexSkin can be calibrated to enable model transfer across sensor instances, and demonstrate its applicability to online reinforcement learning on real robots. Our results highlight DexSkin’s suitability and practicality for learning real-world, contact-rich manipulation.
title_zh: DexSkin：用于学习接触丰富操作的高覆盖适形机器人皮肤
abstract_zh: 人类皮肤提供了丰富的触觉感知流，能够在大范围且具有轮廓的区域上定位有意和无意的接触事件。为灵巧机器人操作系统复现这些触觉感知能力仍是一项长期挑战。在本工作中，我们通过引入 DexSkin 朝这一目标迈进一步。DexSkin 是一种柔软、适形的电容式电子皮肤，能够实现灵敏、局部化且可校准的触觉感知，并可根据不同几何形状进行定制。我们通过为一对平行夹爪手指配备传感器，使其触觉覆盖几乎整个手指表面，展示了其在学习下游机器人操作方面的有效性。我们在示教学习框架中实证评估了 DexSkin 在学习具有挑战性的操作任务方面的能力，这些任务需要覆盖手指整个表面的感知，例如在手中重定向物体以及将橡皮筋缠绕到盒子上。随后我们表明，对于数据驱动方法至关重要的一点是，DexSkin 可以经过校准以实现跨传感器实例的模型迁移，并展示了其在真实机器人上在线强化学习的适用性。我们的结果凸显了 DexSkin 在学习真实世界接触丰富操作方面的适用性和实用性。

title: Visual Imitation Enables Contextual Humanoid Control
abstract: How can we teach humanoids to climb staircases and sit on chairs using the surrounding environment context? Arguably the simplest way is to _just show them_—casually capture a human motion video and feed it to humanoids. We introduce **VideoMimic**, a real-to-sim-to-real pipeline that mines everyday videos, jointly reconstructs the humans and the environment, and produces whole-body control policies for humanoid robots that perform the corresponding skills. We demonstrate the results of our pipeline on real humanoid robots, showing robust, repeatable contextual control such as staircase ascents and descents, sitting and standing from chairs and benches, as well as other dynamic whole-body skills all from a single policy, conditioned on the environment and global root commands. We hope our data and approach help enable a scalable path towards teaching humanoids to operate in diverse real-world environments.
title_zh: 视觉模仿实现情境化人形机器人控制
abstract_zh: 我们如何教人形机器人利用周围环境情境爬上楼梯、坐上椅子？可以说，最简单的方法就是直接示范给它们看——随手拍摄一段人类动作视频，再将其输入人形机器人。我们提出 VideoMimic，一种 real-to-sim-to-real 流水线：它挖掘日常视频，联合重建人与环境，并为人形机器人生成执行相应技能的全身控制策略。我们在真实人形机器人上展示了该流水线的结果，表明仅凭一个策略、以环境和全局根指令为条件，就能实现稳健、可重复的情境化控制，例如上下楼梯、从椅子和长凳上坐下与站起，以及其他动态全身技能。我们希望我们的数据和方法有助于铺就一条可扩展的路径，使人形机器人能够在多样化的真实环境中运行。

title: Safe Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Turn Clinical Agents: When Dense Rewards Beat Outcome Rewards
abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards is increasingly used to improve language model reasoning, yet its effects on sequential decision procedures remain poorly understood. We study this problem in clinical multi-turn agents that must decide what information to request, when to stop gathering evidence, and which action to take. We introduce three controlled environments: medication refill triage, acute diagnostic work-up, and dosing titration, each with hidden clinical states, query costs, exact adaptive oracles, and deterministic outcome verifiers. Across these tasks, outcome-only group relative policy optimization often improves aggregate reward while producing undesirable procedures, including premature commitment, one-question collapse, and failures on rare high-risk cases. In diagnostics, assigning dense credit to questions that reduce uncertainty improves held-out value and moderate-case support across three training seeds relative to outcome-only reinforcement learning, without the high-risk seed collapse observed under outcome-only training. Separating exploration from exploitation further increases high-risk support at its best checkpoint, but at the cost of excessive information gathering on low-acuity cases. Additional experiments show that the optimal strength of process credit is task-dependent; that after a supervised warmup that already gathers carefully, reinforcement learning raises aggregate reward by trimming questions while degrading high-risk performance; and that reinforcement learning does not reliably repair rare behavior gaps inherited from biased supervised data. Verifiable final outcomes are therefore insufficient for training reliable multi-turn agents: reward design must account for the procedure used to reach an answer, and evaluation must distinguish adaptive information gathering from reward-exploiting shortcuts.
title_zh: 多轮临床智能体的安全强化学习：稠密奖励何时胜过结果奖励
abstract_zh: 可验证奖励强化学习正越来越多地用于提升语言模型推理，但其对序贯决策流程的影响仍鲜为人知。我们在临床多轮智能体中研究这一问题；这些智能体必须决定请求哪些信息、何时停止收集证据以及采取哪项行动。我们引入三个受控环境：药物续方分诊、急性诊断检查和剂量滴定，每个环境都有隐藏的临床状态、查询成本、精确的自适应 oracle 以及确定性的结果验证器。在这些任务上，仅基于结果的 group relative policy optimization 往往提高总体奖励，却产生不良流程，包括过早下结论、单问题坍缩以及在罕见高风险病例上的失败。在诊断任务中，相对于仅结果强化学习，给降低不确定性的问题分配稠密信用，在三个训练种子上提高了留出价值和中度病例支持率，且未出现仅结果训练中观察到的高风险种子崩溃。将探索与利用分离，在其最佳检查点进一步提高了高风险支持率，但代价是在低急症程度病例上过度收集信息。额外实验表明，过程信用的最优强度取决于任务；在已经能仔细收集信息的监督预热之后，强化学习通过削减问题提高了总体奖励，却降低了高风险表现；并且强化学习无法可靠修复从有偏监督数据继承的罕见行为差距。因此，可验证的最终结果不足以训练可靠的多轮智能体：奖励设计必须考虑用于达成答案的流程，评估必须区分自适应信息收集与利用奖励漏洞的捷径。

title: Decoupled Asynchronous System for Humanoids (DASH): Latency-Agnostic Scaling of Vision-Language-Action Models for Humanoid Manipulation
abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models pair a vision-language backbone with an action head, but in closed-loop control the backbone sits on the control-critical path: while it computes, the robot keeps moving, so each executed action is conditioned on an increasingly stale observation. A larger backbone therefore directly blocks reactivity, especially in humanoid dexterous manipulation. We present DASH, a Decoupled Asynchronous System for Humanoids that removes this coupling. DASH splits the policy into a slow vision-language model (System 2) and a fast flow-matching action head (System 1) that run as concurrent processes over the LCM communication protocol, so the control rate is set by the action head alone, independent of backbone size. The action head fuses stale semantics from a frozen backbone with fresh vision from its own ResNet encoder, desynchronized training exposes it to the staleness it meets at deployment, and an adaptive temporal aggregator aligns overlapping action chunks under variable inference latency. On an asynchronous RoboTwin benchmark that charges inference latency in simulated time, DASH holds 20 Hz control rate from 0.8B to 8B backbones while the synchronous rate falls from 9.7 to 4.1 Hz, with higher success at every size. On a real humanoid with dexterous hands, DASH achieves clearly higher pick-and-place success than the synchronous pipeline.
title_zh: 用于人形机器人的解耦异步系统（DASH）：人形机器人操作中视觉-语言-动作模型的延迟无关扩展
abstract_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型将视觉-语言骨干网络与动作头配对，但在闭环控制中，骨干网络位于控制关键路径上：在其计算期间，机器人仍在运动，因此每个执行的动作都基于越来越陈旧的观测。更大的骨干网络因此会直接阻碍反应能力，尤其是在人形机器人灵巧操作中。我们提出 DASH，一种用于人形机器人的解耦异步系统，它消除了这种耦合。DASH 将策略拆分为慢速视觉-语言模型（System 2）和快速 flow-matching 动作头（System 1），二者通过 LCM 通信协议作为并发进程运行，因此控制频率仅由动作头决定，与骨干网络规模无关。动作头将来自冻结骨干网络的陈旧语义与其自身 ResNet 编码器的新鲜视觉信息融合；去同步训练使其接触到部署时会遇到的陈旧性；自适应时间聚合器则在可变推理延迟下对齐重叠的动作块。在一个按模拟时间计入推理延迟的异步 RoboTwin 基准上，DASH 在 0.8B 至 8B 骨干网络下保持 20 Hz 控制频率，而同步频率从 9.7 Hz 降至 4.1 Hz，且在各规模下成功率都更高。在配备灵巧手的真实人形机器人上，DASH 的抓取放置成功率明显高于同步流水线。

title: Parallel Simulation for Log-concave Sampling and Score-based Diffusion Models
abstract: Sampling from high-dimensional probability distributions is fundamental in machine learning and statistics. As datasets grow larger, computational efficiency becomes increasingly important, particularly in reducing adaptive complexity , namely the number of sequential rounds required for sampling algorithms. While recent works have introduced several parallelizable techniques, they often exhibit suboptimal convergence rates and remain significantly weaker than the latest lower bounds for log-concave sampling. To address this, we propose a novel parallel sampling method that improves adaptive complexity dependence on dimension $d$ reducing it from $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\log^2 d)$ to $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\log d)$. Our approach builds on parallel simulation techniques from scientific computing.
title_zh: 用于对数凹采样与基于分数的扩散模型的并行模拟
abstract_zh: 从高维概率分布中采样是机器学习和统计学中的基础问题。随着数据集规模增大，计算效率变得日益重要，尤其是在降低自适应复杂度——即采样算法所需的顺序轮数——方面。尽管近期工作提出了若干可并行化技术，但它们往往收敛速率次优，且仍显著弱于对数凹采样的最新下界。为此，我们提出一种新颖的并行采样方法，改善了自适应复杂度对维度 d 的依赖，将其从 $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\log^2 d)$ 降低到 $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\log d)$。我们的方法建立在科学计算中的并行模拟技术之上。

title: Direct Conditioning of Audio Diffusion Transformers on fMRI Reveals Cortical Contributions to Sound Reconstruction
abstract: Reconstructing audio from brain activity remains challenging. Existing brain-to-audio pipelines typically map neural responses to predefined stimulus representations before synthesis. While recent work in the visual domain has explored direct conditioning on brain activity, this approach has not yet been extended to audio diffusion models. We introduce MAAS (Multi-Area Auditory Synthesis), an end-to-end framework that conditions a pretrained audio diffusion transformer on ROI-wise fMRI responses without first supervising a decoder to predict an external stimulus representation. MAAS uses region-specific projections and learned brain tokens to condition Stable Audio through a dedicated cross-attention pathway. On a 7T fMRI dataset, we demonstrate consistent improvements over baselines, including two-stage fMRI-to-latent conditioning, across both acoustic and semantic evaluation metrics. In addition, we introduce a fidelity metric grounded in a computational model of auditory neural processing, which allows us to quantify the contribution of individual auditory cortical regions to reconstructed audio representations.
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 main track as a poster
title_zh: 直接以 fMRI 条件化音频扩散 Transformer 揭示皮层对声音重建的贡献
abstract_zh: 从大脑活动中重建音频仍然具有挑战性。现有的脑到音频流水线通常先将神经响应映射到预定义的刺激表征，再进行合成。尽管近期视觉领域的工作已探索直接以大脑活动为条件，但这一方法尚未扩展到音频扩散模型。我们提出 MAAS（Multi-Area Auditory Synthesis），一个端到端框架，它以逐 ROI 的 fMRI 响应为条件来调节预训练的音频扩散 Transformer，而无需先监督一个解码器来预测外部刺激表征。MAAS 使用区域特定的投影和学习到的 brain tokens，通过专门的 cross-attention 通路对 Stable Audio 进行条件化。在一个 7T fMRI 数据集上，我们在声学和语义评估指标上都展示了相对于基线的一致改进，包括两阶段 fMRI-to-latent 条件化。此外，我们引入一个基于听觉神经处理计算模型的保真度指标，使我们能够量化各个听觉皮层区域对重建音频表征的贡献。

title: Zero-Search Reinforcement Learning for Slay the Spire 2 with Failure-Driven Restarts
abstract: Slay the Spire 2 (STS2) is a deck-building roguelike in which a winning run at the highest difficulty takes several hundred decisions, and most losses happen in late boss fights that a learner seldom reaches. We train agents that choose every action with one forward pass of a 6.6M-parameter entity transformer, without lookahead. Training and evaluation run the game's own compiled assembly (v0.107.1) in a headless .NET host. The host replays a run exactly from its seed and actions, so training episodes can restart from states the learner has visited, and a failure-driven curriculum allocates these restarts in proportion to where complete runs are lost. On 12,800 held-out games at Ascension 10 (A10), the released policies win 8.05% averaged over the five characters (Ironclad 15.6%, Regent 12.5%), and AlphaSpire's released networks used without search win 0.55% on a common panel. Longer A10 training raised Ironclad from 12.4% to 15.6% and Defect from 3.0% to 8.1% on these games. At Ascension 0 the released policies win 80.2%, level with the 80.3% that the tree-search agent Spire Mentor reports, while Mentor leads by 5 to 8 points from A4 upward. Run in our host on the same 2,000 A10 games, Mentor's search wins 8.8% against 8.2% for our policies, which need 21-27 ms per decision on one CPU core. GPT-6 Astra at maximum reasoning won none of 11 A10 games through our text interface. In a controlled study of 18 training runs from six random initializations, failure-driven allocation exceeds uniform restart allocation on each of three Regent initializations, by 3.6 percentage points on average, while the Silent effect is small and changes sign. Code, trained policies, an in-game mod and the records behind every table are at https://github.com/HalfVulpes/sts2ai.
