title_zh: 面向《Slay the Spire 2》的零搜索强化学习与失败驱动重启
abstract_zh: Slay the Spire 2（STS2）是一款构筑卡牌的 roguelike 游戏，在最高难度下，一次获胜需要做出数百个决策，而大多数失败发生在学习者很少能到达的后期 Boss 战中。我们训练智能体，使其通过一个 6.6M 参数实体 Transformer 的一次前向传播来选择每个动作，而不进行前瞻搜索。训练和评估在无头 .NET 宿主中运行游戏自带的编译程序集（v0.107.1）。该宿主可根据种子和动作精确重放一局游戏，因此训练回合可以从学习者访问过的状态重新开始，而失败驱动的课程会根据完整对局失败的位置按比例分配这些重启。在 12,800 局 Ascension 10（A10）留出对局上，发布的策略在五个角色上平均胜率为 8.05%（Ironclad 15.6%，Regent 12.5%），而 AlphaSpire 发布的网络在无搜索情况下于共同面板上的胜率为 0.55%。更长的 A10 训练使 Ironclad 在这些对局上的胜率从 12.4% 提高到 15.6%，Defect 从 3.0% 提高到 8.1%。在 Ascension 0 下，发布的策略胜率为 80.2%，与树搜索智能体 Spire Mentor 报告的 80.3% 持平，而从 A4 起 Mentor 领先 5 到 8 个百分点。在我们的宿主中于同样的 2,000 局 A10 对局上运行，Mentor 的搜索胜率为 8.8%，我们的策略为 8.2%，而我们的策略在单 CPU 核上每次决策需要 21–27 ms。GPT-6 Astra 在最大推理强度下通过我们的文本接口在 11 局 A10 对局中一局未胜。在一项包含来自六个随机初始化的 18 次训练运行的受控研究中，失败驱动分配在三个 Regent 初始化的每一个上都优于均匀重启分配，平均高 3.6 个百分点，而 Silent 效应的幅度较小且方向会改变。代码、训练策略、游戏内 mod 以及每张表背后的记录均见 https://github.com/HalfVulpes/sts2ai。

title: HuB: Learning Extreme Humanoid Balance
abstract: The human body demonstrates exceptional motor capabilities—such as standing steadily on one foot or performing a high kick with the leg raised over 1.5 meters—both requiring precise balance control. While recent research on humanoid control has leveraged reinforcement learning to track human motions for skill acquisition, applying this paradigm to balance-intensive tasks remains challenging. In this work, we identify three key obstacles: instability from reference motion errors, learning difficulties due to morphological mismatch, and the sim-to-real gap caused by sensor noise and unmodeled dynamics. To address these challenges, we propose $\textbf{HuB}$ ($\textbf{Hu}$manoid $\textbf{B}$alance), a unified framework that integrates $\textit{reference motion refinement}$, $\textit{balance-aware policy learning}$, and $\textit{sim-to-real robustness training}$, with each component targeting a specific challenge. We validate our approach on the Unitree G1 humanoid robot across challenging quasi-static balance tasks, including extreme single-legged poses such as $\texttt{Swallow Balance}$ and $\texttt{Bruce Lee’s Kick}$. Our policy remains stable even under strong physical disturbances—such as a forceful soccer strike—while baseline methods consistently fail to complete these tasks.
title_zh: HuB：学习极限人形机器人平衡
abstract_zh: 人体展现出卓越的运动能力——例如单脚稳定站立，或完成腿抬高超过 1.5 米的高踢——二者都需要精确的平衡控制。虽然近期人形机器人控制研究已利用强化学习跟踪人类动作来获取技能，但将这一范式应用于平衡密集型任务仍然具有挑战性。在本工作中，我们识别出三个关键障碍：参考运动误差导致的不稳定性、形态不匹配带来的学习困难，以及传感器噪声和未建模动力学造成的 sim-to-real 差距。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 HuB（Humanoid Balance），一个统一框架，集成了参考运动精炼、平衡感知策略学习和 sim-to-real 鲁棒性训练，每个组件针对一个特定挑战。我们在 Unitree G1 人形机器人上跨具有挑战性的准静态平衡任务验证了我们的方法，包括极端单腿姿势，如 Swallow Balance 和 Bruce Lee’s Kick。我们的策略即使在强物理扰动下——例如有力的足球踢击——仍保持稳定，而基线方法始终无法完成这些任务。

title: FlashBack: Consistency Model-Accelerated Shared Autonomy
abstract: Abstract: Shared autonomy is an enabling technology that provides users with control authority over robots that would otherwise be difficult if not impossible to directly control. Yet, standard methods make assumptions that limit their adoption in practice—for example, prior knowledge of the user’s goals or the objective (i.e., reward) function that they wish to optimize, knowledge of the user’s policy, or query-level access to the user during training. Diffusion-based approaches to shared autonomy do not make such assumptions and instead only require access to demonstrations of desired behaviors, while allowing the user to maintain control authority. However, these advantages have come at the expense of high computational complexity, which has made real-time shared autonomy all but impossible. To overcome this limitation, we propose Consistency Shared Autonomy (CSA), a shared autonomy framework that employs a consistency model-based formulation of diffusion. Key to CSA is that it employs the distilled probability flow of ordinary differential equations (PF ODE) to generate high-fidelity samples in a single step. This results in inference speeds significantly than what is possible with previous diffusion-based approaches to shared autonomy, enabling real-time assistance in complex domains with only a single function evaluation. Further, by intervening on flawed actions at intermediate states of the PF ODE, CSA enables varying levels of assistance. We evaluate CSA on a variety of challenging simulated and real-world robot control problems, demonstrating significant improvements over state-of-the-art methods both in terms of task performance and computational efficiency.
title_zh: FlashBack：一致性模型加速的共享自主
abstract_zh: 共享自主是一种使能技术，使用户能够对原本难以甚至无法直接控制的机器人行使控制权。然而，标准方法所作的假设限制了它们在实际中的应用——例如，需要预先知道用户的目标或其希望优化的目标（即奖励）函数、知道用户的策略，或在训练期间能够以查询级别访问用户。基于扩散的共享自主方法不作此类假设，而仅需要访问期望行为的示范，同时允许用户保持控制权。然而，这些优势的代价是高计算复杂度，这使实时共享自主几乎不可能实现。为克服这一限制，我们提出 Consistency Shared Autonomy（CSA），一个采用基于一致性模型的扩散表述的共享自主框架。CSA 的关键在于，它利用常微分方程（PF ODE）的蒸馏概率流，在单步中生成高保真样本。这使得推理速度显著快于先前的基于扩散的共享自主方法，从而仅需一次函数评估即可在复杂领域实现实时辅助。此外，通过在 PF ODE 的中间状态对有缺陷的动作进行干预，CSA 能够提供不同水平的辅助。我们在多种具有挑战性的仿真和真实世界机器人控制问题上评估 CSA，证明其在任务性能和计算效率两方面都显著优于最先进方法。

title: Learning Long-Horizon Robot Manipulation Skills via Privileged Action
abstract: Long-horizon contact-rich tasks are challenging to learn with reinforcement learning, due to ineffective exploration of high-dimensional state spaces with sparse rewards. The learning process often gets stuck in local optimum and demands task-specific reward fine-tuning for complex scenarios. In this work, we propose a structured framework that leverages privileged actions with curriculum learning, enabling the policy to efficiently acquire long-horizon skills without relying on extensive reward engineering or reference trajectories. Specifically, we use privileged actions in simulation with a general training procedure that would be infeasible to implement in real-world scenarios. These privileges include relaxed constraints and virtual forces that enhance interaction and exploration with objects. Our results successfully achieve complex multi-stage long-horizon tasks that naturally combine non-prehensile manipulation with grasping to lift objects from non-graspable poses. We demonstrate generality by maintaining a parsimonious reward structure and showing convergence to diverse and robust behaviors across various environments. Our approach outperforms state-of-the-art methods in these tasks, converging to solutions where others fail.
title_zh: 通过特权动作学习长时程机器人操作技能
abstract_zh: 长时程富接触任务难以通过强化学习来学习，原因在于在具有稀疏奖励的高维状态空间中进行有效探索十分困难。学习过程常常陷入局部最优，并且对于复杂场景需要针对任务进行奖励微调。在这项工作中，我们提出了一个结构化框架，利用特权动作并结合课程学习，使策略能够高效获得长时程技能，而无需依赖大量奖励工程或参考轨迹。具体而言，我们在仿真中使用特权动作，并采用一种在现实场景中难以实施的通用训练流程。这些特权包括放宽约束和虚拟力，它们增强了与物体的交互和探索。我们的结果成功完成了复杂的多阶段长时程任务，这些任务自然地将非抓取式操作与抓取相结合，以从不可抓取的位姿抬起物体。我们通过保持简约的奖励结构，并展示在不同环境中收敛到多样且鲁棒的行为，证明了方法的通用性。在这些任务上，我们的方法优于最先进的方法，并在其他方法失败的情况下收敛到解决方案。

title: VLA-MOPD: On-Policy Distillation for Multi-Task VLA Policy Consolidation
abstract: Physical intelligence requires embodied agents to ground language in observations and execute actions while retaining useful skills. Vision-language-action (VLA) policies offer a shared interface, but task-specific post-training often produces separate specialists. Consolidation is difficult: mixed-task reinforcement learning provides sparse trajectory-level credit, while offline distillation may miss student-visited observations and endpoint distillation does not supervise intermediate action-generation states. We introduce VLA Multi-teacher On-Policy Distillation (VLA-MOPD), a protocol for consolidating flow-matching VLA specialists. After acquiring task or suite experts, a shared student collects robot rollouts and queries the instruction-routed frozen teacher at each visited observation and intermediate ordinary differential equation (ODE) state. Detached per-flow-step transition targets supervise valid action chunks through a masked local matching loss; an optional reference-policy term supports retention on other tasks. Starting from one trajectory per LIBERO task, VLA-MOPD raises mean success-once from 75.4% to 98.9%, compared with 98.15% for endpoint action distillation. It improves mean RoboTwin 2.0 success from 73.0% to 89.3%; on a Piper robot, two consolidation rounds improve average success from 70.0% to 90.0%. In a near-matched Spatial-adaptation study, reference matching limits the Object suite decrease to 3.0 points, versus 13.2 without the reference term.
title_zh: VLA-MOPD：用于多任务VLA策略整合的同策略蒸馏
abstract_zh: 物理智能要求具身智能体将语言落地到观测中，并在保留有用技能的同时执行动作。视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略提供了共享接口，但针对特定任务的后训练往往会产生彼此独立的专家策略。整合十分困难：混合任务强化学习只能提供稀疏的轨迹级信用分配，而离线蒸馏可能遗漏学生策略访问过的观测，端点蒸馏也无法监督动作生成的中间状态。我们提出VLA多教师同策略蒸馏（VLA-MOPD），一种用于整合流匹配VLA专家策略的协议。在获得任务专家或任务套件专家后，共享学生策略收集机器人 rollout，并在每个访问到的观测和中间常微分方程（ODE）状态处查询按指令路由的冻结教师。分离的逐流步转移目标通过掩码局部匹配损失来监督有效动作块；可选的参考策略项有助于在其他任务上保持性能。从LIBERO每个任务的一条轨迹开始，VLA-MOPD将平均单次成功率从75.4%提升到98.9%，而端点动作蒸馏为98.15%。它将RoboTwin 2.0的平均成功率从73.0%提升到89.3%；在Piper机器人上，两轮整合将平均成功率从70.0%提升到90.0%。在一项近似匹配的Spatial-adaptation研究中，参考匹配将Object套件的性能下降限制在3.0个百分点，而不使用参考项时为13.2个百分点。

title: An Evaluation of Tabular Foundation Models as Training-Free World Models
abstract: World models are widely considered to be a potential key component of model-based reinforcement learning and robot planning, but typically require task-specific training on substantial interaction data. We investigate whether a pretrained tabular foundation model (TabFM) can serve as a training-free dynamics model for world modeling by framing next-state prediction as in-context regression over transition pairs, and where such a model helps and where it breaks. Across synthetic dynamical systems and robot locomotion benchmarks, TabFM is more accurate than LSTM and MLP models trained from scratch on the same limited transitions in almost all settings, and among regressors fitted to the same data it is the most accurate on locomotion, while a Gaussian process is more accurate on smooth low-dimensional systems. However, models trained on the full dataset remain substantially better on most systems. When rolled out autoregressively over multiple steps, TabFM's accuracy depends strongly on how much context it is given. With a short context, its rollouts quickly degrade to the level of a trivial baseline, whereas with a long context they improve substantially and, on one locomotion task, exceed a trained LSTM. Inference is also about three orders of magnitude slower than an LSTM. Overall, in their current state, we find that training-free priors are useful as predictors when data are scarce and enough context is available, but they are not yet a substitute for trained world models in planning.
title_zh: 表格基础模型作为免训练世界模型的评估
abstract_zh: 世界模型被广泛认为是基于模型的强化学习和机器人规划的潜在关键组成部分，但通常需要在大量交互数据上进行针对任务的训练。我们研究预训练表格基础模型（TabFM）能否通过将下一状态预测表述为基于转移对的上下文内回归，来充当用于世界建模的免训练动力学模型，并考察这种模型在何处有帮助、在何处失效。在合成动力系统和机器人运动基准上，TabFM在几乎所有设置中都比在相同有限转移数据上从零训练的LSTM和MLP模型更准确；在基于相同数据拟合的回归器中，它在运动任务上最准确，而高斯过程在平滑低维系统上更准确。然而，在大多数系统上，使用完整数据集训练的模型仍然明显更好。当进行多步自回归展开时，TabFM的准确性在很大程度上取决于所提供上下文的多少。上下文较短时，其 rollout 会迅速退化到平凡基线的水平；上下文较长时则会显著改善，并在一个运动任务上超过训练过的LSTM。其推理速度也比LSTM慢约三个数量级。总体而言，我们发现就当前状态而言，免训练先验在数据稀缺且上下文充足时可作为有用的预测器，但尚不能替代训练好的世界模型用于规划。

title: BEHAVIOR Robot Suite: Streamlining Real-World Whole-Body Manipulation for Everyday Household Activities
abstract: Real-world household tasks present significant challenges for mobile manipulation robots. An analysis of existing robotics benchmarks reveals that successful task performance hinges on three key whole-body control capabilities: bimanual coordination, stable and precise navigation, and extensive end-effector reachability. Achieving these capabilities requires careful hardware design, but the resulting system complexity further complicates visuomotor policy learning. To address these challenges, we introduce the BEHAVIOR Robot Suite (BRS), a comprehensive framework for whole-body manipulation in diverse household tasks. Built on a bimanual, wheeled robot with a 4-DoF torso, BRS integrates a cost-effective whole-body teleoperation interface for data collection and a novel algorithm for learning whole-body visuomotor policies. We evaluate BRS on five challenging household tasks that not only emphasize the three core capabilities but also introduce additional complexities, such as long-range navigation, interaction with articulated and deformable objects, and manipulation in confined spaces. We believe that BRS’s integrated robotic embodiment, data collection interface, and learning framework mark a significant step toward enabling real-world whole-body manipulation for everyday household tasks. BRS is open-sourced at https://behavior-robot-suite.github.io/.
title_zh: BEHAVIOR Robot Suite：简化面向日常家庭活动的真实世界全身操作
abstract_zh: 真实世界的家庭任务对移动操作机器人提出了重大挑战。对现有机器人基准的分析表明，成功的任务执行取决于三项关键的全身控制能力：双臂协调、稳定且精确的导航，以及末端执行器的大范围可达性。实现这些能力需要精心的硬件设计，但由此产生的系统复杂性会进一步增加视觉运动策略学习的难度。为应对这些挑战，我们推出BEHAVIOR Robot Suite（BRS），这是一个用于多样化家庭任务全身操作的综合框架。BRS构建于配备4自由度躯干的双臂轮式机器人之上，集成了经济高效、用于数据采集的全身遥操作接口，以及一种用于学习全身视觉运动策略的新颖算法。我们在五项具有挑战性的家庭任务上评估BRS，这些任务不仅强调上述三项核心能力，还引入了额外复杂性，例如长距离导航、与铰接和可变形物体交互，以及在受限空间中进行操作。我们相信，BRS集成的机器人本体、数据采集接口和学习框架，标志着朝着实现日常家庭任务的真实世界全身操作迈出了重要一步。BRS已在 https://behavior-robot-suite.github.io/ 开源。

title: PCTac: Mechanochromic Photonic-Crystal Tactile Sensor for Dexterous Manipulation
abstract: Modern visuotactile sensors primarily sense contact by imaging the deformation of a compliant interface. Using techniques such as photometric stereo, they can recover detailed contact geometry, often represented as surface normals or depth. However, force-related information typically still needs to be inferred indirectly through calibration, geometric reconstruction, or learned mappings. Mechanochromic photonic-crystal (PC) materials offer an alternative physical encoding mechanism: contact loading changes their periodic microstructure and spectral response, directly transforming local stress into a spatially resolved structural-color field. Despite this potential, PC materials have rarely been explored as visuotactile sensors for closed-loop robot learning. We present PCTac, an open-source mechanochromic PC fingertip that uses a dense hue field as its tactile observation. Loading characterization demonstrates a repeatable relationship between the applied normal load and the observed hue response. We further integrate this representation directly into a Diffusion Policy and evaluate it on three real-robot manipulation tasks. Across 90 physical rollouts, PCTac Hue achieves 68 successes (75.6\%), compared with 60 (66.7\%) for PCTac RGB, 57 (63.3\%) for Wedge RGB, and 29 (32.2\%) for vision-only. PCTac Hue also achieves the highest observed success rate on each evaluated task, including Perturbed Test-Tube Insertion, where it achieves 16/30 successes versus 13/30 for tactile RGB baselines and 1/30 for vision-only. These results demonstrate the potential of mechanochromic structural color as a compact, load-sensitive tactile representation for robot learning and closed-loop manipulation. Project page: https://bey0ndt1me.github.io/PCTac-page/.
title_zh: PCTac：用于灵巧操作的力致变色光子晶体触觉传感器
abstract_zh: 现代视触觉传感器主要通过成像顺应性界面的变形来感知接触。利用光度立体等技术，它们可以恢复详细的接触几何，通常以表面法线或深度表示。然而，与力相关的信息通常仍需通过校准、几何重建或学习到的映射来间接推断。力致变色光子晶体（PC）材料提供了一种替代的物理编码机制：接触载荷会改变其周期性微结构和光谱响应，从而将局部应力直接转换为具有空间分辨率的结构色场。尽管具有这一潜力，PC材料作为视触觉传感器用于闭环机器人学习的研究仍然很少。我们提出PCTac，一种开源的力致变色PC指尖传感器，使用密集色相场作为其触觉观测。加载表征表明，施加的法向载荷与观测到的色相响应之间存在可重复的关系。我们进一步将该表征直接集成到Diffusion Policy中，并在三项真实机器人操作任务上进行评估。在90次物理 rollout 中，PCTac Hue取得成功68次（75.6%），而PCTac RGB为60次（66.7%），Wedge RGB为57次（63.3%），仅视觉方法为29次（32.2%）。PCTac Hue在每项评估任务上也取得了最高的观测成功率，包括扰动试管插入任务，其成功次数为16/30，而触觉RGB基线为13/30，仅视觉方法为1/30。这些结果展示了力致变色结构色作为一种紧凑、对载荷敏感的触觉表征，在机器人学习和闭环操作中的潜力。项目页面：https://bey0ndt1me.github.io/PCTac-page/。

title: Grasp-Taxonomy Conditioning as a Mode Switch for Dexterous Grasping of Climbing Holds
abstract: Dexterous grasping in robotics relies on distinct hand configurations depending on object geometry. We introduce BetaGrasp, a 3D diffusion policy that conditions a DP3-style point-cloud policy on a four-class grasp label (crimp, sloper, pinch, and jug), running on a Franka arm with a 16-DoF LEAP hand. We also introduce a climbing-hold benchmark: a spring testbed whose ratchet gives a slip-force reading in newtons. In our analysis the policy's point-cloud encoder did not separate the four holds, so the scan alone gave it little to choose a grasp from. Without the label (a DP3-style baseline), simulated rollouts from the robot's reset pose all end in a jug grasp, whatever the hold (25% correct grasp type, versus 94% for BetaGrasp). The label works as a switch for which grasp the policy performs. On 80 paired hardware trials, BetaGrasp raises average slip force from 9.6 N to 14.3 N, and grasps slipping fully off the hold drop from 44% of trials to 10%.
title_zh: 将抓取分类条件化作为攀岩握点灵巧抓取的模式开关
abstract_zh: 机器人灵巧抓取依赖根据物体几何形状采用不同的手部构型。我们提出BetaGrasp，一种3D扩散策略，它将DP3风格的点云策略以四类抓取标签（crimp、sloper、pinch和jug）为条件，运行在搭载16自由度LEAP手的Franka机械臂上。我们还提出一个攀岩握点基准：一个弹簧测试平台，其棘轮可提供以牛顿为单位的滑移力读数。在我们的分析中，策略的点云编码器未能区分这四种握点，因此仅凭扫描信息几乎无法帮助它选择抓取方式。在没有标签时（DP3风格基线），从机器人重置位姿开始的仿真 rollout 无论面对哪种握点，最终都会采用 jug 抓取（正确抓取类型为25%，而BetaGrasp为94%）。该标签充当策略执行何种抓取的开关。在80组配对硬件试验中，BetaGrasp将平均滑移力从9.6 N提高到14.3 N，并使抓取完全滑脱握点的试验比例从44%降至10%。

title: PAIR: Proprioception-Aligned Image-Ray Representations for Viewpoint-Robust Manipulation
abstract: While imitation learning has made substantial progress toward generalizable robot manipulation through scaling, viewpoint robustness remains a major bottleneck. Visuomotor policies rely heavily on visual inputs, yet images provide an inherently ambiguous signal under viewpoint change: similar scenes may appear markedly different across viewpoints, while distinct states may share certain visual overlaps. A policy must therefore infer not only the task-relevant state, but also how it is visually projected under a particular camera configuration. This entanglement of viewpoint-dependent appearance and task-relevant state can make learning inefficient and limit generalization to unseen viewpoints. Recent work has begun to address this challenge through camera-ray conditioning and representation learning using geometric cues to induce invariance. However, providing camera information as additional context does not by itself ground visual representations in how the task scene is visually projected, while geometric alignment without camera context can introduce spurious correspondences by ignoring viewpoint-dependent projection. We propose PAIR, a contrastive learning framework that aligns joint image-ray representations using robot proprioception. PAIR encourages observations with similar robot states to remain close in representation space across viewpoints, providing a structured grounding signal for learning viewpoint-robust features. PAIR is a highly adaptable framework: it can be used to train Diffusion Policy (DP) or post-train vision-language-action (VLA) models. In simulated and real-world manipulation benchmarks with camera variation, PAIR consistently outperforms the behavior cloning baseline without ray conditioning by 12.7% and 26.7% points, respectively, demonstrating stronger generalization to unseen viewpoints. Project website: PAIRrobot.github.io.
title_zh: PAIR：面向视角鲁棒操作的本体感觉对齐图像-射线表示
abstract_zh: 尽管模仿学习通过规模化在可泛化机器人操作方面取得了实质性进展，视角鲁棒性仍是主要瓶颈。视觉运动策略严重依赖视觉输入，但图像在视角变化下会提供天然存在歧义的信号：相似场景在不同视角下可能看起来差异显著，而不同状态可能具有某些视觉重叠。因此，策略不仅必须推断任务相关状态，还必须推断该状态在特定相机配置下如何被视觉投影。这种依赖视角的外观与任务相关状态之间的纠缠可能导致学习效率低下，并限制对未见视角的泛化。近期工作开始通过相机射线条件化以及利用几何线索诱导不变性的表示学习来应对这一挑战。然而，仅将相机信息作为额外上下文提供，本身并不能使视觉表示真正以任务场景的视觉投影方式为依据；而不结合相机上下文的几何对齐可能因忽略依赖视角的投影而引入虚假对应关系。我们提出 PAIR，一个利用机器人本体感觉对齐联合图像-射线表示的对比学习框架。PAIR 鼓励机器人状态相似的观测在不同视角下于表示空间中保持接近，为学习视角鲁棒特征提供结构化的接地信号。PAIR 是一个高度可适配的框架：它既可用于训练 Diffusion Policy（DP），也可用于对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型进行后训练。在存在相机变化的仿真和真实世界操作基准中，PAIR 分别比未使用射线条件的行为克隆基线高出 12.7 和 26.7 个百分点，表明其对未见视角具有更强的泛化能力。项目网站：PAIRrobot.github.io。

title: Patching Up Circuit Learning via Parameter Sharing
abstract: Probabilistic circuits (PCs) have emerged as generative models guaranteeing tractable probabilistic inference. However, tractability comes at the price of larger model sizes than in other generative models. As such, to scale PCs to high-dimensional data such as images, previous work has devised several parameter sharing techniques as well as fast evaluation protocols that consider learning PCs on independent image patches. In this work, we revisit this practice to highlight a surprising learnability issue: models that assume independence counterintuitively can yield better likelihoods than models that do not. To break this apparent bottleneck and to scale PCs further, we introduce a recursive parameter sharing construction (RePA) that fosters efficiency without assuming independence. We show empirically that RePA can greatly reduce time and memory consumption while yielding competitive likelihoods. Inspired by these results, we further generalize the approach to data modalities that do not inherently exhibit patch-structure (NoPA), such as tabular data, showing similar efficiency improvements, with marginal changes in likelihoods and sample quality on seven tabular datasets. Code available at https://github.com/april-tools/RePA.
title_zh: 通过参数共享修补电路学习
abstract_zh: 概率电路（PCs）已成为能够保证可处理概率推断的生成模型。然而，可处理性的代价是模型规模比其他生成模型更大。因此，为了将 PCs 扩展到图像等高维数据，先前工作设计了几种参数共享技术，以及考虑在独立图像块上学习 PCs 的快速评估协议。在本工作中，我们重新审视这一做法，并强调一个令人惊讶的可学习性问题：假设独立性的模型反直觉地能比不假设独立性的模型获得更好的似然。为打破这一表面瓶颈并进一步扩展 PCs，我们引入递归参数共享构造（RePA），它能在不假设独立性的情况下提升效率。我们通过实验表明，RePA 能大幅减少时间和内存消耗，同时获得有竞争力的似然。受这些结果启发，我们进一步将该方法推广到本身不具备块结构的数据模态（NoPA），例如表格数据，并在七个表格数据集上显示出类似的效率提升，同时似然和样本质量仅有微小变化。代码见 https://github.com/april-tools/RePA。

title: The balance between feature learning and collapse in dynamical systems-based generative models
abstract: Over the past decade, a growing body of work has established that implicit biases in learning dynamics fundamentally shape the solutions found by neural networks, governing their learned features and generalisation performance. However, despite these strides in deep learning theory, far less is known about representation learning in generative models based on dynamical systems, from normalising flows to diffusion. Importantly, empirical evidence suggests that continuous-time generative models can be prone to mode collapse, yet a learning theory explaining such biases remains elusive. To address this, we use tools from dynamical systems and operator theory to express the gradient flow of a general class of stochastic differential equations as a composition of linear operators, allowing us to relate collapse to low-rank biases in generative models. In variational inference and flow-matching tasks, we show that this bias can manifest in two different mechanisms: i) where collapsed models are stable fixed points of the gradient flow, or ii) in sequential feature learning, where smaller modes take progressively longer to be learned, producing an effective collapse for a fixed training budget. Together these findings point to a trade-off between feature learning and collapse, suggesting an operator view as a step towards a unified framework for understanding the learning dynamics of dynamical systems-based generative models.
title_zh: 基于动力系统的生成模型中特征学习与坍缩之间的平衡
abstract_zh: 在过去的十年里，越来越多的工作表明，学习动力学中的隐式偏差从根本上塑造了神经网络找到的解，并支配其学到的特征和泛化性能。然而，尽管深度学习理论取得了这些进展，人们对于基于动力系统的生成模型（从归一化流到扩散模型）中的表示学习仍知之甚少。重要的是，经验证据表明，连续时间生成模型可能容易发生模式坍缩，但解释此类偏差的学习理论仍难以建立。为解决这一问题，我们使用动力系统和算子理论的工具，将一类通用随机微分方程的梯度流表示为线性算子的复合，从而使我们能够将坍缩与生成模型中的低秩偏差联系起来。在变分推断和流匹配任务中，我们表明这种偏差可以通过两种不同机制表现出来：i）坍缩模型是梯度流的稳定不动点；或 ii）在顺序特征学习中，较小的模式需要越来越长的时间才能被学习，从而在固定训练预算下产生实际上的坍缩。这些发现共同指向特征学习与坍缩之间的权衡，表明算子视角是迈向统一框架的一步，有助于理解基于动力系统的生成模型的学习动力学。

title: Streaming Failure Forecasting: VLA Failure Monitors That Keep Learning After Deployment
abstract: Failure monitors for vision-language-action (VLA) policies are trained offline and then frozen. After deployment, lighting, objects and cameras drift, and the policy itself is updated or moved to new tasks. On recorded real-robot runs, after a switch of task or policy version, a frozen monitor fit on the old task ranks failures little better than chance. We present Streaming Failure Forecasting (SFF), a monitor that keeps learning from the one label every episode provides: whether it succeeded. SFF keeps the offline monitor's network fixed and refits only its last linear layer after each episode, at 2.18 ms per policy call on a Jetson CPU core. Its alarm threshold moves only after successes, which in simulation kept false alarms near target except when two drifts came at once. With every setting locked before testing, SFF ranks failures better than the same monitor kept frozen on 4 of 5 simulated test suites under unannounced drift, and above resetting on detected drift on every suite. Carried with its locked learner settings to 434 recorded runs of four VLAs on real SO-101 arms, replayed across unannounced switches of task or policy version, it ranks failures better than the frozen monitor for every VLA and, in an exploratory comparison, above a full reset at the true switch. A deployed failure monitor need not stay frozen: refitting its readout from outcomes is cheap and helps after the changes we tested.
comment: 25 pages, 13 figures, 9 tables. A short version was accepted at the Sim2Real2Field and EEAI workshops at CoRL 2026. Project page:
title_zh: 流式失败预测：部署后仍能持续学习的 VLA 失败监测器
abstract_zh: 用于视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略的失败监测器先离线训练，随后被冻结。部署后，光照、物体和相机会发生漂移，策略本身也可能被更新或迁移到新任务。在记录的真实机器人运行数据中，任务或策略版本切换后，基于旧任务拟合的冻结监测器对失败的排序几乎不优于随机猜测。我们提出 Streaming Failure Forecasting（SFF），一种持续从每个回合提供的唯一标签——该回合是否成功——中学习的监测器。SFF 保持离线监测器的网络固定，仅在每个回合后重新拟合其最后一个线性层；在 Jetson 的一个 CPU 核心上，每次策略调用耗时 2.18 ms。其告警阈值仅在成功之后调整；在仿真中，这使误报率在除两种漂移同时出现之外的情况下都接近目标水平。在测试前锁定所有设置后，在未预告漂移下的 5 个仿真测试套件中，SFF 在 4 个套件上对失败的排序优于保持冻结的同一监测器，并且在每个套件上都优于在检测到漂移后进行重置。将其锁定的学习器设置用于真实 SO-101 机械臂上四个 VLA 的 434 次记录运行，并在未预告的任务或策略版本切换中重放，它对每个 VLA 的失败排序都优于冻结监测器；在一项探索性比较中，它在真实切换点也优于完全重置。已部署的失败监测器不必一直保持冻结：根据结果重新拟合其读出层成本低廉，并且在我们测试的变化之后有所帮助。

title: Latent Theory of Mind: A Decentralized Diffusion Architecture for Cooperative Manipulation
abstract: We present Latent Theory of Mind (LatentToM), a decentralized diffusion policy architecture for collaborative robot manipulation. Our policy allows multiple manipulators with their own perception and computation to collaborate with each other towards a common task goal with or without explicit communication. Our key innovation lies in allowing each agent to maintain two latent representations: an ego embedding specific to the robot, and a consensus embedding trained to be common to both robots, despite their different sensor streams and poses. We further let each robot train a decoder to infer the other robot’s ego embedding from their consensus embedding, akin to "theory of mind" in latent space. Training occurs centrally, with all the policies’ consensus encoders supervised by a loss inspired by sheaf theory, a mathematical theory for clustering data on a topological manifold. Specifically, we introduce a first-order cohomology loss to enforce sheaf-consistent alignment of the consensus embeddings. To preserve the expressiveness of the consensus embedding, we further propose structural constraints based on theory of mind and a directional consensus mechanism. Execution can be fully distributed, requiring no explicit communication between policies. In which case, the information is exchanged implicitly through each robot’s sensor stream by observing the actions of the other robots and their effects on the scene. Alternatively, execution can leverage direct communication to share the robots’ consensus embeddings, where the embeddings are shared once during each inference step and are aligned using the sheaf Laplacian. While we tested our method using two manipulators, our approach can naturally be extended to an arbitrary number of agents. In our hardware experiments, LatentToM outperforms a naive decentralized diffusion baseline, and shows comparable performance with a state-of-the-art centralized diffusion policy for bi-manual manipulation. Additionally, we show that LatentToM is naturally robust to temporary robot failure or delays, while a centralized policy may fail.
title_zh: Latent Theory of Mind：用于协作操作的去中心化扩散架构
abstract_zh: 我们提出 Latent Theory of Mind（LatentToM），一种用于协作机器人操作的去中心化扩散策略架构。我们的策略允许多个具有各自感知与计算能力的操作器在有无显式通信的情况下，为共同的任务目标相互协作。我们的关键创新在于让每个智能体维护两个潜在表示：一个特定于该机器人的自我嵌入（ego embedding），以及一个被训练为两个机器人共有的共识嵌入（consensus embedding），尽管它们的传感器流和位姿不同。我们进一步让每个机器人训练一个解码器，从共识嵌入中推断另一个机器人的自我嵌入，类似于潜空间中的“心智理论”。训练以集中方式进行，所有策略的共识编码器都受到一个受层论（sheaf theory）启发的损失监督；层论是一种用于在拓扑流形上聚类数据的数学理论。具体而言，我们引入一阶上同调损失，以强制共识嵌入实现层论一致对齐。为保持共识嵌入的表达能力，我们进一步提出基于心智理论的结构约束和有向共识机制。执行可以完全分布式进行，策略之间无需显式通信。在这种情况下，信息通过每个机器人的传感器流隐式交换：机器人观察其他机器人的动作及其对场景的影响。或者，执行也可以利用直接通信来共享机器人的共识嵌入；此时，嵌入在每个推理步骤中共享一次，并使用层拉普拉斯算子进行对齐。虽然我们使用两个操作器测试了该方法，但我们的方法可以自然扩展到任意数量的智能体。在硬件实验中，LatentToM 优于朴素的去中心化扩散基线，并在双臂操作中表现出与最先进的集中式扩散策略相当的性能。此外，我们表明 LatentToM 对临时性的机器人故障或延迟具有天然的鲁棒性，而集中式策略可能会失败。

title: The Sound of Simulation: Learning Multimodal Sim-to-Real Robot Policies with Generative Audio
abstract: Robots must integrate multiple sensory modalities to act effectively in the real world. Yet, learning such multimodal policies at scale remains challenging. Simulation offers a viable solution, but while vision has benefited from high-fidelity simulators, other modalities (e.g. sound) can be notoriously difficult to simulate. As a result, sim-to-real transfer has succeeded primarily in vision-based tasks, with multimodal transfer still largely unrealized. In this work, we tackle these challenges by introducing MultiGen, a framework that integrates large-scale generative models into traditional physics simulators, enabling multisensory simulation. We showcase our framework on the dynamic task of robot pouring, which inherently relies on multimodal feedback. By synthesizing realistic audio conditioned on simulation video, our method enables training on rich audiovisual trajectories—without any real robot data. We demonstrate effective zero-shot transfer to real-world pouring with novel containers and liquids, highlighting the potential of generative modeling to both simulate hard-to-model modalities and close the multimodal sim-to-real gap.
title_zh: 仿真之声：利用生成式音频学习多模态仿真到真实机器人策略
abstract_zh: 机器人必须整合多种感官模态，才能在现实世界中有效行动。然而，大规模学习此类多模态策略仍然具有挑战性。仿真提供了一种可行方案，但尽管视觉已受益于高保真模拟器，其他模态（例如声音）的仿真却可能极其困难。因此，sim-to-real 迁移主要在以视觉为基础的任务中取得成功，多模态迁移仍在很大程度上尚未实现。在本工作中，我们通过引入 MultiGen 应对这些挑战。MultiGen 是一个将大规模生成模型集成到传统物理模拟器中的框架，能够实现多感官仿真。我们在机器人倒水这一本质上依赖多模态反馈的动态任务上展示了该框架。通过以仿真视频为条件合成逼真音频，我们的方法能够在丰富的视听轨迹上进行训练——且无需任何真实机器人数据。我们展示了使用新容器和新液体向真实世界倒水任务的有效零样本迁移，突显了生成式建模在仿真难以建模的模态以及弥合多模态 sim-to-real 差距方面的潜力。

title: RAIL: Representation-Aligned Imitation Learning for Student-Compatible Teacher Policies
abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) from raw sensory inputs such as images or onboard sensors can be challenging due to high-dimensional observations and sparse rewards. A common strategy is to train a teacher policy with access to privileged state information and then distill it into a student policy that acts from raw inputs alone. However, when the teacher relies on information unavailable to the student, exact imitation may be impossible, creating an irreducible imitation gap. Existing approaches typically mitigate this mismatch through careful reward shaping or additional reinforcement learning on the student policy after the teacher has been trained. Instead, we introduce Representation-Aligned Imitation Learning (RAIL), which addresses the mismatch during teacher training itself. RAIL learns a latent representation shared across teacher and student observations using contrastive learning, and trains the teacher policy directly in this space. Because the teacher policy is constrained to operate on this shared space, it learns behaviors that are reproducible from student observations. This substantially reduces the imitation gap while preserving task performance. Across multiple environments, RAIL outperforms strong baselines without reward modification or post-hoc student fine-tuning, and surpasses direct reinforcement learning from raw observations. The learned representations further enable zero-shot transfer to new tasks through teacher-only training. Project site: https://merajmammadov.com/rail/.
title_zh: RAIL：面向学生兼容教师策略的表示对齐模仿学习
abstract_zh: 从图像或机载传感器等原始感官输入进行强化学习（RL）可能因高维观测和稀疏奖励而具有挑战性。一种常见策略是训练一个能够访问特权状态信息的教师策略，然后将其蒸馏到一个仅根据原始输入行动的学生策略中。然而，当教师依赖学生无法获得的信息时，精确模仿可能无法实现，从而产生不可消除的模仿差距。现有方法通常通过在教师训练完成后仔细设计奖励塑形，或对学生策略进行额外强化学习，来缓解这种不匹配。相反，我们引入 Representation-Aligned Imitation Learning（RAIL），在教师训练本身中解决这种不匹配。RAIL 使用对比学习学习一个在教师和学生观测之间共享的潜在表示，并直接在该空间中训练教师策略。由于教师策略被约束在该共享空间中运行，它学习到的行为可以从学生观测中复现。这大幅减小了模仿差距，同时保持任务性能。在多个环境中，RAIL 无需修改奖励或进行事后学生微调即优于强基线，并超过直接从原始观测进行强化学习的方法。学习到的表示还通过仅教师训练实现了对新任务的零样本迁移。项目网站：https://merajmammadov.com/rail/。

title: DeltaForge: A Post-hoc Mixture-of-Experts VLA for Multi-Domain Autonomous Driving
abstract: Fleets of driving vision-language-action (VLA) models are developed one domain at a time: each operator finetunes a shared base model on private data, producing specialized experts that are costly to consolidate into a single model. Weight merging loses accuracy as heterogeneous domains accumulate, and dense mixture-of-experts routing is prohibitively expensive to combine them. We present DeltaForge, to our knowledge the first post-hoc mixture-of-experts VLA for driving, which consolidates N independently finetuned per-domain models into a single multi-domain model from their weights and a small proxy set alone. When different operators finetune the same base model, their weight updates end up sharing a lot of structure. We exploit this by decomposing all the updates together using singular value decomposition (SVD), splitting each one into a shared part (the same across all domains) and a tiny domain-specific part. The router then only needs to work with those tiny domain-specific pieces, not the full expert weights, which is what keeps the approach efficient. Then two cooperating clip-level blind routers, one over the VLM reasoning experts and one over the flow-matching dynamics experts, are trained from soft labels on the proxy dataset. Across six diverse domains spanning urban, off-road, and highway driving on cars, trucks, and all-terrain vehicles (ATVs), DeltaForge approaches the accuracy of the per-domain experts and surpasses every merging, routing, centralized, and federated baseline at close to single-model parameter and compute cost. Adding a new domain requires only projecting its weight update onto the shared basis with no end-to-end retraining needed. The resulting model also generalizes to domain combinations it was never explicitly trained on.
title_zh: DeltaForge：一种面向多域自动驾驶的事后混合专家 VLA
abstract_zh: 驾驶视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型通常按领域逐个开发：每位运营者在私有数据上微调一个共享基础模型，产生专用专家，而这些专家整合为单一模型的成本很高。随着异构领域增多，权重合并会损失精度，而稠密混合专家路由在将这些专家组合起来时成本高得难以承受。我们提出 DeltaForge，据我们所知这是首个用于驾驶的事后混合专家 VLA，它仅凭各模型权重和一小规模代理集，就能将 N 个独立微调的各领域模型整合为一个多域模型。当不同运营者微调同一个基础模型时，他们的权重更新最终会共享大量结构。我们利用这一点，使用奇异值分解（SVD）对所有更新联合分解，将每个更新拆分为共享部分（所有领域相同）和极小的领域特定部分。随后路由器只需处理这些极小的领域特定部分，而非完整的专家权重，这正是该方法保持高效的原因。然后，在代理数据集上使用软标签训练两个协同工作的 clip 级盲路由器，一个负责 VLM 推理专家，另一个负责流匹配动力学专家。在涵盖汽车、卡车和全地形车（ATV）的城市、越野和高速公路驾驶六个不同领域中，DeltaForge 的精度接近各领域专家，并在接近单模型参数与计算成本的条件下超越所有权重合并、路由、集中式和联邦式基线。添加新领域只需将其权重更新投影到共享基上，无需端到端重训练。所得模型还能泛化到其从未显式训练过的领域组合。

title: Accelerated Reinforcement Learning for Soft Robotics: Hours Instead of Years
abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) requires large amounts of interaction data or a reliable simulator, both hard to obtain for nonlinear soft robotic hardware. Recent work shows that a time-scale separation inherent to soft robot dynamics justifies their reduction to low-dimensional invariant manifolds, known as adiabatic spectral submanifolds (aSSMs). We demonstrate that an aSSM-reduced model, a simple polynomial ordinary differential equation learned purely from pre-collected data, can serve as an RL training environment. On a pneumatically actuated soft arm, we train a trajectory-tracking policy in 3 hours on a six-dimensional aSSM-reduced model and deploy it without fine-tuning, whereas reproducing this policy training extrapolates to 3 years of hardware interaction. Our policy tracks dynamic targets with 40% lower error than otherwise identical policies trained on a 4.8-million-parameter recurrent neural network (RNN) or a 1.7-million-parameter transformer, which take 13 and 100 hours to identify, against 5 minutes for our mathematically justified 6,924-parameter model.
title_zh: 加速软体机器人强化学习：从数年缩短到数小时
abstract_zh: 强化学习（RL）需要大量交互数据或可靠的仿真器，而这两者对于非线性软体机器人硬件都难以获得。近期研究表明，软体机器人动力学固有的时间尺度分离使其可以合理地被约化到低维不变流形，即绝热谱子流形（adiabatic spectral submanifolds，aSSMs）。我们证明，aSSM 约化模型——一个完全从预先采集数据中学到的简单多项式常微分方程——可以作为 RL 训练环境。在一只气动驱动软体臂上，我们在六维 aSSM 约化模型上于 3 小时内训练出轨迹跟踪策略，并在无需微调的情况下部署；而若在硬件交互中复现该策略训练，推算需要 3 年。与在 480 万参数循环神经网络（RNN）或 170 万参数 Transformer 上训练的同等策略相比，我们的策略跟踪动态目标的误差低 40%；辨识这两个模型分别需要 13 小时和 100 小时，而我们具有数学依据的 6,924 参数模型仅需 5 分钟。

title: Embodied First Exam
abstract: Early successes on agentic robotics point to a potential paradigm shift toward using coding agents to control robots. Existing robotics benchmarks are built around visuomotor policy learning, leaving it open whether coding agents can reliably control diverse robots under physical-world constraints. We therefore introduce the Embodied First Exam, a unified, comprehensive, and agent-native evaluation framework where coding agents can choose their own control approach: direct control, code to control, or train a policy to control. We hope it serves as a first exam for coding agents before they enter the physical world, with 1,156 tasks in 35 suites on 47 robots, including 9 new suites that go beyond pick-and-place to spatial puzzles, dexterous manipulation, multi-robot interaction, dynamic whole-body control, and sim-to-sim engineering. Each task can be run in up to three evaluation settings. The Standard Setting mimics the real world: the agent receives only sensor observations and, by default, cannot reset the environment. Its Realtime variant keeps the environment running while the agent reasons. The Privileged Setting gives the agent access to the full simulator state and unlimited resets, allowing it to search for an oracle solution for training purposes. Success rates in this setting serve as an approximate upper bound. On the 456 core tasks, the strongest of eight agents, GPT-6 Astra in Codex, achieves a success rate of 34% in the Standard Setting, leaving much room for improvement. To see where agents fail, we label the stage at which failed attempts go wrong and compare failures across agents, settings, and stage categories.
title_zh: 具身首考（Embodied First Exam）
abstract_zh: 智能体机器人领域的早期成功表明，可能出现一种范式转变：使用编码智能体控制机器人。现有机器人基准围绕视觉运动策略学习构建，因此编码智能体能否在物理世界约束下可靠控制多种机器人仍无定论。因此，我们提出 Embodied First Exam，这是一个统一、全面且智能体原生（agent-native）的评估框架；编码智能体可自行选择控制方式：直接控制、用代码控制，或训练策略进行控制。我们希望它成为编码智能体进入物理世界前的首场考试；它包含 47 种机器人上的 35 个套件、共 1,156 个任务，其中 9 个新套件超越了抓取放置，涵盖空间谜题、灵巧操作、多机器人交互、动态全身控制和 sim-to-sim 工程。每个任务最多可在三种评估设置下运行。标准设置模拟真实世界：智能体只能接收传感器观测，且默认不能重置环境。其实时（Realtime）变体在智能体推理时保持环境持续运行。特权设置让智能体访问完整仿真器状态并可无限次重置，从而使其能够为训练目的搜索 oracle 解。该设置下的成功率可作为近似上界。在 456 个核心任务上，八个智能体中最强的 GPT-6 Astra in Codex 在标准设置下达到 34% 的成功率，仍有很大提升空间。为查明智能体在何处失败，我们标注失败尝试出错的阶段，并比较不同智能体、设置和阶段类别下的失败情况。

title: Reactive In-Air Clothing Manipulation with Confidence-Aware Dense Correspondence and Visuotactile Affordance
abstract: Manipulating clothing is challenging due to their complex, variable configurations and frequent self-occlusion. While prior systems often rely on flattening garments, humans routinely identify keypoints in highly crumpled and suspended states. We present a novel, task-agnostic, visuotactile framework that operates directly on crumpled clothing—including in-air configurations that have not been addressed before. Our approach combines global visual perception with local tactile feedback to enable robust, reactive manipulation. We train dense visual descriptors on a custom simulated dataset using a distributional loss that captures cloth symmetries and generates correspondence confidence estimates. These estimates guide a reactive state machine that dynamically selects between folding strategies based on perceptual uncertainty. In parallel, we train a visuotactile grasp affordance network using high-resolution tactile feedback to supervise grasp success. The same tactile classifier is used during execution for real-time grasp validation. Together, these components enable a reactive, task-agnostic framework for in-air garment manipulation, including folding and hanging tasks. Moreover, our dense descriptors serve as a versatile intermediate representation for other planning modalities, such as extracting grasp targets from human video demonstrations, paving the way for more generalizable and scalable garment manipulation.
title_zh: 基于置信度感知稠密对应与视觉触觉可供性的反应式空中衣物操作
abstract_zh: 衣物操作具有挑战性，因为衣物构型复杂多变且经常发生自遮挡。尽管先前系统通常依赖将衣物展平，人类却经常能在高度褶皱和悬空状态下识别关键点。我们提出一种新颖的、任务无关的视觉触觉框架，可直接处理褶皱衣物——包括此前尚未涉及的空中构型。我们的方法将全局视觉感知与局部触觉反馈相结合，以实现稳健的反应式操作。我们在自定义仿真数据集上使用一种分布损失训练稠密视觉描述子，该损失能够捕捉布料对称性并生成对应关系置信度估计。这些估计引导一个反应式状态机，根据感知不确定性在折叠策略之间动态选择。与此同时，我们使用高分辨率触觉反馈监督抓取成功，训练视觉触觉抓取可供性网络。同一个触觉分类器在执行过程中用于实时抓取验证。这些组件共同构成了一个用于空中衣物操作的反应式、任务无关框架，涵盖折叠和悬挂任务。此外，我们的稠密描述子可作为其他规划模态的通用中间表示，例如从人类视频演示中提取抓取目标，为更具泛化性和可扩展性的衣物操作铺平道路。

title: World In-Context Learning for Agentic Robot Manipulation
abstract: Trained action policies write manipulation skill into network weights, tying what is learned to the distribution it is learned from. In-context learning (ICL) avoids this coupling but has not matched trained policies, because a demonstration recorded in another scene carries no feedback from the world the robot currently faces. We observe that what an agent learns in context is semantic, recording task steps and object roles rather than visual appearance, so experience gathered in one world transfers to another. Based on this insight, we propose World In-Context Learning (WICL), a paradigm in which a frozen model starts from a demonstration, rehearses the task in a world such as a simulator, and writes the feedback into its context rather than its weights. We build RoboScript, a modular infrastructure that implements WICL for agentic manipulation. From a single demonstration, RoboScript learns each task through rehearsal in simulation, freezes the learned knowledge as a Task Memory, and deploys the frozen memory on new scenes with data isolation that ensures every deployment input is available on a real robot. On all 50 tasks of RoboTwin 2.0, RoboScript reaches 83.4% mean success across clean and randomized settings with one demonstration per task and no gradient updates, exceeding the strongest trained action policy by over 20 points. The method generalizes across visual distributions, improves through reflection, scales with the foundation model, and transfers to a physical dual-arm robot through cross-embodiment memory adaptation. With a world in the loop, a robot can learn a manipulation task in its context as well as it learns one in its weights. All code is available at https://github.com/ArcheOne-AI/RoboScript
title_zh: 面向智能体机器人操作的世界上下文学习
abstract_zh: 训练得到的动作策略将操作技能写入网络权重，从而把所学内容与其学习来源的分布绑定在一起。上下文学习（ICL）避免了这种耦合，但尚未达到训练策略的水平，因为在另一场景中记录的演示不包含机器人当前所处世界的反馈。我们观察到，智能体在上下文中学习到的是语义信息，记录的是任务步骤和物体角色而非视觉外观，因此在一个世界中积累的经验可以迁移到另一个世界。基于这一洞见，我们提出世界上下文学习（WICL）：在这一范式中，一个冻结模型从演示出发，在仿真器等世界环境中排练任务，并将反馈写入其上下文而非权重。我们构建了 RoboScript，一个为智能体操作实现 WICL 的模块化基础设施。仅凭单次演示，RoboScript 就能通过仿真排练学习每个任务，将学到的知识冻结为任务记忆（Task Memory），并通过数据隔离在新场景中部署该冻结记忆，确保每个部署输入都能在真实机器人上获得。在 RoboTwin 2.0 的全部 50 个任务上，RoboScript 在每个任务仅需一次演示且无梯度更新的情况下，在干净和随机化设置中达到 83.4% 的平均成功率，比最强的训练动作策略高出 20 多个百分点。该方法可跨视觉分布泛化，通过反思得到改进，随基础模型规模扩展而提升，并通过跨具身记忆适配迁移到实体双臂机器人。将世界纳入循环后，机器人可以在上下文中学习操作任务，效果与在权重中学习一样好。所有代码均可在 https://github.com/ArcheOne-AI/RoboScript 获取。

title: CARE-PO: Controllable Tool-Call Efficiency for LLM Agents
abstract: External tool calls are a major running cost of an LLM agent, while its training objectives align almost exclusively with task completion. In a step-level diagnosis of Qwen3.5 trajectories at two model sizes on GAIA, a long-horizon tool-use benchmark, we find that most contain removable calls, at a similar rate at both sizes. Some methods add an efficiency reward to the objective to reduce the call count, but introduce problems of their own: the anchor they price calls against is computed from the policy's own rollouts (e.g., the group's shortest correct rollout) and so moves with the policy; training can drift toward a collapsed policy that issues no tool call at all, a degeneracy seen in published reports and in our 27B baseline; and a training run delivers a single operating point, so the user cannot trade efficiency against capability. We present CARE-PO (Controllable Anchored Relative Efficiency Policy Optimization) to mitigate these problems. The efficiency reward prices calls against a reference budget anchored to the task's own difficulty and fixed before training. Injecting a successful trajectory from the training data into each online GRPO rollout group and charging for evidence a trajectory never gathers ease the drift toward a collapsed call count. Shaping the cost curve by an effort tag in the prompt yields an efficiency and a capability operating point from a single training run. On GAIA, five of the six operating points across three model sizes improve on their base model in success rate and call count at once. On four held-out multi-hop benchmarks the result is size-dependent: at 27B and 4B success rate is held or raised at a lower call count, while at 9B both operating points trade success rate for fewer calls. The call count remains well above zero throughout training at all three sizes.
title_zh: CARE-PO：面向 LLM 智能体的可控工具调用效率
abstract_zh: 外部工具调用是 LLM 智能体的主要运行成本，而其训练目标几乎只与任务完成对齐。在长时程工具使用基准 GAIA 上，我们对两种模型规模的 Qwen3.5 轨迹进行了步骤级诊断，发现大多数轨迹都包含可移除的调用，且两种规模下的比例相近。一些方法在目标中加入效率奖励以减少调用次数，但也带来了自身的问题：它们为调用定价所依据的锚点由策略自身的 rollout 计算得到（例如组内最短的正确 rollout），因此会随策略变化而移动；训练可能漂向一种完全不发出工具调用的坍缩策略，这种退化现象已在已发表报告和我们 27B 基线中出现；并且一次训练运行只提供一个工作点，用户无法在效率与能力之间权衡。我们提出 CARE-PO（Controllable Anchored Relative Efficiency Policy Optimization，可控锚定相对效率策略优化）以缓解这些问题。该效率奖励依据一个参考预算为调用定价，该预算锚定任务自身难度，并在训练前固定。将训练数据中的一条成功轨迹注入每个在线 GRPO rollout 组，并对轨迹从未收集到的证据进行计费，可缓解调用次数向坍缩方向漂移。通过提示词中的努力标签（effort tag）塑造成本曲线，可从一次训练运行中获得一个效率工作点和一个能力工作点。在 GAIA 上，三种模型规模下的六个工作点中有五个同时提升了相对于基础模型的成功率和调用次数表现。在四个留出的多跳基准上，结果取决于模型规模：在 27B 和 4B 规模下，成功率在更低调用次数下保持或提升；而在 9B 规模下，两个工作点都以成功率换取更少调用。在三种规模下，调用次数在整个训练过程中始终远高于零。

title: SPARK: Simple Post-training for Adapting pRetrained Knowledge to Robot Control
abstract: Large-scale representation learning has produced public foundation models that provide strong general-purpose visual features. However, their pretraining objectives are not designed for robot representation learning, so the resulting embeddings tend to emphasize global semantics rather than the temporally sensitive representations required for robot control. Training robot models from scratch is also undesirable due to the limited scale and high collection cost of robotics data, as well as the substantial computational burden of pre-training. In this paper, we propose SPARK (Simple Post-training for Adapting pRetrained Knowledge), a post-training method that adapts foundation models to robot control. SPARK is built on two principles: temporal abstraction, which encourages the encoder to derive compact features that preserve information essential for understanding temporal changes and action-relevant scene structure, and knowledge preservation, which aligns patch-level representations with those of the original foundation model to retain useful pretrained semantics. These objectives yield compact visual state representations that remain semantically meaningful while preserving useful prior knowledge. Experiments across multiple robotics benchmarks show that SPARK consistently improves success rates and generalization over vanilla foundation models, and further demonstrate that these gains transfer to real-world robot manipulation.
title_zh: SPARK：将预训练知识适配到机器人控制的简单后训练方法
abstract_zh: 大规模表征学习已经产生了公开基础模型，这些模型提供了强大的通用视觉特征。然而，它们的预训练目标并非为机器人表征学习而设计，因此所得嵌入往往强调全局语义，而非机器人控制所需的时间敏感表征。从头训练机器人模型同样不可取，因为机器人数据规模有限、采集成本高，而且预训练的计算负担很大。本文提出 SPARK（Simple Post-training for Adapting pRetrained Knowledge），一种将基础模型适配到机器人控制的后训练方法。SPARK 建立在两条原则之上：时间抽象，鼓励编码器提取紧凑特征，保留理解时间变化和动作相关场景结构所必需的信息；以及知识保持，将 patch 级表征与原始基础模型的表征对齐，以保留有用的预训练语义。这些目标产生紧凑的视觉状态表征，既保持语义意义，又保留有用的先验知识。在多个机器人基准上的实验表明，SPARK 相比原始基础模型持续提升成功率和泛化能力，并进一步证明这些收益可迁移到真实世界机器人操作中。

title: HINT-VLM: Humanoid Interactive Navigation over Rough Terrain with Embodiment-Grounded Vision-Language Model
abstract: Humanoid robots have achieved significant progress in locomotion and manipulation, enabling traversal over rough terrain and richer interaction with the environment, such as moving obstacles. However, most traditional navigation methods assume non-interactive environments and focus only on traversal. While Navigation Among Movable Obstacles (NAMO) approaches relax this assumption, prior efforts have largely focused on flat environments and reactive interaction, rather than predicting object movability and planning ahead. These limitations become critical in outdoor rough-terrain scenarios, where robots must jointly reason about terrain traversability and object movability. In this work, we address NAMO for humanoid robots in cluttered outdoor rough terrain by proposing a hybrid planning framework that combines semantic priors from a Vision-Language Model (VLM) with embodied robot interaction data through a Gaussian process (GP) residual model. The GP corrects the VLM-derived movability prior to produce embodiment-grounded probabilistic movability estimates, which are then incorporated into hierarchical uncertainty-aware planning. The proposed approach allows humanoids to jointly leverage locomotion and manipulation for efficient and safe navigation, representing the first solution to NAMO in rough terrain through predictive movability reasoning and probabilistic VLM integration.
title_zh: HINT-VLM：基于具身锚定视觉语言模型的人形机器人崎岖地形交互式导航
abstract_zh: 人形机器人在运动与操作方面已取得显著进展，能够穿越崎岖地形，并与环境进行更丰富的交互，例如移动障碍物。然而，大多数传统导航方法假设环境不可交互，且仅关注通行。可移动障碍物间导航（NAMO）方法虽放宽了这一假设，但以往工作大多集中于平坦环境和反应式交互，而非预测物体可移动性并提前规划。这些局限在户外崎岖地形场景中尤为关键，因为机器人必须联合推理地形可通行性和物体可移动性。本文针对杂乱户外崎岖地形中的 NAMO 问题，提出一种混合规划框架，通过高斯过程（GP）残差模型将视觉语言模型（VLM）的语义先验与机器人具身交互数据相结合。GP 对由 VLM 得出的可移动性先验进行校正，产生具身锚定的概率化可移动性估计，并将其纳入分层不确定性感知规划。所提方法使机器人能够联合利用运动与操作实现高效、安全的导航，是通过预测式可移动性推理和概率化 VLM 集成解决崎岖地形 NAMO 问题的首个方案。

title: reComposer: Editable Planning for Controllable Image Generation
abstract: Prompt-based image generation makes it easy to produce visual assets, but offers little support for engaging with the creative process. Prompting collapses interdependent creative decisions into a monolithic instruction and returns a finished image, leaving control limited to revising the prompt or correcting the model's output. We present reComposer, a process-oriented image-generation interface built around editable planning, which decomposes users' evolving intent into meaningful creative decisions - such as subject, composition, or palette - and collaborates with users to explore underspecified goals and alternatives. reComposer supports conversational and direct manipulation of the plan, moving between concept-level intent and visual-level control. We evaluated reComposer with 8 design and non-design professionals. Compared to prompting, participants felt greater control and ownership while developing visual assets, exploring alternatives, and iterating on details. Our findings suggest how shifting generative AI interaction from specifying outputs to shaping process can support creative thinking alongside asset production.
title_zh: reComposer：面向可控图像生成的可编辑规划
abstract_zh: 基于提示词的图像生成使视觉素材的制作变得容易，但几乎无法支持用户参与创作过程。提示词将相互依存的创作决策压缩为单一的整体化指令，并返回一张成品图像，使用户的控制仅限于修改提示词或纠正模型输出。我们提出 reComposer，一种以可编辑规划为核心、面向过程的图像生成界面。它将用户不断演化的意图分解为有意义的创作决策——例如主体、构图或配色——并与用户协作探索尚未充分明确的目标和备选方案。reComposer 支持对规划进行对话式和直接操作，在概念层意图与视觉层控制之间切换。我们邀请了 8 位设计与非设计领域的专业人士对 reComposer 进行评估。与提示词方式相比，参与者在开发视觉素材、探索备选方案和迭代细节时感受到更强的控制感和主导感。我们的研究结果表明，将生成式 AI 交互从指定输出转向塑造过程，能够在素材生产的同时支持创造性思维。

title: Learning to Act with World Models by Valuing What Comes Next
abstract: A sparse terminal reward tells an agent little about its steps. Much of the missing information is implicit in the environment's dynamics, because each state transition can change the conditions for success long before the reward arrives. A world model trained on real transitions can learn to predict what each action changes, but a predicted observation does not by itself show whether success has become more likely. With a binary terminal reward, PPO's critic makes this judgment by estimating the current policy's probability of success, but only for states the agent reaches. Our method, WM-PPO, elegantly brings the two together. For each action the policy samples, executed or not, the world model predicts the next observation and the critic values the predicted successor. In the policy channel, comparisons among these values give the policy auxiliary advantages; in the value channel, their mean gives the critic an auxiliary target. A shared gate weights both channels according to how reliably comparisons with similar margins predicted real outcomes earlier in training. The policy, critic and world model all learn from the agent's own interaction, with no teacher or privileged information, and only the policy is used at inference. With a comparable number of real environment steps, WM-PPO raises success from PPO's 63.5% to 87.5% on ALFWorld and from 39.3% to 52.9% on ScienceWorld. It matches the strongest PPO refinements we tested on ALFWorld and exceeds the best of them by 6.5 points on ScienceWorld. The trained policy more often completes prerequisite steps before placing an object or committing to an answer.
title_zh: 借助世界模型学习行动：为后续状态估值
abstract_zh: 稀疏的终止奖励几乎不能告诉智能体其各个步骤的表现如何。大量缺失信息隐含在环境动力学中，因为每次状态转移都可能在奖励到来之前很久就改变成功条件。在真实状态转移上训练的世界模型可以学习预测每个动作改变了什么，但仅凭预测观测本身无法表明成功是否变得更可能。在二值终止奖励下，PPO 的 critic 通过估计当前策略的成功概率来作出这一判断，但仅限于智能体实际到达的状态。我们的方法 WM-PPO 将二者结合起来。对于策略采样得到的每个动作，无论是否被执行，世界模型都会预测下一观测，critic 则对预测出的后继状态进行估值。在策略通道中，这些估值之间的比较为策略提供辅助优势；在价值通道中，它们的均值则为 critic 提供辅助目标。一个共享门控根据训练早期具有相似间隔的比较在多大程度上可靠地预测了真实结果，对两个通道进行加权。策略、critic 和世界模型都从智能体自身的交互中学习，无需教师或特权信息，推理时仅使用策略。在真实环境步数相当的情况下，WM-PPO 将 ALFWorld 上的成功率从 PPO 的 63.5% 提升至 87.5%，将 ScienceWorld 上的成功率从 39.3% 提升至 52.9%。在 ALFWorld 上，它达到与我们测试过的最强 PPO 改进方法相当的水平；在 ScienceWorld 上，则比其中最佳方法高出 6.5 个百分点。训练后的策略更常在放置物体或提交答案之前完成前置步骤。

title: HyInv Technical Report
abstract: Inverse folding designs amino-acid sequences for a given protein backbone, and screening needs many candidates that are both diverse and well folded. We present HyInv, a 1.96-million-parameter backbone-conditioned graph network with an encoder-decoder architecture, trained by Hyra 2.0, the research agent developed by our team: pretrained with random-order autoregressive sequence modeling, followed by structure-reward reinforcement learning. At inference, a grouped draft-and-rewrite sampler that uses separate draft and rewrite temperatures improves refolding TM-score at matched diversity. An optimized implementation with BF16 numerics designs 128 sequences for a 402-residue backbone in 50.6 ms on a single NVIDIA H20 GPU, about 52 times faster than the reference sampler, and an exact FP32 path that returns the reference sequences is 8.7 times faster. Across five benchmark datasets and seven dataset-predictor combinations, HyInv reaches a higher average scTM than all ten external baselines at comparable or higher sequence diversity, with large margins over ProteinMPNN and ProteinZero V2. The same default setting supports de novo backbones, pocket-constrained libraries, enzyme redesign with the catalytic site kept, and loop redesign. We have released our code and model at https://github.com/Tencent-Hunyuan/Hyra-results/tree/main/AI4Science/hyinv.
title_zh: HyInv 技术报告
abstract_zh: 逆折叠旨在为给定蛋白质骨架设计氨基酸序列，而筛选需要大量既多样又折叠良好的候选序列。我们提出 HyInv，一个具有 196 万参数的骨架条件图网络，采用编码器-解码器架构，由我们团队开发的研究智能体 Hyra 2.0 训练：先通过随机顺序自回归序列建模进行预训练，再进行结构奖励强化学习。在推理阶段，一种使用独立起草温度和重写温度的分组起草-重写采样器，在多样性匹配的情况下提升重折叠 TM-score。采用 BF16 数值精度的优化实现可在单块 NVIDIA H20 GPU 上于 50.6 ms 内为 402 个残基的骨架设计 128 条序列，比参考采样器快约 52 倍；而能返回参考序列的精确 FP32 路径则快 8.7 倍。在五个基准数据集和七种数据集-预测器组合上，HyInv 在序列多样性相当或更高时，平均 scTM 高于全部十个外部基线，并大幅领先 ProteinMPNN 和 ProteinZero V2。相同的默认设置支持 de novo 骨架、口袋约束文库、保留催化位点的酶重设计以及环区重设计。我们已在 https://github.com/Tencent-Hunyuan/Hyra-results/tree/main/AI4Science/hyinv 发布代码和模型。

title: AnyBreak: Towards Jailbreaking Any T2I Model for Any Concept
abstract: Text-to-image (T2I) models have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in image generation and editing, yet this progress has also introduced significant security risks. Prior work has shown that adversarial prompt can induce the generation of Not-Safe-For-Work (NSFW) content, including pornographic, violent, and graphic imagery. However, such attacks are typically mitigated by prompt filters and often rely on white-box assumptions. In this paper, we propose AnyBreak, a novel jailbreak framework that constructs adversarial images via multi-scale progressive semantic alignment. During the generation process, these adversarial images steer the generation trajectory in latent space towards unsafe data manifolds, enabling cross-modal transfer of malicious concepts from the text modality to the image modality. AnyBreak operates using only clean textual prompts and adversarial images at inference time, and can jailbreak any T2I models towards any malicious concepts in a fully black-box setting. We further introduce AnyBreak-V, an enhanced variant that incorporates a compensation term to bypass post-hoc safety checkers. Extensive experiments demonstrate that AnyBreak achieves high attack success rates while preserving visual fidelity and semantic consistency with the input prompts under black-box and clean-text constraints. Our findings reveal that existing T2I defense leave critical cross-modal attack surfaces insufficiently addressed. The code is available at https://github.com/luqi-glory/AnyBreak.
comment: Accepted for poster presentation at ICME 2026
title_zh: AnyBreak：面向任意概念越狱任意 T2I 模型
abstract_zh: 文本到图像（T2I）模型在图像生成与编辑方面展现出卓越能力，但这一进展也带来了显著的安全风险。已有研究表明，对抗性提示词可诱导生成不适合工作场所（NSFW）的内容，包括色情、暴力和露骨图像。然而，此类攻击通常会被提示词过滤器缓解，且往往依赖白盒假设。本文提出 AnyBreak，一种新颖的越狱框架，通过多尺度渐进语义对齐构建对抗图像。在生成过程中，这些对抗图像会在潜空间中将生成轨迹引向不安全数据流形，从而实现恶意概念从文本模态到图像模态的跨模态迁移。AnyBreak 在推理时仅使用干净的文本提示词和对抗图像，并能在完全黑盒设置下，对任意 T2I 模型实现面向任意恶意概念的越狱。我们进一步提出 AnyBreak-V，一种增强变体，引入补偿项以绕过事后安全检查器。大量实验表明，在黑盒和干净文本约束下，AnyBreak 在保持视觉保真度以及与输入提示词语义一致性的同时，实现了高攻击成功率。我们的发现揭示了现有 T2I 防御未能充分处理关键的跨模态攻击面。代码见 https://github.com/luqi-glory/AnyBreak。

title: Fade to... Red? Scheduling Coloured Noise Exploration Supports Efficient Robot Learning with Reduced Movement Jerk
abstract: Exploration in deep reinforcement learning (RL) for continuous control is commonly driven by temporally uncorrelated Gaussian (white) action noise, which leads to jerky motions with locally constrained exploration. In contrast, temporally correlated coloured noise, particularly pink noise, has been shown to support more efficient exploration in RL. Motivated by these findings, we inquire whether scheduling changes to the noise colour over the course of training can outperform white noise for continuous control robotics. We perform a systematic study of 49 linear schedules between white and red noise, together with generalised state-dependent exploration (gSDE), on four sparse-reward manipulation tasks with a Fetch arm and a Shadow Dexterous Hand. We find that the noise colour at the end of training does not affect learning efficiency or end performance, whereas fading towards red noise halves the jerk of exploration in every task. Balancing learning efficiency, end performance and smoothness, red noise emerges as the preferred strategy: it learns as efficiently as pink noise with almost 2-fold less movement jerk. We therefore recommend exploration schedulers that fade towards red noise as the default for off-policy robot learning.
comment: 10 pages, 4 figures, 1 table. Accepted at the ACRA 2026 conference. Cite as: "López, F. M., and Cruz, F. (2026). Fade to... Red? Scheduling Coloured Noise Explo
title_zh: 渐变为……红色？有色噪声探索调度可助力高效机器人学习并降低运动加加速度
abstract_zh: 在连续控制的深度强化学习（RL）中，探索通常由时间上不相关的高斯（白）动作噪声驱动，这会导致运动出现抖动，并使探索局限于局部。相比之下，时间上相关的有色噪声，尤其是粉红噪声，已被证明能在 RL 中支持更高效的探索。受这些发现启发，我们探究在训练过程中对噪声颜色变化进行调度，是否能在连续控制机器人任务中优于白噪声。我们在使用 Fetch 机械臂和 Shadow Dexterous Hand 的四个稀疏奖励操作任务上，系统研究了白噪声与红噪声之间的 49 种线性调度，以及广义状态相关探索（gSDE）。我们发现，训练结束时的噪声颜色不会影响学习效率或最终性能，而逐渐过渡到红噪声可使每个任务中探索过程的加加速度减半。在平衡学习效率、最终性能和运动平滑性后，红噪声成为首选策略：其学习效率与粉红噪声相当，而运动加加速度减少近一半。因此，我们建议将渐变为红噪声的探索调度器作为离策略机器人学习的默认选择。

title: BECON: Belief-Conditioned Constrained Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning under Drifting Preferences and Budgets
abstract: Constrained preference-conditioned MORL typically assumes full task observability, treating preferences and safety budgets as stationary task signals. In real-world deployment, however, these signals are often unreliable proxies: intent may drift, safety tolerances may shift with context, and exposed descriptors may be noisy, delayed, or incomplete. We therefore formulate constrained preference-conditioned MORL as a partially observed task-specification problem, where the agent must navigate a fundamental conflict between unreliable external signals and latent interaction dynamics. We propose BECON, a belief-conditioned framework for constrained MORL with drifting preferences and budgets, which infers latent task context from recent histories to estimate preferences and safety budgets. These estimates are fused with the exposed task signal via uncertainty-dependent gates, enabling the policy to defer to observations under high epistemic uncertainty while correcting them when history is informative. The fused context jointly conditions preference optimization and context-adaptive constraint enforcement. Experiments on diverse multi-objective control tasks demonstrate that BECON consistently improves over state-of-the-art MORL baselines, achieving stronger robustness and constraint satisfaction under task drift.
title_zh: BECON：偏好与预算漂移下的信念条件约束多目标强化学习
abstract_zh: 约束型偏好条件 MORL 通常假设任务完全可观测，并将偏好和安全预算视为平稳的任务信号。然而，在真实部署中，这些信号往往只是不可靠的代理量：意图可能漂移，安全容忍度会随上下文变化，暴露出的描述符可能有噪声、延迟或不完整。因此，我们将约束型偏好条件 MORL 形式化为一个部分可观测的任务规范问题，其中智能体必须在不可靠的外部信号与潜在交互动态之间的根本冲突中做出决策。我们提出 BECON，一个面向偏好与预算漂移的约束 MORL 信念条件框架，它从近期历史中推断潜在任务上下文，以估计偏好和安全预算。这些估计通过不确定性相关门控与暴露的任务信号融合，使策略在高认知不确定性下能够服从观测，而在历史信息充分时对观测进行修正。融合后的上下文共同条件化偏好优化与上下文自适应约束执行。在多种多目标控制任务上的实验表明，BECON 持续优于最先进的 MORL 基线，在任务漂移下实现更强的鲁棒性和约束满足。

title: Flip Anything with Agentic Robotics Self-Learning
abstract: Flipping is a fundamental robotic manipulation skill that requires reorienting a target object in a stable pose on a planar support surface by rotating it 180^ about an axis parallel to the support surface -- think of flipping a coin from heads to tails. Although flipping is a common objective in industrial tasks such as parts inspection, mechanical assembly, and tool use, coding a bimanual robot with grippers to flip diverse objects is a significant challenge. In this paper, we show that a coding agent can autonomously develop and refine object-flipping strategies through iterative learning in physics simulations across diverse object geometries. Progressive skill acquisition, from basic handover to toppling and pushing, robust grasping and sensing, and thin-object manipulation with recovery, improves task success from 24.7% to 95.0%. The resulting graph-based code integrates high-level strategy selection with reactive control, enabling multi-stage flipping on physical robots.
title_zh: Flip Anything：智能体式机器人自学习的任意物体翻转
abstract_zh: 翻转是一项基础机器人操作技能，要求通过绕平行于平面支撑面的轴将目标物体旋转 180°，使其以稳定姿态重新定向在支撑面上——可以想象把一枚硬币从正面翻到反面。尽管翻转是零件检测、机械装配和工具使用等工业任务中的常见目标，但为配备夹爪的双臂机器人编写程序以翻转各种不同物体仍是一项重大挑战。本文表明，编码智能体可以通过在物理模拟中对多种物体几何形状进行迭代学习，自主开发并改进物体翻转策略。渐进式技能获取——从基础交接，到倾倒与推动、稳健抓取与感知，再到带恢复机制的薄物体操作——将任务成功率从 24.7% 提升至 95.0%。最终得到的基于图的代码将高层策略选择与反应式控制相结合，使物理机器人能够执行多阶段翻转。

title: Disagreement-Aware Distribution Matching Distillation for Few-Step Diffusion Models
abstract: Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD) enables strong few-step diffusion generation by matching the student distribution to a pretrained teacher. Existing improvements to DMD often augment its supervision or modify its optimization machinery. We ask a complementary question: can DMD diagnose its own updates using signals already produced during training? DMD inherently computes the discrepancy between a pretrained teacher and a fake model tracking the student distribution, but conventionally uses it primarily to determine the distribution matching direction. We find that the magnitude of this teacher--fake disagreement provides additional diagnostic information. Across extensive experiments, large disagreement in the high-noise regime consistently coincides with substantially higher-energy DMD updates. This reveals a dual role of disagreement: it determines not only where the student should move, but also provides an intrinsic signal of how aggressively the update should be applied. Based on this observation, we introduce Disagreement-Aware Distribution Matching Distillation (DA-DMD), which activates only in the high-noise regime and continuously modulates the update strength according to teacher--fake disagreement. DA-DMD reuses quantities already available during DMD training and requires no additional model, evaluator, or inference-time modification. We show that it exactly recovers vanilla DMD outside the selected region, reduces update energy only through selected samples, and exhibits redescending influence under extreme disagreement. Across multiple diffusion backbones, DA-DMD consistently improves few-step generation at the same inference cost. On SD3.5-L, DA-DMD improves HPSv2 from 28.23 to 30.93, while achieving a 64.4\% average win rate over DMD2.
title_zh: 面向少步扩散模型的分歧感知分布匹配蒸馏
abstract_zh: 分布匹配蒸馏（Distribution Matching Distillation，DMD）通过将学生分布与预训练教师模型匹配，实现强大的少步扩散生成。现有对 DMD 的改进通常增强其监督信号或修改其优化机制。我们提出一个互补的问题：DMD 能否利用训练期间已经产生的信号来诊断自身的更新？DMD 本质上会计算预训练教师模型与跟踪学生分布的 fake 模型之间的差异，但传统上主要用它来确定分布匹配方向。我们发现，这种 teacher–fake 分歧的幅度提供了额外的诊断信息。在大量实验中，高噪声区间内的大分歧始终与能量显著更高的 DMD 更新同时出现。这揭示了分歧的双重作用：它不仅决定学生应向何处移动，还提供了一种内在信号，表明应以多强的力度施加更新。基于这一观察，我们提出分歧感知分布匹配蒸馏（Disagreement-Aware Distribution Matching Distillation，DA-DMD），它仅在高噪声区间激活，并根据 teacher–fake 分歧连续调制更新强度。DA-DMD 复用了 DMD 训练期间已经可用的量，无需额外模型、评估器或推理时修改。我们表明，它在选定区域之外能够精确恢复原始 DMD，仅通过选中的样本降低更新能量，并在极端分歧下表现出重降式影响（redescending influence）。在多个扩散骨干网络上，DA-DMD 在相同推理成本下持续提升少步生成效果。在 SD3.5-L 上，DA-DMD 将 HPSv2 从 28.23 提升至 30.93，同时对 DMD2 取得 64.4% 的平均胜率。

title: Mitigating Agentic Deception via Evaluation-Side Partially Observable Games
abstract: As large language models become more capable agents, they can exhibit deceptive behaviors, cheating human for higher rewards while appearing helpful. We attribute this failure to evaluation-side partial observability, where models are evaluated mainly from final outcome, without checking the faithfulness of underlying reasoning, tool use, and environmental effects. Prior mitigations address this partial observability by predefined evaluator latent belief space or one-shot monitoring, which do not extend to free-form language space and vulnerable to stronger deceptions that evade simple monitoring. In this work, we formulate deception mitigation as an Evaluation-Side Partially Observable Extensive Form Game (e-PoG), a max-min framework in which an agent maximizes reward, a monitor minimizes the agent's payoff by exposing deception from the full interaction trajectory, and a fixed verifier validates the monitor's claims and converts them into penalties. We define the solution concept as a Subgame-Perfect Oversight Equilibrium (SPOE) between agent and monitor, and prove its existence in finite games. With a perfect verifier, every SPOE is faithful; with an imperfect verifier, the guarantee persists if verifier errors do not reverse the ranking of monitor actions. To achieve faithful SPOE, we derive a two-timescale policy gradient algorithm and enhance the pipeline empirically with NLI verification and deterministic checks. Experiments with Gemma3-4B-IT and Qwen3-4B/8B on Agentic Role-Playing, SearchQA, and WebShop show that e-PoG mitigates multiple emergent deception modes, outperforming the strongest baselines by 26.0% in deception mitigation and by up to 39.8% in task success. These gains persist under weak-to-strong supervision. Code is available at https://github.com/Toyoid/deceptive-agent.
title_zh: 通过评估侧部分可观测博弈缓解智能体欺骗
abstract_zh: 随着大语言模型成为能力更强的智能体，它们可能表现出欺骗行为：为获得更高奖励而欺骗人类，同时表现得乐于助人。我们将这一失败归因于评估侧部分可观测性，即模型主要根据最终结果接受评估，而不会检查其底层推理、工具使用和环境影响的忠实性。此前的缓解方法通过预定义的评估器潜在信念空间或一次性监控来应对这种部分可观测性，但这些方法无法扩展到自由形式的语言空间，并且容易受到能够规避简单监控的更强欺骗行为的影响。在这项工作中，我们将欺骗缓解形式化为评估侧部分可观测扩展式博弈（Evaluation-Side Partially Observable Extensive Form Game，e-PoG），这是一个 max-min 框架：智能体最大化奖励，监控器通过从完整交互轨迹中揭示欺骗来最小化智能体的收益，固定的验证器验证监控器的主张并将其转化为惩罚。我们将解概念定义为智能体与监控器之间的子博弈完美监督均衡（Subgame-Perfect Oversight Equilibrium，SPOE），并证明其在有限博弈中的存在性。在验证器完美时，每个 SPOE 都是忠实的；在验证器不完美时，只要验证器错误不会反转监控器动作的排序，该保证仍然成立。为实现忠实的 SPOE，我们推导了一个双时间尺度策略梯度算法，并通过 NLI 验证和确定性检查在实证层面增强该流程。在 Agentic Role-Playing、SearchQA 和 WebShop 上使用 Gemma3-4B-IT 与 Qwen3-4B/8B 进行的实验表明，e-PoG 缓解了多种涌现的欺骗模式，在欺骗缓解方面比最强基线高出 26.0%，在任务成功率方面最高高出 39.8%。这些增益在弱到强监督下依然存在。代码见 https://github.com/Toyoid/deceptive-agent。

title: MoSTE: Mixture of Spatio-Temporal Experts for Deepfake Detection in Videos
abstract: Generalizable deepfake video detection remains challenging because forgery artifacts vary substantially across manipulation types and often combine diverse spatial and temporal inconsistencies. Existing parameter-efficient adaptation methods typically rely on a single shared representation, rendering them prone to manipulation-specific bias and limiting transfer to unseen forgeries. To address this challenge, we propose Mixture Of Spatio-Temporal Experts (MoSTE), an adaptation framework that enables conditional specialization of forensic representations. Instead of forcing one adapter to model all forgery patterns, MoSTE decomposes adaptation into parallel spatial and temporal expert pools and dynamically routes tokens to the most relevant experts through an unsupervised token-level routing mechanism. This allows experts to naturally specialize in complementary forgery cues without requiring explicit manipulation labels or multi-stage training, while effectively transferring representations from CLIP to the video domain. Extensive experiments across cross-dataset and cross-manipulation benchmarks demonstrate that MoSTE sets a new state of the art in average generalization while preserving strong performance across diverse manipulation families. Additional analysis of expert routing and attention behavior reveals the emergence of expert diversity, suggesting that MoSTE learns complementary spatio-temporal forensic features. Code is available at https://github.com/charbelyah/MoSTE
comment: Accepted to IEEE/CVF Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision (WACV) 2027
title_zh: MoSTE：面向视频 Deepfake 检测的时空专家混合
abstract_zh: 可泛化的 Deepfake 视频检测仍然具有挑战性，因为伪造痕迹会随操纵类型显著变化，并且常常混合多种空间与时间不一致性。现有的参数高效适配方法通常依赖单一共享表示，这使其容易产生操纵类型特定的偏差，并限制向未见伪造类型的迁移。为应对这一挑战，我们提出时空专家混合（Mixture Of Spatio-Temporal Experts，MoSTE），一种能够对取证表示进行条件化特化的适配框架。MoSTE 不强迫单个适配器建模所有伪造模式，而是将适配分解为并行的空间专家池和时间专家池，并通过无监督的 token 级路由机制将 token 动态路由到最相关的专家。这使专家能够自然地专注于互补的伪造线索，而无需显式操纵标签或多阶段训练，同时有效地将 CLIP 的表示迁移到视频领域。跨数据集和跨操纵基准的大量实验表明，MoSTE 在平均泛化性上达到新的最先进水平，同时在多种操纵类别上保持强劲性能。对专家路由和注意力行为的进一步分析揭示了专家多样性的涌现，表明 MoSTE 学到了互补的时空取证特征。代码见 https://github.com/charbelyah/MoSTE

title: PhysOPSD: Code as Privilege for Physically Plausible Video Generation
abstract: While modern video generative models achieve remarkable visual fidelity, they remain noticeably brittle when generating physically plausible dynamics and complex interactions. Targeted post-training is crucial, yet supervised fine-tuning suffers from offline state mismatch, and reinforcement learning is hindered by sparse, ill-defined physical reward functions. On-Policy (Self-)Distillation (OPSD) reconciles on-policy rollouts with dense corrective feedback, shifting the core challenge to designing effective privileged context. However, conventional modalities fall short: text prompts are inherently declarative, whereas real reference videos heavily entangle physical laws with visual appearance without parametric control. To this end, we propose PhysOPSD, introducing executable code as privileged physical context for video generation. Unlike static visual observations, executable code instantiates an editable physical world with intrinsic abstraction and controllability. Powered by PhysOPSD-Engine, we translate real-world physical scenarios into verifiable simulation programs. PhysOPSD then incorporates (i) dual-level physical privilege to bridge the information gap via an intermediate bottleneck, alongside (ii) controlled physical variations under shared rollout noise to expose causal dynamic shifts. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PhysOPSD substantially improves physical plausibility across diverse backbones, outperforming SFT and RL baselines with only 3K samples, while preserving general video generation quality.
title_zh: PhysOPSD：以代码作为特权信息实现物理上合理的视频生成
abstract_zh: 尽管现代视频生成模型实现了出色的视觉保真度，但在生成物理上合理的动力学和复杂交互时，它们仍明显脆弱。有针对性的后训练至关重要，然而监督微调会受离线状态不匹配问题困扰，强化学习则受限于稀疏且定义不清的物理奖励函数。同策略（自）蒸馏（On-Policy (Self-)Distillation，OPSD）将同策略 rollout 与密集纠正反馈相协调，使核心挑战转向设计有效的特权上下文。然而，常规模态难以胜任：文本提示本质上是陈述性的，而真实参考视频会将物理规律与视觉外观严重纠缠在一起，且缺乏参数化控制。为此，我们提出 PhysOPSD，将可执行代码作为视频生成的特权物理上下文。与静态视觉观测不同，可执行代码实例化了一个可编辑的物理世界，具有内在的抽象性和可控性。借助 PhysOPSD-Engine，我们将真实世界的物理场景转化为可验证的仿真程序。随后，PhysOPSD 引入 (i) 双层物理特权，通过中间瓶颈弥合信息差距，以及 (ii) 在共享 rollout 噪声下的受控物理变化，以暴露因果动态变化。大量实验表明，PhysOPSD 在多种骨干网络上显著提升了物理合理性，仅用 3K 样本就优于 SFT 和 RL 基线，同时保持通用视频生成质量。

title: How Many Exposures Does a World Model Need? Learning Unseen Game Mechanics at Test Time
abstract: World models enable agents to plan and learn from imagined experience, but in an unfamiliar environment they must learn its mechanics from limited interaction. A mechanic is a rule for how an action or an interaction changes part of the environment. Each occurrence of a mechanic that the model observes is one exposure. We ask how many exposures a world model needs to predict the effects of a new environment's mechanics. We address this question on ARC-AGI-3, a benchmark of interactive games defined by their programs. We introduce MechEval, which labels 69 recurring mechanics across 20 games from these programs. It scores each prediction on the cells the mechanic changes at each exposure. As a test bed, we build WARC (World model for ARC-AGI-3), a 35M-parameter vision transformer that is pretrained on other games and updates all of its parameters after each transition. On held-out games, WARC learns to predict four in five mechanics with at least 80% accuracy on the cells they change and keeps that accuracy to the end of the recordings. Half of them reach that accuracy within about 80 exposures, in a single play of the game, and without updates only one in seven does at all. In closed-loop play on the public games, WARC-Agent, which pairs WARC with a fixed graph explorer, triples the explorer's official efficiency score from 0.15 to 0.46, mostly through test-time training. On the hidden games of the Kaggle leaderboard, our entry scores 0.20.
